`runtime/gamelib.c`:

```c
// Loads the recompiled game code library (runtime/gamelib.h).
#include "gamelib.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <dlfcn.h>
#endif

#include "paths.h"
#include "rt.h"

static const GameLibTables *g_tables;
static char g_error[256];

// The library's id file (<library>.id, written next to it by the build): its GAMELIB_ID, read without loading it.
static bool id_matches(const char *lib) {
    char path[1100], id[128] = {0};
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s.id", lib);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return false;
    size_t n = fread(id, 1, sizeof id - 1, f);
    fclose(f);
    while (n && (id[n - 1] == '\n' || id[n - 1] == '\r')) id[--n] = 0;
    return !strcmp(id, GAMELIB_ID);
}

static bool exists(const char *p) {
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "rb");
    if (f) fclose(f);
    return f != NULL;
}

// The places to look, in order (gamelib.h). Returns how many were filled.
static int candidates(const char *game_dir, char out[3][1100]) {
    int n = 0;
    const char *env = getenv("LARECOMP_GAME_LIB");
    if (env && *env) snprintf(out[n++], 1100, "%s", env);
    char exe_side[1024];
    if (rt_resource(GAMELIB_NAME, NULL, exe_side, sizeof exe_side) && exists(exe_side))
        snprintf(out[n++], 1100, "%s", exe_side);
    if (game_dir) snprintf(out[n++], 1100, "%s/%s", game_dir, GAMELIB_NAME);
    return n;
}

bool gamelib_present(const char *game_dir) {
    if (g_tables) return true;
    char c[3][1100];
    int n = candidates(game_dir, c);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (exists(c[i]) && id_matches(c[i])) return true;
    return false;
}

static const GameLibTables *open_lib(const char *path) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    HMODULE h = LoadLibraryA(path);
    if (!h) { snprintf(g_error, sizeof g_error, "can't load %s (error %lu)", path, GetLastError()); return NULL; }
    GameLibEntry entry = (GameLibEntry)(void *)GetProcAddress(h, GAMELIB_ENTRY);
#else
    void *h = dlopen(path, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
    if (!h) { snprintf(g_error, sizeof g_error, "%s", dlerror()); return NULL; }
    GameLibEntry entry = (GameLibEntry)dlsym(h, GAMELIB_ENTRY);
#endif
    if (!entry) { snprintf(g_error, sizeof g_error, "%s: not game code", path); return NULL; }
    const GameLibTables *t = entry();
    if (!t || t->abi != GAMELIB_ABI || !t->id || strcmp(t->id, GAMELIB_ID)) {
        snprintf(g_error, sizeof g_error, "%s was built for another version (library: abi %u id %s; this runtime: abi %u id %s)", path,
                 t ? t->abi : 0, t && t->id ? t->id : "-", (unsigned)GAMELIB_ABI, GAMELIB_ID);
        return NULL;  // (left loaded: nothing of it runs)
    }
    return t;
}

bool gamelib_load(const char *game_dir, char *why, size_t why_size) {
    static bool tried;
    if (!tried) {
        tried = true;
        snprintf(g_error, sizeof g_error, "the game code hasn't been built: set up the game files on the start screen");
        char c[3][1100];
        int n = candidates(game_dir, c);
        const char *env = getenv("LARECOMP_GAME_LIB");
        for (int i = 0; i < n && !g_tables; i++) {
            bool given = i == 0 && env && *env;  // LARECOMP_GAME_LIB: loaded as given, the library's own id decides
            if (!exists(c[i])) {
                if (given) { snprintf(g_error, sizeof g_error, "LARECOMP_GAME_LIB: no file %s", c[i]); break; }
                continue;
            }
            if (!given && !id_matches(c[i])) {
                snprintf(g_error, sizeof g_error, "%s was built for another version", c[i]);
                continue;
            }
            g_tables = open_lib(c[i]);
            if (!g_tables) LOG("[gamelib] %s\n", g_error);
            // (the library asked for by name doesn't load: stop there. Falling back to the next candidate ran another
            // game's code - Eevee's build/lasgame.dll with Pikachu's files - and crashed far from the cause)
            if (!g_tables && given) break;
            if (g_tables)
                for (uint32_t m = 0; m < g_tables->nmods; m++)
                    LOG("[gamelib] %s: %s, %llu functions\n", c[i], g_tables->mods[m].name,
                        (unsigned long long)*g_tables->mods[m].count);
        }
    }
    if (!g_tables && why) snprintf(why, why_size, "%s", g_error);
    return g_tables != NULL;
}

const GameLibTables *gamelib_tables(void) { return g_tables; }

```

`runtime/gamelib.h`:

```h
// The recompiled game code: a library built from the player's own game files (`make gen` + `make` in a source
// checkout, the start screen's setup otherwise; runtime/gamebuild.c) and loaded at startup (runtime/gamelib.c).
// Nothing from the game ships with the app.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include "cpu.h"

#if defined(_WIN32)
#define GAMELIB_NAME "lasgame.dll"
#define GAMELIB_EXPORT __declspec(dllexport)
#elif defined(__APPLE__)
#define GAMELIB_NAME "lasgame.dylib"
#define GAMELIB_EXPORT __attribute__((visibility("default")))
#else
#define GAMELIB_NAME "lasgame.so"
#define GAMELIB_EXPORT __attribute__((visibility("default")))
#endif

// GAMELIB_ID (-D, from the Makefile): a hash of the generator and the headers the game code is compiled against. A
// library built with another one is rebuilt, not loaded.
#ifndef GAMELIB_ID
#define GAMELIB_ID "dev"
#endif
#define GAMELIB_ABI 3  // (3: FN_ENTER calls the function hooks, runtime/fnhook.c)
#define GAMELIB_MAX_MODULES 4

// One table per recompiled module, in load order (main, sdk, subsdk0, subsdk1: runtime/loader.c).
typedef struct {
    const char *name;
    const uint64_t *addrs;  // sorted guest addresses
    const GuestFn *fns;     // the functions at them
    const uint64_t *count;
} GameLibModule;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t abi;    // GAMELIB_ABI
    const char *id;  // GAMELIB_ID
    uint32_t nmods;
    GameLibModule mods[GAMELIB_MAX_MODULES];
} GameLibTables;

// The library's one exported function (tools/gamelib_entry.c).
typedef const GameLibTables *(*GameLibEntry)(void);
#define GAMELIB_ENTRY "lasgame_tables"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

// Loads the game code for the game files in game_dir (once; later calls return the first result). Looks at
// LARECOMP_GAME_LIB, next to the executable (a source checkout's build/), then game_dir. false: why says what's wrong.
bool gamelib_load(const char *game_dir, char *why, size_t why_size);
// The tables of the loaded library (NULL before gamelib_load succeeds).
const GameLibTables *gamelib_tables(void);
// True when a library usable with this build is in one of those places (without loading it).
bool gamelib_present(const char *game_dir);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

`runtime/gamesetup.c`:

```c
// Game file setup (runtime/gamesetup.h). The picked folder is searched a few levels deep (dump tools nest the files):
// exefs/ is the folder with main and main.npdm, the RomFS either a romfs.bin image or the folder with bin/message.
// exefs/ is copied into <data root>/extracted (hard links where the file system allows), the RomFS image is copied
// or built (runtime/romfs_build.c), then the game code is recompiled from exefs/ (runtime/gamebuild.c).
#include "gamesetup.h"

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <ctype.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>

#include "gamebuild.h"
#include "gamelib.h"
#include "hle.h"
#include "paths.h"
#include "platform.h"
#include "romfs_build.h"

#define ROOT "extracted"  // (in the data root, the working directory)
// The two games (program ids, main.npdm's ACI0), any version. The 60 fps and wild battles options and the generator's
// instruction patches are addresses in the main: only the builds with address tables get them (game_build).
#define TITLE_EEVEE 0x0100187003A36000ull
#define TITLE_PIKACHU 0x010003F003A34000ull
static const uint8_t EEVEE_100[8] = {0x0a, 0x3f, 0x0d, 0x21, 0xe6, 0x7d, 0xad, 0x80};    // Let's Go, Eevee! v1.0.0 main
static const uint8_t PIKACHU_100[8] = {0x1c, 0x37, 0x56, 0x92, 0xde, 0x4f, 0x4b, 0x87};  // Let's Go, Pikachu! v1.0.0

static _Atomic int g_state;
static _Atomic float g_progress;
static _Atomic bool g_running;
static char g_folder[1024];

int setup_state(void) { return g_state; }
float setup_progress(void) { return g_progress; }
bool setup_running(void) { return g_running; }

static bool is_dir(const char *p) {
    struct stat st;
    return stat(p, &st) == 0 && S_ISDIR(st.st_mode);
}
static bool is_file(const char *p) {
    struct stat st;
    return stat(p, &st) == 0 && S_ISREG(st.st_mode);
}

static uint64_t program_id(const char *exefs) {
    char p[1100];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/main.npdm", exefs);
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "rb");
    if (!f) return 0;
    uint64_t id = 0;
    uint8_t meta[0x80], aci[0x18];  // ACI0 (offset at META+0x70): the program id at +0x10
    if (fread(meta, 1, sizeof meta, f) == sizeof meta && !memcmp(meta, "META", 4) &&
        !fseek(f, *(uint32_t *)(meta + 0x70), SEEK_SET) && fread(aci, 1, sizeof aci, f) == sizeof aci &&
        !memcmp(aci, "ACI0", 4))
        id = *(uint64_t *)(aci + 0x10);
    fclose(f);
    return id;
}

static bool game_ok(const char *exefs) {
    uint64_t id = program_id(exefs);
    return id == TITLE_EEVEE || id == TITLE_PIKACHU;
}

int game_build(const char *exefs) {
    char p[1100];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/main", exefs);
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "rb");
    if (!f) return GAME_BUILD_OTHER;
    uint8_t id[8] = {0};
    fseek(f, 0x40, SEEK_SET);  // (NSO header: the module id)
    size_t n = fread(id, 1, 8, f);
    fclose(f);
    uint64_t pid = program_id(exefs);
    if (n == 8 && !memcmp(id, EEVEE_100, 8) && pid == TITLE_EEVEE) return GAME_BUILD_EEVEE_100;
    if (n == 8 && !memcmp(id, PIKACHU_100, 8) && pid == TITLE_PIKACHU) return GAME_BUILD_PIKACHU_100;
    return GAME_BUILD_OTHER;
}

const char *game_version(const char *exefs) {
    static const struct { uint8_t id[8]; const char *v; } k[] = {
        {{0x0a, 0x3f, 0x0d, 0x21, 0xe6, 0x7d, 0xad, 0x80}, "1.0.0"},  // Eevee
        {{0x1c, 0x37, 0x56, 0x92, 0xde, 0x4f, 0x4b, 0x87}, "1.0.0"},  // Pikachu
        {{0xc2, 0x08, 0xdb, 0x6a, 0x4e, 0xf4, 0x36, 0x1f}, "1.0.2"},  // Pikachu (issue #1's log)
    };
    char p[1100];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/main", exefs);
    uint8_t id[8] = {0};
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "rb");
    if (f) {
        fseek(f, 0x40, SEEK_SET);
        if (fread(id, 1, 8, f) != 8) memset(id, 0, 8);
        fclose(f);
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof k / sizeof *k; i++)
        if (!memcmp(id, k[i].id, 8)) return k[i].v;
    return "1.0.0";  // (a build not listed here)
}

const char *game_name(const char *exefs) {
    uint64_t id = program_id(exefs);
    return id == TITLE_EEVEE ? "Eevee" : id == TITLE_PIKACHU ? "Pikachu" : NULL;
}

bool setup_ready(void) {
    return game_ok(ROOT "/exefs") && is_file(ROOT "/romfs.bin") && gamelib_present(ROOT);
}

typedef struct { char exefs[1024], romfs[1024], romfs_bin[1024]; bool package; } Found;

static void find_game(const char *dir, int depth, Found *f) {
    if (depth > 5 || (f->exefs[0] && (f->romfs[0] || f->romfs_bin[0]))) return;
    char p[1100];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/main.npdm", dir);
    if (!f->exefs[0] && is_file(p)) {
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/main", dir);
        if (is_file(p)) snprintf(f->exefs, sizeof f->exefs, "%s", dir);
    }
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/bin/message", dir);
    if (!f->romfs[0] && is_dir(p)) snprintf(f->romfs, sizeof f->romfs, "%s", dir);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/romfs.bin", dir);
    if (!f->romfs_bin[0] && is_file(p)) snprintf(f->romfs_bin, sizeof f->romfs_bin, "%s", p);
    DIR *d = opendir(dir);
    if (!d) return;
    char sub[64][256];
    int nsub = 0;
    for (struct dirent *e; (e = readdir(d));) {
        const char *n = e->d_name;
        if (n[0] == '.') continue;
        size_t len = strlen(n);
        if (len > 4) {
            char ext[5];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) ext[i] = (char)tolower((unsigned char)n[len - 4 + i]);
            ext[4] = 0;
            if (!strcmp(ext, ".xci") || !strcmp(ext, ".nsp") || !strcmp(ext, ".nca") || !strcmp(ext, ".nsz") ||
                !strcmp(ext, ".xcz"))
                f->package = true;
        }
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", dir, n);
        if (nsub < 64 && strcmp(n, "bin") && is_dir(p)) snprintf(sub[nsub++], sizeof sub[0], "%s", n);
    }
    closedir(d);
    for (int i = 0; i < nsub; i++) {
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", dir, sub[i]);
        find_game(p, depth + 1, f);
    }
}

// progress: copying + the image are the first 15%, the game code the rest
static float g_phase0, g_phase1;
static void copy_progress(uint64_t done, uint64_t total) {
    if (total) g_progress = g_phase0 + (g_phase1 - g_phase0) * (float)((double)done / (double)total);
}
static void build_progress(double f, const char *step) {
    g_progress = 0.15f + 0.85f * (float)f;
    g_state = !strncmp(step, "Reading", 7) ? SETUP_READING : !strncmp(step, "Finishing", 9) ? SETUP_FINISHING
                                                                                           : SETUP_COMPILING;
}

static bool build_code(void) {
    if (!gamebuild_available()) { g_state = SETUP_FAIL_TOOLS; return false; }
    int cores = SDL_GetNumLogicalCPUCores(), ram_gb = SDL_GetSystemRAM() / 1024;
    GameBuildOpts o = {build_progress, cores < ram_gb - 2 ? cores : ram_gb - 2 > 1 ? ram_gb - 2 : 1};
    char why[256] = "";
    g_state = SETUP_READING;
    if (!gamebuild_run(ROOT, &o, why, sizeof why)) {
        LOG("[setup] game code: %s\n", why);
        g_state = SETUP_FAIL_BUILD;
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static void *setup_thread(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    g_progress = 0;
    if (!g_folder[0]) {  // only the game code (files set up already, e.g. a new version of the app)
        if (build_code()) g_state = setup_ready() ? SETUP_DONE : SETUP_FAIL_BUILD;
        g_running = false;
        return NULL;
    }
    g_state = SETUP_LOOKING;
    Found f = {0};
    find_game(g_folder, 0, &f);
    LOG("[setup] %s: exefs %s, romfs %s, romfs.bin %s\n", g_folder, f.exefs[0] ? f.exefs : "-", f.romfs[0] ? f.romfs : "-",
        f.romfs_bin[0] ? f.romfs_bin : "-");
    if (!f.exefs[0] || (!f.romfs[0] && !f.romfs_bin[0])) g_state = f.package ? SETUP_FAIL_PACKAGE : SETUP_FAIL_NOT_FOUND;
    else if (!game_ok(f.exefs)) g_state = SETUP_FAIL_VERSION;
    else {
        // (the picked folder can't be our own copy: setting up again deletes that first)
        char a[4096], b[4096];
        mkdir(ROOT, 0755);
        if (realpath(f.exefs, a) && realpath(ROOT, b) && !strncmp(a, b, strlen(b)))
            snprintf(f.exefs, sizeof f.exefs, "%s", ""), g_state = SETUP_FAIL_NOT_FOUND;
    }
    if (g_state >= SETUP_FAIL_NOT_FOUND) { g_running = false; return NULL; }

    rt_remove_game_files(ROOT);  // (an earlier or interrupted setup's)
    mkdir(ROOT, 0755);
    g_state = SETUP_COPYING;
    g_phase0 = 0, g_phase1 = 0.01f;
    bool ok = true;
    if (!strcmp(f.exefs, f.romfs)) {  // (a flat dump, main next to bin/: only the six code files, not the whole RomFS)
        static const char *const code[] = {"main", "main.npdm", "rtld", "sdk", "subsdk0", "subsdk1"};
        mkdir(ROOT "/exefs", 0755);
        for (size_t i = 0; ok && i < sizeof code / sizeof *code; i++) {
            char src[1100], dst[1100];
            snprintf(src, sizeof src, "%s/%s", f.exefs, code[i]);
            snprintf(dst, sizeof dst, ROOT "/exefs/%s", code[i]);
            ok = is_file(src) && romfs_copy_file(src, dst, copy_progress);
        }
    } else
        ok = romfs_copy_tree(f.exefs, ROOT "/exefs", copy_progress);
    if (ok && f.romfs_bin[0]) {
        g_phase0 = 0.01f, g_phase1 = 0.15f;
        ok = romfs_copy_file(f.romfs_bin, ROOT "/romfs.bin", copy_progress);
    } else if (ok) {
        g_state = SETUP_IMAGE;
        g_phase0 = 0.01f, g_phase1 = 0.15f;
        char why[256] = "";
        ok = romfs_build(f.romfs, ROOT "/romfs.bin", copy_progress, why, sizeof why);
        if (!ok) LOG("[setup] romfs image: %s\n", why);
    }
    if (!ok) g_state = SETUP_FAIL_COPY;
    else if (build_code()) g_state = setup_ready() ? SETUP_DONE : SETUP_FAIL_BUILD;
    LOG("[setup] %s\n", g_state == SETUP_DONE ? "ready" : "failed");
    g_running = false;
    return NULL;
}

void setup_start(const char *folder) {
    if (g_running) return;
    snprintf(g_folder, sizeof g_folder, "%s", folder ? folder : "");
    for (char *c = g_folder; *c; c++) if (*c == '\\') *c = '/';
    g_running = true;
    g_state = SETUP_LOOKING;
    pthread_t t;
    pthread_create(&t, NULL, setup_thread, NULL);
    pthread_detach(t);
}

```

`runtime/gamesetup.h`:

```h
// Game file setup on the start screen (runtime/gamesetup.c): the player picks the folder with their own extracted
// Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee! or Pikachu!, any version (exefs/ and romfs/, or a romfs.bin image), it is checked, set up in
// <data root>/extracted (exefs copied, the RomFS image built) and the game code is recompiled there from it
// (runtime/gamebuild.c). Runs on a background thread; the launcher polls its state.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

enum {
    SETUP_IDLE,         // nothing running
    SETUP_LOOKING,      // looking for the game files in the picked folder
    SETUP_COPYING,      // copying exefs / the RomFS image
    SETUP_IMAGE,        // building the RomFS image from romfs/
    SETUP_READING,      // generator: translating the game code
    SETUP_COMPILING,    // compiler
    SETUP_FINISHING,    // linking
    SETUP_DONE,         // ready to play
    // failures (setup_state)
    SETUP_FAIL_NOT_FOUND,   // no exefs/main + romfs in that folder
    SETUP_FAIL_PACKAGE,     // .xci / .nsp found instead of extracted files
    SETUP_FAIL_VERSION,     // not Let's Go, Eevee! / Pikachu! (main.npdm's program id)
    SETUP_FAIL_COPY,        // disk full / unreadable files
    SETUP_FAIL_BUILD,       // the game code didn't build
    SETUP_FAIL_TOOLS,       // the generator / compiler are missing from this copy
};

// The game files in <data root>/extracted: ready to play (exefs, romfs.bin and game code built for this version).
bool setup_ready(void);
// The game in that exefs/ folder: "Eevee", "Pikachu" or NULL.
const char *game_name(const char *exefs);
// The build of that exefs/main: one with address tables (runtime/fnhook.c, tools/patches.py) - the 60 fps and wild
// battles options and the generator's patches - or GAME_BUILD_OTHER (an update, say: those stay off).
enum { GAME_BUILD_OTHER, GAME_BUILD_EEVEE_100, GAME_BUILD_PIKACHU_100 };
int game_build(const char *exefs);
// Its version ("1.0.0", "1.0.2"...: the builds known by their build id; "1.0.0" otherwise), told to the game (am).
const char *game_version(const char *exefs);
// Starts a setup from the picked folder (NULL: only rebuild the game code from files set up already).
void setup_start(const char *folder);
int setup_state(void);         // SETUP_*
float setup_progress(void);    // 0..1 while running
bool setup_running(void);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

```

`runtime/hle.h`:

```h
// Registration of host implementations for guest symbols.
#pragma once
#include <stdlib.h>
// Environment lookups that run every frame / per call: looked up once per call site (the variables don't change
// while the game runs). ENV("LARECOMP_X") -> const char * or NULL.
#define ENV(name) ({ static const char *env_v_; static int env_i_; if (!env_i_) { env_v_ = getenv(name); env_i_ = 1; } env_v_; })

#include "rt.h"

typedef struct { const char *name; HostFn fn; } HleImplEntry;

// HLE_FUNC("mangled_symbol", c_function) binds a guest import to a host function.
#define HLE_CAT2(a, b) a##b
#define HLE_CAT(a, b) HLE_CAT2(a, b)
#ifdef __APPLE__
#define HLE_SECTION "__DATA,__hle_impls"
#elif defined(__linux__)
#define HLE_SECTION "hle_impls"  // ELF: the linker defines __start_ / __stop_ for C-identifier section names
#else
#define HLE_SECTION ".hle$m"  // between the .hle$a / .hle$z markers in runtime/dispatch.c
#endif
#define HLE_FUNC(sym, fn)                                                                   \
    static void fn(Cpu *c);                                                                 \
    __attribute__((used, section(HLE_SECTION))) static const HleImplEntry                   \
        HLE_CAT(hle_entry_, __LINE__) = {sym, fn};                                          \
    static void fn(Cpu *c)

// Per-boot host state. RT_ON_RESET(fn) { ... } runs when the game is torn down for an in-place reboot (switching
// seeds / vanilla, back to the start screen: runtime/main.c), after every guest thread has stopped and before
// guest memory is wiped: drop guest pointers, kernel handles, seed data and lazily-initialised state, so the next
// boot starts as from a fresh process. (Settings, the window, the GPU device and ENV() lookups stay.)
typedef void (*ResetFn)(void);
#ifdef __APPLE__
#define RESET_SECTION "__DATA,__rt_reset"
#elif defined(__linux__)
#define RESET_SECTION "resets"
#else
#define RESET_SECTION ".rst$m"  // between the .rst$a / .rst$z markers in runtime/main.c
#endif
#define RT_ON_RESET(fn)                                                                     \
    static void fn(void);                                                                   \
    __attribute__((used, section(RESET_SECTION))) static const ResetFn                      \
        HLE_CAT(reset_entry_, __LINE__) = fn;                                               \
    static void fn(void)

#define RES_OK 0u
#define MAKE_RESULT(module, desc) ((uint32_t)(module) | ((uint32_t)(desc) << 9))

```

`runtime/hle/bindings.c`:

```c
// Control remapping: tables runtime/hle/input.c reads on every input event (so a change applies at once), the
// capture used by the "click a binding, then press" UI, and their larecomp.ini lines. See runtime/input_bind.h.
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../hle.h"
#include "../input_bind.h"

_Static_assert(PADB_LTRIGGER == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_COUNT, "trigger pseudo-buttons follow SDL's buttons");

// Defaults: Nintendo layout by position (east = A, south = B, north = X, west = Y), triggers = ZL / ZR;
// keyboard (Let's Go: A confirms / talks / throws, B cancels, X main menu, Y options / box, L / R move Pokemon and
// items, Plus / Minus buddy / Pokedex) WASD left stick, arrows d-pad, Space = A, Q = B, Tab = X, R = Y, Z / C = L / R,
// 1 / 3 = ZL / ZR, = / - = Plus / Minus, F / numpad 0 = stick clicks, numpad 8/5/4/6 right stick; second keys
// (fixed): Enter = A, Backspace = B.
#define DEF_PAD { \
    SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_WEST, \
    SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_STICK, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT_STICK, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER, \
    SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT_SHOULDER, PADB_LTRIGGER, PADB_RTRIGGER, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_START, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_BACK, \
    SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_LEFT, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_UP, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_RIGHT, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_DOWN}
#define DEF_KEY { \
    SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE, SDL_SCANCODE_Q, SDL_SCANCODE_TAB, SDL_SCANCODE_R, SDL_SCANCODE_F, SDL_SCANCODE_KP_0, \
    SDL_SCANCODE_Z, SDL_SCANCODE_C, SDL_SCANCODE_1, SDL_SCANCODE_3, SDL_SCANCODE_EQUALS, SDL_SCANCODE_MINUS, \
    SDL_SCANCODE_LEFT, SDL_SCANCODE_UP, SDL_SCANCODE_RIGHT, SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN, \
    SDL_SCANCODE_W, SDL_SCANCODE_S, SDL_SCANCODE_A, SDL_SCANCODE_D, SDL_SCANCODE_KP_8, SDL_SCANCODE_KP_5, \
    SDL_SCANCODE_KP_4, SDL_SCANCODE_KP_6}
static const int16_t k_def_pad[BIND_PAD_COUNT] = DEF_PAD, k_def_key[BIND_KEY_COUNT] = DEF_KEY;
// Controller layout (launcher, Game page; larecomp.ini pad_layout): Nintendo (the defaults above, by position) or Xbox
// - A on the bottom button, B on the right, X on the left, Y on the top, as the letters printed on an Xbox pad
static int g_layout;  // BIND_LAYOUT_*
static int16_t def_pad(int layout, int slot) {
    static const int16_t xbox[4] = {SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_WEST, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH};
    return layout == BIND_LAYOUT_XBOX && slot < 4 ? xbox[slot] : k_def_pad[slot];
}
int bind_layout(void) { return g_layout; }
// A / B and X / Y follow the layout where they are still at the old one's defaults (a remap of the Controls page stays)
void bind_set_layout(int layout) {
    layout = layout == BIND_LAYOUT_XBOX ? BIND_LAYOUT_XBOX : BIND_LAYOUT_NINTENDO;
    if (layout == g_layout) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        if (g_bind_pad[i] == def_pad(g_layout, i)) g_bind_pad[i] = def_pad(layout, i);
    g_layout = layout;
    LOG("[input] controller layout: %s\n", layout == BIND_LAYOUT_XBOX ? "Xbox (A bottom, B right)" : "Nintendo (A right, B bottom)");
}
int16_t g_bind_pad[BIND_PAD_COUNT] = DEF_PAD, g_bind_key[BIND_KEY_COUNT] = DEF_KEY;
const int16_t g_bind_key2[BIND_PAD_COUNT] = {SDL_SCANCODE_RETURN, SDL_SCANCODE_BACKSPACE};

static const char *const k_ini[BIND_KEY_COUNT] = {
    "a", "b", "x", "y", "lstick", "rstick", "l", "r", "zl", "zr", "plus", "minus", "left", "up", "right", "down",
    "ls_up", "ls_down", "ls_left", "ls_right", "rs_up", "rs_down", "rs_left", "rs_right",
};
static const char *const k_names[BIND_KEY_COUNT] = {
    "A", "B", "X", "Y", "Left stick press", "Right stick press", "L", "R", "ZL", "ZR", "Plus", "Minus",
    "D-pad Left", "D-pad Up", "D-pad Right", "D-pad Down", "Left stick Up", "Left stick Down", "Left stick Left",
    "Left stick Right", "Right stick Up", "Right stick Down", "Right stick Left", "Right stick Right",
};
// controller buttons by position (larecomp.ini)
static const char *const k_pad_ini[PADB_HOST_COUNT] = {
    "south", "east", "west", "north", "back", "guide", "start", "lstick", "rstick", "lshoulder", "rshoulder",
    "dpad_up", "dpad_down", "dpad_left", "dpad_right", "misc1", "rpaddle1", "lpaddle1", "rpaddle2", "lpaddle2",
    "touchpad", "misc2", "misc3", "misc4", "misc5", "misc6", "ltrigger", "rtrigger",
};

int bind_slot_from_name(const char *name) {
    for (int i = 0; i < BIND_KEY_COUNT; i++) if (!strcmp(name, k_ini[i])) return i;
    return -1;
}
int bind_pad_from_name(const char *name) {
    for (int i = 0; i < PADB_HOST_COUNT; i++) if (!strcmp(name, k_pad_ini[i])) return i;
    return -1;
}

const char *bind_input_name(int slot) { return slot >= 0 && slot < BIND_KEY_COUNT ? k_names[slot] : "?"; }

// fam: 0 Nintendo (and pads SDL doesn't name), 1 Xbox, 2 PlayStation
const char *bind_pad_label(int host, int fam) {
    static const char *const nin[PADB_HOST_COUNT] = {
        "B", "A", "Y", "X", "Minus", "Home", "Plus", "Left stick press", "Right stick press", "L", "R",
        "D-pad Up", "D-pad Down", "D-pad Left", "D-pad Right", "Capture", "Right paddle 1", "Left paddle 1",
        "Right paddle 2", "Left paddle 2", "Touchpad", "Misc 2", "Misc 3", "Misc 4", "Misc 5", "Misc 6", "ZL", "ZR",
    };
    static const char *const xb[PADB_HOST_COUNT] = {
        "A", "B", "X", "Y", "View", "Xbox", "Menu", "LS (press)", "RS (press)", "LB", "RB",
        "D-pad Up", "D-pad Down", "D-pad Left", "D-pad Right", "Share", "Paddle P1", "Paddle P3",
        "Paddle P2", "Paddle P4", "Touchpad", "Misc 2", "Misc 3", "Misc 4", "Misc 5", "Misc 6", "LT", "RT",
    };
    static const char *const ps[PADB_HOST_COUNT] = {
        "Cross", "Circle", "Square", "Triangle", "Create", "PS", "Options", "L3", "R3", "L1", "R1",
        "D-pad Up", "D-pad Down", "D-pad Left", "D-pad Right", "Mute", "Right back button", "Left back button",
        "Right Fn", "Left Fn", "Touchpad", "Misc 2", "Misc 3", "Misc 4", "Misc 5", "Misc 6", "L2", "R2",
    };
    if (host < 0 || host >= PADB_HOST_COUNT) return "(none)";
    return fam == 1 ? xb[host] : fam == 2 ? ps[host] : nin[host];
}

const char *bind_key_label(int sc) {
    if (sc <= 0 || sc >= SDL_SCANCODE_COUNT) return "(none)";
    const char *n = SDL_GetScancodeName((SDL_Scancode)sc);
    return n && *n ? n : "(unnamed key)";
}

int bind_label_family(void) {
    extern int input_pad_family(void);  // runtime/hle/input.c (the game's open pad, or LARECOMP_PAD_TYPE)
    int f = input_pad_family();
    if (f) return f;
    int n = 0, t = 0;  // start screen: input.c hasn't opened a pad yet
    SDL_JoystickID *ids = SDL_GetGamepads(&n);
    if (ids && n > 0) t = SDL_GetGamepadTypeForID(ids[0]);
    SDL_free(ids);
    return t == SDL_GAMEPAD_TYPE_XBOX360 || t == SDL_GAMEPAD_TYPE_XBOXONE ? 1 :
           t == SDL_GAMEPAD_TYPE_PS3 || t == SDL_GAMEPAD_TYPE_PS4 || t == SDL_GAMEPAD_TYPE_PS5 ? 2 : 0;
}

static void result(int kind, int dev, int slot, int other);

void bind_reset(int dev) {
    if (dev == BIND_DEV_PAD) for (int i = 0; i < BIND_PAD_COUNT; i++) g_bind_pad[i] = def_pad(g_layout, i);
    else memcpy(g_bind_key, k_def_key, sizeof g_bind_key);
    LOG("[input] %s bindings reset to the defaults\n", dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? "controller" : "keyboard");
    result(5, dev, -1, -1);
}

bool bind_is_default(int dev) {
    if (dev != BIND_DEV_PAD) return !memcmp(g_bind_key, k_def_key, sizeof g_bind_key);
    for (int i = 0; i < BIND_PAD_COUNT; i++) if (g_bind_pad[i] != def_pad(g_layout, i)) return false;
    return true;
}

bool bind_is_default_slot(int dev, int slot) {
    return dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? g_bind_pad[slot] == def_pad(g_layout, slot) : g_bind_key[slot] == k_def_key[slot];
}

int bind_prompt_host(int slot) { return slot >= 0 && slot < BIND_PAD_COUNT ? g_bind_pad[slot] : -1; }

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ capture
static _Atomic int cap_dev = -1, cap_slot = -1;
static _Atomic uint64_t cap_deadline;
static _Atomic int res_kind, res_dev, res_slot, res_other, res_serial;

static void result(int kind, int dev, int slot, int other) {
    res_kind = kind, res_dev = dev, res_slot = slot, res_other = other;
    res_serial++;
}

void bind_capture_begin(int dev, int slot) {
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= (dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? BIND_PAD_COUNT : BIND_KEY_COUNT)) return;
    cap_deadline = SDL_GetTicks() + BIND_CAPTURE_MS;
    cap_slot = slot;
    cap_dev = dev;
}

void bind_capture_cancel(void) {
    if (cap_dev < 0) return;
    result(3, cap_dev, cap_slot, -1);
    cap_dev = -1;
}

bool bind_capture_active(int *dev, int *slot, int *ms_left) {
    int d = cap_dev;
    if (d >= 0 && SDL_GetTicks() >= cap_deadline) { result(4, d, cap_slot, -1); cap_dev = d = -1; }
    if (dev) *dev = d;
    if (slot) *slot = d >= 0 ? cap_slot : -1;
    if (ms_left) *ms_left = d >= 0 ? (int)(cap_deadline - SDL_GetTicks()) : 0;
    return d >= 0;
}

int bind_last_result(int *dev, int *slot, int *other, int *serial) {
    if (dev) *dev = res_dev;
    if (slot) *slot = res_slot;
    if (other) *other = res_other;
    if (serial) *serial = res_serial;
    return res_kind;
}

// Bind `host` to `slot`; an input already on `host` takes the slot's old binding (swap).
static void assign(int dev, int slot, int host) {
    int16_t *t = dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? g_bind_pad : g_bind_key;
    int n = dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? BIND_PAD_COUNT : BIND_KEY_COUNT, other = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (i != slot && t[i] == host) { other = i; t[i] = t[slot]; }
    t[slot] = (int16_t)host;
    LOG("[input] %s %s -> %s%s%s%s\n", dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? "controller" : "keyboard", k_names[slot],
        dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? k_pad_ini[host] : bind_key_label(host), other >= 0 ? " (swapped with " : "",
        other >= 0 ? k_names[other] : "", other >= 0 ? ")" : "");
    if (other >= 0) LOG("[input]   %s -> %s\n", k_names[other], dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? k_pad_ini[t[other]] : bind_key_label(t[other]));
    result(other >= 0 ? 2 : 1, dev, slot, other);
}

bool bind_capture_event(const SDL_Event *e) {
    int dev = cap_dev;
    if (dev < 0) return false;
    switch (e->type) {
    case SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN:
        if (e->key.repeat) return true;
        if (e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE) { bind_capture_cancel(); return true; }
        // F1 (menu), F9 (frame dump), F11 (fullscreen), F12 (settings) stay the overlay's; a controller capture ignores keys
        if (dev != BIND_DEV_KEY || e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_F1 || e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_F9 ||
            e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_F11 || e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_F12 || e->key.scancode >= SDL_SCANCODE_COUNT) return true;
        cap_dev = -1;
        assign(dev, cap_slot, e->key.scancode);
        return true;
    case SDL_EVENT_KEY_UP: case SDL_EVENT_TEXT_INPUT:
        return true;
    case SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DOWN:
        // Home / Guide opens the menu; a keyboard capture ignores the controller (it times out, or Esc)
        if (dev != BIND_DEV_PAD || e->gbutton.button == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_GUIDE || e->gbutton.button >= SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_COUNT) return true;
        cap_dev = -1;
        assign(dev, cap_slot, e->gbutton.button);
        return true;
    case SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_UP:
        return true;
    case SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_AXIS_MOTION:
        if (dev == BIND_DEV_PAD && e->gaxis.value > 16000 &&
            (e->gaxis.axis == SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER || e->gaxis.axis == SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER)) {
            cap_dev = -1;
            assign(dev, cap_slot, e->gaxis.axis == SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER ? PADB_LTRIGGER : PADB_RTRIGGER);
        }
        return true;  // (sticks: no menu movement while waiting)
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ larecomp.ini
bool bind_settings_load(const char *key, const char *val) {
    if (!strcmp(key, "pad_layout")) { bind_set_layout(!strcmp(val, "xbox") ? BIND_LAYOUT_XBOX : BIND_LAYOUT_NINTENDO); return true; }
    bool pad = !strncmp(key, "bind_pad_", 9), kb = !strncmp(key, "bind_key_", 9);
    if (!pad && !kb) return false;
    for (int i = 0; i < (pad ? BIND_PAD_COUNT : BIND_KEY_COUNT); i++) {
        if (strcmp(key + 9, k_ini[i])) continue;
        if (pad) {
            for (int h = 0; h < PADB_HOST_COUNT; h++)
                if (!strcmp(val, k_pad_ini[h])) g_bind_pad[i] = (int16_t)h;
        } else {
            SDL_Scancode sc = strcmp(val, "none") ? SDL_GetScancodeFromName(val) : SDL_SCANCODE_UNKNOWN;
            if (sc != SDL_SCANCODE_UNKNOWN || !strcmp(val, "none")) g_bind_key[i] = (int16_t)sc;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void bind_settings_save(FILE *f) {
    fprintf(f, "pad_layout = %s\n", g_layout == BIND_LAYOUT_XBOX ? "xbox" : "nintendo");  // (before the bind_pad_ lines)
    for (int i = 0; i < BIND_PAD_COUNT; i++)
        if (g_bind_pad[i] != def_pad(g_layout, i) && g_bind_pad[i] >= 0 && g_bind_pad[i] < PADB_HOST_COUNT)
            fprintf(f, "bind_pad_%s = %s\n", k_ini[i], k_pad_ini[g_bind_pad[i]]);
    for (int i = 0; i < BIND_KEY_COUNT; i++)
        if (g_bind_key[i] != k_def_key[i])
            fprintf(f, "bind_key_%s = %s\n", k_ini[i], g_bind_key[i] ? SDL_GetScancodeName((SDL_Scancode)g_bind_key[i]) : "none");
}

```

`runtime/hle/controller_skip.c`:

```c
// No controller screen at start (launcher "Skip controller selection", larecomp.ini skip_controller = 1): the game
// starts at the Game Freak logo, with the controller already chosen, instead of "Press a button on the controller you
// want to use" and its confirmation.
//
// How the game does it (Pikachu and Eevee 1.0.0, the same address in both): the start sequence runs a controller step
// once per frame until it says it is done (f_700004eb50, x0 = the step, true when done). Its mode at [+0x130]:
//  - 0: it looks at the three players' controllers ([controller manager + 0xb40], 0x80 each) and is done at once when
//    fewer than two are set and none is of a kind it doesn't take - else it asks, as below;
//  - otherwise (1 at start): it builds the controller settings app (bin/app/setting_cnt: "main menu", "detail menu",
//    "palma button switch"...) into [+0x88] and waits for it.
// At start the one controller the runtime presents (handheld, npad 0x20: runtime/hle/input.c) is player 0's already,
// so the step is turned to mode 0 before its first run: it finds that controller and ends, as a check after the app
// would. Only the first time per boot - the same step may ask again while playing (a controller lost), and asks then.
// LARECOMP_SKIP_CONTROLLER=0/1 overrides the setting (tests).
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "../hle.h"
#include "../settings.h"

void rt_register_fnhook(uint64_t addr, int (*fn)(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr));  // runtime/fnhook.c
uint64_t rt_addr(uint64_t eevee);  // runtime/fnhook.c: an Eevee 1.0.0 address in the running build (0: unknown build)

#define CONTROLLER_STEP 0x700004eb50ull  // the start sequence's controller step (x0 = it)
#define STEP_APP 0x88                    // its controller settings app, once built
#define STEP_MODE 0x130                  // 0: check the players' controllers; 1 (start): ask

static bool g_on, g_done;  // on (this boot); the start's step seen
RT_ON_RESET(controller_skip_reset) { g_done = false; }

static int step_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    (void)addr;
    if (!g_on || g_done) return 0;
    uint8_t *step = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0];
    g_done = true;
    if (!*(uint64_t *)(step + STEP_APP) && *(uint32_t *)(step + STEP_MODE) == 1) {
        *(uint32_t *)(step + STEP_MODE) = 0;
        LOG("[ctlskip] the controller screen skipped\n");
    }
    return 0;  // (the game's step runs, in mode 0)
}

// Before each boot (runtime/main.c), like the other launcher options that hook the game
void controller_skip_configure(void) {
    static bool hooked;
    extern void settings_load(void);
    settings_load();  // (read once; without the launcher it would come later, in boot)
    const char *e = getenv("LARECOMP_SKIP_CONTROLLER");
    g_on = (e && *e ? atoi(e) != 0 : g_settings.skip_controller) && rt_addr(CONTROLLER_STEP);
    if (!g_on || hooked) return;
    hooked = true;
    rt_register_fnhook(CONTROLLER_STEP, step_hook);
}

```

`runtime/hle/cutscene.c`:

```c
// Cutscenes: the game's event scripts (AMX, docs/MODO-BATALHA.md) take the camera with the native EvCameraStart and give
// it back with EvCameraEnd - a talk with someone doesn't, a scene with the camera moving around does. Between the two
// game_cutscene() is true (runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c: SSAO at half its intensity there and on the title screen).
// Natives found by name in the image (the table of names and functions: LARECOMP_IMAGE_DUMP and a scan); Eevee 1.0.0
// addresses, Pikachu's in runtime/fnhook.c's table. LARECOMP_CUTSCENE_LOG=1: each start and end.
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "../hle.h"

void rt_register_fnhook(uint64_t addr, int (*fn)(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr));  // runtime/fnhook.c
uint64_t rt_addr(uint64_t eevee);  // runtime/fnhook.c: an Eevee 1.0.0 address in the running build (0: unknown build)
uint64_t renderer_game_frame(void);

#define EV_CAMERA_START 0x7000180a20ull  // native EvCameraStart (Pikachu 1.0.0: 0x70001809f0)
#define EV_CAMERA_END 0x7000180a70ull    // native EvCameraEnd (Pikachu 1.0.0: 0x7000180a40)

static volatile bool g_cut;
static int g_log = -1;
RT_ON_RESET(cutscene_reset) { g_cut = false; }

bool game_cutscene(void) { return g_cut; }

static int start_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    (void)c, (void)addr;
    if (!g_cut && g_log) LOG("[cutscene] start at present %llu\n", (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame());
    g_cut = true;
    return 0;  // (the native runs as usual)
}
static int end_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    (void)c, (void)addr;
    if (g_cut && g_log) LOG("[cutscene] end at present %llu\n", (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame());
    g_cut = false;
    return 0;
}

// Before each boot (runtime/main.c)
void cutscene_configure(void) {
    static bool hooked;
    g_cut = false;
    if (g_log < 0) g_log = getenv("LARECOMP_CUTSCENE_LOG") != NULL;
    if (hooked || !rt_addr(EV_CAMERA_START) || !rt_addr(EV_CAMERA_END)) return;
    hooked = true;
    rt_register_fnhook(EV_CAMERA_START, start_hook);
    rt_register_fnhook(EV_CAMERA_END, end_hook);
}
```
