```c
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
static uint64_t make_vtable(HostFn *fns, int n, const char *prefix) {
    uint64_t *t = hle_alloc(64 * 8);
    char name[96];
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "<%s slot %d>", prefix, i);
        t[i] = hle_register(name, i < n ? fns[i] : NULL);
    }
    return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)t;
}

// The game reads the audio and video tracks from different threads; FFmpeg's demuxer is not thread-safe.
static pthread_mutex_t ex_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

static void *self_state(Cpu *c) { return (void *)(uintptr_t)((uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0])[1]; }

static void signal_guest_event(Cpu *c, uint64_t event) {
    if (!event) return;
    uint64_t saved[8];
    memcpy(saved, c->x, sizeof saved);
    c->x[0] = event;
    guest_call(c, guest_sym("_ZN2nn2os11SignalEventEPNS0_9EventTypeE"));
    memcpy(c->x, saved, sizeof saved);
}

static void ok(Cpu *c) { c->x[0] = 0; }

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ Extractor
typedef struct {
    AVFormatContext *fmt;
    int map[16], ntracks;  // exposed track -> stream
    uint64_t selected;  // bitmask of streams
    AVPacket *pkt;
    bool have_pkt, eof;
    bool skippable;  // the launch opening (forced on the first launch, no save yet): A / B / + ends it
    AVIOContext *avio;  // a movie read from inside the RomFS image (romfs.bin): its byte range there
    int img_fd;
    uint64_t img_off, img_size, img_pos;
} Extractor;

static int img_read(void *opaque, uint8_t *buf, int n) {
    Extractor *e = opaque;
    uint64_t left = e->img_size - e->img_pos;
    if (!left) return AVERROR_EOF;
    if ((uint64_t)n > left) n = (int)left;
    ssize_t r = pread(e->img_fd, buf, (size_t)n, (off_t)(e->img_off + e->img_pos));
    if (r <= 0) return AVERROR_EOF;
    e->img_pos += (uint64_t)r;
    return (int)r;
}

static int64_t img_seek(void *opaque, int64_t pos, int whence) {
    Extractor *e = opaque;
    if (whence & AVSEEK_SIZE) return (int64_t)e->img_size;
    whence &= ~AVSEEK_FORCE;
    int64_t to = whence == SEEK_SET ? pos : whence == SEEK_CUR ? (int64_t)e->img_pos + pos
               : whence == SEEK_END ? (int64_t)e->img_size + pos : -1;
    if (to < 0 || (uint64_t)to > e->img_size) return -1;
    e->img_pos = (uint64_t)to;
    return to;
}

static void ex_close(Extractor *e) {
    if (e->fmt) avformat_close_input(&e->fmt);
    if (e->avio) {
        av_freep(&e->avio->buffer);
        avio_context_free(&e->avio);
    }
}

// A movie of the game's RomFS: a mod's copy (runtime/mods.h), else the extracted romfs/ folder (a source checkout),
// else its bytes inside the romfs.bin image (what the start screen sets up: there is no folder).
static bool ex_open(Extractor *e, const char *rel, char *host, size_t cap) {
    struct stat sb;
    if (mod_romfs_override(rel, host, cap) ||
        (snprintf(host, cap, "%s/%s", g_romfs_dir, rel), !stat(host, &sb) && S_ISREG(sb.st_mode)))
        return avformat_open_input(&e->fmt, host, NULL, NULL) >= 0;
    if (!romfs_image_file(rel, &e->img_fd, &e->img_off, &e->img_size)) return false;
    snprintf(host, cap, "%s.bin @ %llx (%s)", g_romfs_dir, (unsigned long long)e->img_off, rel);
    e->img_pos = 0;
    uint8_t *buf = av_malloc(1 << 16);
    e->avio = buf ? avio_alloc_context(buf, 1 << 16, 0, e, img_read, NULL, img_seek) : NULL;
    if (!e->avio) { av_free(buf); return false; }
    e->fmt = avformat_alloc_context();
    e->fmt->pb = e->avio;
    e->fmt->flags |= AVFMT_FLAG_CUSTOM_IO;
    return avformat_open_input(&e->fmt, NULL, NULL, NULL) >= 0;  // (frees fmt on failure; avio: ex_close)
}

static bool g_skip_held;           // ex_fill: A / B held at the last look
static double g_skip_pressed_at;    // when they were pressed (0 = not yet)

static void ex_fill(Extractor *e) {
    if (e->skippable && !e->eof) {
        // the game skips the opening with Plus (once a save exists); A and B do too (we press Plus for it)
        extern uint64_t input_buttons_now(void);
        extern volatile int g_inject_plus;
        bool held = g_skip_held;
        double pressed_at = g_skip_pressed_at;
        uint64_t b = input_buttons_now();
        bool now = (b & ((1u << 0) | (1u << 1) | (1u << 10))) != 0;  // A / B / Plus
        if (now && !held) {
            LOG("[movie] opening: A/B/+ -> Plus (skip)\n");
            if (b & 3) g_inject_plus = 1;
            if (!pressed_at) pressed_at = av_gettime_relative() / 1e6;
        }
        held = now;
        // With no save file yet the game ignores Plus (first viewing can't be skipped): if the movie still plays
        // half a second after the press, jump to its last half second so it ends the normal way (ending the
        // stream outright makes the game restart it).
        if (pressed_at && av_gettime_relative() / 1e6 - pressed_at > 0.5 && e->fmt->duration > 1000000) {
            pressed_at = 0;
            int64_t to = e->fmt->duration - 500000;
            if (av_seek_frame(e->fmt, -1, to, AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD) >= 0) {
                if (e->have_pkt) { av_packet_unref(e->pkt); e->have_pkt = false; }
                LOG("[movie] opening: still playing -> seek to the end\n");
            }
            e->skippable = false;  // (done: later presses on the title / file select are the menus' own)
        }
        g_skip_held = held, g_skip_pressed_at = pressed_at;
    }
    while (!e->have_pkt && !e->eof) {
        if (av_read_frame(e->fmt, e->pkt) < 0) { e->eof = true; break; }
        if (e->selected & (1ull << e->pkt->stream_index)) e->have_pkt = true;
        else av_packet_unref(e->pkt);
    }
}

static void ex_set_data_source(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    const char *path = (const char *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2];
    // "data:/bin/movies/EEVEE_GO/title_male.webm" -> the RomFS file bin/movies/EEVEE_GO/title_male.webm
    const char *rel = path && strstr(path, ":/") ? strstr(path, ":/") + 2 : path;
    char host[1200] = "";
    bool opened = rel && ex_open(e, rel, host, sizeof host);
    LOG("[movie] open %s -> %s\n", path ? path : "(null)", host);
    if (!opened || avformat_find_stream_info(e->fmt, NULL) < 0) {
        LOG("[movie] cannot open %s\n", rel ? rel : "(null)");
        ex_close(e);
        c->x[0] = 1;
        return;
    }
    e->pkt = av_packet_alloc();
    e->ntracks = 0;
    // the opening at launch can always be skipped (with no save yet the game forces it)
    e->skippable = rel && strstr(rel, "movie/opening.webm");
    if (e->skippable) g_skip_pressed_at = 0;  // (a press that ended the title's attract replay isn't for this one)
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < e->fmt->nb_streams && e->ntracks < 16; i++)
        if (e->fmt->streams[i]->codecpar->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO ||
            (e->fmt->streams[i]->codecpar->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO && g_settings.movie_audio && !getenv("LARECOMP_NO_MOVIE_AUDIO")))
            e->map[e->ntracks++] = (int)i;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void ex_get_track_count(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    *(int32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = e->fmt ? e->ntracks : 0;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void ex_get_track_config(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    int i = (int)c->x[1];
    MediaData *m = md(c->x[2]);
    md_clear(m);
    if (!e->fmt || i >= e->ntracks) { c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    AVStream *s = e->fmt->streams[e->map[i]];
    AVCodecParameters *p = s->codecpar;
    m->codecpar = p;
    if (p->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO) {
        md_set_str(m, "mime", p->codec_id == AV_CODEC_ID_VP9 ? "video/x-vnd.on2.vp9" :
                              p->codec_id == AV_CODEC_ID_VP8 ? "video/x-vnd.on2.vp8" : "video/avc");
        md_set_int(m, "width", p->width);
        md_set_int(m, "height", p->height);
        int fps = s->avg_frame_rate.den ? s->avg_frame_rate.num / s->avg_frame_rate.den : 30;
        md_set_int(m, "frame-rate", fps ? fps : 30);
    } else {
        md_set_str(m, "mime", p->codec_id == AV_CODEC_ID_VORBIS ? "audio/vorbis" : "audio/mp4a-latm");
        md_set_int(m, "sample-rate", p->sample_rate);
        md_set_int(m, "channel-count", p->ch_layout.nb_channels);
    }
    if (e->fmt->duration > 0) md_set_int(m, "durationUs", e->fmt->duration);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void ex_select_track(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    int i = (int)c->x[1];
    if (i >= 0 && i < e->ntracks) e->selected |= 1ull << e->map[i];
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void ex_get_sample_track(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    ex_fill(e);
    if (!e->have_pkt) { c->x[0] = e->eof ? MOVIE_STATUS_END_OF_STREAM : 1; return; }
    uint64_t t = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < e->ntracks; i++) if (e->map[i] == e->pkt->stream_index) t = (uint64_t)i;
    *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = t;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void ex_read(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    MBuffer *b = BUF(c->x[1]);
    ex_fill(e);
    if (!e->have_pkt) {
        static int nlog;
        if (nlog++ < 5) LOG("[movie] extractor Read: end of file (lr %llx)\n", (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
        c->x[0] = e->eof ? MOVIE_STATUS_END_OF_STREAM : 1;
        return;
    }
    uint32_t n = (uint32_t)e->pkt->size;
    if (n > b->capacity) { LOG("[movie] packet %u > buffer %llu\n", n, b->capacity); n = (uint32_t)b->capacity; }
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)b->base, e->pkt->data, n);
    b->offset = 0;
    b->size = (int32_t)n;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void ex_advance(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    if (e->have_pkt) { av_packet_unref(e->pkt); e->have_pkt = false; }
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void ex_get_sample_time(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    ex_fill(e);
    if (!e->have_pkt) { c->x[0] = e->eof ? MOVIE_STATUS_END_OF_STREAM : 1; return; }
    AVStream *s = e->fmt->streams[e->pkt->stream_index];
    int64_t ts = e->pkt->pts != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? e->pkt->pts : e->pkt->dts;
    *(int64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = av_rescale_q(ts, s->time_base, (AVRational){1, 1000000});
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// slot 8: SeekTo(int64 timeUs)
static void ex_seek(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    if (!e->fmt) { c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    if (e->have_pkt) { av_packet_unref(e->pkt); e->have_pkt = false; }
    e->eof = false;
    { static int nlog; if (nlog++ < 20) LOG("[movie] extractor SeekTo %lld us (mode %llu)\n", (long long)c->x[1], (unsigned long long)c->x[2]); }
    av_seek_frame(e->fmt, -1, (int64_t)c->x[1], AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// slot 14: GetCachedDuration(out1, int64* durationUs) -- local files are fully cached
static void ex_cached_duration(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    int64_t dur = e->fmt && e->fmt->duration > 0 ? e->fmt->duration : INT64_MAX / 4;
    if (c->x[1]) *(int64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = 1;
    if (c->x[2]) *(int64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2] = dur;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// Movie objects of this boot (host side; a reboot mid-movie closes them): vtables live in the HLE heap.
static uint64_t g_ex_vt, g_dec_vt;
#define MAX_MOVIE_OBJS 32
static void *g_movie_objs[2][MAX_MOVIE_OBJS];  // [0] Extractor, [1] Decoder
static pthread_mutex_t g_movie_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static void movie_track(int kind, void *p, bool add) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_movie_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_MOVIE_OBJS; i++)
        if (g_movie_objs[kind][i] == (add ? NULL : p)) { g_movie_objs[kind][i] = add ? p : NULL; break; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_movie_lock);
}

static void ex_dtor(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    if (e) ex_close(e);
    if (e) movie_track(0, e, false);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void movie_log_slot(Cpu *c) {
    static int n;
    if (n++ < 20) LOG("[movie] unimplemented virtual (lr=%llx)\n", c->x[30]);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

#define EX_LOCKED(fn) \
    static void fn##_l(Cpu *c) { pthread_mutex_lock(&ex_lock); fn(c); pthread_mutex_unlock(&ex_lock); }
EX_LOCKED(ex_dtor)
EX_LOCKED(ex_get_track_count)
EX_LOCKED(ex_get_track_config)
EX_LOCKED(ex_select_track)
EX_LOCKED(ex_seek)
EX_LOCKED(ex_get_sample_track)
EX_LOCKED(ex_read)
EX_LOCKED(ex_advance)
EX_LOCKED(ex_get_sample_time)
EX_LOCKED(ex_cached_duration)
EX_LOCKED(ex_set_data_source)

HLE_FUNC("_ZN5movie9ExtractorC1ENS_13ContainerTypeE", movie_extractor_ctor) {
    uint64_t vt = g_ex_vt;
    if (!vt) {
        HostFn f[16] = {ex_dtor_l, ex_dtor_l, movie_log_slot, movie_log_slot, ex_get_track_count_l,
                        ex_get_track_config_l, ex_select_track_l, movie_log_slot, ex_seek_l, ex_get_sample_track_l,
                        ex_read_l, ex_advance_l, ex_get_sample_time_l, movie_log_slot, ex_cached_duration_l,
                        ex_set_data_source_l};
        vt = g_ex_vt = make_vtable(f, 16, "Extractor");
    }
    uint64_t *self = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0];
    self[0] = vt;
    Extractor *e = calloc(1, sizeof(Extractor));
    self[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)e;
    movie_track(0, e, true);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ Decoder
#define NIN 4
#define NOUT 6
#define NPENDING 16

typedef struct {
    int idx;
    int64_t time;
    uint32_t flags;
} OutReady;

typedef struct {
    AVCodecContext *ctx;
    AVFrame *frame;
    AVPacket *pkt;
    bool video;
    uint64_t events[4];  // input available, output available, format changed, error
    uint8_t *in_mem[NIN];
    uint32_t in_cap;
    bool in_busy[NIN];
    uint8_t *out_mem[NOUT];
    uint32_t out_cap, out_size[NOUT];
    bool out_busy[NOUT];
    int out_next;  // round-robin start for the next free output slot (emit_frame)
    OutReady ready[NOUT];
    int nready;
    int width, height, stride, sample_rate, channels;
    struct SwsContext *sws;
    uint8_t *rgba;
    int src_width, src_height;     // the stream's own size (width / height: what the game gets, maybe scaled)
    struct SwsContext *sws_scale;  // stream frame -> scaled NV12 output (only when the sizes differ)
    AVFrame *pending[NPENDING];
    int64_t pending_time[NPENDING];
    int npending;
    bool eos_pending;
    int64_t eos_time;
    bool stopped;  // Stop / destroyed: no more events (see dec_stop)
    pthread_mutex_t lock;
} Decoder;

// Input / output buffers live in the HLE heap, which only a reboot frees: buffers of destroyed decoders are kept
// for the next movie (the title's attract loop replays the opening, ~37 MB of buffers per showing).
static struct { uint8_t *mem; uint32_t size; } g_buf_pool[64];
static int g_nbuf_pool;
static pthread_mutex_t g_pool_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static uint8_t *buf_get(Cpu *c, uint32_t size) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_pool_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nbuf_pool; i++)
        if (g_buf_pool[i].size == size) {
            uint8_t *m = g_buf_pool[i].mem;
            g_buf_pool[i] = g_buf_pool[--g_nbuf_pool];
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_pool_lock);
            return m;
        }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_pool_lock);
    if (g_movie_alloc_fn && c) {  // from the game's heap (see movie_set_allocator); x0-x2 are ours to clobber here
        uint64_t keep[3] = {c->x[0], c->x[1], c->x[2]};
        c->x[0] = size;
        c->x[1] = 0x1000;
        c->x[2] = g_movie_alloc_user;
        guest_call(c, g_movie_alloc_fn);
        uint8_t *m = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0];
        c->x[0] = keep[0], c->x[1] = keep[1], c->x[2] = keep[2];
        if (m) return m;
        LOG("[movie] game allocator failed (%u bytes): HLE heap\n", size);
    }
    return hle_alloc(size);
}
static void buf_put(uint8_t *m, uint32_t size) {
    if (!m) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_pool_lock);
    if (g_nbuf_pool < 64) g_buf_pool[g_nbuf_pool++].mem = m, g_buf_pool[g_nbuf_pool - 1].size = size;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_pool_lock);
}

// Signal one of the game's decoder events unless the decoder was stopped. Under the lock so a Stop on another
// thread can't slip between the check and the signal.
static void dec_signal(Cpu *c, Decoder *d, int i) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    if (!d->stopped) signal_guest_event(c, d->events[i]);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
}

typedef struct NvnTexture NvnTexture;
void renderer_upload_rgba(NvnTexture *t, const void *rgba, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t stride);

static void dec_configure(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    MediaData *m = md(c->x[1]);
    AVCodecParameters *p = m->codecpar;
    if (!p) { LOG("[movie] Configure without codec parameters\n"); c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    const AVCodec *codec = avcodec_find_decoder(p->codec_id);
    d->ctx = avcodec_alloc_context3(codec);
    avcodec_parameters_to_context(d->ctx, p);
    // Slice threads, not frame threads: frame threading holds frames back (latency of thread_count frames), and the
    // game polls for one output per frame - Let's Go's title movie played at ~19 of its 30 fps and stopped early.
    d->ctx->thread_count = 8;
    d->ctx->thread_type = FF_THREAD_SLICE;
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_MOVIE_FRAME_THREADS")) d->ctx->thread_type = FF_THREAD_FRAME;
    if (avcodec_open2(d->ctx, codec, NULL) < 0) { LOG("[movie] cannot open decoder\n"); c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    d->frame = av_frame_alloc();
    d->pkt = av_packet_alloc();
    d->video = p->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO;
    d->src_width = d->width = p->width;
    d->src_height = d->height = p->height;
    if (d->video) {
        // LARECOMP_MOVIE_MAX=<w>x<h>: frames larger than that are scaled down to fit it (default: native size; a
        // speed / memory option - the game sizes its movie textures from the output format either way).
        int mw = 0, mh = 0;
        const char *e = getenv("LARECOMP_MOVIE_MAX");
        if (e) sscanf(e, "%dx%d", &mw, &mh);
        if (mw > 0 && mh > 0 && (d->width > mw || d->height > mh)) {
            double k = (double)mw / d->width < (double)mh / d->height ? (double)mw / d->width : (double)mh / d->height;
            d->width = ((int)(d->width * k + 0.5)) & ~1;
            d->height = ((int)(d->height * k + 0.5)) & ~1;
            LOG("[movie] %dx%d stream scaled to %dx%d\n", d->src_width, d->src_height, d->width, d->height);
        }
    }
    d->stride = (d->width + 1) & ~1;  // tight NV12 rows: the game sizes its frame buffers w * h * 3 / 2
    d->sample_rate = p->sample_rate;
    d->channels = p->ch_layout.nb_channels;
    d->in_cap = d->video ? 4 << 20 : 256 << 10;
    d->out_cap = d->video ? (uint32_t)(d->stride * d->height * 3 / 2) : 64 << 10;
    for (int i = 0; i < NIN; i++) d->in_mem[i] = buf_get(c, d->in_cap);
    for (int i = 0; i < NOUT; i++) d->out_mem[i] = buf_get(c, d->out_cap);
    LOG("[movie] decoder %s configured: %dx%d %d Hz %d ch\n", codec->name, d->width, d->height, d->sample_rate, d->channels);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_register_events(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    memcpy(d->events, (void *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1], sizeof d->events);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_output_format(Decoder *d, MediaData *m) {
    md_clear(m);
    if (d->video) {
        md_set_str(m, "mime", "video/raw");
        md_set_int(m, "width", d->width);
        md_set_int(m, "height", d->height);
        md_set_int(m, "nv12-y-stride", d->stride);
        md_set_int(m, "nv12-y-offset", 0);
        md_set_int(m, "nv12-uv-offset", d->stride * d->height);
        md_set_int(m, "nv12-colorspace", 0);
    } else {
        md_set_str(m, "mime", "audio/raw");
        md_set_int(m, "sample-rate", d->sample_rate);
        md_set_int(m, "channel-count", d->channels);
    }
}

static void dec_get_output_format(Cpu *c) { dec_output_format(self_state(c), md(c->x[1])); c->x[0] = 0; }
static void dec_get_output_buffer_format(Cpu *c) { dec_output_format(self_state(c), md(c->x[2])); c->x[0] = 0; }

static void dec_start(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    d->stopped = false;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    dec_signal(c, d, 0);  // all input buffers are free
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// slot 6: Stop. The game's player (0x7000912640) stops both decoders, stops its renderer threads, deletes the
// decoders and nulls its pointers to them, and only then tells its decoder thread (0x70009114b0) to exit: an event
// of ours still set by then wakes that thread into a virtual call through the null decoder (signal 11 after the
// title's attract movie, when the thread was slow to run). A stopped hardware decoder signals nothing, so stop
// signalling here and clear what is still set.
static void dec_stop(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    static uint64_t clear_event;
    if (!clear_event) clear_event = guest_sym("_ZN2nn2os10ClearEventEPNS0_9EventTypeE");
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    if (!d->stopped) {
        d->stopped = true;
        LOG("[movie] decoder %s stopped\n", d->video ? "video" : "audio");
        uint64_t saved[8];
        memcpy(saved, c->x, sizeof saved);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            if (d->events[i]) { c->x[0] = d->events[i]; guest_call(c, clear_event); }
        memcpy(c->x, saved, sizeof saved);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static uint64_t n_acq_in, n_send, n_acq_out, n_get_out, n_rel_out, n_frames;
// LARECOMP_MOVIE_STATE=1: every 5 s, each decoder's queues (debug: where a stalled movie waits).
static void *movie_state_thread(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    for (;;) {
        struct timespec ts = {5, 0};
        nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_MOVIE_OBJS; i++) {
            Decoder *d = g_movie_objs[1][i];
            if (!d || !d->ctx) continue;
            pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
            int in_busy = 0, out_busy = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < NIN; k++) in_busy += d->in_busy[k];
            for (int k = 0; k < NOUT; k++) out_busy += d->out_busy[k];
            LOG("[movie] state %s: in_busy %d/%d out_busy %d/%d ready %d pending %d eos_pending %d stopped %d\n",
                d->video ? "video" : "audio", in_busy, NIN, out_busy, NOUT, d->nready, d->npending, d->eos_pending,
                d->stopped);
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static void movie_stats(void) {
    static int state_started;
    if (!state_started && getenv("LARECOMP_MOVIE_STATE")) {
        state_started = 1;
        pthread_t th;
        pthread_create(&th, NULL, movie_state_thread, NULL);
        pthread_detach(th);
    }
    static uint64_t last;
    uint64_t now = n_acq_in + n_send + n_acq_out + n_rel_out;
    if (now / 200 != last / 200)
        LOG("[movie] acq_in %llu send %llu frames %llu acq_out %llu get_out %llu rel_out %llu\n", n_acq_in, n_send,
            n_frames, n_acq_out, n_get_out, n_rel_out);
    last = now;
}

static void dec_acquire_input(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    n_acq_in++;
    movie_stats();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    int out_free = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < NOUT; i++) if (!d->out_busy[i]) out_free++;
    if (out_free < 2 || d->npending) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock); c->x[0] = 1; return; }  // backpressure
    int idx = -1, free_n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < NIN; i++)
        if (!d->in_busy[i]) { if (idx < 0) idx = i; else free_n++; }
    if (idx >= 0) d->in_busy[idx] = true;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    if (idx < 0) { c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    *(int32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = idx;
    if (c->x[2]) *(int32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2] = free_n;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_get_input_buffer(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    int i = (int)c->x[1];
    MBuffer *b = BUF(c->x[2]);
    if (i < 0 || i >= NIN) { c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    memset(b, 0, sizeof *b);
    b->base = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)d->in_mem[i];
    b->capacity = d->in_cap;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// Copy a decoded frame into an output slot; caller holds the lock.
static bool emit_frame(Decoder *d, AVFrame *f, int64_t time, uint32_t flags) {
    // Round robin, not the first free slot: Let's Go releases an output buffer and copies out of it afterwards, so
    // refilling the slot just released overwrote audio it was still reading (robotic movie sound, ~30% of samples).
    int slot = -1;
    for (int k = 0; k < NOUT; k++) {
        int i = (d->out_next + k) % NOUT;
        if (!d->out_busy[i]) { slot = i; break; }
    }
    if (slot < 0) return false;
    d->out_next = (slot + 1) % NOUT;
    uint8_t *o = d->out_mem[slot];
    uint32_t size = 0;
    if (flags & MOVIE_EOS) {
        size = 0;
    } else if (d->video && (d->width != d->src_width || d->height != d->src_height)) {
        int h = d->height, uv_off = d->stride * h;
        d->sws_scale = sws_getCachedContext(d->sws_scale, f->width, f->height, (enum AVPixelFormat)f->format, d->width,
                                            d->height, AV_PIX_FMT_NV12, SWS_BILINEAR, NULL, NULL, NULL);
        uint8_t *dst[2] = {o, o + uv_off};
        int dst_stride[2] = {d->stride, d->stride};
        sws_scale(d->sws_scale, (const uint8_t *const *)f->data, f->linesize, 0, f->height, dst, dst_stride);
        size = (uint32_t)(uv_off + d->stride * (h / 2));
    } else if (d->video) {
        int h = d->height, w = d->width, uv_off = d->stride * h;
        for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) memcpy(o + y * d->stride, f->data[0] + y * f->linesize[0], w);
        for (int y = 0; y < h / 2; y++) {  // interleave U and V into NV12
            uint8_t *uv = o + uv_off + y * d->stride;
            const uint8_t *u = f->data[1] + y * f->linesize[1], *v = f->data[2] + y * f->linesize[2];
            for (int x = 0; x < w / 2; x++) { uv[2 * x] = u[x]; uv[2 * x + 1] = v[x]; }
        }
        size = (uint32_t)(uv_off + d->stride * (h / 2));
    } else {
        // planar float -> interleaved s16
        int ch = f->ch_layout.nb_channels, n = f->nb_samples;
        int16_t *out = (int16_t *)o;
        if ((uint32_t)(n * ch * 2) > d->out_cap) n = (int)(d->out_cap / (ch * 2));
        // FFmpeg reorders Vorbis 5.1 to FL FR FC LFE BL BR; the game expects Vorbis order (FL FC FR BL BR LFE)
        // and reorders itself.
        static const int vorbis51[6] = {0, 2, 1, 4, 5, 3};
        bool native = ch == 6 && d->ctx->codec_id == AV_CODEC_ID_VORBIS;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int k = 0; k < ch; k++) {
                int src = native ? vorbis51[k] : k;
                float s = f->format == AV_SAMPLE_FMT_FLTP ? ((const float *)f->data[src])[i] : 0.0f;
                if (s > 1.0f) s = 1.0f;
                if (s < -1.0f) s = -1.0f;
                out[i * ch + k] = (int16_t)(s * 32767.0f);
            }
        size = (uint32_t)(n * ch * 2);
    }
    if (d->video && size && getenv("LARECOMP_MOVIE_TEST_FILL")) memset(o, atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_MOVIE_TEST_FILL")), size);
    if (d->video && size) {  // the game may wrap this buffer in textures: tell the renderer it changed
        extern void backend_pool_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);
        backend_pool_written((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)o, size);
    }
    d->out_busy[slot] = true;
    d->out_size[slot] = size;
    d->ready[d->nready++] = (OutReady){slot, time, flags};
    return true;
}

// Emit queued frames (and a pending end-of-stream marker) into free output slots.
static bool flush_pending(Decoder *d) {
    bool any = false;
    while (d->npending && emit_frame(d, d->pending[0], d->pending_time[0], 0)) {
        av_frame_free(&d->pending[0]);
        memmove(d->pending, d->pending + 1, (d->npending - 1) * sizeof d->pending[0]);
        memmove(d->pending_time, d->pending_time + 1, (d->npending - 1) * sizeof d->pending_time[0]);
        d->npending--;
        any = true;
    }
    if (!d->npending && d->eos_pending && emit_frame(d, NULL, d->eos_time, MOVIE_EOS)) {
        { static int nlog; if (nlog++ < 20) LOG("[movie] %s decoder: end of stream delivered\n", d->video ? "video" : "audio"); }
        d->eos_pending = false;
        any = true;
    }
    return any;
}

static void dec_send_input(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    n_send++;
    int idx = (int)c->x[1], off = (int)c->x[2], size = (int)c->x[3];
    int64_t time = (int64_t)c->x[4];
    uint32_t flags = (uint32_t)c->x[5];
    if (flags || size <= 0) {
        static int nlog;
        if (nlog++ < 12) LOG("[movie] %s SendInput size %d flags %#x\n", d->video ? "video" : "audio", size, flags);
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    if (size > 0 && idx >= 0 && idx < NIN) {
        av_packet_unref(d->pkt);
        d->pkt->data = d->in_mem[idx] + off;
        d->pkt->size = size;
        d->pkt->pts = time;
        avcodec_send_packet(d->ctx, d->pkt);
    }
    if (flags & MOVIE_EOS) avcodec_send_packet(d->ctx, NULL);
    bool produced = false;
    while (avcodec_receive_frame(d->ctx, d->frame) == 0) {
        int64_t t = d->frame->pts != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? d->frame->pts : time;
        // keep order: queue behind anything already pending
        if (d->npending || !emit_frame(d, d->frame, t, 0)) {
            if (d->npending < NPENDING) {
                d->pending[d->npending] = av_frame_clone(d->frame);
                d->pending_time[d->npending++] = t;
            } else {
                LOG("[movie] output queue full, dropping frame\n");
            }
        }
        n_frames++;
        produced = true;
    }
    if (flags & MOVIE_EOS) { d->eos_pending = true; d->eos_time = time; }
    produced |= flush_pending(d);
    if (idx >= 0 && idx < NIN) d->in_busy[idx] = false;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    dec_signal(c, d, 0);
    if (produced) dec_signal(c, d, 1);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_acquire_output(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    n_acq_out++;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    if (!d->nready) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock); c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    OutReady r = d->ready[0];
    memmove(d->ready, d->ready + 1, --d->nready * sizeof *d->ready);
    int remaining = d->nready;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    *(int32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = r.idx;
    if (c->x[2]) *(int64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2] = r.time;
    if (c->x[3]) *(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[3] = r.flags;
    if (c->x[4]) *(int32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[4] = remaining;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_get_output_buffer(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    n_get_out++;
    int i = (int)c->x[1];
    MBuffer *b = BUF(c->x[2]);
    if (i < 0 || i >= NOUT) { c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    if (d->video && getenv("LARECOMP_LOG_MOVIE_CALLERS")) {
        static int n;
        if (n++ < 4) {
            const uint64_t *p = b->base >= GUEST_LO && b->base < GUEST_HI ? (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)b->base : NULL;
            LOG("[movie] video GetOutputBuffer from %llx: base %llx cap %llx size %d | %llx %llx %llx %llx\n",
                (unsigned long long)c->x[30], (unsigned long long)b->base, (unsigned long long)b->capacity, b->size,
                p ? (unsigned long long)p[0] : 0ull, p ? (unsigned long long)p[1] : 0ull,
                p ? (unsigned long long)p[2] : 0ull, p ? (unsigned long long)p[3] : 0ull);
        }
    }
    if (d->video && b->base && b->capacity == 8) {
        // texture output mode: the buffer points at the game's NVNtexture; write RGBA into it
        NvnTexture *t = *(NvnTexture **)(uintptr_t)b->base;
        int w = d->width, h = d->height;
        if (!d->sws)
            d->sws = sws_getContext(w, h, AV_PIX_FMT_NV12, w, h, AV_PIX_FMT_RGBA, SWS_BILINEAR, NULL, NULL, NULL);
        if (!d->rgba) d->rgba = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
        const uint8_t *src[2] = {d->out_mem[i], d->out_mem[i] + d->stride * h};
        int src_stride[2] = {d->stride, d->stride};
        uint8_t *dst[1] = {d->rgba};
        int dst_stride[1] = {w * 4};
        sws_scale(d->sws, src, src_stride, 0, h, dst, dst_stride);
        renderer_upload_rgba(t, d->rgba, (uint32_t)w, (uint32_t)h, (uint32_t)w * 4);
        c->x[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (d->video && b->base >= GUEST_LO && b->base < GUEST_HI && b->capacity >= d->out_size[i]) {
        // Let's Go passes its own frame buffer (w * h * 3 / 2, tight NV12) and builds its Y / UV textures from it:
        // the frame is written there, not handed back as ours (that left the game's buffer zero: a green movie).
        memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)b->base, d->out_mem[i], d->out_size[i]);
        b->size = (int32_t)d->out_size[i];
        b->offset = 0;
        extern void backend_pool_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);
        backend_pool_written(b->base, d->out_size[i]);
        c->x[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    memset(b, 0, sizeof *b);
    b->base = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)d->out_mem[i];
    b->capacity = d->out_cap;
    b->size = (int32_t)d->out_size[i];
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_release_output(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    n_rel_out++;
    dec_signal(c, d, 0);  // input may be accepted again
    int i = (int)c->x[1];
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    if (i >= 0 && i < NOUT) d->out_busy[i] = false;
    bool produced = flush_pending(d);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    if (produced) dec_signal(c, d, 1);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_dtor(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    if (!d) { c->x[0] = 0; return; }
    dec_stop(c);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    if (d->ctx) avcodec_free_context(&d->ctx);
    for (int i = 0; i < NIN; i++) buf_put(d->in_mem[i], d->in_cap), d->in_mem[i] = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < NOUT; i++) buf_put(d->out_mem[i], d->out_cap), d->out_mem[i] = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < d->npending; i++) av_frame_free(&d->pending[i]);
    d->npending = d->nready = 0;
    av_frame_free(&d->frame);
    av_packet_free(&d->pkt);
    if (d->sws) sws_freeContext(d->sws), d->sws = NULL;
    if (d->sws_scale) sws_freeContext(d->sws_scale), d->sws_scale = NULL;
    free(d->rgba), d->rgba = NULL;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    movie_track(1, d, false);  // (d itself stays: the game's object may still point at it)
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// Reboot: close what a movie left open (decoder threads, the file), new vtables in the next boot's HLE heap.
RT_ON_RESET(movie_reset) {
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_MOVIE_OBJS; i++) {
        Extractor *e = g_movie_objs[0][i];
        if (e) ex_close(e);
        Decoder *d = g_movie_objs[1][i];
        if (d && d->ctx) avcodec_free_context(&d->ctx);
        g_movie_objs[0][i] = g_movie_objs[1][i] = NULL;
    }
    g_ex_vt = g_dec_vt = 0;
    g_nbuf_pool = 0;  // (the HLE heap and the game heap start over)
    g_movie_alloc_fn = g_movie_alloc_user = 0;
    g_skip_held = false, g_skip_pressed_at = 0;
}

static void dec_get_counts(Cpu *c) {  // slot 14: (int*, int64*) queried after Configure
    if (c->x[1]) *(int32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = 0;
    if (c->x[2]) *(int64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2] = 0;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

HLE_FUNC("_ZN5movie7DecoderC1ENS_11DecoderTypeENS_19DecoderOutputFormatENS_11DecoderModeEi", movie_decoder_ctor) {
    uint64_t vt = g_dec_vt;
    if (!vt) {
        HostFn f[19] = {dec_dtor, dec_dtor, dec_configure, dec_register_events, dec_get_output_format,
                        dec_start, dec_stop, ok, ok, dec_acquire_input, dec_get_input_buffer, dec_send_input,
                        dec_acquire_output, dec_get_output_buffer, dec_get_counts, dec_release_output, ok,
                        movie_log_slot, dec_get_output_buffer_format};
        vt = g_dec_vt = make_vtable(f, 19, "Decoder");
    }
    uint64_t *self = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0];
    Decoder *d = calloc(1, sizeof *d);
    movie_track(1, d, true);
    pthread_mutex_init(&d->lock, NULL);
    self[0] = vt;
    self[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)d;
}
```

`runtime/hle/pl.c`:

```c
// nn::pl shared system fonts. The Switch's system fonts are not part of the game; in order of preference:
//  1. LARECOMP_FONT=<file> (.ttf / .otf / .ttc face 0 / .bfttf)
//  2. a dump from the user's own console in fonts/: nintendo_udsg-r_std_003.bfttf (Standard, Morisawa UD Shin Go)
//     and nintendo_ext_003.bfttf (NintendoExt button glyphs); plain .ttf versions of those names also work
//  3. a Japanese gothic like UD Shin Go (much closer to the game's look than Arial): Hiragino Sans W4 on macOS,
//     Yu Gothic Regular / Medium on Windows
//  4. Arial
// .bfttf is the console's obfuscated TTF: 8-byte header (magic, size) then every u32 XORed with a fixed key.
// .ttc collections get face 0 copied out as a standalone font (the game's font engine wants one sfnt).
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <strings.h>

#include "../hle.h"

typedef struct { uint64_t addr, size; } Font;
static Font fonts[2];  // [0] Standard (every type), [1] NintendoExt when a dump provides it

static uint32_t be32(const uint8_t *p) { return (uint32_t)p[0] << 24 | p[1] << 16 | p[2] << 8 | p[3]; }
static void put32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v) { p[0] = v >> 24; p[1] = v >> 16; p[2] = v >> 8; p[3] = v; }

static uint8_t *read_file(const char *path, size_t *len) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    *len = (size_t)ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    uint8_t *p = malloc(*len + 4);
    if (fread(p, 1, *len, f) != *len) { free(p); p = NULL; }
    fclose(f);
    return p;
}

// .bfttf -> TTF in place (returns the new length, 0 if it isn't one)
static size_t bfttf_decode(uint8_t *d, size_t len) {
    static const uint32_t KEY = 0x49621806;
    if (len < 12) return 0;
    for (int swap = 0; swap < 2; swap++) {  // the key's byte order differs between descriptions; accept both
        uint32_t k = swap ? __builtin_bswap32(KEY) : KEY;
        uint32_t w0, w1, w2;
        memcpy(&w0, d, 4); memcpy(&w1, d + 4, 4); memcpy(&w2, d + 8, 4);
        uint32_t size = w1 ^ k, ver = w2 ^ k;
        if (size == 0 || size > len - 8 || (ver != 0x00000100u && ver != 0x4F54544Fu)) continue;  // sfnt 1.0 / OTTO
        (void)w0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i + 4 <= size; i += 4) {
            uint32_t w;
            memcpy(&w, d + 8 + i, 4);
            w ^= k;
            memcpy(d + i, &w, 4);
        }
        return size;
    }
    return 0;
}

// .ttc -> face 0 as its own sfnt (table data copied, offsets rewritten)
static uint8_t *ttc_face0(const uint8_t *f, size_t len, size_t *out_len) {
    if (len < 16 || memcmp(f, "ttcf", 4)) return NULL;
    uint32_t o = be32(f + 12);
    if (o + 12 > len) return NULL;
    uint32_t nt = (uint32_t)f[o + 4] << 8 | f[o + 5];
    size_t total = 12 + 16 * nt;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nt; i++) total += (be32(f + o + 12 + 16 * i + 12) + 3) & ~3u;
    uint8_t *out = calloc(1, total);
    memcpy(out, f + o, 12);
    size_t pos = 12 + 16 * nt;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nt; i++) {
        const uint8_t *e = f + o + 12 + 16 * i;
        uint32_t off = be32(e + 8), n = be32(e + 12);
        if ((size_t)off + n > len) { free(out); return NULL; }
        memcpy(out + 12 + 16 * i, e, 8);  // tag, checksum
        put32(out + 12 + 16 * i + 8, (uint32_t)pos);
        put32(out + 12 + 16 * i + 12, n);
        memcpy(out + pos, f + off, n);
        pos += (n + 3) & ~3u;
    }
    *out_len = total;
    return out;
}

static int load_one(const char *path, Font *ft) {
    size_t len;
    uint8_t *d = read_file(path, &len);
    if (!d) return 0;
    size_t n = strlen(path);
    if (n > 6 && !strcasecmp(path + n - 6, ".bfttf")) {
        len = bfttf_decode(d, len);
        if (!len) { LOG("[pl] %s: not a valid .bfttf\n", path); free(d); return 0; }
    } else if (len >= 4 && !memcmp(d, "ttcf", 4)) {
        size_t l2;
        uint8_t *f0 = ttc_face0(d, len, &l2);
        free(d);
        if (!f0) { LOG("[pl] %s: bad font collection\n", path); return 0; }
        d = f0;
        len = l2;
    }
    void *p = hle_alloc(len + 16);
    memcpy(p, d, len);
    free(d);
    ft->addr = (uint64_t)p;
    ft->size = len;
    LOG("[pl] system font %s (%zu bytes)\n", path, len);
    return 1;
}

static int g_fonts_loaded;
RT_ON_RESET(pl_reset) { g_fonts_loaded = 0; memset(fonts, 0, sizeof fonts); }  // (they were in the HLE heap)

static void load_fonts(void) {
    if (g_fonts_loaded) return;
    g_fonts_loaded = 1;
    const char *env = getenv("LARECOMP_FONT");
    const char *std[] = {env, "fonts/nintendo_udsg-r_std_003.bfttf", "fonts/nintendo_udsg-r_std_003.ttf",
                         "fonts/nintendo_udsgr_std_003.ttf", "fonts/nintendo_udsgr_std_003.bfttf",
                         "/System/Library/Fonts/ヒラギノ角ゴシック W4.ttc",
                         // Windows: Yu Gothic Medium and MS Gothic before Regular, whose face on some Windows 10
                         // builds crashes the game's font engine at boot (issue #1: c0000005 accessing 0x38)
                         "C:/Windows/Fonts/YuGothM.ttc", "C:/Windows/Fonts/msgothic.ttc", "C:/Windows/Fonts/YuGothR.ttc",
                         "/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf", "C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf",
                         "C:/Windows/Fonts/tahoma.ttf",
                         // Linux: DejaVu Sans (Debian / Ubuntu, Arch, Fedora). Not Noto Sans CJK: CFF outlines,
                         // which the game's font engine crashes on (it wants TrueType)
                         "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", "/usr/share/fonts/TTF/DejaVuSans.ttf",
                         "/usr/share/fonts/dejavu-sans-fonts/DejaVuSans.ttf"};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof std / sizeof *std && !fonts[0].addr; i++)
        if (std[i]) load_one(std[i], &fonts[0]);
    if (!fonts[0].addr) FATAL("no usable system font substitute\n");
    if (!load_one("fonts/nintendo_ext_003.bfttf", &fonts[1])) load_one("fonts/nintendo_ext_003.ttf", &fonts[1]);
}

// SharedFontType: 0 Standard, 1 ChineseSimple, 2 ChineseSimpleExt, 3 ChineseTraditional, 4 Korean, 5 NintendoExt
static const Font *font_for(uint64_t type) {
    load_fonts();
    return type == 5 && fonts[1].addr ? &fonts[1] : &fonts[0];
}

HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn2pl22GetSharedFontLoadStateENS0_14SharedFontTypeE", pl_get_load_state) { c->x[0] = 1; }
HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn2pl20GetSharedFontAddressENS0_14SharedFontTypeE", pl_get_address) { c->x[0] = font_for(c->x[0])->addr; }
HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn2pl17GetSharedFontSizeENS0_14SharedFontTypeE", pl_get_size) { c->x[0] = font_for(c->x[0])->size; }

```

`runtime/hle/swkbd.c`:

```c
// Software keyboard (naming Link on a new file, ...). On the Switch nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard launches the keyboard
// library applet; our am service has no applets, so the game crashed. ShowKeyboard is replaced here: the overlay
// (runtime/ui/menu.mm menu_keyboard_run) asks for the text - typed directly with a keyboard, an on-screen keyboard
// with a controller - while this (game) thread keeps re-presenting the last frame.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../hle.h"

int menu_keyboard_run(const char *initial, int max_len, char *out, int cap);  // runtime/ui/menu.mm

// nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard(nn::swkbd::String *out, const nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboardArg &arg) -> nn::Result
// String = {void *ptr; size_t bufSize}
// ShowKeyboardArg (probed 2026-10-08, naming Link): +0x3ac text max length, +0x3b0 min length, +0x3c0 / +0x3c4
// initial text offset / length (UTF-16) in the work buffer at +0x4d0. The game reads the answer as UTF-8.
HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn5swkbd12ShowKeyboardEPNS0_6StringERKNS0_15ShowKeyboardArgE", swkbd_show) {
    uint64_t out = c->x[0], arg = c->x[1];
    uint64_t ptr = LD64(out), size = LD64(out + 8);
    int max_len = (int)*(const int32_t *)(uintptr_t)(arg + 0x3ac);
    uint32_t off = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(arg + 0x3c0), n = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(arg + 0x3c4);
    uint64_t wb = LD64(arg + 0x4d0);
    char initial[96] = "";
    for (uint32_t i = 0; wb && i < n && i < sizeof initial - 1; i++) {
        uint16_t ch = *(const uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)(wb + off + 2 * i);
        initial[i] = ch < 0x80 ? (char)ch : '?';
    }
    char text[96];
    int ok = menu_keyboard_run(initial, max_len, text, sizeof text);
    if (!ok) snprintf(text, sizeof text, "%s", initial);  // cancelled: keep what was there
    LOG("[swkbd] name entry (max %d, initial \"%s\"): %s \"%s\"\n", max_len, initial, ok ? "entered" : "cancelled", text);
    if (ptr && size) {
        memset((void *)(uintptr_t)ptr, 0, size);
        if (getenv("LARECOMP_SWKBD_UTF8")) {  // (Link's Awakening read its answer as UTF-8)
            snprintf((char *)(uintptr_t)ptr, size, "%s", text);
        } else {
            // Let's Go reads UTF-16: "RRS" written as UTF-8 came back as U+5252 'S' ("?S" on screen). The text is
            // UTF-8 from the overlay: decode it and store UTF-16LE, NUL-terminated.
            uint16_t *o = (uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)ptr;
            uint64_t cap = size / 2, k = 0;
            for (const unsigned char *s = (const unsigned char *)text; *s && k + 1 < cap;) {
                uint32_t cp = *s++;
                int more = cp >= 0xF0 ? 3 : cp >= 0xE0 ? 2 : cp >= 0xC0 ? 1 : 0;
                if (more) cp &= 0x3F >> more;
                while (more-- && (*s & 0xC0) == 0x80) cp = (cp << 6) | (*s++ & 0x3F);
                if (cp >= 0x10000) {
                    if (k + 2 >= cap) break;
                    cp -= 0x10000;
                    o[k++] = (uint16_t)(0xD800 | (cp >> 10));
                    o[k++] = (uint16_t)(0xDC00 | (cp & 0x3FF));
                } else {
                    o[k++] = (uint16_t)cp;
                }
            }
            o[k] = 0;
        }
    }
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

```

`runtime/hle/vi.c`:

```c
// nn::vi (display/layer) and nv:: (graphics driver init), implemented on the host.
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "../hle.h"
#include "../kernel.h"

static uint32_t vsync_r, vsync_w;
static KEvent *vsync_event;
uint32_t vi_vsync_handle(void) { return vsync_r; }
volatile uint64_t g_vsync_count;  // vsyncs signalled so far (runtime/hle/framepace.c)
uint64_t g_native_window;

static void *vsync_thread(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    const uint64_t period = 16666667;
    plat_thread_realtime(period);
    uint64_t next = plat_now_ns();
    for (;;) {
        next += period;
        plat_sleep_until_ns(next);
        uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
        if (now > next + period * 3) {
            static int warned;
            if (warned++ < 20) LOG("[vi] vsync timer late by %llums (host throttling?)\n", (unsigned long long)((now - next) / 1000000));
            next = now;  // don't burst-signal to catch up
        }
        __atomic_add_fetch(&g_vsync_count, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_klock);
        kernel_signal(vsync_event);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_klock);
    }
    return NULL;
}

HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn2vi10InitializeEv", vi_initialize) { (void)c; }
HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn2vi8FinalizeEv", vi_finalize) { (void)c; }

HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn2vi18OpenDefaultDisplayEPPNS0_7DisplayE", vi_open_default_display) {
    *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0] = (uint64_t)hle_alloc(0x100);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn2vi12CloseDisplayEPNS0_7DisplayE", vi_close_display) { (void)c; }

HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn2vi11CreateLayerEPPNS0_5LayerEPNS0_7DisplayE", vi_create_layer) {
    *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0] = (uint64_t)hle_alloc(0x100);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn2vi12DestroyLayerEPNS0_5LayerE", vi_destroy_layer) { (void)c; }
HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn2vi12SetLayerCropEPNS0_5LayerEiiii", vi_set_layer_crop) { c->x[0] = 0; }
// Let's Go: how the layer fills the screen. The host window scales the image itself (output_scale.c).

    if (!g_native_window) g_native_window = (uint64_t)hle_alloc(0x100);
    *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0] = g_native_window;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// Reboot: the vsync timer and its event live on (the kernel's handle table doesn't): new handles at the next boot.
RT_ON_RESET(vi_reset) {
    vsync_r = vsync_w = 0;
    g_native_window = 0;  // (HLE heap)
}

HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn2vi20GetDisplayVsyncEventEPNS_2os15SystemEventTypeEPNS0_7DisplayE", vi_get_vsync_event) {
    if (!vsync_event) {
        vsync_event = kernel_create_event_pair(&vsync_w, &vsync_r);
        pthread_t t;
        pthread_create(&t, NULL, vsync_thread, NULL);
    } else if (!vsync_r) {
        vsync_w = kernel_new_handle(vsync_event);
        vsync_r = kernel_new_handle(vsync_event);
    }
    // nn::os::AttachReadableHandleToSystemEvent(event, handle, managed=false, clear_mode=AutoClear)
    c->x[1] = vsync_r;
    c->x[2] = 0;
    c->x[3] = 1;
    guest_call(c, guest_sym("_ZN2nn2os33AttachReadableHandleToSystemEventEPNS0_15SystemEventTypeEjbNS0_14EventClearModeE"));
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nv18InitializeGraphicsEPvm", nv_initialize_graphics) { (void)c; }
HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nv16FinalizeGraphicsEv", nv_finalize_graphics) { (void)c; }
HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nv20SetGraphicsAllocatorEPFPvmmS0_EPFvS0_S0_EPFS0_S0_mS0_ES0_", nv_set_allocator) { (void)c; }
HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nv28SetGraphicsDevtoolsAllocatorEPFPvmmS0_EPFvS0_S0_EPFS0_S0_mS0_ES0_", nv_set_dt_allocator) { (void)c; }
```

`runtime/hle/wildbattle.c`:

```c
// Wild battles (experimental, docs/MODO-BATALHA.md): touching a wild Pokémon starts a battle (the game's "static
// encounter" process: Snorlax, the legendary birds, Mewtwo) instead of the Pokémon GO-style capture.
//
// How the game does a static battle (docs/MODO-BATALHA.md, stage 3c): a script command builds a process of class A
// (factory f_700017f0a0, constructor f_7000289ac0, object of 0xA8 bytes) whose [+0x98] holds the battle's 64-bit hash;
// its state machine loads bin/script_event_data/event_encount.bin (0x40-byte records), looks the hash up
// (f_70002bad00(table, &key) -> parsed record of 0x59 bytes), fills the battle configuration from the record
// (f_70002f60c0) and starts the battle. Here:
//  - the capture's entry point (f_700028ef70: x0 = the process manager, x1 = the allocator) builds a class A process
//    through that factory instead of the capture scene;
//  - the constructor hook then writes our own hash in [+0x98];
//  - the lookup hook answers that hash with a record of our own: Snorlax's real record as the mould (so everything the
//    game keeps in it stays valid) with the species, level and moves replaced.
// LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE=1 turns it on. Test settings (until the touched Pokémon is read): LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_SPECIES=<n>
// (default 19), _LEVEL=<n> (3), _MOVES=<a,b,c,d> (33,45,0,0), _MAX=<n> (battles per run, default 1), _A6=1 (the "mode 3"
// flag of the process), _STATE_LOG=1 (log the process' state changes).
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "../hle.h"
#include "../settings.h"

void rt_register_fnhook(uint64_t addr, int (*fn)(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr));  // runtime/fnhook.c
void rt_call_original(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr);
uint64_t rt_addr(uint64_t eevee);  // runtime/fnhook.c: an Eevee 1.0.0 address in the running build (0: unknown build)
uint64_t renderer_game_frame(void);

#define ENCOUNTER_TRIGGER 0x7000305ad0ull  // a touched wild Pokémon (x0 = it, x1 -> the world's object): starts the capture
#define GOT_ALLOCATOR 0x70015faab8ull      // GOT slot -> pointer to the object holding the allocator at +0x68
#define CLASS_A_DTOR0 0x7000289f60ull
#define CLASS_A_DTOR1 0x7000289fd0ull
#define STATIC_FACTORY 0x700017f0a0ull  // (x0 manager, x1 allocator, x8 -> out handle): creates a class A process
#define STATIC_CTOR 0x7000289ac0ull     // class A constructor (x0 = the object)
#define TABLE_LOOKUP 0x70002bad00ull    // (x0 table, x1 -> u64 key) -> parsed record
#define SNORLAX_HASH 0x343e35139d576e27ull
#define WILD_HASH 0x57494c4442415454ull  // "WILDBATT": ours

static bool g_pending;  // the next class A constructor is ours
static int g_count, g_max = 1;
static int g_species = 19, g_level = 3, g_moves[4] = {33, 45, 0, 0};
static int g_a6;

#define R32(p, o) (*(volatile uint32_t *)((uintptr_t)(p) + (o)))
#define R8(p, o) (*(volatile uint8_t *)((uintptr_t)(p) + (o)))
#define R64(p, o) (*(volatile uint64_t *)((uintptr_t)(p) + (o)))

// The encounter trigger replaced whole: the game's own one starts the capture scene (f_700028ef70) and then keeps
// configuring the handle it gets back, which a battle process can't take. x1 -> [x1] -> [+0x68] is the process manager,
// [[*GOT 0x70015faab8]+0x68] the allocator (both as in the game's call to f_700028ef70).
static bool g_active;  // a static battle process of ours is alive: the touch that keeps calling the trigger is swallowed

// The touched Pokémon's own battle/capture configuration: the object (0x2b8 bytes) that f_70003058f0 builds from the wild Pokémon (species, form, level, nature,
// IVs, shiny...); the battle's configuration is the same kind of object, filled by f_70002f60c0 from a table record. So
// instead of trusting a hand-made record, the trigger keeps a copy of the real configuration and the hook on f_70002f60c0
// lays it over the record-built one (keeping the word at +0x298, which that function sets to 1 for a static battle).
// LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_USECFG=0 keeps the synthetic record (species / level from LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_*).
#define CFG_SIZE 0x2b8
#define CONFIG_FROM_RECORD 0x70002f60c0ull  // (x0 = configuration, x1 = record)
static uint8_t g_cfg[CFG_SIZE] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
static bool g_cfg_valid, g_usecfg;  // (off: copying the builder's configuration crashed; see docs/MODO-BATALHA.md)
static uint8_t g_rec[0x60] __attribute__((aligned(16)));  // (the synthetic record, below)

#define CONFIG_BUILD 0x70002f65d0ull         // (x0 = configuration object, x1 = allocator, x2 = struct, x8 = out): fills it
#define WILD_BUILDER_RETURN 0x7000305a98ull  // the return address of its call inside f_70003058f0, the wild Pokémon's builder
// f_70003058f0 runs in the same update as the trigger, right before it, so the last configuration it built is the touched
// Pokémon's: keep a copy (the species is the word at +0x58, as in the record-built one).
// Research (LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_LOGPOKE=1): the wild builder f_70003058f0 gets x1 -> holder -> P, the Pokémon's own object.
// Log what the game reads from it (species f_70002185d0, form f_70002186a0, and the raw fields the builder copies), to
// compare with what the capture screen shows (species name, level).
#define WILD_BUILDER 0x70003058f0ull
// What the builder reads from the touched Pokémon's object P (docs/MODO-BATALHA.md): species f_70002185d0(P), form
// f_70002186a0(P), level = byte P+0xf0c, IVs = six bytes P+0xf18, +0xf1c, ... +0xf2c, gender = word P+0x40c (0 male, 1 female,
// else none: the builder turns it into 1 / 2 / 0, the record's fixed-gender codes).
static bool g_wild_valid;
static uint32_t g_wild_species, g_wild_form, g_wild_level, g_wild_gender;
static int8_t g_wild_iv[6];
static bool g_explicit;  // LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_SPECIES given: that one, whatever was touched
static bool g_moves_given;  // LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_MOVES given: those moves, not the level-up ones
static int logpoke_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    (void)addr;
    uint64_t holder = c->x[1], p = R64(holder, 0);
    uint64_t save[32], lr = c->x[30], sp = c->sp;
    memcpy(save, c->x, sizeof save);
    c->x[0] = p;
    rt_call_original(c, 0x70002185d0ull);
    uint64_t species = c->x[0] & 0xffff;
    c->x[0] = p;
    rt_call_original(c, 0x70002186a0ull);
    uint64_t form = c->x[0] & 0xff;
    memcpy(c->x, save, sizeof save);
    c->x[30] = lr;
    c->sp = sp;
    g_wild_species = (uint32_t)species;
    g_wild_form = (uint32_t)form;
    g_wild_level = R8(p, 0xf0c);
    g_wild_gender = R32(p, 0x40c) == 0 ? 1 : R32(p, 0x40c) == 1 ? 2 : 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) g_wild_iv[i] = (int8_t)R8(p, 0xf18 + 4 * i);
    g_wild_valid = true;
    if (!getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_LOGPOKE")) return 0;
    LOG("[wild] f%llu builder: P %llx species %llu form %llu | +f0c %u +f10 %u +f12 %u | +f18..f2c %d %d %d %d %d %d | +40c %u +410 %u\n",
        (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame(), (unsigned long long)p, (unsigned long long)species, (unsigned long long)form,
        R8(p, 0xf0c), (unsigned)(*(volatile uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)(p + 0xf10)), (unsigned)(*(volatile uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)(p + 0xf12)),
        (int8_t)R8(p, 0xf18), (int8_t)R8(p, 0xf1c), (int8_t)R8(p, 0xf20), (int8_t)R8(p, 0xf24), (int8_t)R8(p, 0xf28), (int8_t)R8(p, 0xf2c),
        R32(p, 0x40c), R8(p, 0x410));
    if (atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_LOGPOKE")) >= 2) {   // the whole object, to find where the level lives by comparing with the capture screen (build/poke_<present>.bin)
        char path[96];
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "build/poke_%llu.bin", (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame());
        FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
        if (f) { fwrite((const void *)(uintptr_t)p, 1, 0x1100, f); fclose(f); }
    }
    return 0;  // (the builder runs)
}

static int build_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    if (c->x[30] != rt_addr(WILD_BUILDER_RETURN)) return 0;  // (another builder: the game's own)
    uint64_t cfg = c->x[0], lr = c->x[30];
    rt_call_original(c, addr);
    c->x[30] = lr;
    memcpy(g_cfg, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cfg, CFG_SIZE);
    g_cfg_valid = true;
    LOG("[wild] f%llu wild Pokémon's configuration %llx kept: species word +0x58 = %u, +0x54 = %u\n",
        (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame(), (unsigned long long)cfg, *(const uint32_t *)(g_cfg + 0x58), *(const uint32_t *)(g_cfg + 0x54));
    return 1;
}

static int config_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    uint64_t cfg = c->x[0], rec = c->x[1];
    if (rec != (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_rec) return 0;  // (a real record: the game's own)
    uint64_t lr = c->x[30];
    rt_call_original(c, addr);  // the configuration from our synthetic record
    c->x[30] = lr;
    if (g_usecfg && g_cfg_valid) {
        uint8_t from_rec[CFG_SIZE];
        memcpy(from_rec, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cfg, CFG_SIZE);
        int n = 0;
        for (int o = 0; o < CFG_SIZE; o += 4) {
            if (memcmp(from_rec + o, g_cfg + o, 4) && n++ < 90)
                LOG("[wild]   cfg +%03x: record-built %08x, real %08x\n", o, *(const uint32_t *)(from_rec + o), *(const uint32_t *)(g_cfg + o));
        }
        LOG("[wild] real configuration laid over the record's (%d words differ)\n", n);
        uint32_t keep = *(const uint32_t *)(from_rec + 0x298);
        memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)cfg, g_cfg, CFG_SIZE);
        *(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(cfg + 0x298) = keep;
    }
    return 1;
}

// Research: the game's own species / form accessors (f_70003058f0 reads them from [x22] to build the capture's
// configuration), tried on the objects the trigger gets, to find which one is the touched Pokémon's data.
static void probe_identity(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t cand[3] = {c->x[0], c->x[0] - 0x48, R64(c->x[2], 0)};
    const char *name[3] = {"x0", "x0-0x48", "*x2"};
    uint64_t lr = c->x[30], sp = c->sp, save[32];
    memcpy(save, c->x, sizeof save);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        c->x[0] = cand[i];
        rt_call_original(c, 0x70002185d0ull);
        uint64_t species = c->x[0] & 0xffff;
        c->x[0] = cand[i];
        rt_call_original(c, 0x70002186a0ull);
        uint64_t form = c->x[0] & 0xff;
        LOG("[wild]   probe %-8s %llx -> species %llu form %llu\n", name[i], (unsigned long long)cand[i], (unsigned long long)species,
            (unsigned long long)form);
    }
    memcpy(c->x, save, sizeof save);
    c->x[30] = lr;
    c->sp = sp;
}

// The game's own answers about the party, from inside the trigger (its arguments are kept). In the game's own words the
// "partner" is the Pokémon walking with the player and the "buddy" is the starter (Pikachu form 8 / Eevee form 1):
// f_70002462e0(0, &slot) is how the script native GetPartnerIndex_ (f_700019a040) finds the walking one's party slot
// (-1: none); the script natives PokePartyGetCount (f_7000197e90) and PokePartyIsBuddy (f_7000198b20) are called with a
// parameter block of their own ({size, arg}, 64-bit cells).
#define WALKING_SLOT 0x70002462e0ull
#define NATIVE_PARTY_COUNT 0x7000197e90ull
#define NATIVE_IS_BUDDY 0x7000198b20ull
static uint64_t party_call(Cpu *c, uint64_t fn, uint32_t arg, bool native, int *slot) {
    uint64_t keep[19], lr = c->x[30], sp = c->sp;
    memcpy(keep, c->x, sizeof keep);
    c->sp -= 0x20;
    if (native) R64(c->sp, 0x10) = 8, R64(c->sp, 0x18) = arg, c->x[0] = 0, c->x[1] = c->sp + 0x10;
    else R32(c->sp, 0x10) = 6, c->x[0] = arg, c->x[1] = c->sp + 0x10;
    rt_call_original(c, fn);
    uint64_t r = c->x[0];
    if (slot) *slot = (r & 1) ? (int)R32(c->sp, 0x10) : -1;
    memcpy(c->x, keep, sizeof keep);
    c->x[30] = lr, c->sp = sp;
    return r;
}

// Whether the starter itself is the one walking with the player (early in the game no other Pokémon does: issue #6).
// The battle sends the starter in with ee422.bseq (f_7000a88780 for the opening, f_7000a8ced0 for a switch), which moves
// the walking Pokémon's field model into the battle; with the starter walking alone, the static battle - the kind this
// mode starts - has none for it and the game stops (f_7000a9ddb0 reading a null pointer), whether the starter leads or
// is switched in. Nothing tried yet makes it work (docs/HISTORICO.md): such touches go to the game's own capture.
static bool starter_walks_alone(Cpu *c) {
    int walking;
    party_call(c, WALKING_SLOT, 0, false, &walking);
    int n = (int)(uint32_t)party_call(c, NATIVE_PARTY_COUNT, 0, true, NULL), starter = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n && i < 6; i++)
        if (party_call(c, NATIVE_IS_BUDDY, (uint32_t)i, true, NULL) & 1) { starter = i; break; }
    LOG("[wild] f%llu party: %d, walking with the player: slot %d, starter: slot %d\n", (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame(),
        n, walking, starter);
    return starter >= 0 && (walking == starter || walking < 0);
}

static int trigger_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    (void)addr;
    if (g_active) return 1;  // (swallowed: our battle is running)
    if (g_count >= g_max) return 0;  // (the game's capture runs)
    // The starter walking alone can't enter the static battle (issue #6, above): the game's own capture instead.
    // LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_STARTER=1 (research) battles anyway.
    if (!getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_STARTER") && starter_walks_alone(c)) {
        LOG("[wild] f%llu the starter walks alone with the player: the game's capture\n", (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame());
        return 0;
    }
    g_count++;
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_PROBE")) probe_identity(c);
    uint64_t lr = c->x[30];
    uint64_t mgr = R64(R64(c->x[1], 0), 0x68);
    uint64_t alloc = R64(R64(R64(GOT_ALLOCATOR, 0), 0), 0x68);
    LOG("[wild] f%llu encounter intercepted (pokemon obj %llx, manager %llx, allocator %llx): building the static battle process\n",
        (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame(), (unsigned long long)c->x[0], (unsigned long long)mgr, (unsigned long long)alloc);
    uint64_t out[2] = {0, 0};
    g_pending = true;
    g_active = true;
    c->x[0] = mgr;
    c->x[1] = alloc;
    c->x[8] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)out;
    extern void fps60_scene_begin(void);  // (runtime/hle/fps60.c: a battle, 30 fps without in-between images)
    fps60_scene_begin();
    rt_call_original(c, STATIC_FACTORY);
    g_pending = false;
    LOG("[wild] factory returned, handle %llx\n", (unsigned long long)out[0]);
    c->x[30] = lr;
    c->x[0] = 0;
    return 1;
}

// Research (LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_DEBUG=1): 240 presents after the battle's process is gone, dump the frame's render passes
// (build/pass_NNN.png) and every draw (the F9 request of the renderer): what a black screen after the battle is made of.
extern volatile int g_debug_frame_request;
static volatile long g_end_frame;  // the present the battle's process was destroyed in (fade-in timing)
static volatile long g_dbg_frame;  // the same, for the debug dump (which clears it)

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
static DWORD WINAPI debug_thread(LPVOID unused) {
    (void)unused;
    for (;;) {
        Sleep(50);
        if (g_dbg_frame && (long)renderer_game_frame() >= g_dbg_frame + 240) {
            LOG("[wild] f%llu debug dump requested\n", (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame());
            g_debug_frame_request = 1;
            g_dbg_frame = 0;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
#endif

// The game's screen fade (the script natives FadeIn_/FadeOut_, f_70001a7680 / f_70001a7860, end in these): the manager is
// [[*GOT 0x70015facf8]]. f_700011ece0(manager, 0, type, frames) fades in; f_700011ee50(manager, 0, type, ...) is the
// fade-out the object factories and FadeOut_ use. A script fades out before the battle and in after it; ours has no script,
// so (LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_FADEIN=1) the last fade-out's type is repeated as a fade-in some presents after the battle.
#define FADE_IN_FN 0x700011ece0ull
#define FADE_OUT_FN 0x700011ee50ull
#define GOT_FADE 0x70015facf8ull
#define WORLD_TICK 0x70002f78d0ull  // the world's update, every frame (the parent of f_70002f8bb0, which fps60.c hooks: one hook per address)
static int g_fade_type = 1, g_fade_seen;
static bool g_fadein_on = true;
static int g_fadein_delay = 30, g_fadein_frames = 10;
static bool g_fadein_done = true;

static int fade_log_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    LOG("[wild] f%llu fade %s: x1 %llx x2(type) %llx x3 %llx x4 %llx x5 %llx\n", (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame(),
        addr == rt_addr(FADE_IN_FN) ? "in " : "out", (unsigned long long)c->x[1], (unsigned long long)c->x[2], (unsigned long long)c->x[3],
        (unsigned long long)c->x[4], (unsigned long long)c->x[5]);
    if (addr == rt_addr(FADE_OUT_FN)) { g_fade_type = (int)c->x[2]; g_fade_seen = 1; }
    return 0;
}

static int field_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    (void)addr;
    if (!g_fadein_done && g_end_frame && (long)renderer_game_frame() >= g_end_frame + g_fadein_delay) {
        g_fadein_done = true;
        uint64_t save[32], lr = c->x[30], sp = c->sp;
        memcpy(save, c->x, sizeof save);
        c->x[0] = R64(R64(GOT_FADE, 0), 0);
        c->x[1] = 0;
        c->x[2] = (uint64_t)g_fade_type;
        c->x[3] = (uint64_t)g_fadein_frames;
        LOG("[wild] f%llu fading in by hand: manager %llx type %d frames %d (last fade-out %s)\n",
            (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame(), (unsigned long long)c->x[0], g_fade_type, g_fadein_frames, g_fade_seen ? "seen" : "NOT seen");
        rt_call_original(c, FADE_IN_FN);
        memcpy(c->x, save, sizeof save);
        c->x[30] = lr;
        c->sp = sp;
    }
    return 0;  // (the world's update runs)
}

static int dtor_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    LOG("[wild] f%llu class A object %llx destroyed\n", (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame(), (unsigned long long)c->x[0]);
    g_active = false;
    g_end_frame = g_dbg_frame = (long)renderer_game_frame();
    if (g_fadein_on) g_fadein_done = false;
    (void)addr;
    return 0;
}

static int ctor_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    uint64_t lr = c->x[30], self = c->x[0];
    rt_call_original(c, addr);
    if (g_pending) {
        g_pending = false;
        R64(self, 0x98) = WILD_HASH;
        // as the script native CallWildBattle (f_700017e440) sets them after the factory: hash, a0 = a1 = 0, a2 = 1,
        // a3..a5 = !(flag bits 3, 1, 2) of the script's flags argument (0 here: all 1), a6 = 0 unless a special case
        // (the constructor's defaults are a0 = a1 = 1, a2 = 0 and would be wrong). LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_RAWCTOR=1 keeps them.
        if (!getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_RAWCTOR")) {
            R8(self, 0xa0) = 0;
            R8(self, 0xa1) = 0;
            R8(self, 0xa2) = 1;
            R8(self, 0xa3) = 1;
            R8(self, 0xa4) = 1;
            R8(self, 0xa5) = 1;
            R8(self, 0xa6) = 0;
        }
        if (g_a6) R8(self, 0xa6) = 1;
        LOG("[wild] class A object %llx: hash %llx, flags a0..a5 %02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x a6 %02x, state %u\n", (unsigned long long)self,
            (unsigned long long)R64(self, 0x98), R8(self, 0xa0), R8(self, 0xa1), R8(self, 0xa2), R8(self, 0xa3), R8(self, 0xa4),
            R8(self, 0xa5), R8(self, 0xa6), R32(self, 0x68));
    }
    c->x[30] = lr;
    return 1;
}

// the parsed record (f_70002bab70): +0 hash, +8 species, +0xc form, +0xd level, +0x10 shiny, +0x14 gender, +0x18 nature,
// +0x20/+0x28 text references, +0x30 ability, +0x34..+0x40 moves (u32), +0x44/+0x46 V1/V2, +0x48 IVs, +0x4e EVs,
// +0x54..+0x58 stat boosts
static void log_record(const char *what, const uint8_t *r) {
    uint32_t sp = *(const uint32_t *)(r + 8);
    LOG("[wild] %s: hash %llx species %u form %u level %u shiny %u gender %u nature %u ability %u moves %u,%u,%u,%u\n", what,
        (unsigned long long)*(const uint64_t *)r, sp, r[0xc], r[0xd], *(const uint32_t *)(r + 0x10), *(const uint32_t *)(r + 0x14),
        *(const uint32_t *)(r + 0x18), *(const uint32_t *)(r + 0x30), *(const uint32_t *)(r + 0x34), *(const uint32_t *)(r + 0x38),
        *(const uint32_t *)(r + 0x3c), *(const uint32_t *)(r + 0x40));
}

// Level-up moves from the game's own table: bin/archive/waza_oboe.gfpak (a GFLXPACK, docs/MODO-BATALHA.md) holds one file per
// species (the file's index is the species number): (move u16, level u16) pairs in level order, ended by 0xFFFFFFFF. A wild
// Pokémon knows the last four it learns up to its level. Read from the romfs image, the pack parsed once (header: u32 files at
// +0x10, i64 file-table offset at +0x18; 0x18-byte entries: type u8 at +2 (2 = LZ4 block), u32 sizes at +4 / +8, u32 offset at +0x10).
bool romfs_image_file(const char *path, int *fd, uint64_t *off, uint64_t *size);  // runtime/services/fs.c

static bool lz4_block(const uint8_t *in, size_t n, uint8_t *out, size_t outsz) {
    size_t i = 0, o = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        uint8_t t = in[i++];
        size_t lit = t >> 4;
        if (lit == 15) { uint8_t b; do { if (i >= n) return false; b = in[i++]; lit += b; } while (b == 255); }
        if (i + lit > n || o + lit > outsz) return false;
        memcpy(out + o, in + i, lit);
        i += lit, o += lit;
        if (i >= n) break;
        if (i + 2 > n) return false;
        size_t off = in[i] | ((size_t)in[i + 1] << 8), ml = t & 15;
        i += 2;
        if (ml == 15) { uint8_t b; do { if (i >= n) return false; b = in[i++]; ml += b; } while (b == 255); }
        ml += 4;
        if (!off || off > o || o + ml > outsz) return false;
        for (size_t k = 0; k < ml; k++, o++) out[o] = out[o - off];
    }
    return o == outsz;
}

static uint8_t *g_pack;
static size_t g_pack_size;
static bool g_pack_tried;

static bool learnset_pack(void) {
    if (g_pack_tried) return g_pack != NULL;
    g_pack_tried = true;
    int fd;
    uint64_t off, size;
    if (!romfs_image_file("bin/archive/waza_oboe.gfpak", &fd, &off, &size) || size < 0x40 || size > (64u << 20)) return false;
    uint8_t *b = malloc((size_t)size);
    if (!b || pread(fd, b, (size_t)size, (off_t)off) != (ssize_t)size) { free(b); return false; }
    g_pack = b, g_pack_size = (size_t)size;
    return true;
}

// The moves a Pokémon of this species and level knows (moves[4], 0 = empty). False: the table wasn't readable.
static bool learnset_moves(uint32_t species, uint32_t level, int moves[4]) {
    if (!learnset_pack()) return false;
    uint32_t nfiles = *(const uint32_t *)(g_pack + 0x10);
    uint64_t tab = *(const uint64_t *)(g_pack + 0x18);
    if (species >= nfiles || tab + (uint64_t)0x18 * nfiles > g_pack_size) return false;
    const uint8_t *e = g_pack + tab + (uint64_t)0x18 * species;
    uint32_t szd = *(const uint32_t *)(e + 4), szc = *(const uint32_t *)(e + 8), poff = *(const uint32_t *)(e + 0x10);
    if (e[2] != 2 || szd > 4096 || (uint64_t)poff + szc > g_pack_size) return false;
    uint8_t buf[4096];
    if (!lz4_block(g_pack + poff, szc, buf, szd)) return false;
    int n = 0, learned[64];
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 4 <= szd && n < 64; i += 4) {
        uint16_t mv = *(const uint16_t *)(buf + i), lv = *(const uint16_t *)(buf + i + 2);
        if (mv == 0xffff && lv == 0xffff) break;
        if (lv > level) continue;
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) if (learned[k] == mv) goto have;  // (already known: it keeps its place)
        learned[n++] = mv;
    have:;
    }
    int first = n > 4 ? n - 4 : 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) moves[k] = first + k < n ? learned[first + k] : 0;
    return n > 0;
}

static int lookup_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    uint64_t key = R64(c->x[1], 0);
    if (key != WILD_HASH) return 0;  // (a real lookup)
    uint64_t lr = c->x[30], sk = SNORLAX_HASH;
    c->x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&sk;
    rt_call_original(c, addr);  // the real Snorlax record: the mould
    uint64_t rec = c->x[0];
    c->x[30] = lr;
    memcpy(g_rec, (const void *)(uintptr_t)rec, sizeof g_rec);
    log_record("mould (Snorlax)", g_rec);
    *(uint64_t *)g_rec = WILD_HASH;
    if (g_wild_valid && !g_explicit) {  // the touched Pokémon's own data
        *(uint32_t *)(g_rec + 8) = g_wild_species;
        g_rec[0xc] = (uint8_t)g_wild_form;
        g_rec[0xd] = (uint8_t)g_wild_level;
        *(uint32_t *)(g_rec + 0x14) = g_wild_gender;
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) g_rec[0x48 + i] = (uint8_t)g_wild_iv[i];
        int mv[4];
        if (!g_moves_given && learnset_moves(g_wild_species, g_wild_level, mv)) memcpy(g_moves, mv, sizeof mv);
    } else {
        *(uint32_t *)(g_rec + 8) = (uint32_t)g_species;
        g_rec[0xc] = 0;
        g_rec[0xd] = (uint8_t)g_level;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) *(uint32_t *)(g_rec + 0x34 + 4 * i) = (uint32_t)g_moves[i];
    memset(g_rec + 0x54, 0, 5);  // no stat boosts
    log_record("answering with", g_rec);
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_rec;
    return 1;
}

// research: the process' state changes (the switch of f_7000289b40 reads [obj+0x68])
static int state_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    static uint32_t last = 0xffffffff;
    uint32_t st = R32(c->x[0], 0x68);
    if (st != last) {
        last = st;
        LOG("[wild] f%llu process %llx state %u\n", (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame(), (unsigned long long)c->x[0], st);
    }
    (void)addr;
    return 0;
}

// Before each boot (runtime/main.c): the launcher's "Wild battles (experimental)" (larecomp.ini wild_battle = 1) turns the
// mode on when LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE doesn't say otherwise. The research variables (docs/DEPURACAO.md) tune it.
void wildbattle_configure(void) {
    static bool hooked;
    extern void settings_load(void);
    settings_load();  // (read once; without the launcher it would come later, in boot)
    const char *e = getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE");
    bool on = e && *e ? atoi(e) != 0 : g_settings.wild_battle;
    if (!rt_addr(ENCOUNTER_TRIGGER)) on = false;  // (a build runtime/fnhook.c doesn't know: these functions are elsewhere)
    if (!on || hooked) return;
    hooked = true;
    g_max = 1 << 30;  // every touch (the test runs set LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_MAX)
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_SPECIES")) { g_species = atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_SPECIES")); g_explicit = true; }
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_LEVEL")) g_level = atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_LEVEL"));
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_MAX")) g_max = atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_MAX"));
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_A6")) g_a6 = atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_A6"));
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_MOVES")) {
        g_moves_given = true;
        char buf[64];
        snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s", getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_MOVES"));
        int n = 0;
        for (char *t = strtok(buf, ","); t && n < 4; t = strtok(NULL, ",")) g_moves[n++] = atoi(t);
        for (; n < 4; n++) g_moves[n] = 0;
    }
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_FADEIN")) g_fadein_on = atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_FADEIN")) != 0;
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_FADE_TYPE")) { g_fade_type = atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_FADE_TYPE")); g_fade_seen = 1; }
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_FADE_DELAY")) g_fadein_delay = atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_FADE_DELAY"));
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_FADE_FRAMES")) g_fadein_frames = atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_FADE_FRAMES"));
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_USECFG")) g_usecfg = atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_USECFG")) != 0;
    rt_register_fnhook(ENCOUNTER_TRIGGER, trigger_hook);
    rt_register_fnhook(CLASS_A_DTOR0, dtor_hook);
    rt_register_fnhook(CLASS_A_DTOR1, dtor_hook);
    rt_register_fnhook(FADE_IN_FN, fade_log_hook);
    rt_register_fnhook(FADE_OUT_FN, fade_log_hook);
    if (g_fadein_on) rt_register_fnhook(WORLD_TICK, field_hook);
    rt_register_fnhook(STATIC_CTOR, ctor_hook);
    rt_register_fnhook(TABLE_LOOKUP, lookup_hook);
    if (g_usecfg) { rt_register_fnhook(CONFIG_FROM_RECORD, config_hook); rt_register_fnhook(CONFIG_BUILD, build_hook); }
    rt_register_fnhook(WILD_BUILDER, logpoke_hook);
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_STATE_LOG")) rt_register_fnhook(0x7000289b40ull, state_hook);
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_DEBUG")) CreateThread(NULL, 0, debug_thread, NULL, 0, NULL);
#endif
    LOG("[wild] on: the touched Pokémon's own species and level%s (max %d battle(s))\n", g_explicit ? " (a fixed one: LARECOMP_WILDBATTLE_SPECIES)" : "", g_max);
}
```
