`runtime/main.c`:

```c
// LAS Recomp entry: load modules, set up the kernel, run nn::init::Start on the main thread.
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gamelib.h"
#include "gamesetup.h"
#include "paths.h"
#include "settings.h"
#include "hle.h"
#include "kernel.h"

const char *g_romfs_dir;

// rtld normally passes these to nn::init::Start: run every module's init/fini arrays.
static void run_array(Cpu *c, uint64_t arr, uint64_t size) {
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < size / 8; i++) {
        uint64_t fn = ((uint64_t *)arr)[i];
        if (fn) guest_call(c, fn);
    }
}

// nn::init::Start calls x2 right after nnosInitialize and x3 after nninitStartup, just before
// nnMain: SDK constructors run early, the game's run once nninitStartup has set up its heap.
// rtld runs a module's DT_INIT, which registers it (and its TLS template) with musl via
// __nnmusl_init_dso and then runs its init_array; fall back to the array if there is no DT_INIT.
static void module_init(Cpu *c, Module *m) {
    LOG("init %s (DT_INIT %llx, %llu init_array entries)\n", m->name, m->init, m->init_array_sz / 8);
    if (m->init) guest_call(c, m->init);
    else run_array(c, m->init_array, m->init_array_sz);
}

static void rtld_init_sdk(Cpu *c) {  // the SDK, then the subsdk modules that link against it
    for (int i = 1; i < g_nmodules; i++) module_init(c, &g_modules[i]);
}
static void rtld_init_main(Cpu *c) { module_init(c, &g_modules[0]); }

// Claim the guest address range before anything else can map there. The host allocator places
// regions at random addresses in the same window; on a collision, re-exec for a fresh layout.
__attribute__((constructor(101))) static void reserve_guest_space(void) {
    plat_watch_writes(HEAP_BASE);  // (the heap's written pages: vertex data the GPU ring keeps from one frame to the next, exec.c)
    if (plat_reserve_guest(GUEST_LO, GUEST_HI)) return;
    const char *tries = getenv("LARECOMP_REEXEC");
    int n = tries ? atoi(tries) : 0;
    if (n >= 20) {
        fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: guest address range %llx-%llx is not free\n", GUEST_LO, GUEST_HI);
        exit(1);
    }
    char buf[16];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%d", n + 1);
    setenv("LARECOMP_REEXEC", buf, 1);
    plat_exec(NULL);
    perror("re-exec");
    exit(1);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ boot / in-place reboot
// Switching seeds (or vanilla) and going back to the start screen reboot the game inside this process: the window,
// GPU device, settings and shader caches stay. rt_request_reboot (menu, any thread) makes ui_run return on the
// main thread, which then: stops every guest thread (kernel_stop_threads: each unwinds at its next svc / HLE call /
// wait), resets the renderer (textures, address-keyed caches) and all per-boot host state (RT_ON_RESET hooks:
// services, HLE features, seed data, audio), empties the kernel, wipes guest memory, and boots again.
static _Atomic int g_reboot;
void rt_request_reboot(int kind) {
    LOG("[reboot] requested (%s)\n", kind == RT_REBOOT_TITLE ? "start screen" : "boot");
    g_reboot = kind;
}
int rt_reboot_requested(void) { return g_reboot; }

// LARECOMP_REBOOT_AT=<frame>:<seed | vanilla | title>[,...] (test): at that presented frame, switch to the seed /
// vanilla in place, or go back to the start screen (with LARECOMP_LAUNCHER_AUTOPLAY it plays the saved choice).
// Frames count on across reboots. Called by the presenter every frame.
void reboot_test_frame(uint64_t frame) {
    static const char *next;
    static int init;
    if (!init) { init = 1; next = getenv("LARECOMP_REBOOT_AT"); }
    long at;
    char what[128];
    if (!next || !*next || sscanf(next, "%ld:%127[^,]", &at, what) != 2 || (long)frame < at) return;
    next = strchr(next, ',');
    if (next) next++;
    if (!strcmp(what, "title")) { rt_request_reboot(RT_REBOOT_TITLE); return; }
    rt_request_reboot(RT_REBOOT_GAME);
}

#ifdef __APPLE__
extern const ResetFn __start_resets[] __asm__("section$start$__DATA$__rt_reset");
extern const ResetFn __stop_resets[] __asm__("section$end$__DATA$__rt_reset");
#elif defined(__linux__)
extern const ResetFn __start_resets[], __stop_resets[];  // (ELF: defined by the linker)
#else
// PE/COFF: .rst$a < .rst$m (entries, hle.h) < .rst$z (the linker sorts by the text after '$')
__attribute__((section(".rst$a"), used)) static const ResetFn __start_resets[1];
__attribute__((section(".rst$z"), used)) static const ResetFn __stop_resets[1];
#endif

void backend_reset(void);             // renderer: GPU idle, game textures and address-keyed caches dropped
void backend_guest_memory_reset(void);  // renderer: guest memory was replaced (re-wrap the heap)
void backend_clear_window(void);      // a black frame while the game is down

static void reboot_idle(void) {  // (main thread, while guest threads stop) keep the window alive
    SDL_Event e;
    while (SDL_PollEvent(&e))
        if (e.type == SDL_EVENT_QUIT) { LOG("window closed\n"); exit(0); }
}

static void teardown(void) {
    uint64_t t0 = plat_now_ns();
    kernel_stop_threads(reboot_idle);
    backend_clear_window();
    backend_reset();
    const ResetFn *start = __start_resets, *stop = __stop_resets;
    __asm__("" : "+r"(start), "+r"(stop));  // separate objects: keep the compiler from reasoning about them
    int n = 0;
    for (const ResetFn *p = start; p < stop; p++)
        if (*p) { (*p)(); n++; }
    kernel_reset();
    if (!plat_reset_guest(GUEST_LO, GUEST_HI)) FATAL("cannot reset guest memory\n");
    backend_guest_memory_reset();
    g_nmodules = 0;
    g_reboot = RT_REBOOT_NONE;
    LOG("[reboot] game torn down in %llums (%d reset hooks)\n", (unsigned long long)((plat_now_ns() - t0) / 1000000), n);
}

static void boot(const char *root) {
    char exefs[1024], romfs[1024], npdm_path[1024];
    snprintf(exefs, sizeof exefs, "%s/exefs", root);
    snprintf(romfs, sizeof romfs, "%s/romfs", root);
    snprintf(npdm_path, sizeof npdm_path, "%s/main.npdm", exefs);
    if (!g_romfs_dir) g_romfs_dir = strdup(romfs);

    char why[512];
    if (!gamelib_load(root, why, sizeof why)) FATAL("%s\n", why);
    loader_load(exefs);
    { extern void settings_load(void); settings_load(); }
    kernel_init();
    dispatch_init();

    uint32_t stack_size = 0x100000;
    int prio = 44;
    FILE *f = fopen(npdm_path, "rb");
    if (f) {
        uint8_t meta[0x80];
        if (fread(meta, 1, sizeof meta, f) == sizeof meta && !memcmp(meta, "META", 4)) {
            prio = meta[0xE];
            stack_size = *(uint32_t *)(meta + 0x1C);
            uint8_t aci[0x18];  // ACI0 (offset at META+0x70): the program id at +0x10 (svcGetInfo 18)
            if (!fseek(f, *(uint32_t *)(meta + 0x70), SEEK_SET) && fread(aci, 1, sizeof aci, f) == sizeof aci &&
                !memcmp(aci, "ACI0", 4))
                g_program_id = *(uint64_t *)(aci + 0x10);
        }
        fclose(f);
    }
    LOG("main thread: prio %d, stack 0x%x, program id %016llx\n", prio, stack_size, (unsigned long long)g_program_id);

    uint64_t start = loader_find_symbol("_ZN2nn4init5StartEmmPFvvES2_");
    if (!start) FATAL("nn::init::Start not found\n");
    uint64_t init_fn = hle_register("<rtld_init_sdk>", rtld_init_sdk);
    uint64_t fini_fn = hle_register("<rtld_init_main>", rtld_init_main);
    KThread *t = kernel_create_main_thread(start, stack_size, prio);
    kernel_run_main(t, t->handle, 0, init_fn, fini_fn);  // nn::init::Start(thread_handle, args_region, init, fini)
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    plat_init();
#ifdef _WIN32
    setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IONBF, 0);  // the Windows CRT treats _IOLBF as full buffering
#else
    setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IOLBF, 0);
#endif
    const char *root = "extracted";  // (in the data root)
    bool skip_launcher = getenv("LARECOMP_NO_LAUNCHER") || getenv("LARECOMP_INPUT");  // tests boot straight in
    static char arg_root[1024];
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--play")) skip_launcher = true;
        else if (argv[i][0] != '-' && !realpath(argv[i], arg_root)) root = argv[i];  // (relative to where we started)
        else if (argv[i][0] != '-') root = arg_root;
    }
    rt_paths_init();  // the data root becomes the working directory (runtime/paths.h)
    for (bool title = !skip_launcher;;) {
        if (title) {  // start screen: resolution, fullscreen, anti-aliasing, translation, keys (runtime/ui/launcher_lg.mm)
            extern void launcher_lg_run(const char *root);
            launcher_lg_run(root);
        }
        {  // (runtime/fnhook.c: the runtime's hooks, in the address tables of the known builds)
            extern void rt_fnhook_set_build(int build);
            char exefs[1100];
            snprintf(exefs, sizeof exefs, "%s/exefs", root);
            int build = game_build(exefs);
            rt_fnhook_set_build(build);
            extern const char *g_game_version;  // (runtime/services/am.c)
            g_game_version = game_version(exefs);
            if (build == GAME_BUILD_OTHER) LOG("[boot] %s: a build without address tables, 60 fps, wild battles and the controller skip stay off\n", exefs);
        }
        { extern void fps60_configure(void); fps60_configure(); }  // (runtime/hle/fps60.c: the launcher's 60 fps option)
        { extern void wildbattle_configure(void); wildbattle_configure(); }  // (runtime/hle/wildbattle.c: the wild battles option)
        { extern void controller_skip_configure(void); controller_skip_configure(); }  // (runtime/hle/controller_skip.c)
        { extern void cutscene_configure(void); cutscene_configure(); }  // (runtime/hle/cutscene.c)
        boot(root);
        int kind = ui_run();  // window and input on the main thread; returns when a reboot is requested
        teardown();
        title = kind == RT_REBOOT_TITLE;
    }
}
```

`runtime/mods.c`:

```c
// Mods: LayeredFS-style replacement files and the game's language (runtime/mods.h). The RomFS reader
// (runtime/services/fs.c) asks mod_romfs_override for every file of the image and serves the mod's copy instead, and
// adds the files a mod has that the game hasn't.
#include "mods.h"

#include <dirent.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>

#include "gamesetup.h"
#include "hle.h"
#include "paths.h"
#include "platform.h"
#include "romfs_build.h"
#include "settings.h"

static bool is_dir(const char *p) {
    struct stat sb;
    return !stat(p, &sb) && S_ISDIR(sb.st_mode);
}

// The romfs/ folder inside dir, up to `depth` levels down (a download unpacked with its own folders around it). Packs
// made for both games (atmosphere/titles/<Pikachu>/ and <Eevee>/) are searched under the set-up game's title id first.
#define EEVEE_TITLE "0100187003A36000"
#define PIKACHU_TITLE "010003F003A34000"
static bool find_romfs(const char *dir, int depth, char *out, size_t cap) {
    char p[1024];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/romfs", dir);  // (RomFs / romfs: Windows names ignore case)
    if (is_dir(p)) { snprintf(out, cap, "%s", p); return true; }
    if (depth <= 0) return false;
    const char *name = game_name("extracted/exefs");
    bool pikachu = name && !strcmp(name, "Pikachu");
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", dir, pikachu ? PIKACHU_TITLE : EEVEE_TITLE);
    if (is_dir(p) && find_romfs(p, depth - 1, out, cap)) return true;
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", dir, pikachu ? EEVEE_TITLE : PIKACHU_TITLE);
    if (is_dir(p) && find_romfs(p, depth - 1, out, cap)) return true;
    DIR *d = opendir(dir);
    if (!d) return false;
    bool found = false;
    for (struct dirent *e; !found && (e = readdir(d));) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", dir, e->d_name);
        if (is_dir(p)) found = find_romfs(p, depth - 1, out, cap);
    }
    closedir(d);
    return found;
}

int mods_list(char names[][128], int max) {
    DIR *d = opendir("mods");
    if (!d) return 0;
    int n = 0;
    char p[1024], r[1024];
    for (struct dirent *e; n < max && (e = readdir(d));) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "mods/%s", e->d_name);
        if (is_dir(p) && find_romfs(p, 4, r, sizeof r)) snprintf(names[n++], 128, "%s", e->d_name);
    }
    closedir(d);
    return n;
}

const char *mods_dir_abs(void) {
    static char p[1100];
    mkdir("mods", 0755);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/mods", rt_data_root());
    return p;
}

static const char *romfs_of(const char *name) {
    static char cached_name[128], dir[1024];
    static bool ok;
    if (!name || !*name) return NULL;
    if (strcmp(name, cached_name)) {
        snprintf(cached_name, sizeof cached_name, "%s", name);
        char p[1024];
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "mods/%s", name);
        ok = find_romfs(p, 4, dir, sizeof dir);  // (the active ones are logged by active_dirs)
    }
    return ok ? dir : NULL;
}

// The active mods' romfs/ folders, made again when g_settings.mod changes
static char g_dirs[MODS_MAX][1024], g_dirs_of[sizeof g_settings.mod];
static int g_ndirs = -1;
static void active_dirs(void) {
    if (g_ndirs >= 0 && !strcmp(g_dirs_of, g_settings.mod)) return;
    snprintf(g_dirs_of, sizeof g_dirs_of, "%s", g_settings.mod);
    g_ndirs = 0;
    char list[sizeof g_settings.mod];
    snprintf(list, sizeof list, "%s", g_settings.mod);
    for (char *save = NULL, *name = strtok_r(list, "|", &save); name && g_ndirs < MODS_MAX; name = strtok_r(NULL, "|", &save)) {
        while (*name == ' ') name++;
        char p[1024];
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "mods/%s", name);
        if (*name && find_romfs(p, 4, g_dirs[g_ndirs], sizeof g_dirs[0])) LOG("[mods] %d: %s: %s\n", g_ndirs, name, g_dirs[g_ndirs]), g_ndirs++;
        else if (*name) LOG("[mods] %s: no romfs/ folder found under mods/%s\n", name, name);
    }
}

int mod_romfs_dirs(const char **out, int max) {
    active_dirs();
    int n = 0;
    for (; n < g_ndirs && n < max; n++) out[n] = g_dirs[n];
    return n;
}

bool mod_romfs_override(const char *path, char *out, size_t cap) {
    active_dirs();
    struct stat sb;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ndirs; i++) {
        snprintf(out, cap, "%s/%s", g_dirs[i], path);
        if (!stat(out, &sb) && S_ISREG(sb.st_mode)) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// bin/message/<folder> -> language code
static const struct { const char *folder, *code; } k_msg_langs[] = {
    {"English", "en-US"}, {"Spanish", "es"},  {"French", "fr"},          {"German", "de"},         {"Italian", "it"},
    {"JPN", "ja"},        {"Korean", "ko"},   {"Simp_Chinese", "zh-CN"}, {"Trad_Chinese", "zh-TW"},
};

const char *mod_language(const char *name) {
    const char *root = romfs_of(name);
    if (!root) return NULL;
    const char *found = NULL;
    char p[1100];
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof k_msg_langs / sizeof k_msg_langs[0]; i++) {
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/bin/message/%s", root, k_msg_langs[i].folder);
        if (!is_dir(p)) continue;
        if (found) return NULL;  // several languages: the player's choice stands
        found = k_msg_langs[i].code;
    }
    return found;
}

const char *game_language(void) {
    char list[sizeof g_settings.mod];
    snprintf(list, sizeof list, "%s", g_settings.mod);
    for (char *save = NULL, *name = strtok_r(list, "|", &save); name; name = strtok_r(NULL, "|", &save)) {
        static char lang[16];  // (mod_language's answer lives in a table: copied out of the loop's buffer anyway)
        const char *m = mod_language(name);
        if (m) { snprintf(lang, sizeof lang, "%s", m); return lang; }
    }
    return g_settings.game_lang[0] ? g_settings.game_lang : "en-US";
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ installing a mod (the start screen's button)
static void rm_tree(const char *p) {  // (only ever called on folders under mods/)
    DIR *d = opendir(p);
    if (!d) { remove(p); return; }
    char c[1100];
    for (struct dirent *e; (e = readdir(d));) {
        if (!strcmp(e->d_name, ".") || !strcmp(e->d_name, "..")) continue;
        snprintf(c, sizeof c, "%s/%s", p, e->d_name);
        if (is_dir(c)) rm_tree(c);
        else remove(c);
    }
    closedir(d);
    rmdir(p);
}

static _Atomic int g_install_state;
static char g_install_src[1024], g_install_name[128];
int mod_install_state(void) { return g_install_state; }
const char *mod_install_name(void) { return g_install_name; }

static void *install_thread(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    const char *src = g_install_src, *base = src;
    for (const char *c = src; *c; c++) if (*c == '/' || *c == '\\') base = c + 1;
    // the name: the file / folder name without its extension, letters, digits, spaces, '-' and '.' only
    char name[128];
    int n = 0;
    for (const char *c = base; *c && n < 60; c++) {
        unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)*c;
        name[n++] = (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') || (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || ch == '-' || ch == ' ' || ch == '.' ? (char)ch : '_';
    }
    name[n] = 0;
    char *dot = strrchr(name, '.');
    if (dot && !is_dir(src)) *dot = 0;
    while (n && name[strlen(name) - 1] == ' ') name[strlen(name) - 1] = 0;
    if (!name[0]) snprintf(name, sizeof name, "mod");
    mkdir("mods", 0755);
    const char *root = src;
    if (!is_dir(src)) {  // an archive: Windows' own tar (libarchive: .zip, .rar, .7z) into mods/.install
        rm_tree("mods/.install");
        mkdir("mods/.install", 0755);
        char tar[600];
        const char *sys = getenv("SystemRoot");
        snprintf(tar, sizeof tar, "%s\\System32\\tar.exe", sys ? sys : "C:\\Windows");
        const char *argv[] = {tar, "-xf", src, "-C", "mods/.install", NULL};
        PlatProc p = plat_spawn(argv, "mods/.install.log", false);
        int r = p ? plat_proc_wait(p, true) : -1;
        remove("mods/.install.log");
        if (r != 0) { LOG("[mods] couldn't unpack %s (tar %d)\n", src, r); g_install_state = MOD_INSTALL_FAIL_UNPACK; goto done; }
        root = "mods/.install";
    }
    {
        char romfs[1024];
        if (!find_romfs(root, 6, romfs, sizeof romfs)) { g_install_state = MOD_INSTALL_FAIL_NOT_MOD; goto done; }
        char dst[300];
        snprintf(dst, sizeof dst, "mods/%s", name);
        if (is_dir(dst)) rm_tree(dst);
        mkdir(dst, 0755);
        strlcat(dst, "/romfs", sizeof dst);
        if (!romfs_copy_tree(romfs, dst, NULL)) { g_install_state = MOD_INSTALL_FAIL_UNPACK; goto done; }
        snprintf(g_install_name, sizeof g_install_name, "%s", name);
        LOG("[mods] installed %s from %s\n", name, src);
        g_install_state = MOD_INSTALL_DONE;
    }
done:
    rm_tree("mods/.install");
    return NULL;
}

void mod_install_start(const char *src) {
    if (g_install_state == MOD_INSTALL_RUNNING) return;
    snprintf(g_install_src, sizeof g_install_src, "%s", src);
    g_install_name[0] = 0;
    g_install_state = MOD_INSTALL_RUNNING;
    pthread_t t;
    pthread_create(&t, NULL, install_thread, NULL);
    pthread_detach(t);
}
```

`runtime/mods.h`:

```h
// Mods: game files replaced or added from a folder, as Atmosphere's LayeredFS (fan translations, textures, models come
// this way; mods of the game's code - exefs, IPS patches, cheats - can't apply to the recompiled code), and the game's
// language. runtime/mods.c; the start screen's Mods tab (runtime/ui/launcher_lg.mm) picks the active ones: several at
// once, in order - where two replace the same file, the first one's wins (g_settings.mod: "<name>|<name>...").
//
```

```c
// decode bit for bit (the decode_unorm8 path its CLI uses for -dl / -ds into 8-bit images):
//   endpoints expand to 16 bits (linear: v * 257, sRGB: v << 8 | 0x80, all four channels),
//   texel = (e0 * (64 - w) + e1 * w + 32) >> 6, output = top 8 bits.
// Error blocks (illegal encodings, HDR void extents) -> magenta; HDR endpoint modes -> magenta

_Static_assert(sizeof wunq_data == 142 && sizeof cunq_data == 936, "unquantization table size");

// ---- bits ----

typedef struct { uint64_t lo, hi; } Bits128;

static inline uint64_t load64(const uint8_t *p) {
    uint64_t v = 0;
    for (int i = 7; i >= 0; i--) v = v << 8 | p[i];
    return v;
}

// n (<= 32) bits at pos; bits past 127 read as zero.
static inline uint32_t rbits(const Bits128 *b, int pos, int n) {
    if (n == 0 || pos >= 128) return 0;
    uint64_t v;
    if (pos >= 64) v = b->hi >> (pos - 64);
    else if (pos == 0) v = b->lo;
    else v = b->lo >> pos | b->hi << (64 - pos);
    return (uint32_t)(v & ((1ull << n) - 1));
}

static inline uint64_t bitrev64(uint64_t v) {
    v = (v >> 1 & 0x5555555555555555ull) | (v & 0x5555555555555555ull) << 1;
    v = (v >> 2 & 0x3333333333333333ull) | (v & 0x3333333333333333ull) << 2;
    v = (v >> 4 & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0Full) | (v & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0Full) << 4;
    v = (v >> 8 & 0x00FF00FF00FF00FFull) | (v & 0x00FF00FF00FF00FFull) << 8;
    v = (v >> 16 & 0x0000FFFF0000FFFFull) | (v & 0x0000FFFF0000FFFFull) << 16;
    return v >> 32 | v << 32;
}

// ---- integer sequence encoding ----

static int ise_bitcount(int count, int q) {
    int n = count * q_bits[q];
    if (q_trits[q]) n += (8 * count + 4) / 5;
    if (q_quints[q]) n += (7 * count + 2) / 3;
    return n;
}

static void trits_of(uint32_t T, int t[5]) {
    uint32_t C;
    if ((T >> 2 & 7) == 7) {
        C = (T >> 5 & 7) << 2 | (T & 3);
        t[4] = t[3] = 2;
    } else {
        C = T & 0x1F;
        if ((T >> 5 & 3) == 3) { t[4] = 2; t[3] = T >> 7 & 1; }
        else { t[4] = T >> 7 & 1; t[3] = T >> 5 & 3; }
    }
    if ((C & 3) == 3) {
        t[2] = 2; t[1] = C >> 4 & 1;
        t[0] = (C >> 3 & 1) << 1 | ((C >> 2 & 1) & ~(C >> 3) & 1);
    } else if ((C >> 2 & 3) == 3) {
        t[2] = 2; t[1] = 2; t[0] = C & 3;
    } else {
        t[2] = C >> 4 & 1; t[1] = C >> 2 & 3;
        t[0] = (C >> 1 & 1) << 1 | ((C & 1) & ~(C >> 1) & 1);
    }
}

static void quints_of(uint32_t Q, int q[3]) {
    if ((Q >> 1 & 3) == 3 && (Q >> 5 & 3) == 0) {
        uint32_t q0 = Q & 1;
        q[2] = (int)(q0 << 2 | ((Q >> 4 & 1) & ~q0 & 1) << 1 | ((Q >> 3 & 1) & ~q0 & 1));
        q[1] = q[0] = 4;
        return;
    }
    uint32_t C;
    if ((Q >> 1 & 3) == 3) { q[2] = 4; C = (Q >> 3 & 3) << 3 | (~(Q >> 5) & 3) << 1 | (Q & 1); }
    else { q[2] = Q >> 5 & 3; C = Q & 0x1F; }
    if ((C & 7) == 5) { q[1] = 4; q[0] = C >> 3 & 3; }
    else { q[1] = C >> 3 & 3; q[0] = C & 7; }
}

// Decodes count raw ISE values (tq << bits | bits) starting at bit pos.
static void ise_decode(const Bits128 *b, int pos, int count, int q, uint8_t *out) {
    int nb = q_bits[q];
    if (q_trits[q]) {
        static const uint8_t tb[5] = {2, 2, 1, 2, 1}, ts[5] = {0, 2, 4, 5, 7};
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i += 5) {
            uint32_t m[5], T = 0;
            int k = 0, t[5];
            for (; k < 5 && i + k < count; k++) {
                m[k] = rbits(b, pos, nb); pos += nb;
                T |= rbits(b, pos, tb[k]) << ts[k]; pos += tb[k];
            }
            trits_of(T, t);
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) out[i + j] = (uint8_t)((uint32_t)t[j] << nb | m[j]);
        }
    } else if (q_quints[q]) {
        static const uint8_t qb[3] = {3, 2, 2}, qs[3] = {0, 3, 5};
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i += 3) {
            uint32_t m[3], Q = 0;
            int k = 0, v[3];
            for (; k < 3 && i + k < count; k++) {
                m[k] = rbits(b, pos, nb); pos += nb;
                Q |= rbits(b, pos, qb[k]) << qs[k]; pos += qb[k];
            }
            quints_of(Q, v);
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) out[i + j] = (uint8_t)((uint32_t)v[j] << nb | m[j]);
        }
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++, pos += nb) out[i] = (uint8_t)rbits(b, pos, nb);
    }
}

// ---- block mode ----

typedef struct { int wx, wy, dual, quant, wbits; } BlockMode;

static bool block_mode_2d(uint32_t m, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, BlockMode *bm) {
    uint32_t r = m >> 4 & 1, h = m >> 9 & 1, d = m >> 10 & 1, a = m >> 5 & 3;
    int wx, wy;
    if (m & 3) {
        r |= (m & 3) << 1;
        uint32_t b = m >> 7 & 3;
        switch (m >> 2 & 3) {
        case 0: wx = b + 4; wy = a + 2; break;
        case 1: wx = b + 8; wy = a + 2; break;
        case 2: wx = a + 2; wy = b + 8; break;
        default:
            b &= 1;
            if (m & 0x100) { wx = b + 2; wy = a + 2; }
            else { wx = a + 2; wy = b + 6; }
            break;
        }
    } else {
        r |= (m >> 2 & 3) << 1;
        if ((m >> 2 & 3) == 0) return false;
        uint32_t b = m >> 9 & 3;
        switch (m >> 7 & 3) {
        case 0: wx = 12; wy = a + 2; break;
        case 1: wx = a + 2; wy = 12; break;
        case 2: wx = a + 6; wy = b + 6; d = 0; h = 0; break;
        default:
            if (a == 0) { wx = 6; wy = 10; }
            else if (a == 1) { wx = 10; wy = 6; }
            else return false;
            break;
        }
    }
    int count = wx * wy * (int)(d + 1);
    bm->wx = wx; bm->wy = wy; bm->dual = (int)d;
    bm->quant = (int)(r - 2 + 6 * h);
    bm->wbits = ise_bitcount(count, bm->quant);
    return count <= 64 && bm->wbits >= 24 && bm->wbits <= 96 && wx <= (int)bw && wy <= (int)bh;
}

// ---- partitions ----

static uint32_t hash52(uint32_t p) {
    p ^= p >> 15; p -= p << 17; p += p << 7; p += p << 4;
    p ^= p >> 5;  p += p << 16; p ^= p >> 7; p ^= p >> 3;
    p ^= p << 6;  p ^= p >> 17;
    return p;
}

typedef struct { int s[8]; uint32_t r[4]; int count; } PartSel;

static void part_init(PartSel *ps, int seed, int count) {
    seed += (count - 1) * 1024;
    uint32_t rnum = hash52((uint32_t)seed);
    int s[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { int v = (int)(rnum >> (4 * i) & 0xF); s[i] = v * v; }
    int sh1, sh2;
    if (seed & 1) { sh1 = seed & 2 ? 4 : 5; sh2 = count == 3 ? 6 : 5; }
    else { sh1 = count == 3 ? 6 : 5; sh2 = seed & 2 ? 4 : 5; }
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) ps->s[i] = s[i] >> (i & 1 ? sh2 : sh1);
    ps->r[0] = rnum >> 14; ps->r[1] = rnum >> 10; ps->r[2] = rnum >> 6; ps->r[3] = rnum >> 2;
    ps->count = count;
}

static inline int part_of(const PartSel *ps, int x, int y) {
    // z = 0 for 2D, so seeds 9..12 drop out
    int a = (int)((uint32_t)(ps->s[0] * x + ps->s[1] * y) + ps->r[0]) & 0x3F;
    int b = (int)((uint32_t)(ps->s[2] * x + ps->s[3] * y) + ps->r[1]) & 0x3F;
    int c = ps->count >= 3 ? (int)((uint32_t)(ps->s[4] * x + ps->s[5] * y) + ps->r[2]) & 0x3F : 0;
    int d = ps->count >= 4 ? (int)((uint32_t)(ps->s[6] * x + ps->s[7] * y) + ps->r[3]) & 0x3F : 0;
    if (a >= b && a >= c && a >= d) return 0;
    if (b >= c && b >= d) return 1;
    if (c >= d) return 2;
    return 3;
}

// ---- colour endpoints ----

static inline int clamp255(int v) { return v < 0 ? 0 : v > 255 ? 255 : v; }

// e[0..3] endpoint 0, e[4..7] endpoint 1 (8-bit). Returns false for an HDR mode.
static bool unpack_endpoints(int cem, const uint8_t *v, int e0[4], int e1[4]) {
    switch (cem) {
    case 0:  // L direct
        e0[0] = e0[1] = e0[2] = v[0]; e1[0] = e1[1] = e1[2] = v[1];
        e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        return true;
    case 1: {  // L delta
        int l0 = v[0] >> 2 | (v[1] & 0xC0);
        int l1 = l0 + (v[1] & 0x3F);
        if (l1 > 255) l1 = 255;
        e0[0] = e0[1] = e0[2] = l0; e1[0] = e1[1] = e1[2] = l1;
        e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        return true;
    }
    case 4:  // LA direct
        e0[0] = e0[1] = e0[2] = v[0]; e1[0] = e1[1] = e1[2] = v[1];
        e0[3] = v[2]; e1[3] = v[3];
        return true;
    case 5: {  // LA delta
        int l0 = v[0], l1 = v[1], a0 = v[2], a1 = v[3];
        l0 |= (l1 & 0x80) << 1; a0 |= (a1 & 0x80) << 1;
        l1 &= 0x7F; a1 &= 0x7F;
        if (l1 & 0x40) l1 -= 0x80;
        if (a1 & 0x40) a1 -= 0x80;
        l0 >>= 1; a0 >>= 1; l1 >>= 1; a1 >>= 1;  // arithmetic shift of the signed deltas
        l1 = clamp255(l1 + l0); a1 = clamp255(a1 + a0);
        e0[0] = e0[1] = e0[2] = l0; e1[0] = e1[1] = e1[2] = l1;
        e0[3] = a0; e1[3] = a1;
        return true;
    }
    case 6:  // RGB scale
    case 10: {  // RGB scale + two alphas
        int s = v[3];
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { e1[c] = v[c]; e0[c] = v[c] * s >> 8; }
        if (cem == 6) e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        else { e0[3] = v[4]; e1[3] = v[5]; }
        return true;
    }
    case 8:  // RGB(A) direct
    case 12: {
        int a[4] = {v[0], v[2], v[4], cem == 12 ? v[6] : 0};
        int b[4] = {v[1], v[3], v[5], cem == 12 ? v[7] : 0};
        if (a[0] + a[1] + a[2] > b[0] + b[1] + b[2]) {  // blue contraction: swap + uncontract
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = b[c]; e1[c] = a[c]; }
            e0[0] = (e0[0] + e0[2]) >> 1; e0[1] = (e0[1] + e0[2]) >> 1;
            e1[0] = (e1[0] + e1[2]) >> 1; e1[1] = (e1[1] + e1[2]) >> 1;
        } else {
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = a[c]; e1[c] = b[c]; }
        }
        if (cem == 8) e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        return true;
    }
    case 9:  // RGB(A) base + delta
    case 13: {
        int n = cem == 13 ? 4 : 3;
        int a[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0}, b[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
        for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
            int base = v[2 * c], delta = v[2 * c + 1];
            a[c] = base >> 1 | (delta & 0x80);
            b[c] = delta >> 1 & 0x3F;
            if (b[c] & 0x20) b[c] -= 0x40;
        }
        int sum = b[0] + b[1] + b[2];
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) b[c] += a[c];
        if (sum < 0) {  // swap + uncontract
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = b[c]; e1[c] = a[c]; }
            e0[0] = (e0[0] + e0[2]) >> 1; e0[1] = (e0[1] + e0[2]) >> 1;
            e1[0] = (e1[0] + e1[2]) >> 1; e1[1] = (e1[1] + e1[2]) >> 1;
        } else {
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = a[c]; e1[c] = b[c]; }
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = clamp255(e0[c]); e1[c] = clamp255(e1[c]); }
        if (cem == 9) e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        return true;
    }
    default:  // 2, 3, 7, 11, 14, 15: HDR
        return false;
    }
}

// ---- block ----

static void fill_error(uint8_t *out, int texels) {
    for (int i = 0; i < texels; i++) {
        out[4 * i + 0] = 0xFF; out[4 * i + 1] = 0x00; out[4 * i + 2] = 0xFF; out[4 * i + 3] = 0xFF;
    }
}

bool astc_decode_block(const uint8_t block[16], uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb, uint8_t *out) {
    if (bw < 4 || bh < 4 || bw > 12 || bh > 12) return false;  // not an ASTC 2D footprint
    int texels = (int)(bw * bh);
    Bits128 b = {load64(block), load64(block + 8)};
    uint32_t mode = (uint32_t)(b.lo & 0x7FF);

    if ((mode & 0x1FF) == 0x1FC) {  // void extent
        if (mode & 0x200) goto error;           // HDR (fp16) constant: error in LDR
        if ((b.lo >> 10 & 3) != 3) goto error;  // reserved bits
        uint32_t s0 = rbits(&b, 12, 13), s1 = rbits(&b, 25, 13);
        uint32_t t0 = rbits(&b, 38, 13), t1 = rbits(&b, 51, 13);
        bool all_ones = s0 == 0x1FFF && s1 == 0x1FFF && t0 == 0x1FFF && t1 == 0x1FFF;
        if ((s0 >= s1 || t0 >= t1) && !all_ones) goto error;
        uint8_t c[4] = {block[9], block[11], block[13], block[15]};  // top 8 bits of the UNORM16s
        for (int i = 0; i < texels; i++) memcpy(out + 4 * i, c, 4);
        return true;
    }

    BlockMode bm;
    if (!block_mode_2d(mode, bw, bh, &bm)) goto error;
    int pcount = (int)(b.lo >> 11 & 3) + 1;
    int wcount = bm.wx * bm.wy;

    // Weights, read backwards from the top of the block.
    uint8_t raw[64];
    Bits128 rev = {bitrev64(b.hi), bitrev64(b.lo)};
    ise_decode(&rev, 0, wcount << bm.dual, bm.quant, raw);
    if (bm.dual && pcount == 4) goto error;

    const uint8_t *wt = wunq_data + wunq_off[bm.quant];
    uint8_t grid[2][80];
    memset(grid, 0, sizeof grid);
    if (bm.dual) {
        for (int i = 0; i < wcount; i++) { grid[0][i] = wt[raw[2 * i]]; grid[1][i] = wt[raw[2 * i + 1]]; }
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < wcount; i++) grid[0][i] = wt[raw[i]];
    }

    // Colour endpoint modes.
    int cem[4];
    int below = 128 - bm.wbits, high = 0;
    if (pcount == 1) {
        cem[0] = (int)(b.lo >> 13 & 0xF);
    } else {
        high = 3 * pcount - 4;
        below -= high;
        uint32_t enc = (uint32_t)(b.lo >> 23 & 0x3F) | rbits(&b, below, high) << 6;
        uint32_t base = enc & 3;
        if (base == 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i < pcount; i++) cem[i] = (int)(enc >> 2 & 0xF);
            below += high;
            high = 0;
        } else {
            base--;
            for (int i = 0; i < pcount; i++) cem[i] = (int)(((enc >> (2 + i) & 1) + base) << 2);
            for (int i = 0; i < pcount; i++) cem[i] |= (int)(enc >> (2 + pcount + 2 * i) & 3);
        }
    }
    int ccount = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < pcount; i++) ccount += ((cem[i] >> 2) + 1) * 2;
    if (ccount > 18) goto error;
    int cbits = (pcount == 1 ? 111 : 99) - bm.wbits - high - (bm.dual ? 2 : 0);
    if (cbits < 0) cbits = 0;
    int cq = -1;
    for (int q = 20; q >= 0; q--) {
        if (ise_bitcount(ccount, q) <= cbits) { cq = q; break; }
    }
    if (cq < QUANT_6) goto error;
    uint8_t cv[18];
    ise_decode(&b, pcount == 1 ? 17 : 29, ccount, cq, cv);
    if (cq != QUANT_256) {
        const uint8_t *ct = cunq_data + cunq_off[cq - QUANT_6];
        for (int i = 0; i < ccount; i++) cv[i] = ct[cv[i]];
    }
    int ccs = bm.dual ? (int)rbits(&b, below - 2, 2) : -1;

    // Endpoints, expanded to 16 bits.
    int ep[4][2][4];
    for (int p = 0, k = 0; p < pcount; p++) {
        int *e0 = ep[p][0], *e1 = ep[p][1];
        if (!unpack_endpoints(cem[p], cv + k, e0, e1)) {
            static const int magenta[4] = {0xFF, 0x00, 0xFF, 0xFF};
            memcpy(e0, magenta, sizeof magenta);
            memcpy(e1, magenta, sizeof magenta);
        }
        k += ((cem[p] >> 2) + 1) * 2;
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
            e0[c] = srgb ? e0[c] << 8 | 0x80 : e0[c] * 257;
            e1[c] = srgb ? e1[c] << 8 | 0x80 : e1[c] * 257;
        }
    }

    // Weight grid -> texel weights (bilinear infill), per axis.
    int xi[12], xf[12], yi[12], yf[12];
    for (uint32_t x = 0; x < bw; x++) {
        int v = (int)(((1024 + bw / 2) / (bw - 1)) * x * (uint32_t)(bm.wx - 1) + 32) >> 6;
        xi[x] = v >> 4; xf[x] = v & 0xF;
    }
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < bh; y++) {
        int v = (int)(((1024 + bh / 2) / (bh - 1)) * y * (uint32_t)(bm.wy - 1) + 32) >> 6;
        yi[y] = (v >> 4) * bm.wx; yf[y] = v & 0xF;
    }

    PartSel ps = {0};
    if (pcount > 1) part_init(&ps, (int)(b.lo >> 13 & 0x3FF), pcount);
    int small = texels < 32;

    uint8_t *o = out;
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < bh; y++) {
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < bw; x++, o += 4) {
            int fs = xf[x], ft = yf[y];
            int w11 = (fs * ft + 8) >> 4, w10 = fs - w11, w01 = ft - w11, w00 = 16 - fs - ft + w11;
            int i0 = yi[y] + xi[x];
            int w[2];
            for (int pl = 0; pl <= bm.dual; pl++) {
                const uint8_t *g = grid[pl];
                w[pl] = (g[i0] * w00 + g[i0 + 1] * w10 + g[i0 + bm.wx] * w01 + g[i0 + bm.wx + 1] * w11 + 8) >> 4;
            }
            int p = pcount > 1 ? part_of(&ps, small ? (int)x << 1 : (int)x, small ? (int)y << 1 : (int)y) : 0;
            const int *e0 = ep[p][0], *e1 = ep[p][1];
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                int wc = c == ccs ? w[1] : w[0];
                o[c] = (uint8_t)((e0[c] * (64 - wc) + e1[c] * wc + 32) >> 14);  // >> 6, then top 8 bits
            }
        }
    }
    return true;

error:
    fill_error(out, texels);
    return false;
}

void astc_decode_ldr(const uint8_t *blocks, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh,
                     bool srgb, uint8_t *rgba_out) {
    if (bw < 4 || bh < 4 || bw > 12 || bh > 12) return;
    uint32_t bx = (width + bw - 1) / bw, by = (height + bh - 1) / bh;
    uint8_t tmp[12 * 12 * 4];
    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < by; j++) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < bx; i++) {
            const uint8_t *src = blocks + 16 * ((size_t)j * bx + i);
            uint32_t x0 = i * bw, y0 = j * bh;
            uint32_t cw = width - x0 < bw ? width - x0 : bw, ch = height - y0 < bh ? height - y0 : bh;
            // decode in place when the block's rows are contiguous in the output
            uint8_t *dst = width == bw && ch == bh ? rgba_out + (size_t)y0 * width * 4 : tmp;
            astc_decode_block(src, bw, bh, srgb, dst);
            if (dst == tmp) {
                for (uint32_t y = 0; y < ch; y++)
                    memcpy(rgba_out + ((size_t)(y0 + y) * width + x0) * 4, tmp + y * bw * 4, cw * 4);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`runtime/nvn/astc.h`:

```h
// ASTC LDR decoder (2D blocks) to RGBA8, for GPUs without native ASTC (desktop NVIDIA / AMD).
// Bit-exact with ARM astcenc's 8-bit (decode_unorm8) decode, -dl (srgb = false) / -ds (srgb = true).
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

// blocks: row-major 16-byte blocks covering ceil(width/bw) x ceil(height/bh).
// rgba_out: width*height*4 bytes, tightly packed rows. Values are the 8-bit UNORM results (no sRGB
// -> linear conversion; srgb only selects the sRGB endpoint expansion, which changes rounding).
// Error / illegal blocks and HDR content decode to magenta (FF 00 FF FF).
void astc_decode_ldr(const uint8_t *blocks, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh,
                     bool srgb, uint8_t *rgba_out);

// One block -> bw*bh*4 bytes (rows of bw texels). Returns false for an error block (output magenta).
bool astc_decode_block(const uint8_t block[16], uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb, uint8_t *rgba_out);
```

`runtime/nvn/cmdbuf.c`:

```c
// NVN command buffers: commands are recorded into the guest-provided command memory as CmdRec
// records, so the game's own memory management and out-of-memory callbacks work as designed.
// A command handle is the guest address of a list's first record.
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "nvn.h"

#define JUMP_RESERVE (sizeof(CmdRec) + 8)

static NvnCmdBuf *cb_of(uint64_t guest) { return HOST(NvnCmdBuf, guest); }

NVN(nvnCommandBufferInitialize) {
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = calloc(1, sizeof *cb);
    cb->guest = A(0);
    SET_HOST(A(0), cb);
    RET(1);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferFinalize) { free(cb_of(A(0))); SET_HOST(A(0), 0); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferSetDebugLabel) { (void)c; }

static CmdRec *raw_rec(uint64_t at, uint32_t op, uint32_t size) {
    CmdRec *r = (CmdRec *)(uintptr_t)at;
    memset(r, 0, sizeof *r);
    r->op = op;
    r->size = size;
    return r;
}

NVN(nvnCommandBufferAddCommandMemory) {
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    uint64_t mem = HOST(NvnPool, A(1))->storage + A(2), size = A(3);
    if (cb->recording && cb->mem) {
        // chain the list being recorded into the new chunk
        CmdRec *j = raw_rec(cb->mem + cb->used, CMD_JUMP, sizeof(CmdRec));
        j->x[0] = mem;
    }
    cb->mem = mem;
    cb->size = size;
    cb->used = 0;
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferAddControlMemory) { (void)c; }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetCommandMemorySize) { RET(cb_of(A(0))->size); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetCommandMemoryUsed) { RET(cb_of(A(0))->used); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetCommandMemoryFree) {
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    RET(cb->size > cb->used + JUMP_RESERVE ? cb->size - cb->used - JUMP_RESERVE : 0);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetControlMemorySize) { RET(0x10000); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetControlMemoryUsed) { RET(0); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetControlMemoryFree) { RET(0x10000); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferSetMemoryCallback) { cb_of(A(0))->callback = A(1); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetMemoryCallback) { RET(cb_of(A(0))->callback); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferSetMemoryCallbackData) { cb_of(A(0))->callback_data = A(1); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetMemoryCallbackData) { RET(cb_of(A(0))->callback_data); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferSetCommandMemoryCallbackEnabled) { (void)c; }

// Reserve a record. May call back into the guest for more memory, so callers snapshot their
// arguments first.
static CmdRec *rec(Cpu *c, NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint32_t op, uint32_t extra) {
    uint32_t size = (uint32_t)((sizeof(CmdRec) + extra + 7) & ~7u);
    for (int tries = 0; !cb->mem || cb->used + size + JUMP_RESERVE > cb->size; tries++) {
        if (!cb->callback || tries == 2) FATAL("nvn: out of command memory (need %u)\n", size);
        uint64_t saved[8];
        memcpy(saved, c->x, sizeof saved);
        c->x[0] = cb->guest;
        c->x[1] = 0;  // NVN_COMMAND_BUFFER_MEMORY_EVENT_OUT_OF_COMMAND_MEMORY
        c->x[2] = size + JUMP_RESERVE;
        c->x[3] = cb->callback_data;
        guest_call(c, cb->callback);
        memcpy(c->x, saved, sizeof saved);
    }
    CmdRec *r = raw_rec(cb->mem + cb->used, op, size);
    cb->used += size;
    return r;
}

// ---- the game object being drawn (frame interpolation, docs/PESQUISA-60FPS.md)
// The game draws each object from a few functions, called once per object (and pass) with the object in x0: hooked
// while interpolation is on, they name the object around the command lists it calls and the draws it records, so the
// in-between frame pairs each draw with the same object's draw in the previous frame (the game reorders objects every
// frame: pairing by order made ghosts).
void rt_register_fnhook(uint64_t addr, int (*fn)(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr));  // runtime/fnhook.c
void rt_call_original(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr);
static __thread uint64_t g_obj_tag;
static const uint64_t k_obj_fns[] = {
    0x70006237b0,  // one per object (Viridian: 22 a frame), called by the draw loop f_70006453a0
    0x7000641190,  // objects drawn in two passes (shadow / colour), via f_7000642990
};
static int obj_hook(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    uint64_t saved = g_obj_tag;
    g_obj_tag = c->x[0];
    rt_call_original(c, addr);
    g_obj_tag = saved;
    return 1;  // (the original ran)
}
// Before a draw or a command list call: a CMD_OBJECT when the object changed since the list's last one.
static void obj_mark(Cpu *c, NvnCmdBuf *cb) {
    if (cb->obj_tag == g_obj_tag) return;
    CmdRec *r = rec(c, cb, CMD_OBJECT, 0);
    r->x[0] = g_obj_tag;
    cb->obj_tag = g_obj_tag;
}

static void draw_chain(Cpu *c, const char *kind, uint64_t count);
static uint64_t g_trace_cb[16], g_trace_list[64];  // (LARECOMP_TRACE_COUNT, below)
static int g_ntrace_cb, g_ntrace_list;
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBeginRecording) {
    draw_chain(c, "begin", 0);
    static bool hooked;  // (hooks cost every game function a lookup: only with interpolation on)
    extern bool vk_interp_enabled(void), fps60_enabled(void);
    // (the 60 fps mode turns interpolation on only in menus: hooked from when it is on - the start, or the F12 menu later)
    if (!hooked && (vk_interp_enabled() || fps60_enabled()) && !getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_NOOBJ")) {  // (NOOBJ: pair by order, the old prototype)
        hooked = true;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof k_obj_fns / sizeof k_obj_fns[0]; i++) rt_register_fnhook(k_obj_fns[i], obj_hook);
    }
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    cb->obj_tag = 0;
    cb->recording = true;
    rec(c, cb, CMD_BARRIER, 0);  // makes sure memory exists; the list starts here
    cb->start = cb->mem + cb->used - sizeof(CmdRec);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferEndRecording) {
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ntrace_cb; i++)
        if (g_trace_cb[i] == A(0)) {  // (LARECOMP_TRACE_COUNT: this list holds the traced draw)
            g_trace_cb[i] = g_trace_cb[--g_ntrace_cb];
            if (g_ntrace_list < 64) g_trace_list[g_ntrace_list++] = cb->start;
            LOG("[trace] list %llx holds the traced draw\n", (unsigned long long)cb->start);
            break;
        }
    rec(c, cb, CMD_END, 0);
    cb->recording = false;
    RET(cb->start);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferIsRecording) { RET(cb_of(A(0))->recording); }

// ---- generic recorders
typedef struct { uint64_t x[8]; float f[4]; } Snap;
static Snap snap(Cpu *c) {
    Snap s;
    memcpy(s.x, c->x, sizeof s.x);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) s.f[i] = *(float *)&c->v[i];
    return s;
}
static CmdRec *record(Cpu *c, uint32_t op, uint32_t extra, Snap *s) {
    CmdRec *r = rec(c, cb_of(s->x[0]), op, extra);
    memcpy(r->x, s->x + 1, sizeof r->x);
    memcpy(r->f, s->f, sizeof r->f);
    return r;
}
// record with a copy of `len` bytes from the guest pointer in argument `arg`
static CmdRec *record_copy(Cpu *c, uint32_t op, int arg, uint32_t len) {
    Snap s = snap(c);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, op, len, &s);
    if (s.x[arg] && len) memcpy(r->extra, (void *)(uintptr_t)s.x[arg], len);
    return r;
}
#define PLAIN(name, op) NVN(name) { Snap s = snap(c); record(c, op, 0, &s); }

// ---- state binding
// (cmd, program, stages): only the stages in the mask are bound. Let's Go binds separate programs per stage (a
// vertex program, then a fragment program) and unbinds stages with a NULL program: the executor (exec.c) keeps the
// combination - binding the whole program each time left draws with half a program, all skipped (no 3D).
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindProgram) {
    Snap s = snap(c);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_BIND_PROGRAM, 0, &s);
    r->x[0] = s.x[1] ? (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)HOST(NvnProgram, s.x[1]) : 0;  // host program (0: unbind the stages)
    r->x[1] = s.x[2];                                                      // NVNshaderStageBits
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindBlendState) { record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_BLEND, 1, 8); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindChannelMaskState) { record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_CHANNEL_MASK, 1, 4); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindColorState) { record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_COLOR, 1, 4); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindDepthStencilState) { record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_DEPTH_STENCIL, 1, 8); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindMultisampleState) { record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_MULTISAMPLE, 1, 0x18); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindPolygonState) { record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_POLYGON, 1, 4); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindVertexAttribState) { record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_VERTEX_ATTRIB, 2, (uint32_t)A(1) * 4); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindVertexStreamState) { record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_VERTEX_STREAM, 2, (uint32_t)A(1) * 8); }

}

NVN(nvnCommandBufferSetTexturePool) {
    Snap s = snap(c);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_SET_TEXTURE_POOL, 0, &s);

// SetRenderTargets(cmd, n, colors[], colorViews[], depth, depthView)
// extra: { u64 tex[8]; NvnTextureView views[8]; u8 has_view[8]; u64 depth; NvnTextureView dview; u8 has_dview }
typedef struct {
    uint64_t tex[8];
    NvnTextureView views[8];
    uint8_t has_view[8];
    uint64_t depth;
    NvnTextureView dview;
    uint8_t has_dview;
} RtRec;
NVN(nvnCommandBufferSetRenderTargets) {
    Snap s = snap(c);
    int n = (int)s.x[1];
    if (n > 8) n = 8;
    RtRec rt = {0};
    const uint64_t *colors = (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)s.x[2], *views = (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)s.x[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        rt.tex[i] = colors && colors[i] ? (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)HOST(NvnTexture, colors[i]) : 0;
        if (views && views[i]) { rt.has_view[i] = 1; memcpy(&rt.views[i], (void *)(uintptr_t)views[i], sizeof(NvnTextureView)); }
    }
    rt.depth = s.x[4] ? (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)HOST(NvnTexture, s.x[4]) : 0;
    if (s.x[5]) { rt.has_dview = 1; memcpy(&rt.dview, (void *)(uintptr_t)s.x[5], sizeof(NvnTextureView)); }
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_SET_RENDER_TARGETS, sizeof rt, &s);
    r->x[0] = (uint64_t)n;
    memcpy(r->extra, &rt, sizeof rt);
}

// ClearTexture(cmd, texture, view, region, color, mask)
typedef struct { uint64_t tex; NvnTextureView view; uint8_t has_view; int32_t region[6]; float color[4]; } ClearTexRec;
static void clear_texture(Cpu *c, int kind) {
    Snap s = snap(c);
    ClearTexRec ct = {0};
    ct.tex = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)HOST(NvnTexture, s.x[1]);
    if (s.x[2]) { ct.has_view = 1; memcpy(&ct.view, (void *)(uintptr_t)s.x[2], sizeof ct.view); }
    if (s.x[3]) memcpy(ct.region, (void *)(uintptr_t)s.x[3], sizeof ct.region);
    if (s.x[4]) memcpy(ct.color, (void *)(uintptr_t)s.x[4], 16);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_CLEAR_TEXTURE, sizeof ct, &s);
    r->x[6] = (uint64_t)kind;
    memcpy(r->extra, &ct, sizeof ct);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferClearTexture) { clear_texture(c, 0); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferClearTexturei) { clear_texture(c, 1); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferClearTextureui) { clear_texture(c, 2); }

// DiscardColor(cmdbuf, index): the target's contents become undefined. On the Switch a discarded (compressed)
// target reads back cleared; areas the game then leaves undrawn (e.g. a pit after a floor tile falls away) stay
// black there. Treated as a clear to (0,0,0,0) (LARECOMP_KEEP_DISCARD=1: old no-op behaviour).
NVN(nvnCommandBufferDiscardColor) {
    static int keep = -1, logged;
    if (keep < 0) keep = getenv("LARECOMP_KEEP_DISCARD") != NULL;
    if (logged < 5) { logged++; LOG("[nvn] DiscardColor index %llu%s\n", (unsigned long long)c->x[1], keep ? " (kept)" : " -> clear"); }
    if (keep) return;
    Snap s = snap(c);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_CLEAR_COLOR, 16, &s);
    memset(r->extra, 0, 16);
    r->x[2] = 0xF;  // all channels
    r->x[5] = 0;    // float clear
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferDiscardDepthStencil) { (void)c; }

NVN(nvnCommandBufferDrawArrays) { draw_chain(c, "arrays", c->x[3]); Snap s = snap(c); obj_mark(c, cb_of(s.x[0])); CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS, 0, &s); r->x[3] = 0; r->x[4] = 1; }

// Debug: LARECOMP_TRACE_COUNT=<n> logs the guest call chain of indexed draws with n indices.
// LARECOMP_TRACE_COUNT: the command lists that hold the traced draw (recorded once, called every frame): their
// handles, so nvnCommandBufferCallCommands can log who calls them and in which present.
static bool trace_list(uint64_t h) { for (int i = 0; i < g_ntrace_list; i++) if (g_trace_list[i] == h) return true; return false; }
static void trace_chain(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t fp = c->x[29];
    for (int i = 0; i < 14 && fp >= 0x7000000000ull && fp < 0x8000000000ull && (fp & 7) == 0; i++) {
        uint64_t next = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)fp, lr = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(fp + 8);
        LOG(" %llx", (unsigned long long)lr);
        if (next <= fp) break;
        fp = next;
    }
    LOG("\n");
}
static void trace_draw(Cpu *c, uint64_t count) {
    static long want = -2;
    if (want == -2) want = getenv("LARECOMP_TRACE_COUNT") ? atol(getenv("LARECOMP_TRACE_COUNT")) : -1;
    if (want < 0 || (long)count != want) return;
    static int n;
    if (n++ > 4000) return;
    if (g_ntrace_cb < 16) g_trace_cb[g_ntrace_cb++] = c->x[0];
    extern uint64_t renderer_game_frame(void);
    LOG("[trace] f%llu draw count %llu lr %llx chain:", (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame(), (unsigned long long)count, (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
    uint64_t fp = c->x[29];
    for (int i = 0; i < 14 && fp >= 0x7000000000ull && fp < 0x8000000000ull && (fp & 7) == 0; i++) {
        uint64_t next = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)fp, lr = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(fp + 8);
        LOG(" %llx", (unsigned long long)lr);
        if (next <= fp) break;
        fp = next;
    }
    LOG("\n");
}

// Debug: LARECOMP_DRAW_CHAINS=<frame>[-<last>] logs every draw recorded during those presents: the present, its
// order, count and the guest call chain (return addresses up the frame records), plus command list recordings and
// calls - to find which game function draws each object, and whether lists are recorded every frame or reused.
static bool chains_on(void) {
    static long from = -2, to = -2;
    if (from == -2) {
        const char *e = getenv("LARECOMP_DRAW_CHAINS");
        from = e ? atol(e) : -1;
        to = e && strchr(e, '-') ? atol(strchr(e, '-') + 1) : from;
    }
    extern uint64_t renderer_game_frame(void);
    long f = (long)renderer_game_frame();
    return from >= 0 && f >= from && f <= to;
}
static void draw_chain(Cpu *c, const char *kind, uint64_t count) {
    if (!chains_on()) return;
    extern uint64_t renderer_game_frame(void);
    static int n;
    char line[512];
    int len = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "[chain] f%llu %d %s %llu cb %llx tag %llx:", (unsigned long long)renderer_game_frame(),
                       n++, kind, (unsigned long long)count, (unsigned long long)c->x[0], (unsigned long long)g_obj_tag);
    uint64_t fp = c->x[29];
    len += snprintf(line + len, sizeof line - len, " %llx", (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
    for (int i = 0; i < 16 && fp >= 0x7000000000ull && fp < 0x8000000000ull && (fp & 7) == 0; i++) {
        uint64_t next = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)fp, lr = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(fp + 8);
        if (len < (int)sizeof line - 20) len += snprintf(line + len, sizeof line - len, " %llx", (unsigned long long)lr);
        if (next <= fp) break;
        fp = next;
    }
    LOG("%s\n", line);
}

// ---- copies
typedef struct { uint64_t tex; NvnTextureView view; uint8_t has_view; int32_t region[6]; } TexRef;
static void tex_ref(TexRef *t, uint64_t tex, uint64_t view, uint64_t region) {
    t->tex = tex ? (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)HOST(NvnTexture, tex) : 0;
    if (view) { t->has_view = 1; memcpy(&t->view, (void *)(uintptr_t)view, sizeof t->view); }
    if (region) memcpy(t->region, (void *)(uintptr_t)region, sizeof t->region);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferCopyBufferToTexture) {  // (cmd, src, dst, dstView, dstRegion, flags)

    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_COPY_BUFFER_TO_TEXTURE, sizeof t, &s);
    memcpy(r->extra, &t, sizeof t);
}

        const uint64_t *h = (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)A(2);

            if (trace_list(h[i])) {
```

`runtime/nvn/formats.c`:

```c
// NVNformat -> block size and kind.
#include "tegra.h"

#define C(bpb) {bpb, 1, 1, FMT_COLOR, 0}
#define B(bpb, w, h) {bpb, w, h, FMT_COMPRESSED, 0}

static const FormatInfo formats[] = {
    [0x00] = C(0),
    [0x01] = C(1), [0x02] = C(1), [0x03] = C(1), [0x04] = C(1),                 // R8
    [0x05] = C(2), [0x06] = C(2), [0x07] = C(2), [0x08] = C(2), [0x09] = C(2),  // R16
    [0x0A] = C(4), [0x0B] = C(4), [0x0C] = C(4),                                // R32
    [0x0D] = C(2), [0x0E] = C(2), [0x0F] = C(2), [0x10] = C(2),                 // RG8
    [0x11] = C(4), [0x12] = C(4), [0x13] = C(4), [0x14] = C(4), [0x15] = C(4),  // RG16
    [0x16] = C(8), [0x17] = C(8), [0x18] = C(8),                                // RG32
    [0x19] = C(3), [0x1A] = C(3), [0x1B] = C(3), [0x1C] = C(3),                 // RGB8
    [0x1D] = C(6), [0x1E] = C(6), [0x1F] = C(6), [0x20] = C(6), [0x21] = C(6),  // RGB16
    [0x22] = C(12), [0x23] = C(12), [0x24] = C(12),                             // RGB32
    [0x25] = C(4), [0x26] = C(4), [0x27] = C(4), [0x28] = C(4),                 // RGBA8
    [0x29] = C(8), [0x2A] = C(8), [0x2B] = C(8), [0x2C] = C(8), [0x2D] = C(8),  // RGBA16
    [0x2E] = C(16), [0x2F] = C(16), [0x30] = C(16),                             // RGBA32
    [0x31] = {1, 1, 1, FMT_STENCIL, 0},
    [0x32] = {2, 1, 1, FMT_DEPTH, 0},
    [0x33] = {4, 1, 1, FMT_DEPTH, 0},
    [0x34] = {4, 1, 1, FMT_DEPTH, 0},
    [0x35] = {4, 1, 1, FMT_DEPTH_STENCIL, 0},
    [0x36] = {8, 1, 1, FMT_DEPTH_STENCIL, 0},
    [0x37] = C(4), [0x38] = C(4),                                               // RGBX8/RGBA8 sRGB
    [0x39] = C(2), [0x3A] = C(2), [0x3B] = C(2), [0x3C] = C(2),                 // RGBA4, RGB5, RGB5A1, RGB565
    [0x3D] = C(4), [0x3E] = C(4), [0x3F] = C(4), [0x40] = C(4),                 // RGB10A2(UI), R11G11B10F, RGB9E5
    [0x41] = B(8, 4, 4), [0x42] = B(8, 4, 4), [0x43] = B(16, 4, 4), [0x44] = B(16, 4, 4),
    [0x45] = B(8, 4, 4), [0x46] = B(8, 4, 4), [0x47] = B(16, 4, 4), [0x48] = B(16, 4, 4),

    [0x98] = C(4), [0x99] = C(4), [0x9A] = C(4), [0x9B] = C(4),                  // BGRX8, BGRA8 (+sRGB)
};

const FormatInfo *nvn_format_info(uint32_t f) {
    static const FormatInfo unknown = {4, 1, 1, FMT_COLOR, 0};
    if (f >= sizeof formats / sizeof *formats || !formats[f].bpb) return &unknown;
    return &formats[f];
}
```
