```c
                float fa, fb, v;
                memcpy(&fa, &a[i], 4);
                memcpy(&fb, &b[i], 4);
                if (curve) {
                    float fc;
                    memcpy(&fc, &c3[i], 4);
                    v = ip_curve3(fc, fa, fb, ip_t);
                    if (ip_cap_k) ip_cap_k[i] = 1, ip_cap_c[i * IP_PC_N] = fa, ip_cap_c[i * IP_PC_N + 1] = (fb - fc) * 0.5f,
                                  ip_cap_c[i * IP_PC_N + 2] = (fb - 2.0f * fa + fc) * 0.5f;
                } else {
                    v = fa + (fb - fa) * ip_t;
                    if (ip_cap_k) ip_cap_k[i] = 1, ip_cap_c[i * IP_PC_N] = fa, ip_cap_c[i * IP_PC_N + 1] = fb - fa, ip_cap_c[i * IP_PC_N + 2] = 0;
                }
                memcpy(&buf[i], &v, 4);
            }
            if (curve) ip_stats_curved += changed;
            if (dg) dg->blended += changed;
        } else {
            for (uint32_t i = g; i < g + m; i++) buf[i] = b[i];
            ip_stats[2] += changed;
            if (dg) { dg->jumps += jump ? changed : 0; dg->nonfloat += bad ? changed : 0; }
        }
    }
    ip_rot_blend(a, b, buf, nw);
    if (n->size > nw * 4) memcpy((uint8_t *)buf + nw * 4, nd + nw * 4, n->size - nw * 4);
    ip_stats[0]++;
    if (ip_draw_2d && ip_kept_log_now()) {
        uint32_t ch = 0, same = 0;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nw; i++) if (a[i] != b[i]) { ch++; if (buf[i] == b[i]) same++; }
        if (ch) LOG("[interp-kept] present %llu 2d blended stage %d cbuf %d size %u: %u changed, %u of them at N%s: %s\n",
                    (unsigned long long)renderer_present_count(), stage, k, size, ch, same, c3 ? " (curve)" : "", ip_sig_txt);
    }
    {   // LARECOMP_INTERP_FAR_LOG=<units> (research): blended words this far from frame N's, per draw
        static float far = -1;
        if (far < 0) far = getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_FAR_LOG") ? (float)atof(getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_FAR_LOG")) : 0;
        if (far > 0) {
            float mx = 0; uint32_t at = 0;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nw; i++) {
                float x, y; memcpy(&x, &buf[i], 4); memcpy(&y, &b[i], 4);
                if (isfinite(x) && isfinite(y) && fabsf(x - y) > mx) mx = fabsf(x - y), at = i;
            }
            if (mx > far) {
                float x, y, z; memcpy(&x, &a[at], 4); memcpy(&y, &b[at], 4); memcpy(&z, &buf[at], 4);
                NvnTexture *t0 = st.rt.ncolor && st.rt.color[0] ? st.rt.color[0] : st.rt.depth;
                LOG("[interp-far] present %llu t %.2f rt %u stage %d cbuf %d size %u occ %u%s: word %u N-1 %g N %g blended %g (%s)\n",
                    (unsigned long long)renderer_present_count(), ip_t, t0 ? t0->width : 0, stage, k, size, ip_draw_occ,
                    ip_part_set ? " (by content)" : "", at, x, y, z, ip_sig_txt);
            }
        }
    }
    return buf;
}

// hash of a command list's records (JUMPs and CALLs followed), to tell whether its memory still holds what ran
static uint64_t ip_list_hash(uint64_t handle, int depth) {
    uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull, p = handle;
    for (int guard = 0; guard < 10000000; guard++) {
        const CmdRec *r = (const CmdRec *)(uintptr_t)p;
        if (r->op >= CMD_COUNT || r->size < sizeof(CmdRec) || r->size > (1u << 20)) return 0;
        const uint64_t *w = (const uint64_t *)r;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < r->size / 8; i++) h = ip_mix(h, w[i]);
        if (r->op == CMD_END) return h;
        if (r->op == CMD_JUMP) { p = r->x[0]; continue; }
        if (r->op == CMD_CALL) {
            const uint64_t *hs = (const uint64_t *)r->extra;
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[0] && depth < 8; i++) h = ip_mix(h, ip_list_hash(hs[i], depth + 1));
        }
        p += r->size;
    }
    return 0;
}

static void ip_note_list(uint64_t handle) {
    IpFrame *f = &ipf[ipc];
    if (f->nlists >= 256) { f->overflow = true; return; }
    f->hashes[f->nlists] = ip_list_hash(handle, 0);
    f->lists[f->nlists++] = handle;
}

// The images of a present, kept until they are shown (device.c shows them on schedule, after the replays that wrote
// the game's textures): the presented texture as it was (raw) and, when post_process does something to it (FSR 3,
// SMAA, the colour pass), the result - made right away, while the scene's depth, motion vectors, jitter and interface
// mask are this image's. Slots 0 .. 7: the in-between images; IP_KEEP_N: frame N's own. Two sets, one per present
// in turn: a present's images wait for their time (device.c) while the next present's are rendered.
// An in-between image drawn into a window image right after it is made (device.c, the present queue: the default) is
// not copied: its processed image is drawn from where post_process_ex left it (direct), before the next replay writes
// there in the command buffer's order. At 4K a copy was ~66 MB of traffic and two full barriers an image.
#define IP_KEEP_N 8
typedef struct { TexBackend raw, post; TexBackend *direct; bool post_ok, raw_ok; double ow, oh; } IpKeep;
static IpKeep ip_keep_sets[2][IP_KEEP_N + 1], *ip_keep = ip_keep_sets[0];
static TexBackend *hold_copy_into(TexBackend *d, TexBackend *src);
static VkImageView ip_post_view(TexBackend *b, double ow, double oh) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (IP_KEEP_N + 1); i++) {
        IpKeep *k = &ip_keep_sets[0][0] + i;
        if (b != &k->raw) continue;
        if (!k->post_ok) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        k->post_ok = false;
        TexBackend *d = k->direct;
        k->direct = NULL;
        if (fabs(ow - k->ow) > 0.5 || fabs(oh - k->oh) > 0.5) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;  // (the window changed size)
        return post_view(d ? d : &k->post);
    }
    return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
}
static TexBackend *ip_lo_resolve(TexBackend *lo);
static TexBackend *ip_keep_image(TexBackend *b, int slot, bool now) {
    IpKeep *k = &ip_keep[slot];
    k->post_ok = k->raw_ok = false;
    k->direct = NULL;
    TexBackend *res = NULL, *in = b;
    // (a reduced in-between image without FSR 3.1: back to N's size against N's image first, then processed as N was)
    if (slot != IP_KEEP_N && vk_tex_lo_active() && !fsr3_on()) in = ip_lo_resolve(b);
    if (post_last_ow > 0 && post_last_oh > 0) {
        ip_side_post = slot != IP_KEEP_N;  // (an in-between image: FSR 3.1's history is the real frames' alone)
        post_process_ex(vk_cmd(), in, post_last_ow, post_last_oh, &res);
        ip_side_post = false;
    } else if (in != b) res = in;
    if (res && res != b) {  // (the processed image is what is shown: the raw one is only its handle, not copied)
        if (now && slot != IP_KEEP_N) k->direct = res;  // (drawn before anything writes it again: no copy)
        else hold_copy_into(&k->post, res);
        k->post_ok = true, k->ow = post_last_ow, k->oh = post_last_oh;
        // (N's own image, whole, when the reduced in-between images are resolved against it: ip_lo_resolve)
        if (slot == IP_KEEP_N && ip_lo_factor() < 0.99f && !fsr3_on()) hold_copy_into(&k->raw, b), k->raw_ok = true;
        else if (!k->raw.image) hold_copy_into(&k->raw, b);
        k->raw.sx = b->sx, k->raw.sy = b->sy, k->raw.scalable = b->scalable;
        return &k->raw;
    }
    hold_copy_into(&k->raw, b);  // (nothing done to it: the raw copy is shown, as b would be)
    k->raw_ok = true;
    return &k->raw;
}
// The in-between images' render size, x the real frames' on each axis: full, frame generation "Auto"'s own when the GPU
// is behind (ip_auto_mult: 75 %, then 50 %, before a lower multiplier), or LARECOMP_FG_SCALE=<f> (research, fixed).
// Measured at 4K (FSR 3.1 native, SSAO, GI high), GPU per in-between image:
// 3.65 ms at full size, 2.52 at 75 %, 1.63 at 50 % (the game's scene pass 1.27 / 0.79 / 0.41); detail within 1 - 3 % of
// the real frames (RCAS adjusted: ip_side_sharp_stops), halfway placement the same (93 % of the moving blocks); flicker
// 1.60 / 1.66 / 1.89 % of the blocks (the walk in the grass, 3x).
static float ip_auto_scale = 1;  // (frame generation "Auto": this present's, ip_auto_mult)
static float ip_lo_factor(void) {
    static float env = -1;
    if (env < 0) env = getenv("LARECOMP_FG_SCALE") ? (float)atof(getenv("LARECOMP_FG_SCALE")) : 0;
    float f = env > 0 ? env : g_settings.frame_gen == FG_AUTO ? ip_auto_scale : 1.0f;
    return f < 0.25f ? 0.25f : f > 1 ? 1 : f;
}
// A reduced in-between image without FSR 3.1, back to N's size (post image 30 of the reduced set): N's image taken
// where the motion vectors say each pixel was in N, clipped to the reduced image's 3x3 there (side_resolve.frag, as
// the FSR 3.1 path does against FSR's output)
static TexBackend *ip_lo_resolve(TexBackend *lo) {
    IpKeep *n = &ip_keep[IP_KEEP_N];
    if (!n->raw_ok || !n->raw.image) return lo;
    TexBackend *out = post_image(30, n->raw.width, n->raw.height);
    TexBackend *mv = ao.depth && ao.proj_frame == fx_frame() && mv_wanted()
                   ? post_image_fmt(8, ao.depth->width, ao.depth->height, VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT) : NULL;
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cmd();
    gp_mark(cb, "ours: reduced image resolve (in-between)");
    // ... then sharpened (RCAS): the clip to the reduced image's 3x3 and its share soften it - without, 13 - 17 % less
    // detailed than the real frames at 75 %, 21 % at 50 %. 1 stop at 75 % (0.9 at 50 %) with SMAA, 1.3 (1.15) with TAA,
    // whose own sharpening follows (post_process_ex): within 3 % of the real frames. (Research: LARECOMP_LO_SHARP=<stops>,
    // negative: none; LARECOMP_LO_HIST=<weight of N's image>, default the TAA's 0.9.)
    static float hist = -1, env_stops = -100;
    if (hist < 0) hist = getenv("LARECOMP_LO_HIST") ? (float)atof(getenv("LARECOMP_LO_HIST")) : TAA_HISTORY;
    if (env_stops == -100) env_stops = getenv("LARECOMP_LO_SHARP") ? (float)atof(getenv("LARECOMP_LO_SHARP")) : -99;
    float stops = env_stops != -99 ? env_stops : (taa_on() ? 1.3f : 1.0f) - 0.5f * (0.75f - ip_lo_factor());
    float ps[8] = {1.0f / (float)out->width, 1.0f / (float)out->height, 1.0f / (float)lo->width, 1.0f / (float)lo->height, hist};
    VkImageView si[4] = {raw_view(lo), raw_view(&n->raw), mv ? post_view(mv) : vk_dummy_view(TEXTYPE_2D)};
    post_pass_view(cb, post_pipeline("side_resolve.frag"), si, 3, post_view(out), out->width, out->height, ps, 32, false, false);
    if (stops >= 0) {  // (the post passes after it wait with their own barriers; a keep copy with its own)
        TexBackend *r = post_image(31, out->width, out->height);
        float pr[8] = {exp2f(-stops), 0, 0, 0, (float)out->width, (float)out->height};
        VkImageView ri_[3] = {post_view(out)};
        post_pass_view(cb, post_pipeline("rcas.frag"), ri_, 1, post_view(r), out->width, out->height, pr, 32, false, false);
        out = r;
    }
    out->sx = n->raw.sx, out->sy = n->raw.sy, out->scalable = n->raw.scalable;
    return ip_ui_keep(cb, out, &n->raw, true);  // (its interface: N's)
}
// N's processed image (made at vk_interp_begin, before the in-between images), when it is at ow x oh
static TexBackend *ip_n_post(double ow, double oh) {
    IpKeep *k = &ip_keep[IP_KEEP_N];
    return k->post_ok && fabs(ow - k->ow) < 0.5 && fabs(oh - k->oh) < 0.5 ? &k->post : NULL;
}
// The presented texture b after an in-between image was rendered into it: kept in slot `slot` (0 .. 7) to be shown -
// now (drawn into the window before the next replay: no copy) or later
TexBackend *vk_interp_keep(TexBackend *b, int slot, bool now) {
    TexBackend *r = ip_keep_image(vk_tex_lo(b), slot < 0 ? 0 : slot >= IP_KEEP_N ? IP_KEEP_N - 1 : slot, now);
    vk_tex_lo_end();  // (a reduced image: vk_interp_replay began it)
    return r;
}
static TexBackend *hold_copy_into(TexBackend *d, TexBackend *src) {
    if (d->image && (d->width != src->width || d->height != src->height || d->format != src->format)) {
        vk_views_forget(d);
        vk_defer_image(d->image, d->mem);
        d->image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        d->mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    if (!d->image) {
        VkImageCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, .flags = VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT,
                                .imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, .format = src->format, .extent = {src->width, src->height, 1},
                                .mipLevels = 1, .arrayLayers = 1, .samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
                                .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT};
        VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE};
        VK_CHECK(vmaCreateImage(g_vk.vma, &ci, &ai, &d->image, &d->mem, NULL));
        d->format = src->format; d->width = src->width; d->height = src->height; d->depth = 1; d->layers = 1; d->levels = 1;
        d->samples = 1; d->aspect = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT; d->base_type = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
        vk_image_init_layout(vk_cmd(), d->image, d->aspect);
    }
    d->sx = src->sx; d->sy = src->sy; d->scalable = src->scalable;
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cmd();
    gp_mark(cb, "ours: keep copy %ux%u", src->width, src->height);
    vk_barrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT,
               VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT);
    VkImageCopy rg = {.srcSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}, .dstSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1},
                      .extent = {src->width, src->height, 1}};
    vkCmdCopyImage(cb, src->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, d->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, 1, &rg);
    vk_barrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT,
               VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT);
    return d;
}

// Frame generation "Auto" (frame_gen = auto): the multiplier of the world's rate. Its candidates, 2 .. 4: those whose
// rate the display's refresh shows evenly (60 fps at 240 Hz: 4x, 240 images a second, one every refresh; 3x would be
// 180, every 1.33 refreshes - uneven), the largest first; none even (60 fps at 144 Hz): the largest at or below the
// refresh. With variable refresh (LARECOMP_FG_VRR=1: the display shows any rate evenly) the largest at or below it.
// Then the GPU: when the frames come late (the measured period 8 % over the game's for half a second's presents in a
// row: the in-between images cost more than the GPU has) the in-between images are rendered smaller first - 75 %, then
// 50 % of the real frames' size on each axis (ip_lo_factor; at 4K 3.65 / 2.52 / 1.63 ms an image, detail within 1 - 3 %
// of the real frames) - and only then the next candidate down, at full size again (60 fps at 240 Hz: 4x at 100 / 75 /
// 50 %, then 2x at 100 / 75 / 50 %: each step costs less than the one before; 4x at 50 % is 4.9 ms, 2x at full size
// 3.65) - a lower multiplier after a second late; none in the 3 s after the game's rate
// changed (entering the world: the loading's hitches and shader builds came down to 2x for 10 s); back up after 10 s on time, the wait doubling
// each time it had to come down again within 5 s of going up (up to 2 min) - as the dynamic resolution does
// (output_scale.c). Measured at 4K (FSR 3.1 native, SSAO, GI high, 240 Hz): 60 fps x 4 needs ~16.8 ms of GPU a frame
// (8.8 the real one, 3 x 2.5 the in-between ones) for 16.7 - it comes down to 2x.
// LARECOMP_FG_DISPLAY_HZ=<hz> (research) stands in for the display's refresh.
static int ip_auto_mult(uint64_t period) {
    extern double vk_display_hz(void);
    extern uint64_t fps60_period_ns(void);
    static double env_hz = -1;
    static int vrr = -1;
    if (env_hz < 0) env_hz = getenv("LARECOMP_FG_DISPLAY_HZ") ? atof(getenv("LARECOMP_FG_DISPLAY_HZ")) : 0;
    if (vrr < 0) vrr = getenv("LARECOMP_FG_VRR") != NULL;
    double hz = env_hz > 0 ? env_hz : vk_display_hz();
    if (hz < 20) hz = 60;  // (unknown: the common case)
    double fps = g_settings.fps > 0 ? g_settings.fps : 30;
    int cand[3], nc = 0;
    for (int m = 4; m >= 2; m--) {  // (even on the refresh first)
        double r = hz / (fps * m);
        if (!vrr && r >= 0.99 && fabs(r - lround(r)) < 0.02) cand[nc++] = m;
    }
    for (int m = 4; m >= 2 && !nc; m--)
        if (fps * m <= hz * 1.01) cand[nc++] = m;
    if (!nc) cand[nc++] = 2;
    // the GPU keeping up: by the presents' period against the game's own for this frame. Level l: candidate l / 3 at
    // the (l % 3)-th size
    static const float scales[3] = {1.0f, 0.75f, 0.5f};
    int nl = nc * 3;
    static int level, late, good, last_level = -1;
    static double wait_s = 10, last_raise_t = -100;
    static uint64_t last_t;
    static double key_hz, key_fps, key_want, grace_until;
    if (key_hz != hz || key_fps != fps) key_hz = hz, key_fps = fps, level = 0, late = good = 0;  // (another display or rate: again)
    uint64_t now = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    double t = now / 1e9;
    double want = (double)fps60_period_ns();
    if (want != key_want) key_want = want, grace_until = t + 3, late = good = 0;
    if (last_t && now - last_t < 200000000ull && want > 0 && t >= grace_until) {  // (not after a pause: loading, a menu's stop)
        if ((double)period > want * 1.08) { late++; good = 0; }
        else { good++; if ((double)period < want * 1.03) late = 0; }
        double late_s = (level + 1) % 3 ? 0.5 : 1.0;  // (a smaller size after half a second late, a lower multiplier after one)
        if (late >= (int)(late_s * 1e9 / want) && level < nl - 1) {
            level++, late = good = 0;
            if (t - last_raise_t < 5) wait_s = fmin(wait_s * 2, 120);
        } else if (level > 0 && good >= (int)(wait_s * 1e9 / want)) {
            level--, good = 0, last_raise_t = t;
        }
    }
    last_t = now;
    if (level >= nl) level = nl - 1;
    int m = cand[level / 3];
    ip_auto_scale = scales[level % 3];
    if (level != last_level) {
        LOG("[fg] auto: %dx, in-between images at %.0f %% (display %.0f Hz%s, world %.0f fps%s; frames every %.1f ms for %.1f)\n",
            m, ip_auto_scale * 100, hz, vrr ? ", variable refresh" : "", fps, level ? ", the GPU behind: lowered" : "",
            period / 1e6, want / 1e6);
        last_level = level;
    }
    return m;
}

// Images per present with interpolation, for a frame that came `period` ns after the one before: N and k - 1 in-between
// images, at (1 .. k-1) / k of the way from N-1 to N. Frame generation (F12 menu, frame_gen = 2 / 3 / 4): that many
// times the world's frame rate (fps: 30, 60, 120), whatever this frame's own - a menu or a battle at the game's 30 in
// the 60 fps mode gets twice the images the world does, and both reach the same rate. Otherwise 2 (the 60 fps mode's
// menus). LARECOMP_INTERP_MULT=<k> (research) fixes k.
static int ip_images(uint64_t period) {
    static int env = -1;
    if (env < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_MULT");
        env = e ? atoi(e) : 0;
        if (env) env = env < 2 ? 2 : env > 8 ? 8 : env;
    }
    if (env) return env;
    if (g_settings.frame_gen >= FG_AUTO) {
        // this frame's rate as the game means it (runtime/hle/fps60.c): the world's (fps) in the 60 / 120 fps mode, the
        // game's own 30 in menus, battles, the start - not the period measured: a frame the GPU could not finish in time
        // came later, got more images (k from the period, or the base taken as 30 from it) and was later still
        extern uint64_t fps60_period_ns(void);
        int m = g_settings.frame_gen == FG_AUTO ? ip_auto_mult(period) : g_settings.frame_gen;
        long k = lround((double)fps60_period_ns() * g_settings.fps * m / 1e9);
        return k < 2 ? 2 : k > 8 ? 8 : (int)k;
    }
    return 2;
}
int vk_interp_images(void) { return ip_k; }  // (after vk_interp_begin)

// At the present of frame N (presented texture b, `period` ns after N-1): true when frame N-1 was recorded too and N's
// lists are intact - N's own image is then kept in *hold, and vk_interp_replay(t) renders the image at t (0..1, N-1 to
// N) into the game's textures (b holds it), as many times as wanted (vk_interp_images: how many to show); false: nothing
// to show before N. Then vk_interp_end, either way.
static bool ip_began;  // (vk_interp_end moves recording on only after a present that had it on)
static bool ip_lo;     // this present's in-between images are rendered at ip_lo_factor (vk_interp_begin)
// LARECOMP_INTERP_REJ_LOG=1: each present without in-between images and why, each object kept at N
static bool ip_rej_log(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_REJ_LOG") != NULL;
    return on;
}

bool vk_interp_begin(TexBackend *b, TexBackend **hold, uint64_t period) {
    ip_began = false;
    if (!ip_enabled()) {
        // Off (the world, a battle): what was recorded the last time it was on is stale - a menu opened later blended
        // with that old scene (a flash when the menu opened while walking)
        ipf[0].valid = ipf[1].valid = ipf[2].valid = false;
        return false;
    }
    ip_began = true;
    ip_keep = ip_keep_sets[ip_keep == ip_keep_sets[0]];
    ip_k = ip_images(period);
    IpFrame *cur = &ipf[ipc], *prev = &ipf[IP_PREV], *prev2 = &ipf[IP_PREV2];
    {
        extern uint64_t fps60_period_ns(void);
        cur->real = renderer_present_count(), cur->period = fps60_period_ns();
        static int curve = -1;
        if (curve < 0) curve = getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_CURVE") ? atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_CURVE")) : 1;
        ip_three_ok = prev2->valid && prev->valid && !prev2->overflow && prev->real == cur->real - 1 &&
                      prev2->real == cur->real - 2 && prev->period == cur->period && prev2->period == cur->period;
        ip_curve_ok = curve && ip_three_ok;
    }
    bool ok = prev->valid && cur->valid && cur->nlists > 0 && !cur->overflow && !prev->overflow && b && b->image &&
              b->aspect == VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT && b->samples <= 1 && cur->destroyed == g_nvn_destroyed;
    bool structural = ok;
    for (int i = 0; ok && i < cur->nlists; i++)
        if (!cur->hashes[i] || ip_list_hash(cur->lists[i], 0) != cur->hashes[i]) ok = false;
    if (!ok) {
        if (!prev->valid || !cur->valid || cur->nlists == 0) ip_rej[0]++;
        else if (cur->overflow || prev->overflow) ip_rej[1]++;
        else if (cur->destroyed != g_nvn_destroyed) ip_rej[2]++;
        else if (!structural) ip_rej[3]++;
        else ip_rej[4]++;
        if (ip_rej_log())
            LOG("[interp-rej] present %llu: %s (valid %d/%d lists %d overflow %d/%d destroyed %d/%d)\n",
                (unsigned long long)renderer_present_count(),
                !prev->valid || !cur->valid || cur->nlists == 0 ? "no previous frame" : cur->overflow || prev->overflow ? "overflow"
                : cur->destroyed != g_nvn_destroyed ? "a texture destroyed" : !structural ? "format" : "a command list changed",
                prev->valid, cur->valid, cur->nlists, prev->overflow, cur->overflow, (int)cur->destroyed, (int)g_nvn_destroyed);
    }
    if (ok) {
        // Per object, before the replay: the share of its changed float words that changed by a large step. Above
        // LARECOMP_INTERP_OBJ_LIMIT (0.4) the object is not blended (ip_obj_rejected); when the rejected objects hold
        // most of the frame's changes (a camera cut), there is no in-between image at all. (0.2 before: a walking
        // skeleton at 30 fps has 0.20 - 0.25, and was kept at N one frame in two - with the camera still, the whole
        // in-between image went, a 33 ms step several times a second at 2x. Swapped models and cuts: 0.5 - 0.95.)
        typedef struct { uint64_t obj, changed, big; } ObjAcc;
        static ObjAcc acc[IP_REJ];
        memset(acc, 0, sizeof acc);
        memset(ip_rej_obj, 0, sizeof ip_rej_obj);
        uint64_t changed = 0, big = 0, rej_changed = 0;
        int nrej = 0, nobj = 0;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cur->n; i++) {
            const IpEntry *n = &cur->e[i], *o = ip_find(prev, n->key);
            if (!o || o->size != n->size || n->d2) continue;
            uint64_t gobj = n->obj ? n->obj : 1;  // (draws without an object: one group)
            const float *fa = (const float *)(prev->data + o->off), *fb = (const float *)(cur->data + n->off);
            uint64_t c = 0, bg = 0;
            for (uint32_t w = 0; w < n->size / 4; w++) {
                float a = fa[w], v = fb[w];
                if (a == v || !isfinite(a) || !isfinite(v)) continue;
                float m = fmaxf(fabsf(a), fabsf(v));
                if (m < 1e-3f || m > 1e7f) continue;
                c++;
                if (fabsf(v - a) > 0.3f * m && fabsf(v - a) > 0.1f) bg++;
            }
            if (!c) continue;
            uint32_t sl = (uint32_t)((gobj >> 4) * 0x9E3779B1u) & (IP_REJ - 1);
            while (acc[sl].obj && acc[sl].obj != gobj) sl = (sl + 1) & (IP_REJ - 1);
            if (!acc[sl].obj) { acc[sl].obj = gobj; nobj++; }
            acc[sl].changed += c, acc[sl].big += bg;
            changed += c, big += bg;
        }
        extern bool fps60_menu(void);
        bool menu = fps60_menu();  // (menus: the cut checks are for battles; a menu screen changes by large steps all the time)
        static double obj_limit = -1;
        if (obj_limit < 0) obj_limit = getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_OBJ_LIMIT") ? atof(getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_OBJ_LIMIT")) : 0.4;
        for (int i = 0; i < IP_REJ; i++)
            if (!menu && acc[i].obj && acc[i].changed >= 8 && (double)acc[i].big > obj_limit * (double)acc[i].changed) {
                uint32_t sl = (uint32_t)((acc[i].obj >> 4) * 0x9E3779B1u) & (IP_REJ - 1);
                while (ip_rej_obj[sl]) sl = (sl + 1) & (IP_REJ - 1);
                ip_rej_obj[sl] = acc[i].obj;
                nrej++;
                rej_changed += acc[i].changed;
                if (ip_rej_log())
                    LOG("[interp-obj] present %llu: object %#llx rejected, %llu of %llu changed words big (%.2f)\n",
                        (unsigned long long)renderer_present_count(), (unsigned long long)acc[i].obj, (unsigned long long)acc[i].big,
                        (unsigned long long)acc[i].changed, (double)acc[i].big / (double)acc[i].changed);
            }
        if (getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_DIAG") || (ip_rej_log() && nrej))
            LOG("[interp-cut] present %llu: objects %d rejected %d (%llu of %llu changed words; big %llu)\n",
                (unsigned long long)renderer_present_count(), nobj, nrej, (unsigned long long)rej_changed, (unsigned long long)changed,
                (unsigned long long)big);
        if (!menu && changed && rej_changed * 10 > changed * 6) { ok = false; ip_rej[5]++; }
    }
    if (ok) {
        vk_end_pass();
        // (the blends decided at this present's first in-between image serve the others: ip_plan_*)
        if (!++ip_plan_cur) ip_plan_cur = 1, memset(ip_plan, 0, ip_plan_cap * sizeof *ip_plan);
        ip_pwn = 0;
        static int plan_env = -1;  // (LARECOMP_INTERP_PLAN=0: comparison, every image decides its blends again; 2: both, compared)
        if (plan_env < 0) plan_env = getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_PLAN") ? atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_PLAN")) : 1, LOG("[interp-plan] mode %d\n", plan_env);
        ip_plan_on = plan_env && ip_k > 2, ip_plan_verify = plan_env == 2;
        *hold = ip_keep_image(b, IP_KEEP_N, false);
        // Reduced in-between images: only with frame N's full-size image to resolve them against (FSR 3.1's output, or
        // N's own image)
        ip_lo = ip_lo_factor() < 0.99f &&
                (fsr3_on() ? ip_n_post(post_last_ow, post_last_oh) != NULL : ip_keep[IP_KEEP_N].raw_ok && post_last_ow > 0);
    }
    return ok;
}

// The in-between images are side images: they read N's temporal state (camera, object constants, SSAO / GI results,
// TAA history) and leave it as it was, so the real frames chain N-1, N, N+1 in time order whatever comes between them
// (counted as frames of their own they ran the histories back and forth: N, then images before it in time, then N+1 -
// the GI and SSAO accumulation shimmering in blotches, TAA / FSR 3.1 fed the past after the future).
static struct {
    double vp[16], vp_prev[16];
    uint64_t vp_frame, vp_real;
    bool prev_ok;
    uint8_t scene[2][4096];
    uint32_t scene_size[2];
    int scene_cur;
    float proj[4];
} ip_cam;
static void ip_cam_save(void) {
    memcpy(ip_cam.vp, ao.vp, sizeof ao.vp), memcpy(ip_cam.vp_prev, ao.vp_prev, sizeof ao.vp_prev);
    ip_cam.vp_frame = ao.vp_frame, ip_cam.vp_real = ao.vp_real, ip_cam.prev_ok = ao.prev_ok;
    memcpy(ip_cam.scene, ao.scene, sizeof ao.scene), memcpy(ip_cam.scene_size, ao.scene_size, sizeof ao.scene_size);
    ip_cam.scene_cur = ao.scene_cur;
    memcpy(ip_cam.proj, ao.proj, sizeof ao.proj);
}
static void ip_cam_restore(void) {
    memcpy(ao.vp, ip_cam.vp, sizeof ao.vp), memcpy(ao.vp_prev, ip_cam.vp_prev, sizeof ao.vp_prev);
    ao.vp_frame = ip_cam.vp_frame, ao.vp_real = ip_cam.vp_real, ao.prev_ok = ip_cam.prev_ok;
    memcpy(ao.scene, ip_cam.scene, sizeof ao.scene), memcpy(ao.scene_size, ip_cam.scene_size, sizeof ao.scene_size);
    ao.scene_cur = ip_cam.scene_cur;
    memcpy(ao.proj, ip_cam.proj, sizeof ao.proj);
}

// The image at t (0..1, from N-1 to N) into the game's textures (after vk_interp_begin said yes)
void vk_interp_replay(float t) {
    gp_mark(vk_cmd(), "ours: replay t=%.2f", t);
    IpFrame *cur = &ipf[ipc];
    ip_t = t;
    {   // LARECOMP_INTERP_TFIX=<t> (research): every in-between image at that t (1: should be frame N itself)
        static float tf = -2;
        if (tf == -2) tf = getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_TFIX") ? (float)atof(getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_TFIX")) : -1;
        if (tf >= 0) ip_t = tf;
    }
    ip_cam_save();
    mvo_replay_begin();
    if (ip_lo) vk_end_pass(), vk_tex_lo_begin(ip_lo_factor());  // (ended by vk_interp_keep, after its resolve)
    __typeof__(st) end = st;
    st = cur->start;
    st.rt_dirty = true;
    ip_replaying = true;
    ip_ord = 0;
    ip_occ_reset();
    for (int i = 0; i < cur->nlists; i++) exec_list(cur->lists[i], 0);
    vk_end_pass();
    ip_replaying = false;
    ip_replays++;
    ip_cam_restore();
    st = end;
    st.rt_dirty = true;
    ip_stats[3]++;
    if (ip_stats[3] % 300 == 1)
        LOG("[interp] frame %llu: %llu blended, %llu without a match, %llu words kept, %llu stepped, %llu alternating, %llu curved, %llu draws paired by content (replays %llu)\n",
            (unsigned long long)vk_frame_counter(), (unsigned long long)ip_stats[0], (unsigned long long)ip_stats[1],
            (unsigned long long)ip_stats[2], (unsigned long long)ip_stats_held, (unsigned long long)ip_stats_alt, (unsigned long long)ip_stats_curved,
            (unsigned long long)ip_stats_content, (unsigned long long)ip_stats[3]);
    if (ip_stats[3] % 300 == 0 && getenv("LARECOMP_INTERP_DIAG")) ip_diag_dump();
    if (ip_stats[3] % 300 == 1)
        LOG("[interp] draws with an object %llu, without %llu; vertices blended %llu; another copy as partner %llu, partner taken %llu (sibling-moved cbufs %llu; %llu %llu %llu %llu); matrices along the arc %llu; buffers of frame N reused %llu, copied again %llu\n",
            (unsigned long long)ip_stats_tagged, (unsigned long long)ip_stats_untagged, (unsigned long long)ip_stats_vtx,
            (unsigned long long)ip_stats_other_copy, (unsigned long long)ip_stats_taken, (unsigned long long)ip_stats_sib,
            (unsigned long long)ip_stats_sibw[0], (unsigned long long)ip_stats_sibw[1], (unsigned long long)ip_stats_sibw[2], (unsigned long long)ip_stats_sibw[3], (unsigned long long)ip_stats_rot,
            (unsigned long long)vtx_memo_hits, (unsigned long long)vtx_memo_miss);
}

// After the present's images: the next frame records into the other slot, from the state this one ended with
void vk_interp_end(void) {
    if (!ip_began) return;
    ip_began = false;
    ipc = (ipc + 1) % 3;
    ip_frame_clear(&ipf[ipc]);
    ip_ord = 0, vtx_memo_gen++;  // (the next frame's draws: vtx_memo)
    ipf[ipc].start = st;
    ipf[ipc].destroyed = g_nvn_destroyed;
    ipf[ipc].valid = true;
    ip_occ_reset();
}
```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/fsr3.cpp`:

```cpp
// AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 3.1 upscaling (C++: the SDK's Vulkan header is) (FidelityFX SDK 1.1.4: the newest FSR with a Vulkan backend - the FSR
// SDK 2.x, FSR 4, is DirectX 12 only), through its C API (third_party/fidelityfx, MIT) and the signed prebuilt
// amd_fidelityfx_vk.dll, loaded at run time next to the exe: without it the upscaler stays FSR 1 (exec.c).
// exec.c post_process hands it the game image at the render resolution with the scene's depth, the motion vectors
// (camera and per object) and a mask of the interface; the scene was jittered by fsr3_jitter's sequence.
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#endif
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

extern "C" {
#include "vk.h"
#include "fsr3.h"
}
#include "ffx_api/ffx_api.h"
#include "ffx_api/ffx_upscale.h"
#include "ffx_api/vk/ffx_api_vk.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#include "ffx_api/ffx_api_loader.h"
static ffxFunctions fx;
#endif
static int loaded = -1;  // -1 not tried, 0 missing, 1 loaded
static ffxContext ctx;
static uint32_t ctx_rw, ctx_rh, ctx_ow, ctx_oh;

static void fsr3_message(uint32_t type, const wchar_t *msg) {
    char m[512];
    snprintf(m, sizeof m, "%ls", msg);
    LOG("[fsr3] %s: %s\n", type == FFX_API_MESSAGE_TYPE_ERROR ? "error" : "warning", m);
}

extern "C" bool fsr3_available(void) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (loaded < 0) {
        HMODULE m = LoadLibraryA("amd_fidelityfx_vk.dll");
        loaded = m != NULL;
        if (m) ffxLoadFunctions(&fx, m);
        if (loaded && (!fx.CreateContext || !fx.Dispatch || !fx.Query || !fx.DestroyContext)) loaded = 0;
        LOG("[fsr3] amd_fidelityfx_vk.dll %s\n", loaded ? "loaded" : "not found: FSR 1 instead");
    }
    return loaded == 1;
#else
    return false;
#endif
}

// The backend asks the device for its functions; one this device lacks (the debug-utils names and labels of an
// extension not enabled) came back null and was called: a crash in the DLL. Those get a function doing nothing.
static VkResult VKAPI_CALL fsr3_noop(void) { return VK_SUCCESS; }
static PFN_vkVoidFunction VKAPI_CALL fsr3_device_proc(VkDevice dev, const char *name) {
    PFN_vkVoidFunction f = vkGetDeviceProcAddr(dev, name);
    size_t n = strlen(name);
    if (!f && n > 3 && !strcmp(name + n - 3, "KHR") && n < 128) {  // (an extension's name for what Vulkan 1.1+ has in its core)
        char core[128];
        snprintf(core, sizeof core, "%.*s", (int)(n - 3), name);
        f = vkGetDeviceProcAddr(dev, core);
    }
    if (!f) {
        LOG("[fsr3] the backend asked for %s: not on this device, a no-op\n", name);
        f = (PFN_vkVoidFunction)fsr3_noop;
    }
    return f;
}

#ifdef _WIN32
static bool ensure_context(uint32_t rw, uint32_t rh, uint32_t ow, uint32_t oh) {
    if (ctx && ctx_rw == rw && ctx_rh == rh && ctx_ow == ow && ctx_oh == oh) return true;
    if (ctx) {
        vkDeviceWaitIdle(g_vk.dev);
        fx.DestroyContext(&ctx, NULL);
        ctx = NULL;
    }
    ffxCreateBackendVKDesc be = {};
    be.header.type = FFX_API_CREATE_CONTEXT_DESC_TYPE_BACKEND_VK;
    be.vkDevice = g_vk.dev, be.vkPhysicalDevice = g_vk.phys, be.vkDeviceProcAddr = fsr3_device_proc;
    // the game image is gamma-encoded (perceptual): FSR linearises it and writes the output the same way
    ffxCreateContextDescUpscale cd = {};
    cd.header.type = FFX_API_CREATE_CONTEXT_DESC_TYPE_UPSCALE, cd.header.pNext = &be.header;
    cd.flags = FFX_UPSCALE_ENABLE_NON_LINEAR_COLORSPACE;
    cd.maxRenderSize.width = rw, cd.maxRenderSize.height = rh, cd.maxUpscaleSize.width = ow, cd.maxUpscaleSize.height = oh;
    cd.fpMessage = fsr3_message;
    ffxReturnCode_t r = fx.CreateContext(&ctx, &cd.header, NULL);
    if (r != FFX_API_RETURN_OK) {
        LOG("[fsr3] context %ux%u -> %ux%u failed (%u): FSR 1 instead\n", rw, rh, ow, oh, r);
        ctx = NULL;
        loaded = 0;
        return false;
    }
    ctx_rw = rw, ctx_rh = rh, ctx_ow = ow, ctx_oh = oh;
    LOG("[fsr3] context %ux%u -> %ux%u\n", rw, rh, ow, oh);
    return true;
}
#endif

extern "C" void fsr3_jitter(uint32_t rw, uint32_t ow, uint64_t frame, float *jx, float *jy) {
    *jx = *jy = 0;
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (!fsr3_available() || !rw || !ow) return;
    int32_t phases = 8;
    ffxQueryDescUpscaleGetJitterPhaseCount pq = {};
    pq.header.type = FFX_API_QUERY_DESC_TYPE_UPSCALE_GETJITTERPHASECOUNT;
    pq.renderWidth = rw, pq.displayWidth = ow, pq.pOutPhaseCount = &phases;
    fx.Query(NULL, &pq.header);  // (a query without a context: the API's static queries)
    if (phases < 1) phases = 8;
    ffxQueryDescUpscaleGetJitterOffset jq = {};
    jq.header.type = FFX_API_QUERY_DESC_TYPE_UPSCALE_GETJITTEROFFSET;
    jq.index = (int32_t)(frame % (uint64_t)phases), jq.phaseCount = phases, jq.pOutX = jx, jq.pOutY = jy;
    fx.Query(NULL, &jq.header);
#else
    (void)frame;
#endif
}

static FfxApiResource res(VkImage img, uint32_t fmt, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t usage) {
    FfxApiResourceDescription d = {};
    d.type = FFX_API_RESOURCE_TYPE_TEXTURE2D, d.format = fmt, d.width = w, d.height = h, d.depth = 1, d.mipCount = 1;
    d.flags = 0, d.usage = usage;
    return ffxApiGetResourceVK((void *)img, d, FFX_API_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS);  // (every image here: GENERAL)
}

extern "C" bool fsr3_dispatch(VkCommandBuffer cb, const Fsr3Dispatch *in) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (!fsr3_available() || !ensure_context(in->rw, in->rh, in->ow, in->oh)) return false;
    ffxDispatchDescUpscale d = {};
    d.header.type = FFX_API_DISPATCH_DESC_TYPE_UPSCALE;
    d.commandList = cb;
    d.color = res(in->color, FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, in->rw, in->rh, FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_READ_ONLY);
    d.depth = res(in->depth, FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT, in->rw, in->rh, FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_READ_ONLY);
    d.motionVectors = res(in->mv, FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, in->mvw, in->mvh, FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_READ_ONLY);
    if (in->mask) d.transparencyAndComposition = res(in->mask, FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, in->rw, in->rh, FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_READ_ONLY);
    d.output = res(in->output, FFX_API_SURFACE_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, in->ow, in->oh, FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_UAV);
    d.jitterOffset.x = in->jx, d.jitterOffset.y = in->jy;
    d.motionVectorScale.x = in->mv_scale_x, d.motionVectorScale.y = in->mv_scale_y;
    d.renderSize.width = in->rw, d.renderSize.height = in->rh;
    d.upscaleSize.width = in->ow, d.upscaleSize.height = in->oh;
    d.enableSharpening = in->sharpness > 0.01f;
    d.sharpness = in->sharpness;
    d.frameTimeDelta = in->frame_ms;
    d.preExposure = 1.0f;
    d.reset = in->reset;
    d.cameraNear = in->near_;
    d.cameraFar = in->far_;
    d.cameraFovAngleVertical = in->fov_y;
    d.viewSpaceToMetersFactor = in->meters_per_unit;
    d.flags = FFX_UPSCALE_FLAG_NON_LINEAR_COLOR_SRGB;
    ffxReturnCode_t r = fx.Dispatch(&ctx, &d.header);
    if (r != FFX_API_RETURN_OK) {
        static int n;
        if (n++ < 4) LOG("[fsr3] dispatch failed (%u)\n", r);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
#else
    (void)cb, (void)in;
    return false;
#endif
}

extern "C" void fsr3_shutdown(void) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (ctx) { vkDeviceWaitIdle(g_vk.dev); fx.DestroyContext(&ctx, NULL); ctx = NULL; }
#endif
}
```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/fsr3.h`:

```h
// FSR 3.1 upscaling (runtime/nvn/vulkan/fsr3.c): the AMD FidelityFX DLL, loaded at run time.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

typedef struct {
    VkImage color, depth, mv, mask, output;  // color RGBA8 (gamma-encoded), depth R32F, mv RGBA16F, mask RGBA8 (or none)
    uint32_t rw, rh, ow, oh, mvw, mvh;       // render size, output size, the motion vectors' size
    float jx, jy;                            // this frame's jitter, in render pixels (fsr3_jitter)
    float mv_scale_x, mv_scale_y;            // the motion vectors to pixels, previous - current
    float near_, far_, fov_y, meters_per_unit, frame_ms, sharpness;
    bool reset;                              // no history (a cut, the first frame)
} Fsr3Dispatch;

bool fsr3_available(void);
// the jitter sequence for render width rw upscaled to ow: frame's offset in pixels
void fsr3_jitter(uint32_t rw, uint32_t ow, uint64_t frame, float *jx, float *jy);
// records the upscale into cb (outside any rendering); false: not done (use FSR 1)
bool fsr3_dispatch(VkCommandBuffer cb, const Fsr3Dispatch *d);
void fsr3_shutdown(void);
```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/imgui_glue.cpp`:

```cpp
// Dear ImGui's Vulkan backend on our device (start screen and in-game menu; both draw inside the window image's
// dynamic rendering begun by vk_frame_begin).
#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_impl_vulkan.h"

extern "C" {
#include "vk.h"
}

// Per ImGui context (the start screen and the in-game menu each have one, and the start screen comes back after an
// in-place reboot while the menu's context lives on): the backend keeps its data in the current context.
extern "C" bool vk_imgui_backend_init(void) {
    if (ImGui::GetIO().BackendRendererUserData) return true;
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_InitInfo ii = {};
    ii.ApiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3;
    ii.Instance = g_vk.inst;
    ii.PhysicalDevice = g_vk.phys;
    ii.Device = g_vk.dev;
    ii.QueueFamily = g_vk.qfam;
    ii.Queue = g_vk.queue;
    ii.DescriptorPoolSize = 64;
    ii.MinImageCount = 2;
    ii.ImageCount = (g_vk.sc_count > 3 ? g_vk.sc_count : 3) + 1;  // vertex buffers rotate per image: cover frames in flight
    ii.MSAASamples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    ii.PipelineCache = g_vk.pcache;
    ii.UseDynamicRendering = true;
    ii.PipelineRenderingCreateInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RENDERING_CREATE_INFO_KHR;
    ii.PipelineRenderingCreateInfo.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
    ii.PipelineRenderingCreateInfo.pColorAttachmentFormats = &g_vk.sc_format;
    bool ok = ImGui_ImplVulkan_Init(&ii);
    if (!ok) LOG("[vk] ImGui Vulkan backend init failed\n");
    return ok;
}

extern "C" void vk_imgui_backend_shutdown(void) {
    if (!ImGui::GetIO().BackendRendererUserData) return;
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(g_vk.dev);
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_Shutdown();
}

// A static RGBA8 image for ImGui (start screen background). Returns the ImTextureID.
extern "C" uint64_t vk_imgui_texture_rgba(const void *rgba, int w, int h) {
    VkImageCreateInfo ci = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO};
    ci.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    ci.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    ci.extent = {(uint32_t)w, (uint32_t)h, 1};
    ci.mipLevels = 1;
    ci.arrayLayers = 1;
    ci.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    ci.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    ci.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {};
    ai.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE;
    VkImage img;
    VmaAllocation mem;
    if (vmaCreateImage(g_vk.vma, &ci, &ai, &img, &mem, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_upload_cmd();
    vk_image_init_layout(cb, img, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT);
    VkSpan s = vk_transient_copy(rgba, (uint64_t)w * h * 4, 16);
    VkBufferImageCopy rg = {};
    rg.bufferOffset = s.off;
    rg.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1};
    rg.imageExtent = {(uint32_t)w, (uint32_t)h, 1};
    vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, s.buf, img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, 1, &rg);
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO};
    vi.image = img;
    vi.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    vi.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    vi.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
    VkImageView view;
    if (vkCreateImageView(g_vk.dev, &vi, NULL, &view) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    return (uint64_t)ImGui_ImplVulkan_AddTexture(vk_default_sampler(true), view, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
}
```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/renderdoc.c`:

```c
// RenderDoc frame capture on demand (docs/PLANO-3D.md, fase 3). Run the game under RenderDoc
// (`renderdoccmd capture -w ./build/lasrecomp.exe ...`, see tools/repro.sh RENDERDOC=1) with
// LARECOMP_RENDERDOC_AT=<frame>: the frames after that one are captured into build/rdc/ (LARECOMP_RENDERDOC_FRAMES of
// them, default 4: the game doesn't draw its scene on every present). Without RenderDoc loaded this does nothing.
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <dlfcn.h>
#endif

#include "../../rt.h"

// The parts of renderdoc_app.h (MIT, RenderDoc) used here: RENDERDOC_GetAPI and the 1.6.0 API table up to
// TriggerMultiFrameCapture.
typedef int (*pRENDERDOC_GetAPI)(int version, void **out);
typedef struct {
    void *GetAPIVersion, *SetCaptureOptionU32, *SetCaptureOptionF32, *GetCaptureOptionU32, *GetCaptureOptionF32,
        *SetFocusToggleKeys, *SetCaptureKeys, *GetOverlayBits, *MaskOverlayBits, *RemoveHooks, *UnloadCrashHandler;
    void (*SetCaptureFilePathTemplate)(const char *pathtemplate);
    void *GetCaptureFilePathTemplate, *GetNumCaptures, *GetCapture;
    void (*TriggerCapture)(void);
    void *IsTargetControlConnected, *LaunchReplayUI, *SetActiveWindow, *StartFrameCapture, *IsFrameCapturing,
        *EndFrameCapture;
    void (*TriggerMultiFrameCapture)(uint32_t frames);
} RenderDocApi;
enum { RENDERDOC_API_1_6_0 = 10600 };

void renderdoc_frame(uint64_t frame) {
    static int state;  // 0 not checked, 1 inactive, 2 armed
    static uint64_t at;
    static RenderDocApi *api;
    if (state == 1) return;
    if (state == 0) {
        state = 1;
        const char *e = getenv("LARECOMP_RENDERDOC_AT");
        if (!e) return;
        pRENDERDOC_GetAPI get = NULL;
#ifdef _WIN32
        HMODULE m = GetModuleHandleA("renderdoc.dll");
        if (m) get = (pRENDERDOC_GetAPI)(void *)GetProcAddress(m, "RENDERDOC_GetAPI");
#else
        void *m = dlopen("librenderdoc.so", RTLD_NOW | RTLD_NOLOAD);
        if (m) get = (pRENDERDOC_GetAPI)dlsym(m, "RENDERDOC_GetAPI");
#endif
        if (!get || !get(RENDERDOC_API_1_6_0, (void **)&api) || !api) {
            LOG("[renderdoc] LARECOMP_RENDERDOC_AT set but RenderDoc is not loaded (run under renderdoccmd capture)\n");
            return;
        }
        api->SetCaptureFilePathTemplate("build/rdc/capture");
        at = strtoull(e, NULL, 10);
        state = 2;
        LOG("[renderdoc] armed: capturing from frame %llu\n", (unsigned long long)at + 1);
    }
    if (frame == at) {
        const char *n = getenv("LARECOMP_RENDERDOC_FRAMES");
        api->TriggerMultiFrameCapture(n ? (uint32_t)atoi(n) : 4);
        LOG("[renderdoc] capture of %s frames triggered at frame %llu\n", n ? n : "4", (unsigned long long)frame);
        state = 1;
    }
}
```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/renderthread.c`:

```c
// The render thread (LARECOMP_RENDER_THREAD): the game's calls into the backend (command lists, presents, texture
// destruction) are queued in the order the game made them and run on one thread of ours, so the game thread goes on with
// the next frame while the Vulkan commands of this one are recorded (docs/PESQUISA-GPU.md: without the backend's work the
// game's chain runs at ~160 fps, with it at ~90).
//
// What the console's contract gives us: after nvnQueueSubmitCommands the game may not touch what the lists use until a
// fence says the GPU is done, so running the lists later changes nothing it can see. The rest is kept in order here:
//  - fences are tickets (the jobs queued so far): nvnSyncWait waits for the render thread to pass its ticket and then for
//    the GPU submission it ended with, not for everything queued since (that would put the game thread right back in
//    step with the render thread);
//  - what the game writes to memory the GPU reads (backend_pool_written) is stamped on each list, so a list sees the writes
//    made before it was submitted and no later ones (textures.c dirty_check);
//  - destroying a texture runs on this thread, after the lists queued before it (rt_call);
//  - the counters the game and the scripted tests see (renderer_game_frame) count the presents it has made; the backend's
//    own (renderer_present_count) count the ones it has shown.
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../../rt.h"
#include "../../settings.h"
#include "../nvn.h"

void vk_wait_seq(uint64_t seq);                    // exec.c
uint64_t renderer_fence_seq(void);                 // exec.c: GPU submissions so far (the one being filled included)
void renderer_wait_seq(uint64_t seq);              // exec.c
uint64_t backend_dirty_seq(void);                  // textures.c
void backend_set_dirty_limit(uint64_t seq);        // textures.c
uint64_t renderer_present_count(void);             // device.c: presents shown
void input_frame(uint64_t frame);                  // hle/input.c
void fnprof_frame(uint64_t frame);                 // fnprof.c
void reboot_test_frame(uint64_t frame);            // main.c
bool vk_pending_next(uint64_t *due);               // device.c: the next scheduled image's time (false: none)
void vk_pending_run(bool all);                     // device.c: show the scheduled images due by now
void vk_pending_drop(void);                        // device.c: forget them (a reboot)

enum { RJ_EXEC, RJ_PRESENT, RJ_CALL };
typedef struct {
    int kind;
    uint64_t handle, dirty;
    NvnTexture *tex;
    void (*fn)(void *);
    void *arg;
    volatile int *done;
} Job;

#define QN 256       // jobs queued at most (the game thread waits when it is full)
#define MAX_PRESENTS 2  // presents queued at most: the game runs up to two frames ahead of what the window shows
static Job queue[QN];
static unsigned qhead, qtail;
static pthread_mutex_t lk = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t c_work = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER, c_done = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static uint64_t enq, fin;              // tickets: jobs queued / finished
static uint64_t seq_after[1024];       // the GPU submission count after each finished job (by ticket)
static uint64_t pres_enq, pres_fin;
static uint64_t game_frames;
static bool started, busy, dropping;
static __thread bool on_render_thread;
static pthread_t thread;

bool rt_active(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("LARECOMP_RENDER_THREAD");
        on = e ? atoi(e) != 0 : g_settings.render_thread;  // (the environment wins over larecomp.ini)
        if (on) LOG("[rt] render thread on\n");
    }
    return on;
}
bool rt_on_render_thread(void) { return on_render_thread; }

uint64_t renderer_game_frame(void) {
    return rt_active() ? __atomic_load_n(&game_frames, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) : renderer_present_count();
}

static void run(Job *j) {
    switch (j->kind) {
    case RJ_EXEC:
        backend_set_dirty_limit(j->dirty);
        backend_execute(j->handle);
        backend_set_dirty_limit(0);
        break;
    case RJ_PRESENT: backend_present(j->tex); break;
    case RJ_CALL: j->fn(j->arg); break;
    }
}

// The images a present scheduled for later (frame interpolation: device.c vk_pending_*) are shown here when due:
// between jobs, or while waiting for one - the next frame's lists run meanwhile instead of waiting with them.
// A job runs to its end first, so an image can come up to one job late (a command list: well under a millisecond).
static void wait_work(void) {  // (holds lk; returns with a job queued)
    while (qhead == qtail) {
        uint64_t due;
        if (!vk_pending_next(&due)) { pthread_cond_wait(&c_work, &lk); continue; }
        uint64_t now = SDL_GetTicksNS();
        // Until it is due, slices of at most 1 ms with SDL's high-resolution timer, looking for work between them: a
        // timed wait on the condition (winpthreads) woke up to ~7 ms late, absolute or relative - the scheduled image
        // came with the next present instead (2x: shown in pairs, 15 / 2 ms apart instead of 8.3 / 8.3)
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk);
        if (due > now) SDL_DelayPrecise(due - now > 1000000 ? 1000000 : due - now);
        vk_pending_run(false);
        pthread_mutex_lock(&lk);
    }
}

static void *render_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    on_render_thread = true;
    crash_handler_install();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lk);
    for (;;) {
        wait_work();
        Job j = queue[qhead % QN];
        busy = true;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk);
        if (!dropping || j.kind == RJ_CALL) run(&j);  // (a reboot drops queued lists and presents, never a caller's call)
        if (!dropping) vk_pending_run(false);
        uint64_t seq = renderer_fence_seq();
        pthread_mutex_lock(&lk);
        qhead++;
        fin++;
        seq_after[fin & 1023] = seq;
        if (j.kind == RJ_PRESENT) pres_fin++;
        if (j.done) *j.done = 1;
        busy = false;
        pthread_cond_broadcast(&c_done);
    }
    return NULL;
}

// Waits on c_done for up to 5 ms (the caller holds lk); false once a reboot is stopping the guest threads.
static bool wait_done(void) {
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
    ts.tv_nsec += 5000000;
    if (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000) { ts.tv_sec++; ts.tv_nsec -= 1000000000; }
    pthread_cond_timedwait(&c_done, &lk, &ts);
    return !g_rt_unwind;
}

// Queues a job; returns its ticket (0: not queued, a reboot is stopping the guest threads).
static uint64_t push(Job j) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lk);
    if (!started) {
        started = true;
        pthread_attr_t attr;
        pthread_attr_init(&attr);
        pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, 64ull << 20);
        pthread_create(&thread, &attr, render_main, NULL);
        pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
    }
    while (qtail - qhead >= QN)
        if (!wait_done()) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk); return 0; }
    queue[qtail % QN] = j;
    qtail++;
    uint64_t t = ++enq;
    pthread_cond_signal(&c_work);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk);
    return t;
}

void rt_submit(uint64_t handle) {
    if (!rt_active()) { backend_execute(handle); return; }
    Job j = {.kind = RJ_EXEC, .handle = handle, .dirty = backend_dirty_seq()};
    push(j);
}

// Game thread: the frame's present. The window shows it when the render thread gets there; the game's own bookkeeping that a
// present used to run at its end (scripted input, function profile, reboot tests) happens here, in the game's order.
void rt_present(NvnTexture *t) {
    if (!t) return;
    if (!rt_active()) { backend_present(t); return; }
    // Frame interpolation replays the frame's command lists at its present (exec.c vk_interp_replay): the game may not
    // write them again for the frame after the next until then, so it runs one present ahead instead of two (with two,
    // its next-but-one frame went into the memory being replayed: a crash in the replay)
    extern bool vk_interp_enabled(void);
    int ahead = vk_interp_enabled() ? 1 : MAX_PRESENTS;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lk);
    while (pres_enq - pres_fin >= (uint64_t)ahead)
        if (!wait_done()) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk); return; }
    pres_enq++;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk);
    Job j = {.kind = RJ_PRESENT, .tex = t};
    push(j);
    uint64_t n = __atomic_add_fetch(&game_frames, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    input_frame(n);
    fnprof_frame(n);
    reboot_test_frame(n);
}

// Runs fn(arg) on the render thread, after everything queued before it, and returns when it is done.
void rt_call(void (*fn)(void *), void *arg) {
    if (!rt_active() || on_render_thread) { fn(arg); return; }
    volatile int done = 0;
    Job j = {.kind = RJ_CALL, .fn = fn, .arg = arg, .done = &done};
    if (!push(j)) { return; }  // (a reboot: the call is dropped with the guest thread's work)
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lk);
    while (!done) pthread_cond_wait(&c_done, &lk);  // (the render thread never waits for the game: this ends)
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk);
}

// Everything queued so far has run.
void rt_drain(void) {
    if (!rt_active() || on_render_thread) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lk);
    uint64_t target = enq;
    while (fin < target)
        if (!wait_done()) break;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk);
}

uint64_t rt_fence_ticket(void) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lk);
    uint64_t t = enq;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk);
    return t;
}

// The fence of a ticket: the render thread has passed it, and the GPU has run what it submitted up to there.
void rt_wait_ticket(uint64_t ticket) {
    if (!ticket) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lk);
    while (fin < ticket)
        if (!wait_done()) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk); return; }
    uint64_t seq = seq_after[ticket & 1023];
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk);
    renderer_wait_seq(seq);
}

// Reboot (backend_reset, the guest threads stopped): the queued work belongs to the game that is going away.
void rt_reset(void) {
    if (!started) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lk);
    dropping = true;
    while (qhead != qtail || busy) pthread_cond_wait(&c_done, &lk);
    dropping = false;
    pres_enq = pres_fin = 0;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk);
    vk_pending_drop();
    __atomic_store_n(&game_frames, renderer_present_count(), __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/shaders.c`:

```c
// GLSL -> SPIR-V (shaderc), descriptor layouts from the SPIR-V itself, translated NVN programs, built-in shaders.
#include <pthread.h>
#include <shaderc/shaderc.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>

#include "shaders.h"

void vk_shaders_init(void) {  // (compilers are per thread: check shaderc works at all)
    shaderc_compiler_t c = shaderc_compiler_initialize();
    if (!c) FATAL("shaderc_compiler_initialize failed\n");
    shaderc_compiler_release(c);
}

static shaderc_shader_kind kind_of(int stage) {
    return stage == STAGE_VERTEX ? shaderc_vertex_shader : stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT ? shaderc_fragment_shader : shaderc_compute_shader;
}

// SPIR-V disk cache: cache/spirv/<hash of stage + source>.spv, so a known shader costs a file read instead of a
// GLSL compile (the driver's pipeline cache only covers the step after this one).
static uint64_t src_hash(const char *src, int stage) {
    uint64_t h = (0xcbf29ce484222325ull ^ (uint64_t)stage) + 3;  // + version of the post-processing (no_contraction)
    for (const char *p = src; *p; p++) { h ^= (uint8_t)*p; h *= 0x100000001B3ull; }
    return h;
}

static uint32_t *cache_load(uint64_t h, size_t *nwords) {
    char path[64];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "cache/spirv/%016llx.spv", (unsigned long long)h);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    uint32_t *d = n > 20 && n % 4 == 0 ? malloc((size_t)n) : NULL;
    if (d && fread(d, 1, (size_t)n, f) != (size_t)n) { free(d); d = NULL; }
    fclose(f);
    if (d && d[0] != 0x07230203) { free(d); d = NULL; }
    if (d) *nwords = (size_t)n / 4;
    return d;
}

static void cache_store(uint64_t h, const uint32_t *spv, size_t nwords) {
    static int made;
    if (!made) { made = 1; mkdir("cache", 0755); mkdir("cache/spirv", 0755); }
    char path[64], tmp[80];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "cache/spirv/%016llx.spv", (unsigned long long)h);
    snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.%llx", path, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)&made ^ (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)spv);
    FILE *f = fopen(tmp, "wb");
    if (!f) return;
    bool ok = fwrite(spv, 4, nwords, f) == nwords;
    fclose(f);
    if (!ok || rename(tmp, path) != 0) remove(tmp);  // (another thread may have stored it first)
}

// Vertex shaders: every float add/sub/mul/div/fma gets NoContraction, so no compiler fuses or splits them. Depth
// pre-pass and colour pass are different shaders computing the same position, and the colour pass tests EQUAL:
// any difference in fusing leaves holes (foliage flickered black). GLSL's `precise gl_Position` only covers what
// glslang traces back from the position, which the translated register code defeats.
static bool float_arith(const uint32_t *w, uint32_t wc, uint32_t op) {
    switch (op) {
    case 127: case 129: case 131: case 133: case 136:  // FNegate FAdd FSub FMul FDiv
    case 142: case 143: case 144: case 145: case 146: case 148:  // vector/matrix products, Dot
        return true;
    case 12: return wc >= 5 && w[4] == 50;  // ExtInst GLSL.std.450 Fma
    default: return false;
    }
}

static uint32_t *no_contraction(uint32_t *spv, size_t *nwords) {
    enum { OP_DECORATE = 71, DEC_NO_CONTRACTION = 42 };
    size_t n = *nwords, insert = 0, count = 0;
    uint32_t bound = spv[3];
    uint8_t *done = calloc(bound, 1);  // already decorated (glslang does it for what it traces from precise)
    for (size_t i = 5; i < n;) {
        uint32_t wc = spv[i] >> 16, op = spv[i] & 0xFFFF;
        if (!wc) break;
        if (!insert && op >= 19 && op <= 39) insert = i;  // first type declaration: end of the annotations
        if (op == OP_DECORATE && wc >= 3 && spv[i + 2] == DEC_NO_CONTRACTION && spv[i + 1] < bound) done[spv[i + 1]] = 1;
        i += wc;
    }
    for (size_t i = 5; i < n;) {
        uint32_t wc = spv[i] >> 16, op = spv[i] & 0xFFFF;
        if (!wc) break;
        if (float_arith(spv + i, wc, op) && spv[i + 2] < bound && !done[spv[i + 2]]) count++;
        i += wc;
    }
    if (!insert || !count) { free(done); return spv; }
    uint32_t *out = malloc((n + count * 3) * 4);
    memcpy(out, spv, insert * 4);
    size_t o = insert;
    for (size_t i = 5; i < n;) {
        uint32_t wc = spv[i] >> 16, op = spv[i] & 0xFFFF;
        if (!wc) break;
        if (float_arith(spv + i, wc, op) && spv[i + 2] < bound && !done[spv[i + 2]]) {
            done[spv[i + 2]] = 1;
            out[o++] = 3u << 16 | OP_DECORATE;
            out[o++] = spv[i + 2];  // result id
            out[o++] = DEC_NO_CONTRACTION;
        }
        i += wc;
    }
    memcpy(out + o, spv + insert, (n - insert) * 4);
    *nwords = o + (n - insert);
    free(done);
    free(spv);
    return out;
}

// SPIR-V words of src, or NULL (error logged with the source). *nwords set on success. Thread-safe: one shaderc
// compiler per thread (a shared one behind a lock serialised all the pipeline workers).
// No spirv-opt by default: it rewrote the depth pre-pass and colour-pass vertex shaders differently enough that
// their depths stopped matching (EQUAL test: black holes in foliage), and it was most of the compile time; the
// driver optimises anyway. LARECOMP_VK_OPT=1 turns it back on (experiments).
uint32_t *vk_glsl_to_spirv(const char *src, int stage, const char *name, size_t *nwords) {
    uint64_t h = src_hash(src, stage);
    static int nocache = -1;
    if (nocache < 0) nocache = getenv("LARECOMP_VK_NO_SPIRV_CACHE") != NULL;
    uint32_t *out = nocache ? NULL : cache_load(h, nwords);
    if (out) return out;
    static __thread shaderc_compiler_t comp;
    if (!comp) comp = shaderc_compiler_initialize();
    shaderc_compile_options_t o = shaderc_compile_options_initialize();
    shaderc_compile_options_set_target_env(o, shaderc_target_env_vulkan, shaderc_env_version_vulkan_1_3);
    shaderc_compile_options_set_optimization_level(o, getenv("LARECOMP_VK_OPT") ? shaderc_optimization_level_performance
                                                                                  : shaderc_optimization_level_zero);
    shaderc_compilation_result_t r = shaderc_compile_into_spv(comp, src, strlen(src), kind_of(stage), name, "main", o);
    shaderc_compile_options_release(o);
    if (shaderc_result_get_compilation_status(r) != shaderc_compilation_status_success) {
        static int nlog;
        if (nlog++ < 20) LOG("[shader] %s: GLSL compile failed:\n%s\n%s\n", name, shaderc_result_get_error_message(r), src);
    } else {
        size_t n = shaderc_result_get_length(r);
        out = malloc(n);
        memcpy(out, shaderc_result_get_bytes(r), n);
        *nwords = n / 4;
        if (stage == STAGE_VERTEX) out = no_contraction(out, nwords);
        if (!nocache) cache_store(h, out, *nwords);
    }
    shaderc_result_release(r);
    return out;
}

VkShaderModule vk_module(const uint32_t *spv, size_t nwords) {
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO, .codeSize = nwords * 4, .pCode = spv};
    VkShaderModule m;
    return vkCreateShaderModule(g_vk.dev, &ci, NULL, &m) == VK_SUCCESS ? m : VK_NULL_HANDLE;
}

VkShaderModule vk_compile_glsl(const char *src, int stage, const char *name) {
    size_t n;
    uint32_t *spv = vk_glsl_to_spirv(src, stage, name, &n);
    if (!spv) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkShaderModule m = vk_module(spv, n);
    free(spv);
    return m;
}

// ================================================================== reflection
// Just enough SPIR-V parsing to list the descriptor bindings a module declares (set, binding, type).
enum { OP_TYPE_IMAGE = 25, OP_TYPE_SAMPLER = 26, OP_TYPE_SAMPLED_IMAGE = 27, OP_TYPE_ARRAY = 28, OP_TYPE_RUNTIME_ARRAY = 29,
       OP_TYPE_STRUCT = 30, OP_TYPE_POINTER = 32, OP_VARIABLE = 59, OP_DECORATE = 71 };
enum { DEC_BLOCK = 2, DEC_BUFFER_BLOCK = 3, DEC_BINDING = 33, DEC_SET = 34 };
enum { SC_UNIFORM_CONSTANT = 0, SC_UNIFORM = 2, SC_STORAGE_BUFFER = 12 };

int vk_reflect(const uint32_t *spv, size_t n, VkBindingInfo *out, int max) {
    if (n < 5 || spv[0] != 0x07230203) return 0;
    uint32_t bound = spv[3];
    int32_t *binding = malloc(bound * sizeof *binding), *set = malloc(bound * sizeof *set);
    uint8_t *flags = calloc(bound, 1);    // 1 Block, 2 BufferBlock
    uint32_t *op = calloc(bound, sizeof *op), *ref = calloc(bound, sizeof *ref), *sc = calloc(bound, sizeof *sc);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < bound; i++) binding[i] = set[i] = -1;
    for (size_t i = 5; i < n;) {
        uint32_t wc = spv[i] >> 16, o = spv[i] & 0xFFFF;
        if (!wc) break;
        const uint32_t *w = spv + i;
        if (o == OP_DECORATE && wc >= 3 && w[1] < bound) {
            if (w[2] == DEC_BINDING && wc >= 4) binding[w[1]] = (int32_t)w[3];
            else if (w[2] == DEC_SET && wc >= 4) set[w[1]] = (int32_t)w[3];
            else if (w[2] == DEC_BLOCK) flags[w[1]] |= 1;
            else if (w[2] == DEC_BUFFER_BLOCK) flags[w[1]] |= 2;
        } else if ((o == OP_TYPE_IMAGE || o == OP_TYPE_SAMPLER || o == OP_TYPE_SAMPLED_IMAGE || o == OP_TYPE_STRUCT) && wc >= 2 && w[1] < bound) {
            op[w[1]] = o;
        } else if ((o == OP_TYPE_ARRAY || o == OP_TYPE_RUNTIME_ARRAY) && wc >= 3 && w[1] < bound) {
            op[w[1]] = o;
            ref[w[1]] = w[2];
        } else if (o == OP_TYPE_POINTER && wc >= 4 && w[1] < bound) {
            op[w[1]] = o;
            sc[w[1]] = w[2];
            ref[w[1]] = w[3];
        } else if (o == OP_VARIABLE && wc >= 4 && w[2] < bound && w[1] < bound) {
            op[w[2]] = o;
            ref[w[2]] = w[1];  // pointer type
            sc[w[2]] = w[3];
        }
        i += wc;
    }
    int cnt = 0;
    for (uint32_t id = 0; id < bound && cnt < max; id++) {
        if (op[id] != OP_VARIABLE || binding[id] < 0) continue;
        uint32_t t = ref[ref[id]];  // pointee
        while (t < bound && (op[t] == OP_TYPE_ARRAY || op[t] == OP_TYPE_RUNTIME_ARRAY)) t = ref[t];
        VkDescriptorType dt;
        if (t >= bound) continue;
        if (op[t] == OP_TYPE_SAMPLED_IMAGE) dt = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER;
        else if (op[t] == OP_TYPE_IMAGE) dt = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLED_IMAGE;
        else if (op[t] == OP_TYPE_SAMPLER) dt = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLER;
        else if (op[t] == OP_TYPE_STRUCT && (sc[id] == SC_STORAGE_BUFFER || (flags[t] & 2))) dt = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER;
        else if (op[t] == OP_TYPE_STRUCT && sc[id] == SC_UNIFORM) dt = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER;
        else continue;
        out[cnt++] = (VkBindingInfo){(uint32_t)(set[id] < 0 ? 0 : set[id]), (uint32_t)binding[id], dt};
    }
    free(binding); free(set); free(flags); free(op); free(ref); free(sc);
    return cnt;
}

VkDescriptorSetLayout vk_set_layout(const VkBindingInfo *b, int n, uint32_t set, VkShaderStageFlags stages) {
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding lb[96];
    uint32_t k = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n && k < 96; i++)
        if (b[i].set == set) lb[k++] = (VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding){b[i].binding, b[i].type, 1, stages, NULL};
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .bindingCount = k, .pBindings = lb};
    VkDescriptorSetLayout l;
    VK_CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(g_vk.dev, &ci, NULL, &l));
    return l;
}

// ================================================================== built-in shaders
static const char *builtin_src(const char *name, int *stage) {
    if (!strcmp(name, "present.vert")) {
        *stage = STAGE_VERTEX;
        // pv[0].x: flip (lower-left origin), pv[1]: uv crop (origin, size). Fullscreen triangle; Vulkan NDC y points down.
        return "#version 450\n"
               "layout(push_constant) uniform P { vec4 a; vec4 crop; } pc;\n"
               "layout(location = 0) out vec2 uv;\n"
               "void main() {\n"
               "  vec2 p = vec2((gl_VertexIndex << 1) & 2, gl_VertexIndex & 2);\n"
               "  gl_Position = vec4(p * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);\n"
               "  vec2 u = vec2(p.x, pc.a.x > 0.5 ? 1.0 - p.y : p.y);\n"
               "  uv = pc.crop.xy + u * pc.crop.zw;\n"
               "}\n";
    }
    if (!strcmp(name, "present.frag")) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        return "#version 450\n"
               "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t;\n"
               "layout(location = 0) in vec2 uv;\n"
               "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
               // A render resolution above the window's (the launcher's 1440p / 4K on a smaller screen: supersampling)
               // is reduced with four bilinear taps spread over each window pixel's footprint - one bilinear tap
               // skips texels and keeps the jaggies (exactly 2x: the 2x2 box).
               "void main() {\n"
               "  vec2 d = vec2(dFdx(uv.x), dFdy(uv.y)), r = abs(d) * vec2(textureSize(t, 0));\n"
               "  if (max(r.x, r.y) < 1.05) { o = vec4(texture(t, uv).rgb, 1.0); return; }\n"
               "  vec2 q = d * 0.25;\n"
               "  vec3 c = texture(t, uv + vec2(-q.x, -q.y)).rgb + texture(t, uv + vec2(q.x, -q.y)).rgb +\n"
               "           texture(t, uv + vec2(-q.x, q.y)).rgb + texture(t, uv + vec2(q.x, q.y)).rgb;\n"
               "  o = vec4(c * 0.25, 1.0);\n"
               "}\n";
    }
    // ---- post passes before the present (Video tab "Anti-aliasing" / "Upscaler"): exec.c vk_present_draw.
    // Each draws a fullscreen triangle into an image the size of its output; push constants: two vec4.
    if (!strcmp(name, "post.vert")) {
        *stage = STAGE_VERTEX;
        return "#version 450\n"
               "void main() {\n"
               "  vec2 p = vec2((gl_VertexIndex << 1) & 2, gl_VertexIndex & 2);\n"
               "  gl_Position = vec4(p * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);\n"
               "}\n";
    }
    // SMAA 1x (third_party/smaa, runtime/nvn/smaa_data.c): the reference SMAA.hlsl in its GLSL mode, High preset,
    // with an entry point per pass. a = SMAA_RT_METRICS (1 / size, size). The vertex-stage offset helpers run per
    // pixel here. Luma edges (t0 = colour) -> blending weights (t0 = edges, t1 = area, t2 = search) -> neighbourhood
    // blending (t0 = colour, t1 = weights). Vulkan's texture origin is top-left, as SMAA expects (no flips).
    if (!strncmp(name, "smaa_", 5)) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        static char *src[3];
        int k = !strcmp(name, "smaa_edge.frag") ? 0 : !strcmp(name, "smaa_weight.frag") ? 1 : !strcmp(name, "smaa_blend.frag") ? 2 : -1;
        if (k < 0) return NULL;
        if (!src[k]) {
            extern const char smaa_hlsl_src[];
            static const char *head =
                "#version 450\n"
                "layout(push_constant) uniform P { vec4 a; vec4 b; } pc;\n"
                "#define SMAA_RT_METRICS pc.a\n"
                "#define SMAA_GLSL_4\n"
                "#define SMAA_PRESET_HIGH\n";
            static const char *mains[3] = {
                "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t0;\n"
                "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
                "void main() {\n"
                "  vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy * SMAA_RT_METRICS.xy;\n"
                "  vec4 off[3];\n"
                "  SMAAEdgeDetectionVS(uv, off);\n"
                "  o = vec4(SMAALumaEdgeDetectionPS(uv, off, t0), 0.0, 0.0);\n"
                "}\n",
                "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t0;\n"
                "layout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform sampler2D t1;\n"
                "layout(set = 0, binding = 2) uniform sampler2D t2;\n"
                "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
                "void main() {\n"
                "  vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy * SMAA_RT_METRICS.xy, pix;\n"
                "  vec4 off[3];\n"
                "  SMAABlendingWeightCalculationVS(uv, pix, off);\n"
                "  o = SMAABlendingWeightCalculationPS(uv, pix, off, t0, t1, t2, vec4(0.0));\n"
                "}\n",
                "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t0;\n"
                "layout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform sampler2D t1;\n"
                "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
                "void main() {\n"
                "  vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy * SMAA_RT_METRICS.xy;\n"
                "  vec4 off;\n"
                "  SMAANeighborhoodBlendingVS(uv, off);\n"
                "  o = vec4(SMAANeighborhoodBlendingPS(uv, off, t0, t1).rgb, 1.0);\n"
                "}\n"};
            size_t n = strlen(head) + strlen(smaa_hlsl_src) + strlen(mains[k]) + 1;
            src[k] = malloc(n);
            snprintf(src[k], n, "%s%s%s", head, smaa_hlsl_src, mains[k]);
        }
        return src[k];
    }
    // AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1 (MIT), EASU: edge-adaptive upscale. a = (in / out scale xy, offset zw),
    // b.xy = input size. 12 taps around the source pixel, direction / edge length from luma, Lanczos-2-like
    // weights stretched along the edge, clamped to the nearest 4 (no ringing).
    if (!strcmp(name, "easu.frag")) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        return "#version 450\n"
               "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t;\n"
               "layout(push_constant) uniform P { vec4 a; vec4 b; } pc;\n"
               "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
               "vec3 tap(ivec2 p) { return texelFetch(t, clamp(p, ivec2(0), ivec2(pc.b.xy) - 1), 0).rgb; }\n"
               "float lum(vec3 c) { return c.g + 0.5 * (c.r + c.b); }\n"
               "void setf(inout vec2 dir, inout float len, float w, float lA, float lB, float lC, float lD, float lE) {\n"
               "  float dx = lD - lB, dy = lE - lA;\n"
               "  float lx = clamp(abs(dx) / max(max(abs(lD - lC), abs(lC - lB)), 1.0 / 65536.0), 0.0, 1.0);\n"
               "  float ly = clamp(abs(dy) / max(max(abs(lE - lC), abs(lC - lA)), 1.0 / 65536.0), 0.0, 1.0);\n"
               "  dir += vec2(dx, dy) * w;\n"
               "  len += (lx * lx + ly * ly) * w;\n"
               "}\n"
               "void tapf(inout vec3 ac, inout float aw, vec2 off, vec2 dir, vec2 len2, float lob, float clp, vec3 c) {\n"
               "  vec2 v = vec2(dot(off, dir), dot(off, vec2(-dir.y, dir.x))) * len2;\n"
               "  float d2 = min(dot(v, v), clp);\n"
               "  float wb = 0.4 * d2 - 1.0, wa = lob * d2 - 1.0;\n"
               "  wb *= wb; wa *= wa;\n"
               "  float w = (1.5625 * wb - 0.5625) * wa;\n"
               "  ac += c * w; aw += w;\n"
               "}\n"
               "void main() {\n"
               "  vec2 pp = floor(gl_FragCoord.xy) * pc.a.xy + pc.a.zw;\n"
               "  vec2 fpf = floor(pp); pp -= fpf;\n"
               "  ivec2 fp = ivec2(fpf);\n"
               "  //    b c\n"
               "  //  e f g h\n"
               "  //  i j k l\n"
               "  //    n o\n"
               "  vec3 bC = tap(fp + ivec2(0, -1)), cC = tap(fp + ivec2(1, -1));\n"
               "  vec3 eC = tap(fp + ivec2(-1, 0)), fC = tap(fp), gC = tap(fp + ivec2(1, 0)), hC = tap(fp + ivec2(2, 0));\n"
               "  vec3 iC = tap(fp + ivec2(-1, 1)), jC = tap(fp + ivec2(0, 1)), kC = tap(fp + ivec2(1, 1)), lC = tap(fp + ivec2(2, 1));\n"
               "  vec3 nC = tap(fp + ivec2(0, 2)), oC = tap(fp + ivec2(1, 2));\n"
               "  float bL = lum(bC), cL = lum(cC), eL = lum(eC), fL = lum(fC), gL = lum(gC), hL = lum(hC);\n"
               "  float iL = lum(iC), jL = lum(jC), kL = lum(kC), lL = lum(lC), nL = lum(nC), oL = lum(oC);\n"
               "  vec2 dir = vec2(0.0);\n"
               "  float len = 0.0;\n"
               "  setf(dir, len, (1.0 - pp.x) * (1.0 - pp.y), bL, eL, fL, gL, jL);\n"
               "  setf(dir, len, pp.x * (1.0 - pp.y), cL, fL, gL, hL, kL);\n"
               "  setf(dir, len, (1.0 - pp.x) * pp.y, fL, iL, jL, kL, nL);\n"
               "  setf(dir, len, pp.x * pp.y, gL, jL, kL, lL, oL);\n"
               "  float dr = dot(dir, dir);\n"
               "  bool zro = dr < 1.0 / 32768.0;\n"
               "  dir = zro ? vec2(1.0, 0.0) : dir * inversesqrt(dr);\n"
               "  len = len * 0.5; len *= len;\n"
               "  float stretch = dot(dir, dir) / max(abs(dir.x), abs(dir.y));\n"
               "  vec2 len2 = vec2(1.0 + (stretch - 1.0) * len, 1.0 - 0.5 * len);\n"
               "  float lob = 0.5 - 0.29 * len, clp = 1.0 / lob;\n"
               "  vec3 mn = min(min(fC, gC), min(jC, kC)), mx = max(max(fC, gC), max(jC, kC));\n"
               "  vec3 ac = vec3(0.0);\n"
               "  float aw = 0.0;\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(0.0, -1.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, bC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(1.0, -1.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, cC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(-1.0, 1.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, iC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(0.0, 1.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, jC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(0.0, 0.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, fC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(-1.0, 0.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, eC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(1.0, 1.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, kC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(2.0, 1.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, lC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(2.0, 0.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, hC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(1.0, 0.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, gC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(1.0, 2.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, oC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(0.0, 2.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, nC);\n"
               "  o = vec4(min(mx, max(mn, ac / aw)), 1.0);\n"
               "}\n";
    }
    // FSR 1 RCAS: contrast-adaptive sharpening of the EASU output (same size). a.x = sharpness (exp2(-stops)),
    // b.xy = image size. The lobe is limited so the result stays inside the neighbours' range; noise is damped.
    // Debanding, the last post pass (exec.c post_process_ex): the game's 8-bit targets show steps in smooth gradients
    // (sky, fog, the menus' blurred backdrop). As mpv's / libplacebo's deband: around each pixel, at a random angle and
    // distance within a radius, four taps; when their mean is within the threshold of the pixel (a step of a band, not
    // an edge or a texture's detail) it takes the mean - twice, the second time twice as far and half the threshold.
    // Then a triangular dither of one 8-bit step, fixed per pixel (not per frame: TAA, FSR and the in-between images
    // see the same pattern). a = (1 / size, threshold), b = (size, radius in pixels).
    if (!strcmp(name, "deband.frag")) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        return "#version 450\n"
               "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t;\n"
```
