```h
// Where Let's Go Recomp keeps its files (runtime/paths.c).
//
// Data root: everything the app writes or the user brings - extracted/ (game files), mods/ (translations), save/,
// cache/ (shaders / pipelines), fonts/ (optional), larecomp.ini. rt_paths_init() picks it and makes it the
// working directory, so the rest of the runtime opens those by their relative names. In order:
//   1. LARECOMP_DATA_ROOT (tests, scratch installs)
//   2. dev / portable mode: the starting directory already has extracted/ (a source checkout: `./build/lasrecomp
//      extracted`, the test scripts) - used as is
//   3. macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/com.peiikai.lasrecomp (the .app bundle itself is never written to)
//      Windows: the folder of the .exe (portable, no installer); refuses to start, with a message, if not writable
//      Linux: $XDG_DATA_HOME/lasrecomp (~/.local/share/lasrecomp)
//
// Resources: files that ship with the app (helper programs, the window icon) - next to the executable (the
// Windows folder, the .app's Contents/MacOS), in the .app's Contents/Resources, or in the source tree.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define RT_BUNDLE_ID "com.peiikai.lasrecomp"  // (data folder on macOS / Linux: kept)
#define RT_APP_NAME "Let's Go Recomp"         // window title, messages, the launcher
#define RT_APP_VERSION "0.6.0"                // the release (Makefile `dist` names the zip after it)

void rt_paths_init(void);         // first thing in main(), after plat_init
const char *rt_data_root(void);   // absolute
bool rt_dev_mode(void);           // dev / portable mode (rule 2 above): e.g. a source checkout

// A shipped file: `name` next to the executable or in Contents/Resources, else `dev_rel` in the source tree (the
// starting directory or the executable's parent; NULL = shipped builds only). Absolute path in out; false = none.
bool rt_resource(const char *name, const char *dev_rel, char *out, size_t n);

// The only way the app deletes game files. Removes the named entry of game_dir (an extracted/ folder) only if
// game_dir is <data root>/extracted itself (symlinks resolved; a symlinked extracted/ is refused) and the entry is
// one the setup creates (exefs, romfs, romfs.bin, leftover folders) and not a link. The folder the user picked
// never gets here. true = removed or not there.
bool rt_remove_game_file(const char *game_dir, const char *name);
// All the game files set up there (rt_remove_game_file on each, then the empty folder). Saves, seeds, settings stay.
bool rt_remove_game_files(const char *game_dir);
// Bytes taken by the extracted game files in game_dir (links not followed).
unsigned long long rt_game_files_size(const char *game_dir);

typedef struct SDL_Window SDL_Window;
void rt_window_icon(SDL_Window *w);  // the shipped icon.png, if any

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

`runtime/platform.h`:

```h
// Host OS layer: everything the runtime needs that differs between macOS and Windows.
// Implementations: runtime/platform/macos.c, runtime/platform/windows.c (the Makefile picks one).
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include "platform/win_compat.h"
#elif defined(__linux__)
#include "platform/linux_compat.h"
#endif

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

// ---- guest address space
// Claim [lo, hi) for the guest at exactly that address, readable/writable (pages may be backed lazily).
bool plat_reserve_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi);
// Make sure [addr, addr+size) inside the guest window is backed (before the OS itself writes there, e.g.
// file reads); a no-op where the whole window is backed from the start.
void plat_commit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);
// In-place reboot: every page of [lo, hi) back to zero (and unbacked), the window still claimed.
bool plat_reset_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi);
// Track the pages written in [watch_lo, the window's end) from plat_reserve_guest on (call before it): any writer, the game's
// code, ours or the OS's. False where the platform can't, with LARECOMP_WRITE_WATCH=0, and (Windows) by default on a primary
// display adapter that isn't NVIDIA's (LARECOMP_WRITE_WATCH=1 forces it).
bool plat_watch_writes(uint64_t watch_lo);
// The pages of [addr, addr+size) written since the last call that covered them (which forgets them): their addresses in out,
// at most max; returns how many (max: maybe more), or -1 when writes aren't tracked there.
int plat_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t *out, int max);
enum { PLAT_PROT_NONE = 0, PLAT_PROT_READ = 1, PLAT_PROT_RW = 3 };
int plat_protect(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, int prot);  // 0 on success
#define PLAT_PAGE 0x4000ull  // largest page size we deal with (macOS 16K; multiple of Windows' 4K)

// ---- time
uint64_t plat_now_ns(void);                // monotonic
void plat_sleep_until_ns(uint64_t t);      // precise wait for plat_now_ns() >= t
void plat_thread_realtime(uint64_t period_ns);  // periodic timing thread (vsync): don't coalesce its timers

// ---- process
void plat_init(void);                                // first thing in main()
bool plat_exe_path(char *buf, size_t size);
void plat_exec(char *const argv[]);  // replace the process (NULL = same command line); returns only on failure
#if defined(_WIN32) || defined(__linux__)
void plat_terminate(void);  // end the process now, skipping DLL teardown (exit status 0)
#endif

// Child processes (seed generator, game-file extraction). stdout + stderr go to log_path (NULL = /dev/null).
typedef intptr_t PlatProc;  // 0 = failed to start
PlatProc plat_spawn(const char *const argv[], const char *log_path, bool append_log);
int plat_proc_wait(PlatProc p, bool block);  // exit code, or -1 while still running (block = false)
void plat_proc_kill(PlatProc p);             // end it and what it started (then it's gone: no wait)
bool plat_remove_tree(const char *dir);      // rm -rf
#ifdef _WIN32
#define PLAT_EXE_SUFFIX ".exe"
#define PLAT_VENV_PYTHON "venv/Scripts/python.exe"  // relative to the venv's parent
#else
#define PLAT_EXE_SUFFIX ""
#define PLAT_VENV_PYTHON "venv/bin/python"
#endif

// ---- diagnostics
// Name of the host function containing pc (guest functions are f_<addr>), NULL if unknown.
const char *plat_symbol(uint64_t pc, uint64_t *offset);
void plat_print_backtrace(void);
void plat_fatal_notice(void);  // a fatal error is about to end the process: tell the user (Windows release: message box)
void plat_crash_handler_install(void);  // per thread where the OS needs it (alternate signal stack)
// Called by the crash handler (runtime/dispatch.c): true = fault handled (watchpoint), resume.
bool rt_fault_watch(uint64_t fault_addr, uint64_t host_pc);
void rt_fault_report(const char *what, uint64_t fault_addr, uint64_t host_pc, uint64_t host_lr) __attribute__((noreturn));

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

`runtime/platform/linux.c`:

```c
// Linux host layer (runtime/platform.h). x86-64 and aarch64.
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <execinfo.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <sched.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/resource.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ucontext.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "../platform.h"

#ifndef MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE
#define MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE 0x100000
#endif

// ---- guest address space
// Everything readable/writable from the start, like macOS: the guest maps at 4K granularity, and untouched pages
// cost nothing (MAP_NORESERVE: the 12 GB window doesn't count against overcommit).
bool plat_reserve_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    void *p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)lo, hi - lo, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
                   MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_NORESERVE | MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE, -1, 0);
    if (p == MAP_FAILED) return false;
    if (p != (void *)(uintptr_t)lo) { munmap(p, hi - lo); return false; }  // (kernels before 4.17: just a hint)
    return true;
}

// Fresh zero pages over the whole window (the old ones are released at once).
bool plat_reset_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    return mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)lo, hi - lo, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_NORESERVE | MAP_FIXED,
                -1, 0) == (void *)(uintptr_t)lo;
}

void plat_commit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) { (void)addr; (void)size; }

bool plat_watch_writes(uint64_t watch_lo) { (void)watch_lo; return false; }
int plat_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t *out, int max) { (void)addr, (void)size, (void)out, (void)max; return -1; }

int plat_protect(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, int prot) {
    int p = prot == PLAT_PROT_NONE ? PROT_NONE : prot == PLAT_PROT_READ ? PROT_READ : PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE;
    return mprotect((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, p);
}

// ---- time
uint64_t plat_now_ns(void) {
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000u + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec;
}

void plat_sleep_until_ns(uint64_t t) {
    struct timespec ts = {.tv_sec = (time_t)(t / 1000000000u), .tv_nsec = (long)(t % 1000000000u)};
    while (clock_nanosleep(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, TIMER_ABSTIME, &ts, NULL) == EINTR) {}
}

// Real-time scheduling where the user may have it (rtkit / limits.conf), else just a higher priority: keeps the
// vsync thread on time while the guest threads load every core.
void plat_thread_realtime(uint64_t period_ns) {
    (void)period_ns;
    struct sched_param sp = {.sched_priority = 1};
    if (pthread_setschedparam(pthread_self(), SCHED_FIFO, &sp) == 0) return;
    setpriority(PRIO_PROCESS, (id_t)gettid(), -10);  // (per thread on Linux; fails quietly without CAP_SYS_NICE)
}

// ---- process
// Started from a desktop (the AppImage) there is no terminal: stdout / stderr go to lasrecomp.log in the data folder
// (runtime/paths.h; rt_paths_init runs later, so the same rule is applied here). Processes started by this one (the
// start screen re-executing itself for the game) append to the same log.
static char g_log_path[1024];

static void log_to_file_without_terminal(void) {
    if (isatty(STDERR_FILENO)) return;
    char dir[900];
    const char *env = getenv("LARECOMP_DATA_ROOT"), *xdg = getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME"), *home = getenv("HOME");
    struct stat st;
    if (env && *env) snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s", env);
    else if (stat("extracted", &st) == 0 && S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) return;  // dev mode: wherever stderr goes already
    else if (xdg && *xdg == '/') snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s/lasrecomp", xdg);
    else snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s/.local/share/lasrecomp", home && *home ? home : "/tmp");
    for (char *c = dir + 1; *c; c++)
        if (*c == '/') { *c = 0; mkdir(dir, 0755); *c = '/'; }
    mkdir(dir, 0755);
    snprintf(g_log_path, sizeof g_log_path, "%s/lasrecomp.log", dir);
    bool append = getenv("LASRECOMP_LOG_APPEND") != NULL;
    if (!append) {
        // Keep the previous run around for crash reports (see the Windows branch).
        char prev[1024];
        snprintf(prev, sizeof prev, "%s/lasrecomp-prev.log", dir);
        rename(g_log_path, prev);
    }
    if (!freopen(g_log_path, append ? "a" : "w", stderr)) { g_log_path[0] = 0; return; }
    dup2(STDERR_FILENO, STDOUT_FILENO);
    setenv("LASRECOMP_LOG_APPEND", "1", 1);
}

#if defined(__x86_64__)
// The recompiled game code is built for x86-64-v3 (Makefile GENARCH: AVX2, FMA, BMI2): say so instead of crashing
// with an illegal instruction on an older CPU.
static void require_cpu(void) {
    __builtin_cpu_init();
    if (__builtin_cpu_supports("avx2") && __builtin_cpu_supports("fma") && __builtin_cpu_supports("bmi2")) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: " RT_APP_NAME " needs a CPU with AVX2 (Intel Haswell / 2013 or newer, AMD Excavator / Zen or "
                    "newer).\n");
    exit(1);
}
#else
static void require_cpu(void) {}
#endif

void plat_init(void) {
    log_to_file_without_terminal();
    require_cpu();
}

// (inside an AppImage: the binary in its mount, which stays mounted while this process lives - re-exec included)
bool plat_exe_path(char *buf, size_t size) {
    ssize_t n = readlink("/proc/self/exe", buf, size - 1);
    if (n <= 0) return false;
    buf[n] = 0;
    return true;
}

// Our own command line, from /proc/self/cmdline (NUL-separated).
static char **self_argv(void) {
    static char buf[32768];
    static char *argv[256];
    int fd = open("/proc/self/cmdline", O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0) return NULL;
    ssize_t n = read(fd, buf, sizeof buf - 1);
    close(fd);
    if (n <= 0) return NULL;
    buf[n] = 0;
    int k = 0;
    for (char *p = buf; p < buf + n && k < 255; p += strlen(p) + 1) argv[k++] = p;
    argv[k] = NULL;
    return argv;
}

void plat_exec(char *const argv[]) {
    if (argv) { execv(argv[0], argv); return; }
    char path[4096];
    char **av = self_argv();
    if (av && plat_exe_path(path, sizeof path)) execv(path, av);
}

// ---- diagnostics
// Exported symbols only (the Makefile links with -rdynamic); frames in the generated code are left to the caller,
// which maps them to guest functions (runtime/dispatch.c). Static runtime functions come out as the nearest guest
// function, so backtrace lines also give the offset in the executable (addr2line -fe lasrecomp <offset>).
const char *plat_symbol(uint64_t pc, uint64_t *offset) {
    Dl_info di = {0};
    if (!dladdr((void *)(uintptr_t)pc, &di) || !di.dli_sname) return NULL;
    if (offset) *offset = pc - (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)di.dli_saddr;
    return di.dli_sname;
}

// Fatal error without a terminal: say so in a message box rather than vanishing (the details are in the log).
void plat_fatal_notice(void) {
    if (!g_log_path[0]) return;
    fflush(stderr);
    char text[1200];
    snprintf(text, sizeof text, RT_APP_NAME " stopped because of an error.\n\nDetails: %s", g_log_path);
    SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(SDL_MESSAGEBOX_ERROR, RT_APP_NAME, text, NULL);
}

const char *rt_host_fn_name(uint64_t pc, uint64_t *offset);  // runtime/dispatch.c

void plat_print_backtrace(void) {
    void *bt[64];
    int n = backtrace(bt, 64);
    Dl_info self = {0};
    dladdr((void *)plat_print_backtrace, &self);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint64_t pc = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)bt[i], off = 0;
        Dl_info di = {0};
        if (!dladdr(bt[i], &di)) di.dli_fname = NULL;
        bool ours = di.dli_fbase && di.dli_fbase == self.dli_fbase;
        const char *s = plat_symbol(pc, &off);
        if (!s && ours) s = rt_host_fn_name(pc, &off);
        const char *mod = di.dli_fname ? (strrchr(di.dli_fname, '/') ? strrchr(di.dli_fname, '/') + 1 : di.dli_fname) : "?";
        uint64_t moff = pc - (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)di.dli_fbase;
        if (s && ours) fprintf(stderr, "  #%-2d %016llx %s+%llx (lasrecomp+%llx)\n", i, (unsigned long long)pc, s,
                               (unsigned long long)off, (unsigned long long)moff);
        else if (s) fprintf(stderr, "  #%-2d %016llx %s+%llx (%s)\n", i, (unsigned long long)pc, s, (unsigned long long)off, mod);
        else fprintf(stderr, "  #%-2d %016llx %s+%llx\n", i, (unsigned long long)pc, mod, (unsigned long long)moff);
    }
}

static void crash_handler(int sig, siginfo_t *si, void *ctx) {
    ucontext_t *uc = ctx;
    static volatile int depth;
    if (sig == SIGABRT && depth++ > 0) { signal(SIGABRT, SIG_DFL); abort(); }  // (nested: just die)
    uint64_t fa = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)si->si_addr;
#if defined(__aarch64__)
    uint64_t pc = uc->uc_mcontext.pc, lr = uc->uc_mcontext.regs[30];
#else
    // x86-64 has no link register: report the return address on top of the stack (valid at function entry)
    uint64_t pc = (uint64_t)uc->uc_mcontext.gregs[REG_RIP], sp = (uint64_t)uc->uc_mcontext.gregs[REG_RSP], lr = 0;
    if (sig != SIGSEGV || (fa & ~0xFFFull) != (sp & ~0xFFFull)) lr = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)sp;
#endif
    if (rt_fault_watch(fa, pc)) return;
    char what[32];
    snprintf(what, sizeof what, "signal %d", sig);
    rt_fault_report(what, fa, pc, lr);
}

void plat_crash_handler_install(void) {
    stack_t ss = {.ss_sp = malloc(1 << 20), .ss_size = 1 << 20};
    sigaltstack(&ss, NULL);
    struct sigaction sa = {0};
    sa.sa_sigaction = crash_handler;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_ONSTACK;
    sigaction(SIGSEGV, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGBUS, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGILL, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGFPE, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGABRT, &sa, NULL);
}

// ---- child processes
#include <ftw.h>
#include <spawn.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
extern char **environ;

PlatProc plat_spawn(const char *const argv[], const char *log_path, bool append_log) {
    posix_spawn_file_actions_t fa;
    posix_spawn_file_actions_init(&fa);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_addopen(&fa, 1, log_path ? log_path : "/dev/null",
                                     O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | (append_log ? O_APPEND : O_TRUNC), 0644);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_adddup2(&fa, 1, 2);
    posix_spawnattr_t at;  // (its own process group: plat_proc_kill ends what it starts, e.g. a compiler's own child)
    posix_spawnattr_init(&at);
    posix_spawnattr_setflags(&at, POSIX_SPAWN_SETPGROUP);
    posix_spawnattr_setpgroup(&at, 0);
    pid_t pid;
    int rc = posix_spawn(&pid, argv[0], &fa, &at, (char *const *)argv, environ);
    posix_spawnattr_destroy(&at);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_destroy(&fa);
    return rc ? 0 : (PlatProc)pid;
}

void plat_proc_kill(PlatProc p) {
    kill(-(pid_t)p, SIGKILL);
    waitpid((pid_t)p, NULL, 0);
}

int plat_proc_wait(PlatProc p, bool block) {
    int st = 0;
    pid_t r = waitpid((pid_t)p, &st, block ? 0 : WNOHANG);
    if (r == 0) return -1;
    if (r < 0) return 255;
    return WIFEXITED(st) ? WEXITSTATUS(st) : 255;
}

static int rm_entry(const char *path, const struct stat *sb, int flag, struct FTW *ftw) {
    (void)sb, (void)flag, (void)ftw;
    return remove(path);
}
bool plat_remove_tree(const char *dir) { return nftw(dir, rm_entry, 16, FTW_DEPTH | FTW_PHYS) == 0; }

// End the process at once, skipping the library teardown: as on Windows, the GPU driver's threads crashed in exit()
// while the game's threads still submitted work.
void plat_terminate(void) { _exit(0); }
```

`runtime/platform/linux_compat.h`:

```h
// What glibc before 2.38 lacks (included via runtime/platform.h on Linux only): the AppImage is built against
// Ubuntu 22.04's glibc 2.35 (no strlcpy / strlcat until 2.38, no arc4random until 2.36).
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/random.h>

#if !__GLIBC_PREREQ(2, 38)
static inline size_t strlcpy(char *d, const char *s, size_t n) {
    size_t len = strlen(s);
    if (n) {
        size_t k = len < n - 1 ? len : n - 1;
        memcpy(d, s, k);
        d[k] = 0;
    }
    return len;
}
static inline size_t strlcat(char *d, const char *s, size_t n) {
    size_t dl = strnlen(d, n);
    if (dl == n) return n + strlen(s);
    return dl + strlcpy(d + dl, s, n - dl);
}
#endif

#if !__GLIBC_PREREQ(2, 36)
static inline uint32_t arc4random(void) {
    uint32_t v = 0;
    while (getrandom(&v, sizeof v, 0) != sizeof v) {}
    return v;
}
static inline uint32_t arc4random_uniform(uint32_t n) {
    if (n < 2) return 0;
    uint32_t min = -n % n, r;  // reject the low values that would bias the modulo
    do r = arc4random(); while (r < min);
    return r % n;
}
#endif

```

`runtime/platform/win_compat.h`:

```h
// POSIX bits mingw-w64 lacks (included via runtime/platform.h on Windows only).
// Build with -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64 so off_t / stat sizes are 64-bit (romfs.bin is > 4 GB).
#pragma once
#include <direct.h>
#include <io.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <unistd.h>

// Positional read/write (thread-safe: does not move the descriptor's file pointer).
ssize_t pread(int fd, void *buf, size_t n, off_t off);
ssize_t pwrite(int fd, const void *buf, size_t n, off_t off);

static inline int setenv(const char *k, const char *v, int overwrite) {
    if (!overwrite && getenv(k)) return 0;
    return _putenv_s(k, v);
}
static inline int unsetenv(const char *k) { return _putenv_s(k, ""); }

static inline int fsync(int fd) { return _commit(fd); }

#ifndef _CRT_RAND_S
int __cdecl rand_s(unsigned int *v);  // (declared by stdlib.h only with _CRT_RAND_S)
#endif
static inline uint32_t arc4random(void) {
    unsigned v = 0;
    rand_s(&v);
    return v;
}

static inline uint32_t arc4random_uniform(uint32_t n) {
    if (n < 2) return 0;
    uint32_t min = -n % n, r;  // reject the low values that would bias the modulo
    do r = arc4random(); while (r < min);
    return r % n;
}

static inline size_t strlcpy(char *d, const char *s, size_t n) {
    size_t len = strlen(s);
    if (n) {
        size_t k = len < n - 1 ? len : n - 1;
        memcpy(d, s, k);
        d[k] = 0;
    }
    return len;
}
static inline size_t strlcat(char *d, const char *s, size_t n) {
    size_t dl = strnlen(d, n);
    if (dl == n) return n + strlen(s);
    return dl + strlcpy(d + dl, s, n - dl);
}
static inline char *strsep(char **sp, const char *delim) {
    char *s = *sp;
    if (!s) return NULL;
    char *e = s + strcspn(s, delim);
    *sp = *e ? e + 1 : NULL;
    *e = 0;
    return s;
}

// POSIX mkdir(path, mode); mingw's takes only the path.
static inline int plat_mkdir(const char *p, int mode) { (void)mode; return _mkdir(p); }
#define mkdir(p, m) plat_mkdir(p, m)

// realpath(path, out[PATH_MAX]): absolute form of an existing path (links not resolved; callers check them).
#ifndef PATH_MAX
#define PATH_MAX 260
#endif
static inline char *realpath(const char *p, char *out) {
    struct stat st;
    return stat(p, &st) == 0 ? _fullpath(out, p, PATH_MAX) : NULL;
}

```

`runtime/platform/windows.c`:

```c
// Windows host layer (runtime/platform.h).
#include <windows.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <timeapi.h>
#include <io.h>

#include "../platform.h"
#include "../paths.h"

// ---- guest address space
// The window is reserved up front and committed per region (plat_commit from the loader / kernel). Anything
// the guest touches outside a committed region is committed on its first access by the exception handler
// below, so the window behaves like macOS's all-RW reservation. The OS itself (ReadFile into a guest buffer)
// does not fault: such buffers must be inside committed regions.
static uint64_t g_lo, g_hi;
#define COMMIT_CHUNK 0x10000ull

static bool lazy_commit(uint64_t a) {
    if (a < g_lo || a >= g_hi) return false;
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
    if (!VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)a, &mi, sizeof mi)) return false;
    // Two threads touching the same uncommitted chunk at once: the first commits it, the second faulted before that
    // and finds it committed - retry the access. (A page protected on purpose, plat_protect / LARECOMP_WATCH, is not
    // plain read-write and still faults.)
    if (mi.State == MEM_COMMIT) return mi.Protect == PAGE_READWRITE;
    if (mi.State != MEM_RESERVE) return false;
    uint64_t base = a & ~(COMMIT_CHUNK - 1);
    return VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)base, COMMIT_CHUNK, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE) != NULL;
}

static bool g_report_crashes;

static LONG CALLBACK vectored_handler(EXCEPTION_POINTERS *ep) {
    EXCEPTION_RECORD *er = ep->ExceptionRecord;
    if (er->ExceptionCode != EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION || er->NumberParameters < 2) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    uint64_t fa = er->ExceptionInformation[1];
    // (an execute fault on a read-write page would be "retried" by lazy_commit forever)
    if (er->ExceptionInformation[0] != 8 && lazy_commit(fa)) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    if (g_report_crashes && rt_fault_watch(fa, ep->ContextRecord->Rip)) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}

// The written-pages tracking (plat_watch_writes): the window's top part is a reservation of its own made with MEM_WRITE_WATCH
// (the OS keeps a written bit per page; GetWriteWatch reads and clears them), so the rest pays nothing for it.
static uint64_t g_watch_lo;

// On by default only where the primary display adapter is an NVIDIA card: the heap is also imported into Vulkan
// (VK_EXT_external_memory_host, exec.c gmem_import), and a write-watched region was only tested there. Elsewhere off until it
// is; LARECOMP_WRITE_WATCH=1 / 0 forces it on / off.
static bool primary_adapter_is_nvidia(void) {
    DISPLAY_DEVICEW dd = {.cb = sizeof dd};
    for (DWORD i = 0; EnumDisplayDevicesW(NULL, i, &dd, 0); i++, dd.cb = sizeof dd)
        if (dd.StateFlags & DISPLAY_DEVICE_PRIMARY_DEVICE) return wcsstr(dd.DeviceString, L"NVIDIA") != NULL;
    return false;
}

bool plat_watch_writes(uint64_t watch_lo) {
    const char *e = getenv("LARECOMP_WRITE_WATCH");
    if (e ? atoi(e) == 0 : !primary_adapter_is_nvidia()) return false;
    g_watch_lo = watch_lo;
    return true;
}

bool plat_reserve_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    uint64_t split = g_watch_lo > lo && g_watch_lo < hi ? g_watch_lo : hi;
    void *p = VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)lo, split - lo, MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (p != (void *)(uintptr_t)lo) return false;
    if (split < hi && VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)split, hi - split, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_WRITE_WATCH, PAGE_READWRITE) != (void *)(uintptr_t)split) {
        VirtualFree(p, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
        return false;
    }
    if (split == hi) g_watch_lo = 0;
    g_lo = lo;
    g_hi = hi;
    AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1, vectored_handler);
    return true;
}

// Decommit everything: the range stays reserved, and pages come back zeroed when committed again (lazily). (One call per
// reservation: a decommit can't span two.)
bool plat_reset_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    uint64_t split = g_watch_lo > lo && g_watch_lo < hi ? g_watch_lo : hi;
    bool ok = VirtualFree((void *)(uintptr_t)lo, split - lo, MEM_DECOMMIT) != 0;
    if (split < hi) ok = VirtualFree((void *)(uintptr_t)split, hi - split, MEM_DECOMMIT) != 0 && ok;
    return ok;
}

int plat_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t *out, int max) {
    if (!g_watch_lo || addr < g_watch_lo || addr + size > g_hi || max <= 0) return -1;
    uint64_t a = addr & ~0xFFFull, e = (addr + size + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFull;
    ULONG_PTR n = (ULONG_PTR)max;
    DWORD gran = 0;
    if (GetWriteWatch(WRITE_WATCH_FLAG_RESET, (void *)(uintptr_t)a, (SIZE_T)(e - a), (PVOID *)out, &n, &gran) != 0) return -1;
    return (int)n;
}

void plat_commit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if (!size) return;
    uint64_t a = addr & ~0xFFFull, e = (addr + size + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFull;
    if (!VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)a, e - a, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE))
        fprintf(stderr, "[plat] commit %llx+%llx failed (%lu)\n", (unsigned long long)addr,
                (unsigned long long)size, GetLastError());
}

int plat_protect(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, int prot) {
    DWORD p = prot == PLAT_PROT_NONE ? PAGE_NOACCESS : prot == PLAT_PROT_READ ? PAGE_READONLY : PAGE_READWRITE, old;
    if (addr >= g_lo && addr < g_hi) plat_commit(addr, size);
    return VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, p, &old) ? 0 : -1;
}

// ---- time
static LARGE_INTEGER qpf;

uint64_t plat_now_ns(void) {
    if (!qpf.QuadPart) QueryPerformanceFrequency(&qpf);
    LARGE_INTEGER t;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t);
    return (uint64_t)((unsigned __int128)t.QuadPart * 1000000000u / (uint64_t)qpf.QuadPart);
}

#ifndef CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION
#define CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION 0x2
#endif

void plat_sleep_until_ns(uint64_t t) {
    static __thread HANDLE timer;
    if (!timer) {
        timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(NULL, NULL, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
        if (!timer) timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(NULL, NULL, 0, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
    }
    for (;;) {
        uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
        if (now >= t) return;
        uint64_t left = t - now;
        if (left < 200000) { YieldProcessor(); continue; }  // last 0.2 ms: spin (timer slack)
        LARGE_INTEGER due = {.QuadPart = -(LONGLONG)((left - 100000) / 100)};  // relative, 100 ns units
        if (!timer || !SetWaitableTimer(timer, &due, 0, NULL, NULL, FALSE)) { Sleep(1); continue; }
        WaitForSingleObject(timer, INFINITE);
    }
}

void plat_thread_realtime(uint64_t period_ns) {
    (void)period_ns;
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_TIME_CRITICAL);
}

// ---- process
// Release builds are GUI-subsystem executables (no console window): stdout / stderr go to lasrecomp.log next to the
// exe, and a fatal error shows a message box (plat_fatal_notice) instead of vanishing. Processes started by this one
// (the start screen re-executing itself for the game) append to the same log.
static char g_log_path[MAX_PATH];

static void log_to_file_without_console(void) {
    if (GetStdHandle(STD_ERROR_HANDLE) && GetStdHandle(STD_ERROR_HANDLE) != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;  // console / pipe
    char exe[MAX_PATH];
    DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, exe, sizeof exe);
    if (!n || n >= sizeof exe) return;
    char *slash = strrchr(exe, '\\');
    if (slash) slash[1] = 0;
    snprintf(g_log_path, sizeof g_log_path, "%slasrecomp.log", exe);
    bool append = getenv("LASRECOMP_LOG_APPEND") != NULL;
    if (!append) {
        // Keep the previous run around for crash reports: a fresh launch moves it aside first
        // (a crash log would otherwise be lost the moment the game is started again).
        char prev[MAX_PATH];
        snprintf(prev, sizeof prev, "%slasrecomp-prev.log", exe);
        DeleteFileA(prev);
        MoveFileA(g_log_path, prev);
    }
    if (!freopen(g_log_path, append ? "ab" : "wb", stderr)) { g_log_path[0] = 0; return; }
    setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
    _dup2(_fileno(stderr), _fileno(stdout));
    _putenv("LASRECOMP_LOG_APPEND=1");
}

// The recompiled game code is built for x86-64-v3 (Makefile GENARCH: AVX2, FMA, BMI2): say so instead of crashing
// with an illegal instruction on an older CPU.
static void require_cpu(void) {
    __builtin_cpu_init();
    if (__builtin_cpu_supports("avx2") && __builtin_cpu_supports("fma") && __builtin_cpu_supports("bmi2")) return;
    MessageBoxA(NULL, RT_APP_NAME " needs a CPU with AVX2 (Intel Haswell / 2013 or newer, AMD Excavator / Zen or newer).",
                RT_APP_NAME, MB_ICONERROR | MB_OK);
    ExitProcess(1);
}

// Fatal error (rt_fatal_trace): the last FATAL / exception line of the log in a message box, when there is no console.
void plat_fatal_notice(void) {
    if (!g_log_path[0]) return;
    fflush(stderr);
    char text[1024] = RT_APP_NAME " stopped because of an error.";
    FILE *f = fopen(g_log_path, "rb");
    if (f) {
        static char tail[16384];
        fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
        long sz = ftell(f), from = sz > (long)sizeof tail - 1 ? sz - (long)sizeof tail + 1 : 0;
        fseek(f, from, SEEK_SET);
        size_t got = fread(tail, 1, sizeof tail - 1, f);
        tail[got] = 0;
        fclose(f);
        char *line = NULL;
        for (char *p = tail; (p = strstr(p, "FATAL: ")) != NULL; p++) line = p;
        if (!line) for (char *p = tail; (p = strstr(p, "*** ")) != NULL; p++) line = p;
        if (line) {
            char *end = strchr(line, '\n');
            if (end) *end = 0;
            snprintf(text, sizeof text, RT_APP_NAME " stopped because of an error:\n\n%.600s", line);
            if (strstr(line, "Vulkan") || strstr(line, "VK_") || strstr(line, "vk")) {
                size_t l = strlen(text);
                snprintf(text + l, sizeof text - l, "\n\n" RT_APP_NAME " needs a graphics driver with Vulkan 1.3: install the "
                         "latest driver for your GPU (NVIDIA, AMD or Intel).");
            }
        }
    }
    size_t l = strlen(text);
    snprintf(text + l, sizeof text - l, "\n\nDetails: %s", g_log_path);
    MessageBoxA(NULL, text, RT_APP_NAME, MB_ICONERROR | MB_OK);
}

void plat_init(void) {
    // abort() (rt_fatal_trace, after the crash dialog) without the C runtime's own "Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime
    // Library - abort() has been called" box and the Windows error report: the player sees only LAS Recomp's dialog
#ifdef _WRITE_ABORT_MSG  // (MinGW's stdlib.h declares it with these flags)
    _set_abort_behavior(0, _WRITE_ABORT_MSG | _CALL_REPORTFAULT);
#endif
    log_to_file_without_console();
    require_cpu();
    _fmode = _O_BINARY;  // fopen/open default to binary (the runtime's "r"/"w" files are binary or LF text)
    _setmode(_fileno(stdout), _O_BINARY);
    _setmode(_fileno(stderr), _O_BINARY);
    SetConsoleOutputCP(CP_UTF8);
    timeBeginPeriod(1);  // 1 ms Sleep / condition-variable timeouts (default 15.6 ms)
    // Opt out of EcoQoS and of Windows 11 ignoring the timer resolution while the window is occluded.
    PROCESS_POWER_THROTTLING_STATE pt = {
        .Version = PROCESS_POWER_THROTTLING_CURRENT_VERSION,
        .ControlMask = PROCESS_POWER_THROTTLING_EXECUTION_SPEED | PROCESS_POWER_THROTTLING_IGNORE_TIMER_RESOLUTION,
        .StateMask = 0,
    };
    SetProcessInformation(GetCurrentProcess(), ProcessPowerThrottling, &pt, sizeof pt);
}

bool plat_exe_path(char *buf, size_t size) {
    DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, buf, (DWORD)size);
    return n > 0 && n < size;
}

// Quote one argument the way CommandLineToArgvW / the CRT parse it back.
static void append_arg(char *out, size_t cap, const char *a) {
    size_t n = strlen(out);
    bool q = !*a || strpbrk(a, " \t\"") != NULL;
    if (n && n + 1 < cap) out[n++] = ' ';
    if (q && n + 1 < cap) out[n++] = '"';
    for (const char *p = a; *p; p++) {
        int bs = 0;
        while (*p == '\\') { bs++; p++; }
        int reps = !*p ? (q ? 2 * bs : bs) : *p == '"' ? 2 * bs + 1 : bs;
        for (int i = 0; i < reps && n + 1 < cap; i++) out[n++] = '\\';
        if (!*p) break;
        if (n + 1 < cap) out[n++] = *p;
    }
    if (q && n + 1 < cap) out[n++] = '"';
    out[n] = 0;
}

// No exec() on Windows: start the new process with the same console / standard handles, then exit.
void plat_exec(char *const argv[]) {
    STARTUPINFOW si = {.cb = sizeof si};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    BOOL ok;
    fflush(stdout);
    fflush(stderr);
    if (!argv) {
        ok = CreateProcessW(NULL, GetCommandLineW(), NULL, NULL, TRUE, 0, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi);
    } else {
        static char cmd[32768];
        cmd[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; argv[i]; i++) append_arg(cmd, sizeof cmd, argv[i]);
        static wchar_t wcmd[32768];
        MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, cmd, -1, wcmd, 32768);
        ok = CreateProcessW(NULL, wcmd, NULL, NULL, TRUE, 0, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi);
    }
    if (!ok) return;
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    ExitProcess(0);
}

// ---- diagnostics
// DLL frames are named module+offset; frames in our own executable are left to the caller, which maps
// them to guest functions (runtime/dispatch.c) - mingw builds carry DWARF, not PDB symbols.
const char *plat_symbol(uint64_t pc, uint64_t *offset) {
    static __thread char name[MAX_PATH];
    HMODULE m;
    if (!GetModuleHandleExA(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
                            (LPCSTR)(uintptr_t)pc, &m))
        return NULL;
    if (m == GetModuleHandleA(NULL)) return NULL;
    char path[MAX_PATH];
    if (!GetModuleFileNameA(m, path, sizeof path)) return NULL;
    const char *b = strrchr(path, '\\');
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%s", b ? b + 1 : path);
    if (offset) *offset = pc - (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)m;
    return name;
}

const char *rt_host_fn_name(uint64_t pc, uint64_t *offset);  // runtime/dispatch.c

void plat_print_backtrace(void) {
    void *bt[64];
    USHORT n = RtlCaptureStackBackTrace(0, 64, bt, NULL);
    uint64_t exe = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)GetModuleHandleA(NULL);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint64_t pc = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)bt[i], off = 0;
        const char *s = rt_host_fn_name(pc, &off);  // (recompiled game code first: f_<guest addr>)
        if (!s) s = plat_symbol(pc, &off);
        if (s) fprintf(stderr, "  #%-2d %016llx %s+%llx\n", i, (unsigned long long)pc, s, (unsigned long long)off);
        else fprintf(stderr, "  #%-2d %016llx lasrecomp+%llx\n", i, (unsigned long long)pc,
                     (unsigned long long)(pc - exe));
    }
}

static LONG WINAPI unhandled_filter(EXCEPTION_POINTERS *ep) {
    EXCEPTION_RECORD *er = ep->ExceptionRecord;
    uint64_t fa = er->NumberParameters >= 2 ? er->ExceptionInformation[1] : 0;
    char what[48];
    snprintf(what, sizeof what, "exception %08lx", er->ExceptionCode);
    // x64 has no link register: report the return address on top of the stack (valid at function entry).
    uint64_t lr = 0;
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
    if (VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)ep->ContextRecord->Rsp, &mi, sizeof mi) && mi.State == MEM_COMMIT)
        lr = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)ep->ContextRecord->Rsp;
    rt_fault_report(what, fa, ep->ContextRecord->Rip, lr);
}

void plat_crash_handler_install(void) {
    ULONG guarantee = 64 << 10;  // room for the report after a stack overflow
    SetThreadStackGuarantee(&guarantee);
    if (g_report_crashes) return;
    g_report_crashes = true;
    SetUnhandledExceptionFilter(unhandled_filter);
}

// ---- POSIX shims (win_compat.h)
static ssize_t prw(int fd, void *buf, size_t n, off_t off, bool write) {
    HANDLE h = (HANDLE)_get_osfhandle(fd);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return -1;
    size_t done = 0;
    while (done < n) {
        OVERLAPPED ov = {0};
        uint64_t o = (uint64_t)off + done;
        ov.Offset = (DWORD)o;
        ov.OffsetHigh = (DWORD)(o >> 32);
        DWORD chunk = n - done > 0x40000000 ? 0x40000000 : (DWORD)(n - done), got = 0;
        BOOL ok = write ? WriteFile(h, (const char *)buf + done, chunk, &got, &ov)
                        : ReadFile(h, (char *)buf + done, chunk, &got, &ov);
        if (!ok) {
            if (GetLastError() == ERROR_HANDLE_EOF) break;
            return done ? (ssize_t)done : -1;
        }
        if (!got) break;
        done += got;
    }
    return (ssize_t)done;
}
ssize_t pread(int fd, void *buf, size_t n, off_t off) { return prw(fd, buf, n, off, false); }
ssize_t pwrite(int fd, const void *buf, size_t n, off_t off) { return prw(fd, (void *)buf, n, off, true); }

// ---- child processes
PlatProc plat_spawn(const char *const argv[], const char *log_path, bool append_log) {
    static __thread char cmd[32768];
    cmd[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; argv[i]; i++) append_arg(cmd, sizeof cmd, argv[i]);
    static __thread wchar_t wcmd[32768], wlog[MAX_PATH];
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, cmd, -1, wcmd, 32768);
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, log_path ? log_path : "NUL", -1, wlog, MAX_PATH);
    SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES sa = {.nLength = sizeof sa, .bInheritHandle = TRUE};
    HANDLE log = CreateFileW(wlog, append_log ? FILE_APPEND_DATA : GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE,
                             &sa, append_log ? OPEN_ALWAYS : CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
    if (log == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    STARTUPINFOW si = {.cb = sizeof si, .dwFlags = STARTF_USESTDHANDLES, .hStdInput = NULL, .hStdOutput = log,
                       .hStdError = log};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    // CreateProcess doesn't resolve relative paths written with '/' (e.g. a helper under tools/): pass the program
    // as a full path, like posix_spawn takes it as given
    static __thread wchar_t wprog[MAX_PATH], wfull[MAX_PATH];
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, argv[0], -1, wprog, MAX_PATH);
    for (wchar_t *p = wprog; *p; p++) if (*p == L'/') *p = L'\\';
    const wchar_t *app = GetFullPathNameW(wprog, MAX_PATH, wfull, NULL) ? wfull : NULL;
    BOOL ok = CreateProcessW(app, wcmd, NULL, NULL, TRUE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW | CREATE_SUSPENDED, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi);
    if (!ok) fprintf(stderr, "[plat] could not start %s (error %lu)\n", argv[0], GetLastError());
    CloseHandle(log);
    if (!ok) return 0;
    // every child in one job that ends with this process (a compiler's own children too: no leftovers on quit)
    static HANDLE job;
    if (!job && (job = CreateJobObjectW(NULL, NULL))) {
        JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION li = {0};
        li.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags = JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE;
        SetInformationJobObject(job, JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation, &li, sizeof li);
    }
    if (job) AssignProcessToJobObject(job, pi.hProcess);
    ResumeThread(pi.hThread);
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    return (PlatProc)pi.hProcess;
}

void plat_proc_kill(PlatProc p) {  // (what it started ends with this process: the job above)
    TerminateProcess((HANDLE)p, 255);
    WaitForSingleObject((HANDLE)p, INFINITE);
    CloseHandle((HANDLE)p);
}

int plat_proc_wait(PlatProc p, bool block) {
    HANDLE h = (HANDLE)p;
    DWORD w = WaitForSingleObject(h, block ? INFINITE : 0);
    if (w == WAIT_TIMEOUT) return -1;
    if (w != WAIT_OBJECT_0) return 255;  // (not a process we can wait for: ended as far as the caller is concerned)
    DWORD code = 255;
    GetExitCodeProcess(h, &code);
    CloseHandle(h);
    return code > 255 ? 255 : (int)code;  // (a crash's NTSTATUS, e.g. 0xC0000409, is not "still running" (-1))
}

bool plat_remove_tree(const char *dir) {
    // SHFileOperation wants a double-NUL-terminated path with backslashes
    static __thread wchar_t w[MAX_PATH + 2];
    int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, dir, -1, w, MAX_PATH);
    if (n <= 1) return false;
    w[n] = 0;
    for (wchar_t *p = w; *p; p++) if (*p == L'/') *p = L'\\';
    SHFILEOPSTRUCTW op = {.wFunc = FO_DELETE, .pFrom = w, .fFlags = FOF_NO_UI};
    return SHFileOperationW(&op) == 0 && !op.fAnyOperationsAborted;
}

// End the process at once, skipping DLL teardown (from an atexit handler, after flushing). Exit status 0.
void plat_terminate(void) { TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), 0); }
```

`runtime/platform/windows_threads.h`:

```h
// Windows guest threads reserve room for recompiled recursion without committing the whole stack. The CRT entry
// point keeps thread-local cleanup; the returned handle remains owned by the caller until the thread is joined.
#pragma once
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#include <process.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

typedef struct { void *(*entry)(void *); void *argument; } GuestThreadStart;
static unsigned __stdcall guest_thread_trampoline(void *argument) {
    GuestThreadStart start = *(GuestThreadStart *)argument;
    free(argument);
    start.entry(start.argument);
    return 0;
}

// winpthreads passes its requested stack size as a Windows commit size. Guest
// recursion needs a large address reservation, not 256 MB committed per thread.
// The CRT entry point retains thread-local cleanup while Windows grows the stack.
static uintptr_t guest_thread_create(void *(*entry)(void *), void *argument, unsigned reserve) {
    GuestThreadStart *start = malloc(sizeof *start);
    if (!start) return 0;
    *start = (GuestThreadStart){entry, argument};
    uintptr_t handle = _beginthreadex(NULL, reserve, guest_thread_trampoline, start,
                                    STACK_SIZE_PARAM_IS_A_RESERVATION, NULL);
    if (!handle) free(start);
    return handle;
}

static bool guest_thread_join(uintptr_t handle) {
    if (WaitForSingleObject((HANDLE)handle, INFINITE) != WAIT_OBJECT_0) return false;
    return CloseHandle((HANDLE)handle) != 0;
}
#endif

```

`runtime/romfs_build.c`:

```c
// RomFS image builder (romfs_build.h). Layout as the game's own image: a 0x50-byte header, file data
// from 0x200 (each file 16-byte aligned), then the directory hash table, directory entries, file hash table and file
// entries. Entries are found by hash (the game's RomFS code walks the tables itself), so the order inside them only
// has to be consistent: directories and files are sorted by name, children before siblings' children.
#include "romfs_build.h"

#include "platform.h"  // (Windows: POSIX mkdir)

#include <dirent.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#ifdef __APPLE__
#include <sys/clonefile.h>
#endif
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#endif

#define EMPTY 0xFFFFFFFFu
#define DATA_START 0x200u

typedef struct Dir Dir;
typedef struct {
    char *name, *path;
    uint64_t size, data_off;
    uint32_t off;  // entry offset in the file table
    Dir *parent;
} File;
struct Dir {
    char *name, *path;
    Dir *parent;
    Dir **dirs;
    File **files;
    int ndirs, nfiles;
    uint32_t off;  // entry offset in the directory table
};

static int by_name_dir(const void *a, const void *b) { return strcmp((*(Dir *const *)a)->name, (*(Dir *const *)b)->name); }
static int by_name_file(const void *a, const void *b) { return strcmp((*(File *const *)a)->name, (*(File *const *)b)->name); }

static Dir *scan(const char *path, const char *name, Dir *parent, int depth) {
    if (depth > 32) return NULL;
    DIR *d = opendir(path);
    if (!d) return NULL;
    Dir *dir = calloc(1, sizeof *dir);
    dir->name = strdup(name), dir->path = strdup(path), dir->parent = parent;
    int cd = 0, cf = 0;
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;  // (".", "..", and hidden files such as .DS_Store aren't the game's)
        size_t n = strlen(path) + strlen(e->d_name) + 2;
        char *p = malloc(n);
        snprintf(p, n, "%s/%s", path, e->d_name);
        struct stat st;
        if (stat(p, &st) != 0) { free(p); continue; }
        if (S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) {
            Dir *c = scan(p, e->d_name, dir, depth + 1);
            free(p);
            if (!c) continue;
            if (dir->ndirs == cd) dir->dirs = realloc(dir->dirs, sizeof *dir->dirs * (cd = cd ? cd * 2 : 8));
            dir->dirs[dir->ndirs++] = c;
        } else if (S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) {
            File *f = calloc(1, sizeof *f);
            f->name = strdup(e->d_name), f->path = p, f->size = (uint64_t)st.st_size, f->parent = dir;
            if (dir->nfiles == cf) dir->files = realloc(dir->files, sizeof *dir->files * (cf = cf ? cf * 2 : 16));
            dir->files[dir->nfiles++] = f;
        } else {
            free(p);
        }
    }
    closedir(d);
    if (dir->ndirs) qsort(dir->dirs, dir->ndirs, sizeof *dir->dirs, by_name_dir);
    if (dir->nfiles) qsort(dir->files, dir->nfiles, sizeof *dir->files, by_name_file);
    return dir;
}

static void free_tree(Dir *d) {
    if (!d) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) free_tree(d->dirs[i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < d->nfiles; i++) free(d->files[i]->name), free(d->files[i]->path), free(d->files[i]);
    free(d->dirs), free(d->files), free(d->name), free(d->path), free(d);
}

// flat lists, in table order
typedef struct { Dir **dirs; File **files; int nd, nf, cd, cf; } Lists;
static void flatten(Dir *d, Lists *l) {
    for (int i = 0; i < d->nfiles; i++) {
        if (l->nf == l->cf) l->files = realloc(l->files, sizeof *l->files * (l->cf = l->cf ? l->cf * 2 : 256));
        l->files[l->nf++] = d->files[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) {
        if (l->nd == l->cd) l->dirs = realloc(l->dirs, sizeof *l->dirs * (l->cd = l->cd ? l->cd * 2 : 64));
        l->dirs[l->nd++] = d->dirs[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) flatten(d->dirs[i], l);
}

// the RomFS name hash and bucket count (as the game's RomFS code computes them)
static uint32_t name_hash(uint32_t parent, const char *name) {
    uint32_t h = parent ^ 123456789u;
    for (const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)name; *p; p++) h = ((h >> 5) | (h << 27)) ^ *p;
    return h;
}
static uint32_t bucket_count(uint32_t n) {
    if (n < 3) return 3;
    if (n < 19) return n | 1;
    uint32_t c = n;
    while (c % 2 == 0 || c % 3 == 0 || c % 5 == 0 || c % 7 == 0 || c % 11 == 0 || c % 13 == 0 || c % 17 == 0) c++;
    return c;
}

static uint32_t align4(uint32_t x) { return (x + 3) & ~3u; }
static uint64_t align16(uint64_t x) { return (x + 15) & ~15ull; }
static void put32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v) { memcpy(p, &v, 4); }
static void put64(uint8_t *p, uint64_t v) { memcpy(p, &v, 8); }

uint64_t romfs_dir_bytes(const char *dir) {
    Dir *t = scan(dir, "", NULL, 0);
    if (!t) return 0;
    Lists l = {0};
    flatten(t, &l);
    uint64_t n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nf; i++) n += l.files[i]->size;
    free(l.dirs), free(l.files);
    free_tree(t);
    return n;
}

static bool copy_data(FILE *out, const char *path, uint64_t size, uint8_t *buf, size_t bufsize, uint64_t *done,
                      uint64_t total, void (*progress)(uint64_t, uint64_t)) {
    FILE *in = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!in) return false;
    uint64_t left = size;
    while (left) {
        size_t want = left < bufsize ? (size_t)left : bufsize;
        size_t got = fread(buf, 1, want, in);
        if (got != want || fwrite(buf, 1, got, out) != got) { fclose(in); return false; }
        left -= got;
        *done += got;
        if (progress) progress(*done, total);
    }
    fclose(in);
    return true;
}

bool romfs_build(const char *dir, const char *out_path, void (*progress)(uint64_t, uint64_t), char *why, size_t why_size) {
    #define FAIL(...) do { if (why) snprintf(why, why_size, __VA_ARGS__); goto fail; } while (0)
    bool ok = false;
    FILE *out = NULL;
    uint8_t *dtab = NULL, *ftab = NULL, *buf = NULL;
    uint32_t *dbuckets = NULL, *fbuckets = NULL;
    Lists l = {0};
    Dir *root = scan(dir, "", NULL, 0);
    if (!root) FAIL("can't read %s", dir);
    // table order: root, then each directory's subdirectories as flatten() lists them; files likewise
    if (l.nd == l.cd) l.dirs = realloc(l.dirs, sizeof *l.dirs * (l.cd = 64));
    l.dirs[l.nd++] = root;
    flatten(root, &l);
    if (!l.nf) FAIL("no files in %s", dir);

    // entry offsets
    uint32_t dsize = 0, fsize = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nd; i++) l.dirs[i]->off = dsize, dsize += 0x18 + align4((uint32_t)strlen(l.dirs[i]->name));
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nf; i++) l.files[i]->off = fsize, fsize += 0x20 + align4((uint32_t)strlen(l.files[i]->name));
    // file data offsets (relative to the data start), each 16-byte aligned
    uint64_t data = 0, total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nf; i++) {
        data = align16(data);
        l.files[i]->data_off = data;
        data += l.files[i]->size;
        total += l.files[i]->size;
    }

    uint32_t nbd = bucket_count((uint32_t)l.nd), nbf = bucket_count((uint32_t)l.nf);
    dbuckets = malloc(4 * nbd), fbuckets = malloc(4 * nbf);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nbd; i++) dbuckets[i] = EMPTY;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nbf; i++) fbuckets[i] = EMPTY;
    dtab = calloc(1, dsize), ftab = calloc(1, fsize);
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nd; i++) {
        Dir *d = l.dirs[i];
        uint8_t *e = dtab + d->off;
        uint32_t parent = d->parent ? d->parent->off : 0, nl = (uint32_t)strlen(d->name);
        uint32_t sib = EMPTY;
        if (d->parent)
            for (int k = 0; k + 1 < d->parent->ndirs; k++)
                if (d->parent->dirs[k] == d) sib = d->parent->dirs[k + 1]->off;
        uint32_t h = name_hash(parent, d->name) % nbd;
        put32(e, parent);
        put32(e + 4, sib);
        put32(e + 8, d->ndirs ? d->dirs[0]->off : EMPTY);
        put32(e + 12, d->nfiles ? d->files[0]->off : EMPTY);
        put32(e + 16, dbuckets[h]);
        put32(e + 20, nl);
        memcpy(e + 0x18, d->name, nl);
        dbuckets[h] = d->off;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nf; i++) {
        File *f = l.files[i];
        uint8_t *e = ftab + f->off;
        uint32_t nl = (uint32_t)strlen(f->name), sib = EMPTY;
        for (int k = 0; k + 1 < f->parent->nfiles; k++)
            if (f->parent->files[k] == f) sib = f->parent->files[k + 1]->off;
        uint32_t h = name_hash(f->parent->off, f->name) % nbf;
        put32(e, f->parent->off);
        put32(e + 4, sib);
        put64(e + 8, f->data_off);
        put64(e + 16, f->size);
        put32(e + 24, fbuckets[h]);
        put32(e + 28, nl);
        memcpy(e + 0x20, f->name, nl);
        fbuckets[h] = f->off;
    }

    // header: tables after the file data (4-byte aligned)
    uint64_t dhash_off = (DATA_START + data + 3) & ~3ull;
    uint64_t dmeta_off = dhash_off + 4ull * nbd, fhash_off = dmeta_off + dsize, fmeta_off = fhash_off + 4ull * nbf;
    uint8_t hdr[DATA_START] = {0};
    uint64_t hv[10] = {0x50, dhash_off, 4ull * nbd, dmeta_off, dsize, fhash_off, 4ull * nbf, fmeta_off, fsize, DATA_START};
    memcpy(hdr, hv, sizeof hv);

    out = fopen(out_path, "wb");
    if (!out) FAIL("can't write %s", out_path);
    if (fwrite(hdr, 1, DATA_START, out) != DATA_START) FAIL("write failed (disk full?)");
    size_t bufsize = 4u << 20;
    buf = malloc(bufsize);
    uint64_t pos = 0, done = 0;
    static const uint8_t zero[16];
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nf; i++) {
        File *f = l.files[i];
        if (f->data_off > pos && fwrite(zero, 1, (size_t)(f->data_off - pos), out) != f->data_off - pos)
            FAIL("write failed (disk full?)");
        if (!copy_data(out, f->path, f->size, buf, bufsize, &done, total, progress)) FAIL("can't copy %s", f->path);
        pos = f->data_off + f->size;
    }
    uint64_t tail = dhash_off - DATA_START - pos;
    if (tail && fwrite(zero, 1, (size_t)tail, out) != tail) FAIL("write failed (disk full?)");
    if (fwrite(dbuckets, 4, nbd, out) != nbd || fwrite(dtab, 1, dsize, out) != dsize ||
        fwrite(fbuckets, 4, nbf, out) != nbf || fwrite(ftab, 1, fsize, out) != fsize)
        FAIL("write failed (disk full?)");
    if (fclose(out) != 0) { out = NULL; FAIL("write failed (disk full?)"); }
    out = NULL;
    ok = true;
fail:
    if (out) fclose(out);
    if (!ok) remove(out_path);
    free(buf), free(dtab), free(ftab), free(dbuckets), free(fbuckets), free(l.dirs), free(l.files);
    free_tree(root);
    return ok;
    #undef FAIL
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ copying the player's folder
static bool copy_file(const char *src, const char *dst, uint64_t size, uint64_t *done, uint64_t total,
                      void (*progress)(uint64_t, uint64_t)) {
    remove(dst);
#ifdef __APPLE__
    if (clonefile(src, dst, 0) == 0) goto linked;  // (APFS: a copy-on-write clone, instant)
#endif
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (CreateHardLinkA(dst, src, NULL)) goto linked;  // (same NTFS volume: a hard link)
#else
    if (link(src, dst) == 0) goto linked;  // (same volume: a hard link)
#endif
    {
        FILE *in = fopen(src, "rb"), *out = in ? fopen(dst, "wb") : NULL;
        bool ok = in && out;
        static uint8_t buf[1 << 20];
        while (ok) {
            size_t n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, in);
            if (!n) break;
            if (fwrite(buf, 1, n, out) != n) ok = false;
            *done += n;
            if (progress) progress(*done, total);
        }
        if (in) fclose(in);
        if (out && fclose(out) != 0) ok = false;
        return ok;
    }
linked:
    *done += size;
    if (progress) progress(*done, total);
    return true;
}

static bool copy_dir(Dir *d, const char *dst, uint64_t *done, uint64_t total, void (*progress)(uint64_t, uint64_t)) {
    mkdir(dst, 0755);
    for (int i = 0; i < d->nfiles; i++) {
        size_t n = strlen(dst) + strlen(d->files[i]->name) + 2;
        char *p = malloc(n);
        snprintf(p, n, "%s/%s", dst, d->files[i]->name);
        bool ok = copy_file(d->files[i]->path, p, d->files[i]->size, done, total, progress);
        free(p);
        if (!ok) return false;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) {
        size_t n = strlen(dst) + strlen(d->dirs[i]->name) + 2;
        char *p = malloc(n);
        snprintf(p, n, "%s/%s", dst, d->dirs[i]->name);
        bool ok = copy_dir(d->dirs[i], p, done, total, progress);
        free(p);
        if (!ok) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool romfs_copy_tree(const char *src, const char *dst, void (*progress)(uint64_t, uint64_t)) {
    Dir *t = scan(src, "", NULL, 0);
    if (!t) return false;
    Lists l = {0};
    flatten(t, &l);
    uint64_t total = 0, done = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nf; i++) total += l.files[i]->size;
    bool ok = copy_dir(t, dst, &done, total, progress);
    free(l.dirs), free(l.files);
    free_tree(t);
    return ok;
}

bool romfs_copy_file(const char *src, const char *dst, void (*progress)(uint64_t, uint64_t)) {
    struct stat st;
    if (stat(src, &st) != 0) return false;
    uint64_t done = 0;
    return copy_file(src, dst, (uint64_t)st.st_size, &done, (uint64_t)st.st_size, progress);
}
```

`runtime/romfs_build.h`:

```h
// RomFS image from a folder of game files (runtime/romfs_build.c). The game reads its data through one raw RomFS
// image (romfs.bin, runtime/services/fs.c); players bring their own game files, and the start screen builds the image
// from their romfs/ folder.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

// Writes the RomFS image of the folder `dir` to `out`. progress (may be NULL): bytes of file data written so far and
// the total, now and then. false = failed (why: a short message).
bool romfs_build(const char *dir, const char *out, void (*progress)(uint64_t done, uint64_t total), char *why,
                 size_t why_size);

// Bytes of file data under dir (the image is about this plus its tables).
uint64_t romfs_dir_bytes(const char *dir);

// Copies the folder tree src to dst (hard links where the file system allows: no second copy of 6 GB). progress as
// above. false = failed.
bool romfs_copy_tree(const char *src, const char *dst, void (*progress)(uint64_t done, uint64_t total));
// One file the same way (a hard link where the file system allows).
bool romfs_copy_file(const char *src, const char *dst, void (*progress)(uint64_t done, uint64_t total));

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

`runtime/rt.h`:

```h
// Runtime-internal declarations.
#pragma once
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdio.h>

#include "cpu.h"
#include "platform.h"

#define LOG(...) fprintf(stderr, __VA_ARGS__)
#define FATAL(...) (fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: " __VA_ARGS__), rt_fatal_trace())

// ---- address space layout (guest addresses == host addresses)
// macOS reserves 0x2_0000_0000-0x70_0000_0000, and guest addresses must fit in 39 bits, so the
// guest lives in a 12.5 GB window at 0x70_0000_0000 claimed at startup (see main.c).
#define GUEST_LO     0x7000000000ull
#define GUEST_HI     0x7320000000ull
#define MAIN_BASE    0x7000000000ull
#define SDK_BASE     0x7004000000ull
#define SUBSDK0_BASE 0x7006000000ull   // Let's Go: glslc (runtime GLSL -> Maxwell compiler)
#define SUBSDK1_BASE 0x7008000000ull   // Let's Go: multimedia (movie::)
#define HLE_BASE     0x7080000000ull   // fake addresses for host-implemented functions
#define HLE_SIZE     0x0000100000ull
#define TLS_BASE     0x7090000000ull
#define TLS_SIZE     0x0000100000ull
#define HLE_HEAP     0x7092000000ull   // guest-visible memory owned by host code
#define HLE_HEAP_SIZE 0x000E000000ull
#define ALIAS_BASE   0x7100000000ull   // alias region (svcMapMemory targets)
#define ALIAS_SIZE   0x0100000000ull
#define HEAP_BASE    0x7240000000ull
#define HEAP_MAX     0x00D0000000ull   // 3.25 GB

// ---- loader.c
typedef struct Module {
    const char *name;
    uint64_t base, size;
    uint64_t text_off, text_size, ro_off, ro_size, data_off, data_size;
    uint64_t dynamic, init, fini, init_array, init_array_sz, fini_array, fini_array_sz;
    uint64_t symtab, strtab, nsyms;
} Module;

extern Module g_modules[4];
extern int g_nmodules;
void loader_load(const char *exefs_dir);  // (again after a reboot: modules are reloaded into wiped memory)
uint64_t loader_find_symbol(const char *name);
const char *loader_symbol_at(uint64_t addr, uint64_t *offset);

// ---- dispatch.c
typedef void (*HostFn)(Cpu *c);
void dispatch_init(void);
GuestFn dispatch_lookup(uint64_t addr);
uint64_t hle_register(const char *name, HostFn fn);  // returns fake guest address
HostFn hle_lookup_impl(const char *name);
void hle_override(uint64_t guest_addr, HostFn fn, const char *name);
void rt_fatal_trace(void) __attribute__((noreturn));
void crash_handler_install(void);  // per thread (alternate signal stack)

// ---- kernel.c
typedef struct KThread KThread;
void kernel_init(void);
void kernel_stop_threads(void (*idle)(void));  // reboot: unwind every guest thread and join it (idle: called while waiting)
void kernel_reset(void);                       // reboot: empty handle table, memory map, thread list
KThread *kernel_create_main_thread(uint64_t entry, uint64_t stack_size, int prio);
void kernel_run_main(KThread *t, uint64_t x0, uint64_t x1, uint64_t x2, uint64_t x3);
uint32_t kernel_current_thread_handle(void);
Cpu *kernel_current_cpu(void);

// ---- ipc.c
typedef struct Service Service;
int ipc_handle_request(Cpu *c, uint32_t handle);
uint32_t ipc_connect_named_port(const char *name);

// ---- in-place reboot (main.c): switch seeds or go back to the start screen without leaving the process
enum { RT_REBOOT_NONE, RT_REBOOT_GAME, RT_REBOOT_TITLE };  // GAME: boot again at once (new seed); TITLE: start screen
void rt_request_reboot(int kind);  // any thread; the window loop (ui_run) returns it and main() carries it out
int rt_reboot_requested(void);
```

```c
// acc:u0 (one local user) and the preselected-user launch parameter.
#include <string.h>

#include "../hle.h"
#include "../ipc.h"

const uint8_t g_user_id[16] = {0x4c, 0x41, 0x52, 0x65, 0x63, 0x6f, 0x6d, 0x70, 0x01, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x01};

static void write_uid_list(IpcReq *req) {
    IpcBuf *c = out_buf(req, 0);
    if (!c) return;
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)c->addr, 0, c->size);
    if (c->size >= 16) memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)c->addr, g_user_id, 16);
}

static void profile(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: case 1: {  // Get / GetBase -> ProfileBase {uid, u64 timestamp, nickname[0x21]}
        memset(resp->data, 0, 0x38);
        memcpy(resp->data, g_user_id, 16);
        *(uint64_t *)(resp->data + 16) = 1600000000;
        strcpy((char *)resp->data + 24, "Link");
        resp_size(resp, 0x38);
        if (req->cmd == 0 && out_buf(req, 0)) memset((void *)(uintptr_t)out_buf(req, 0)->addr, 0, out_buf(req, 0)->size);
        break;
    }
    case 10: OUT(uint32_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 4); break;  // GetImageSize
    case 11: OUT(uint32_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 4); break;  // LoadImage
    default: LOG("[acc] IProfile cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
    }
}

static void manager(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: break;  // CheckAvailability
    case 1: OUT(uint64_t, 0) = 0x1234567890abcdefull; resp_size(resp, 8); break;  // GetAccountId
    default: LOG("[acc] IManagerForApplication cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd); resp_size(resp, 0x10);
    }
}

SERVICE("acc:u0", acc_u0) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: OUT(int32_t, 0) = 1; resp_size(resp, 4); break;  // GetUserCount
    case 1: OUT(uint8_t, 0) = !memcmp(req->data, g_user_id, 16); resp_size(resp, 1); break;
    case 2: case 3: case 141: write_uid_list(req); break;  // ListAllUsers / ListOpenUsers / ListQualifiedUsers
    case 4: case 51: memcpy(resp->data, g_user_id, 16); resp_size(resp, 16); break;  // GetLastOpenedUser
    case 5: ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("IProfile", profile, NULL)); break;
    case 50: OUT(uint8_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 1); break;
    case 100: case 140: break;  // InitializeApplicationInfo
    case 101: ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("IManagerForApplication", manager, NULL)); break;
    case 150: OUT(uint8_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 1); break;  // IsUserAccountSwitchLocked
    default: LOG("[acc] acc:u0 cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd); resp_size(resp, 0x10);
    }
}
```

`runtime/services/am.c`:

```c
// Applet manager (appletOE), apm, and lm.
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../mods.h"
#include "../hle.h"
#include "../ipc.h"

#define AM_NO_MESSAGE MAKE_RESULT(128, 3)
#define AM_NO_DATA MAKE_RESULT(128, 2)

static uint32_t msg_event_r, msg_event_w;
static KEvent *msg_event;
static uint32_t msg_queue[16];
static int msg_count;

static bool preselected_popped;
RT_ON_RESET(am_reset) {  // (reboot: the message queue starts over with FocusStateChanged)
    msg_event = NULL;
    msg_event_r = msg_event_w = 0;
    msg_count = 0;
    preselected_popped = false;
}

static void am_init_once(void) {
    if (msg_event) return;
    msg_event = kernel_create_event_pair(&msg_event_w, &msg_event_r);
    msg_queue[msg_count++] = 15;  // FocusStateChanged
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_klock);
    kernel_signal(msg_event);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_klock);
}

static uint32_t new_event(void) {
    uint32_t w, r;
    kernel_create_event_pair(&w, &r);
    return r;
}

#define UNHANDLED(iface) LOG("[am] %s cmd %u (unhandled, ok)\n", iface, req->cmd)

static void common_state_getter(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = msg_event_r; break;  // GetEventHandle
    case 1:  // ReceiveMessage
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_klock);
        if (msg_count) {
            OUT(uint32_t, 0) = msg_queue[0];
            memmove(msg_queue, msg_queue + 1, --msg_count * sizeof(uint32_t));
            if (!msg_count) msg_event->signaled = false;
            resp_size(resp, 4);
        } else {
            resp->result = AM_NO_MESSAGE;
        }
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_klock);
        break;
    case 5: OUT(uint8_t, 0) = 1; resp_size(resp, 1); break;   // GetOperationMode: docked
    case 6: OUT(uint32_t, 0) = 1; resp_size(resp, 4); break;  // GetPerformanceMode: boost
    case 8: OUT(uint8_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 1); break;   // GetBootMode
    case 9: OUT(uint8_t, 0) = 1; resp_size(resp, 1); break;   // GetCurrentFocusState: in focus
    case 13: case 61: resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = new_event(); break;
    case 60: {  // GetDefaultDisplayResolution
        int w = getenv("LARECOMP_DISPLAY_W") ? atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_DISPLAY_W")) : 1920;
        LOG("[am] GetDefaultDisplayResolution -> %dx1080\n", w);
        OUT(int32_t, 0) = w; OUT(int32_t, 4) = 1080; resp_size(resp, 8); break;
    }
    default: UNHANDLED("ICommonStateGetter");
    }
}

static void self_controller(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: LOG("[am] application requested exit\n"); exit(0);
    case 9: resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = new_event(); break;
    case 40: OUT(uint64_t, 0) = 1; resp_size(resp, 8); break;  // CreateManagedDisplayLayer
    case 69: OUT(uint8_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 1); break;
    default: UNHANDLED("ISelfController");
    }
}

static void window_controller(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 1: OUT(uint64_t, 0) = 0x1234; resp_size(resp, 8); break;  // GetAppletResourceUserId
    default: UNHANDLED("IWindowController");
    }
}

static void generic_ok(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    LOG("[am] %s cmd %u (ok)\n", s->name, req->cmd);
    resp_size(resp, 0x10);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ IStorage / IStorageAccessor
typedef struct { uint8_t *data; uint64_t size; } AmStorage;

static void storage_accessor(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    AmStorage *st = s->state;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: OUT(int64_t, 0) = (int64_t)st->size; resp_size(resp, 8); break;  // GetSize
    case 10: {  // Write(offset, A)
        int64_t off = IN(int64_t, 0);
        IpcBuf *a = in_buf(req, 0);
        uint64_t n = a->size;
        if ((uint64_t)off + n > st->size) n = st->size - (uint64_t)off;
        memcpy(st->data + off, (void *)(uintptr_t)a->addr, n);
        break;
    }
    case 11: {  // Read(offset, B)
        int64_t off = IN(int64_t, 0);
        IpcBuf *b = out_buf(req, 0);
        uint64_t n = b->size;
        if ((uint64_t)off + n > st->size) n = st->size - (uint64_t)off;
        memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)b->addr, st->data + off, n);
        break;
    }
    default: LOG("[am] IStorageAccessor cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
    }
}

static void am_storage(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    if (req->cmd == 0) ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("IStorageAccessor", storage_accessor, s->state));
    else LOG("[am] IStorage cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
}

static Service *new_am_storage(const void *data, uint64_t size) {
    AmStorage *st = calloc(1, sizeof *st);
    st->data = calloc(1, size);
    st->size = size;
    if (data) memcpy(st->data, data, size);
    return service_new("IStorage", am_storage, st);
}

extern const uint8_t g_user_id[16];

const char *g_game_version = "1.0.0";  // the set-up game's version (runtime/gamesetup.c game_version)

static void application_functions(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 1:  // PopLaunchParameter(kind)
        if (IN(uint32_t, 0) == 2 && !preselected_popped) {  // PreselectedUser
            uint8_t p[0x88] = {0};
            *(uint32_t *)p = 0xC79497CA;
            *(uint32_t *)(p + 4) = 1;
            memcpy(p + 8, g_user_id, 16);
            preselected_popped = true;
            ipc_return_object(resp, new_am_storage(p, sizeof p));
        } else {
            resp->result = AM_NO_DATA;
        }
        break;
    case 20: OUT(uint64_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 8); break;  // EnsureSaveData
    case 21: memset(resp->data, 0, 8); memcpy(resp->data, game_language(), strlen(game_language())); resp_size(resp, 8);  // GetDesiredLanguage
        LOG("[am] GetDesiredLanguage: %s\n", game_language()); break;
    case 23: {  // GetDisplayVersion: the version of the set-up build (runtime/main.c)
        extern const char *g_game_version;
        memset(resp->data, 0, 0x10);
        memcpy(resp->data, g_game_version, strlen(g_game_version));
        resp_size(resp, 0x10);
        break;
    }
    case 40: OUT(uint8_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 1); break;  // NotifyRunning
    case 130: case 140: resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = new_event(); break;
    default: UNHANDLED("IApplicationFunctions");
    }
}

static void application_proxy(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    static const struct { int cmd; const char *name; ServiceHandler h; } subs[] = {
        {0, "ICommonStateGetter", common_state_getter},
        {1, "ISelfController", self_controller},
        {2, "IWindowController", window_controller},
        {3, "IAudioController", generic_ok},
        {4, "IDisplayController", generic_ok},
        {10, "IProcessWindingController", generic_ok},
        {11, "ILibraryAppletCreator", generic_ok},
        {20, "IApplicationFunctions", application_functions},
        {1000, "IDebugFunctions", generic_ok},
    };
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof subs / sizeof *subs; i++) {
        if (subs[i].cmd == (int)req->cmd) {
            ipc_return_object(resp, service_new(subs[i].name, subs[i].h, NULL));
            return;
        }
    }
    UNHANDLED("IApplicationProxy");
}

SERVICE("appletOE", applet_oe) {
    (void)s;
    am_init_once();
    if (req->cmd == 0) ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("IApplicationProxy", application_proxy, NULL));
    else UNHANDLED("appletOE");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ apm
static void apm_session(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    if (req->cmd == 1) { OUT(uint32_t, 0) = 0x92220008; resp_size(resp, 4); }  // GetPerformanceConfiguration
}

SERVICE("apm", apm) {
    (void)s;
    if (req->cmd == 0) ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("apm:ISession", apm_session, NULL));
    else if (req->cmd == 1) { OUT(uint32_t, 0) = 1; resp_size(resp, 4); }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ lm (guest log output)
static void lm_logger(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s; (void)resp;
    if (req->cmd != 0) return;
    IpcBuf *b = in_buf(req, 0);
    if (!b || !b->size) return;
    // Log packets are TLV chunks after a 0x18-byte header; print the string chunks.
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)b->addr, *end = p + b->size;
    p += 0x18;
    char line[1024];
    int n = 0;
    while (p + 2 <= end) {
        uint8_t key = p[0], len = p[1];
        p += 2;
        if (p + len > end) break;
        if (key == 2 || key == 4 || key == 5 || key == 6 || key == 7) {  // message, file, function, module, thread
            n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - n, "%s%.*s", n ? " | " : "", len, (const char *)p);
            if (n >= (int)sizeof line) break;
        }
        p += len;
    }
    if (n) LOG("[lm] %s\n", line);
}

SERVICE("lm", lm) {
    (void)s;
    if (req->cmd == 0) ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("lm:ILogger", lm_logger, NULL));
}
```

`runtime/services/audio.c`:

```c
// audren:u (audio renderer) and audout:u.
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <time.h>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

#include "../hle.h"
#include "../settings.h"
#include "../ipc.h"

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ audren: a CPU mixer modelled on
// Ryujinx's AudioRenderer (VoiceState / DataSourceHelper / StateUpdater, copies in notes/ryujinx_audio).
// Voices decode PCM16 / ADPCM wave buffers, resample to 48 kHz, and mix into their destination mix's
// buffers; sub mixes route into their destination; the final mix feeds the device sink, which we
// downmix to stereo and push to an SDL audio stream. Effects and splitters are not implemented.
#define WB_COUNT 4
#define MIXBUF_MAX 24
#define HIST 4

typedef struct {
    uint64_t addr, size, ctx;
    uint32_t start, end, loop_start, loop_end;
    int32_t loop_count;
    uint8_t loop, eos, sent;  // sent = IsSendToAudioProcessor
} WaveBuf;

typedef struct {  // per channel resource, "VoiceUpdateState"
    uint8_t valid[WB_COUNT];
    uint32_t wb_index, consumed;
    uint64_t played;
    int32_t offset, loop_count;
    float fraction;
    int16_t hist[HIST];
    int16_t pred_scale, h0, h1;
    float bq[2][2];  // biquad filter state per voice filter
} ChanState;

typedef struct {
    float mix[MIXBUF_MAX], prev[MIXBUF_MAX];
    uint8_t used;
} ChanRes;

typedef struct {
    uint8_t in_use, is_new, play_state;  // play_state: 0 started, 1 stopped, 2 stopping, 3 paused
    uint8_t fmt, chans, drop;
    uint32_t rate, wb_count, flush;
    float pitch, volume, prev_volume;
    int32_t mix_id;
    uint32_t splitter_id;
    uint32_t chan_ids[6];
    uint64_t ds_addr;
    uint16_t behaviour;
    uint8_t bq_on[2], bq_reset[2];
    float bq[2][5];  // a0 a1 a2 b1 b2
    WaveBuf wb[WB_COUNT];
} Voice;

typedef struct {
    uint8_t used;
    float volume;
    uint32_t bufs;
    int32_t dest;
    uint32_t dest_splitter;
    float vol[MIXBUF_MAX * MIXBUF_MAX];
    float *buf;  // bufs * sample_count
} Mix;

typedef struct Effect Effect;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t sample_rate, sample_count, mix_buffers, submixes, voices, sinks, effects, perf_frames;
    uint32_t splitters, revision;
    uint64_t elapsed_frames;
    uint32_t event_r, event_w;
    KEvent *event;
    uint32_t state;  // 0 started, 1 stopped
    pthread_mutex_t lock;
    Voice *voice;
    ChanRes *chres;
    ChanState *chst;
    Mix *mix;
    uint32_t nmix;
    uint8_t sink_used, sink_inputs, sink_input[6];
    Effect *fx;
    SDL_AudioStream *stream;
    FILE *wav;
    uint32_t wav_bytes;
    pthread_t thread;
    volatile bool quit;  // reboot (audio_reset)
} Renderer;

static float clampf(float v, float lo, float hi) { return v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v; }

// One sample of DSP ADPCM at absolute sample index s (frames of 8 bytes: header + 14 nibbles).
static int16_t adpcm_next(const uint8_t *data, uint64_t size, uint32_t s, const int16_t *coefs, ChanState *cs) {
    uint32_t frame = s / 14, n = s % 14;
    uint64_t hdr = (uint64_t)frame * 8;
    if (hdr + 1 + n / 2 >= size) return 0;
    uint8_t ps = data[hdr];
    int scale = ps & 15, ci = (ps >> 4) & 7;
    uint8_t b = data[hdr + 1 + n / 2];
    int nib = (n & 1) ? (int8_t)(b << 4) >> 4 : (int8_t)b >> 4;
    int pred = coefs[ci * 2] * cs->h0 + coefs[ci * 2 + 1] * cs->h1;
    int v = ((nib * (2048 << scale)) + pred + 1024) >> 11;
    if (v > 32767) v = 32767;
    if (v < -32768) v = -32768;
    cs->h1 = cs->h0;
    cs->h0 = (int16_t)v;
    return (int16_t)v;
}

static void mark_end(ChanState *cs, WaveBuf *wb, uint32_t *idx) {
    cs->valid[*idx] = 0;
    *idx = (*idx + 1) % WB_COUNT;
    cs->loop_count = 0;
    cs->consumed++;
    if (wb->eos) cs->played = 0;
}

// Decode up to `need` samples of channel `ch` into out; returns how many were produced.
static int decode_voice(Voice *v, int ch, ChanState *cs, int16_t *out, int need) {
    int y = 0;
    uint32_t idx = cs->wb_index;
    const int16_t *coefs = (const int16_t *)(uintptr_t)v->ds_addr;
    while (y < need) {
        if (!cs->valid[idx]) break;  // starving
        WaveBuf *wb = &v->wb[idx];
        if (cs->offset == 0 && v->fmt == 6 && wb->ctx) {
            const int16_t *c = (const int16_t *)(uintptr_t)wb->ctx;
            cs->pred_scale = c[0]; cs->h0 = c[1]; cs->h1 = c[2];
        }
        uint32_t start = wb->start, end = wb->end;
        if (cs->loop_count > 0 && wb->loop_start && wb->loop_end && wb->loop_start <= wb->loop_end) {
            start = wb->loop_start;
            end = wb->loop_end;
        }
        int total = (int)end - (int)start, n = 0;
        int avail = total - cs->offset;
        if (avail < 0) avail = 0;
        int want = need - y < avail ? need - y : avail;
        const uint8_t *data = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)wb->addr;
        if (data && wb->size) {
            if (v->fmt == 2) {  // PCM16 interleaved
                const int16_t *pcm = (const int16_t *)data;
                uint64_t nsamp = wb->size / 2 / v->chans;
                for (; n < want; n++) {
                    uint64_t s = (uint64_t)start + cs->offset + n;
                    if (s >= nsamp) break;
                    out[y + n] = pcm[s * v->chans + ch];
                }
            } else if (v->fmt == 6 && coefs) {
                for (; n < want; n++) out[y + n] = adpcm_next(data, wb->size, start + cs->offset + n, coefs, cs);
            } else if (v->fmt == 3) {  // PCM float
                const float *pcm = (const float *)data;
                uint64_t nsamp = wb->size / 4 / v->chans;
                for (; n < want; n++) {
                    uint64_t s = (uint64_t)start + cs->offset + n;
                    if (s >= nsamp) break;
                    out[y + n] = (int16_t)clampf(pcm[s * v->chans + ch] * 32767.f, -32768.f, 32767.f);
                }
            }
        }
        y += n;
        cs->offset += n;
        cs->played += n;
        if (cs->offset >= total || n == 0) {
            cs->offset = 0;
            if (wb->loop) {
                cs->loop_count++;
                if (wb->loop_count >= 0 && (n == 0 || cs->loop_count > wb->loop_count)) mark_end(cs, wb, &idx);
                if (n == 0) break;
                if (v->behaviour & 1) cs->played = 0;  // PlayedSampleCountResetWhenLooping
            } else {
                mark_end(cs, wb, &idx);
            }
        }
    }
    cs->wb_index = idx;
    return y;
}

// UpdateParametersForCommandGeneration: returns whether the voice should be played this frame.
static int voice_prepare(Renderer *r, Voice *v) {
    int nch = v->chans > 6 ? 6 : v->chans;
    if (v->is_new) {
        for (int c = 0; c < nch; c++) memset(&r->chst[v->chan_ids[c] % r->voices], 0, sizeof(ChanState));
```
