```c
// hid (shared memory, input state filled in later) and settings (set, set:sys).
#include <string.h>

#include "../mods.h"
#include "../hle.h"
#include "../ipc.h"

static uint32_t new_event_handle(void) {
    uint32_t w, r;
    kernel_create_event_pair(&w, &r);
    return r;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ hid
KSharedMem *g_hid_shmem;
uint32_t g_npad_supported_styles = 0x1F;  // NpadStyleTag bits: 0 FullKey, 1 Handheld, 2 JoyDual, 3 JoyLeft, 4 JoyRight, 5 Palma
static uint32_t hid_shmem_handle;
RT_ON_RESET(hid_reset) { g_hid_shmem = NULL; hid_shmem_handle = 0; }

static void applet_resource(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    if (req->cmd == 0) {  // GetSharedMemoryHandle
        if (!g_hid_shmem) g_hid_shmem = kernel_create_shared_memory(0x40000, NULL, &hid_shmem_handle);
        resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = hid_shmem_handle;
    }
}

SERVICE("hid", hid) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("IAppletResource", applet_resource, NULL)); break;
    case 40: case 106: resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = new_event_handle(); break;
    case 100:  // SetSupportedNpadStyleSet (the styles the game accepts: runtime/hle/input.c picks one of them)
        g_npad_supported_styles = IN(uint32_t, 0);
        LOG("[hid] SetSupportedNpadStyleSet %#x\n", g_npad_supported_styles);
        break;
    case 101: OUT(uint32_t, 0) = g_npad_supported_styles; resp_size(resp, 4); break;  // GetSupportedNpadStyleSet
    case 121: OUT(int64_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 8); break;      // GetNpadJoyHoldType
    case 129: OUT(int64_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 8); break;      // GetNpadHandheldActivationMode
    case 201: case 202: case 203: case 206: case 207: case 208: case 209: break;  // vibration
    case 200: memset(resp->data, 0, 0x10); OUT(uint32_t, 0) = 1; resp_size(resp, 0x10); break;
    default: break;  // Activate*/Set*: accept
    }
}

SERVICE("hid:sys", hid_sys) { (void)s; (void)req; resp_size(resp, 0x10); }

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ settings
static const char *const languages[] = {"ja", "en-US", "fr", "de", "it", "es", "zh-CN", "ko", "nl",
                                         "pt", "ru", "zh-TW", "en-GB", "fr-CA", "es-419", "zh-Hans",
                                         "zh-Hant", "pt-BR"};
#define NLANG 18

static uint64_t lang_code(const char *s) {
    uint64_t v = 0;
    memcpy(&v, s, strlen(s));
    return v;
}

static void language_list(IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp, int max) {
    IpcBuf *b = out_buf(req, 0);
    int n = 0;
    if (b) {
        uint64_t *out = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)b->addr;
        for (; n < max && n < NLANG && (uint64_t)(n + 1) * 8 <= b->size; n++) out[n] = lang_code(languages[n]);
    }
    OUT(int32_t, 0) = n;
    resp_size(resp, 4);
}

SERVICE("set", set) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: OUT(uint64_t, 0) = lang_code(game_language()); resp_size(resp, 8);  // GetLanguageCode (launcher / mod)
        LOG("[set] GetLanguageCode: %s\n", game_language()); break;
    case 1: language_list(req, resp, 15); break;                                   // GetAvailableLanguageCodes
    case 2: {                                                                      // MakeLanguageCode
        uint32_t i = IN(uint32_t, 0);
        OUT(uint64_t, 0) = i < NLANG ? lang_code(languages[i]) : 0;
        resp_size(resp, 8);
        break;
    }
    case 3: OUT(int32_t, 0) = 15; resp_size(resp, 4); break;
    case 4: OUT(uint32_t, 0) = 1; resp_size(resp, 4); break;                       // GetRegionCode: USA
    case 5: language_list(req, resp, NLANG); break;
    case 6: OUT(int32_t, 0) = NLANG; resp_size(resp, 4); break;
    case 8: OUT(uint8_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 1); break;                        // GetQuestFlag
    default: LOG("[set] cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd); resp_size(resp, 0x10);
    }
}

SERVICE("set:sys", set_sys) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 3: case 4: {  // GetFirmwareVersion(2) -> B buffer 0x100
        IpcBuf *b = out_buf(req, 0);
        if (b) {
            uint8_t *v = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)b->addr;
            memset(v, 0, 0x100);
            v[0] = 8; v[1] = 1; v[2] = 0; v[4] = 8; v[5] = 1; v[6] = 0;  // 8.1.0
            strcpy((char *)v + 0x68, "8.1.0");
            strcpy((char *)v + 0x80, "8.1.0-1.0");
        }
        break;
    }
    case 23: OUT(uint32_t, 0) = 1; resp_size(resp, 4); break;  // GetColorSetId: dark
    default: LOG("[set:sys] cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd); resp_size(resp, 0x10);
    }
}
```

`runtime/services/hwopus.c`:

```c
// hwopus (nn::codec::HardwareOpusDecoder): Opus packets -> interleaved s16 PCM, decoded on the host with FFmpeg.
// Let's Go's music and sound effects are Opus; with the logging stub GetWorkBufferSize returned 0 and the game gave up
// on every decoder (its 6-channel audio out played silence).
//
// IHardwareOpusDecoderManager: 0 Open(params {u32 rate, u32 channels}, u32 work size, transfer memory),
//   1 GetWorkBufferSize(params), 2 OpenForMultiStream, 3 GetWorkBufferSizeForMultiStream (multistream: not seen yet).
// IHardwareOpusDecoder: 0 DecodeInterleavedOld, 4 DecodeInterleavedWithPerfOld, 6 DecodeInterleaved(u8 reset).
//   Input buffer: {u32 size BE, u32 final range BE} + packet. Output: s16 interleaved at the opened rate.
//   Returns u32 bytes consumed, u32 samples per channel (+ u64 time in microseconds for 4 / 6).
#include <libavcodec/avcodec.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../hle.h"
#include "../ipc.h"

typedef struct {
    uint32_t rate, channels;
    AVCodecContext *ctx;
    AVPacket *pkt;
    AVFrame *frame;
    pthread_mutex_t lock;
} OpusDec;

static uint32_t be32(const uint8_t *p) { return (uint32_t)p[0] << 24 | (uint32_t)p[1] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[2] << 8 | p[3]; }

static bool opus_open(OpusDec *d) {
    const AVCodec *codec = avcodec_find_decoder(AV_CODEC_ID_OPUS);
    // (the game aborts without it, right after the controller screen: say why instead - an FFmpeg built without
    // swresample has no Opus decoder, tools/build_deps_windows.sh)
    if (!codec) FATAL("the game's audio needs FFmpeg's Opus decoder, and the avcodec DLL next to the exe has none\n");
    d->ctx = avcodec_alloc_context3(codec);
    d->ctx->sample_rate = 48000;  // (FFmpeg decodes Opus at 48 kHz: other rates are decimated below)
    av_channel_layout_default(&d->ctx->ch_layout, (int)d->channels);
    if (avcodec_open2(d->ctx, codec, NULL) < 0) { LOG("[hwopus] cannot open the Opus decoder\n"); return false; }
    d->pkt = av_packet_alloc();
    d->frame = av_frame_alloc();
    return true;
}

static int16_t to_s16(float s) {
    if (s > 1.0f) s = 1.0f;
    if (s < -1.0f) s = -1.0f;
    return (int16_t)(s * 32767.0f);
}

// One packet -> out (interleaved s16 at d->rate). Returns samples per channel, or -1.
static int opus_decode(OpusDec *d, const uint8_t *data, uint32_t size, int16_t *out, uint64_t out_cap) {
    av_packet_unref(d->pkt);
    d->pkt->data = (uint8_t *)data;
    d->pkt->size = (int)size;
    if (avcodec_send_packet(d->ctx, d->pkt) < 0) return -1;
    uint32_t step = d->rate && d->rate < 48000 ? 48000 / d->rate : 1;  // Opus rates divide 48 kHz exactly
    int total = 0;
    while (avcodec_receive_frame(d->ctx, d->frame) == 0) {
        AVFrame *f = d->frame;
        int ch = f->ch_layout.nb_channels;
        bool planar = f->format == AV_SAMPLE_FMT_FLTP;
        for (int i = 0; i + (int)step <= f->nb_samples; i += (int)step) {
            if ((uint64_t)(total + 1) * d->channels * 2 > out_cap) break;
            for (uint32_t c = 0; c < d->channels; c++) {
                int sc = (int)c < ch ? (int)c : ch - 1;
                float acc = 0;
                for (uint32_t k = 0; k < step; k++)
                    acc += planar ? ((const float *)f->data[sc])[i + k] : ((const float *)f->data[0])[(i + k) * ch + sc];
                out[total * d->channels + c] = to_s16(acc / (float)step);
            }
            total++;
        }
    }
    return total;
}

static void opus_decoder(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    OpusDec *d = s->state;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: case 4: case 6: {  // DecodeInterleaved*(in packet buffer, out PCM buffer)
        IpcBuf *in = in_buf(req, 0), *out = out_buf(req, 0);
        if (!in || !out || in->size < 8) { resp->result = 111 | (6 << 9); return; }  // (module 111 codec: bad input)
        const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)in->addr;
        uint32_t size = be32(p);
        if (8 + (uint64_t)size > in->size) { resp->result = 111 | (6 << 9); return; }
        if (req->cmd == 6 && req->data_size >= 1 && IN(uint8_t, 0)) {
            pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
            avcodec_flush_buffers(d->ctx);  // reset: a new stream
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
        }
        uint64_t t0 = plat_now_ns();
        pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
        int n = opus_decode(d, p + 8, size, (int16_t *)(uintptr_t)out->addr, out->size);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
        if (n < 0) {
            static int nlog;
            if (nlog++ < 10) LOG("[hwopus] packet of %u bytes failed to decode\n", size);
            n = 0;
        }
        OUT(uint32_t, 0) = 8 + size;
        OUT(uint32_t, 4) = (uint32_t)n;
        if (req->cmd != 0) { OUT(uint64_t, 8) = (plat_now_ns() - t0) / 1000; resp_size(resp, 16); }
        else resp_size(resp, 8);
        break;
    }
    case 1: break;  // SetContext
    default: LOG("[hwopus] IHardwareOpusDecoder cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd); resp_size(resp, 0x10);
    }
}

static void opus_decoder_close(Service *s) {
    OpusDec *d = s->state;
    if (!d) return;
    avcodec_free_context(&d->ctx);
    av_packet_free(&d->pkt);
    av_frame_free(&d->frame);
    pthread_mutex_destroy(&d->lock);
    free(d);
    s->state = NULL;
}

// What a decoder of this many channels needs on the console (any non-zero size works: the work buffer is unused).
static uint32_t work_size(uint32_t channels) { return 0x4000 + channels * 0x8000; }

SERVICE("hwopus", hwopus) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: {  // OpenHardwareOpusDecoder(params, work size, transfer memory)
        OpusDec *d = calloc(1, sizeof *d);
        d->rate = IN(uint32_t, 0);
        d->channels = IN(uint32_t, 4);
        pthread_mutex_init(&d->lock, NULL);
        if (d->channels < 1 || d->channels > 2 || !opus_open(d)) {
            LOG("[hwopus] cannot open a decoder for %u Hz, %u ch\n", d->rate, d->channels);
            free(d);
            resp->result = 111 | (1 << 9);
            return;
        }
        static int nlog;
        if (nlog++ < 8) LOG("[hwopus] decoder opened: %u Hz, %u ch\n", d->rate, d->channels);
        Service *dec = service_new("IHardwareOpusDecoder", opus_decoder, d);
        dec->on_close = opus_decoder_close;
        ipc_return_object(resp, dec);
        break;
    }
    case 1:  // GetWorkBufferSize(params)
        OUT(uint32_t, 0) = work_size(IN(uint32_t, 4));
        resp_size(resp, 4);
        break;
    default: LOG("[hwopus] IHardwareOpusDecoderManager cmd %u (not implemented)\n", req->cmd); resp_size(resp, 0x10);
    }
}
```

`runtime/services/network.c`:

```c
// Network services of a console that is offline (issue #1, from the second patch there): nifm (no internet), ssl,
// bsd:u (sockets) and ldn:u (local wireless, no network found). Before, sm handed the game a logging stub for them,
// which answers without the objects the game asks for (CreateGeneralService, CreateRequest...): the game used a null
// session and closed when opening local wireless, Mystery Gift or internet co-op. Now those screens open and wait;
// local wireless and the GO Park settings leave with B, the Mystery Gift / internet screens keep their spinner (the
// game polls RecvFrom with no timeout and no cancel there: nothing to download without Nintendo's servers).
// Command shapes as in switchbrew (nn::nifm IGeneralService / IRequest, nn::ldn, bsd).
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../hle.h"
#include "../ipc.h"

// An event the game can wait on, signalled already: nothing will ever happen, so a wait on it ends at once.
static uint32_t signalled_event(void) {
    uint32_t w, r;
    KEvent *ev = kernel_create_event_pair(&w, &r);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_klock);
    kernel_signal(ev);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_klock);
    return r;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ nifm:u
static void nifm_request(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: OUT(uint32_t, 0) = 1; resp_size(resp, 4); break;  // GetRequestState: free (done, not accepted)
    case 1: {  // GetResult: no internet connection (2110-0300); LARECOMP_NIFM_ERROR=<result> for experiments
        const char *e = getenv("LARECOMP_NIFM_ERROR");
        resp->result = e && *e ? (uint32_t)strtoul(e, NULL, 0) : MAKE_RESULT(110, 300);
        break;
    }
    case 2:  // GetSystemEventReadableHandles: two events
        resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = signalled_event();
        resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = signalled_event();
        break;
    case 4: break;  // Submit: done at once (GetRequestState)
    default: LOG("[nifm] IRequest cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
    }
}

static void nifm_general(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 1: memset(resp->data, 0, 4); resp_size(resp, 4); break;                               // GetClientId
    case 4: ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("IRequest", nifm_request, NULL)); break;      // CreateRequest
    case 18: memset(resp->data, 0, 4); resp_size(resp, 4); break;                              // GetInternetConnectionStatus
    default: LOG("[nifm] IGeneralService cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
    }
}

SERVICE("nifm:u", nifm_u) {
    (void)s;
    if (req->cmd == 5) ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("IGeneralService", nifm_general, NULL));  // CreateGeneralService
    else LOG("[nifm] nifm:u cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ ssl (no TLS)
static void ssl_context(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    LOG("[ssl] ISslContext cmd %u (ok, no TLS)\n", req->cmd);
    memset(resp->data, 0, 0x10);
    resp_size(resp, 0x10);
}

SERVICE("ssl", ssl) {
    (void)s;
    if (req->cmd == 0) ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("ISslContext", ssl_context, NULL));  // CreateContext
    else LOG("[ssl] cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ bsd:u (sockets)
// Setting up succeeds; a new socket fails with ENETDOWN (the network is down) and a receive returns one zero byte.
SERVICE("bsd:u", bsd_u) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 2:  // Socket
    case 3:  // SocketExempt
        OUT(int32_t, 0) = -1;
        OUT(int32_t, 4) = 100;  // ENETDOWN (Linux errno values, switchbrew)
        resp_size(resp, 8);
        break;
    case 9:  // RecvFrom
        OUT(int32_t, 0) = 1;
        OUT(int32_t, 4) = 0;
        resp_size(resp, 8);
        break;
    default: LOG("[bsd] bsd:u cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ ldn:u (local wireless)
typedef struct { bool init; } Ldn;

static void ldn_user(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    Ldn *u = s->state;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: OUT(uint32_t, 0) = u && u->init ? 1 : 0; resp_size(resp, 4); break;  // GetState: initialized or not
    case 100: resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = signalled_event(); break;       // GetStateChangeEvent
    case 102: OUT(uint16_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 4); break;                    // Scan: no network found
    case 400: if (u) u->init = true; break;                                        // Initialize
    case 401: if (u) u->init = false; break;                                       // Finalize
    default: LOG("[ldn] IUserLocalCommunicationService cmd %u (ok, no wireless)\n", req->cmd);
    }
}

SERVICE("ldn:u", ldn_u) {
    (void)s;
    if (req->cmd == 0) ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("IUserLocalCommunicationService", ldn_user, calloc(1, sizeof(Ldn))));
    else LOG("[ldn] ldn:u cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
}
```

```c
// Let's Go: system services for features this port runs without - Bluetooth (Poke Ball Plus, Pokemon GO link) and
// the hardware random generator. Each answers the way a console with nothing paired / nothing nearby would, and
// logs what it was asked, so a feature that needs more shows up in the log.
#include <string.h>

#include "../hle.h"
#include "../ipc.h"

static uint32_t new_event_handle(void) {
    uint32_t w, r;
    kernel_create_event_pair(&w, &r);
    return r;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ btm:u (nn::btm::user, BLE for the Poke Ball Plus)
// IBtmUserCore (switchbrew "BTM services"): the Acquire*Event commands return a bool and an event the game waits on;
// the events are never signalled (no BLE device is ever found or connected).
static void btm_user_core(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0:   // AcquireBleScanEvent
    case 17:  // AcquireBleConnectionEvent
    case 21:  // AcquireBlePairingEvent (the GO Park settings wait on it: without it they abort, issue #1)
    case 26:  // AcquireBleServiceDiscoveryEvent
    case 33:  // AcquireBleMtuConfigEvent
        OUT(uint8_t, 0) = 1;
        resp_size(resp, 4);
        resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = new_event_handle();
        break;
    default:  // (no output, like a console with nothing paired: a made-up 0x10-byte reply made the GO settings abort, #1)
        LOG("[btm] IBtmUserCore cmd %u (ok, nothing found)\n", req->cmd);
    }
}

SERVICE("btm:u", btm_u) {
    (void)s;
    if (req->cmd == 0) {  // GetCore
        ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("IBtmUserCore", btm_user_core, NULL));
        return;
    }
    LOG("[btm] btm:u cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ bt (nn::bluetooth user)
SERVICE("bt", bt) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0:  // RegisterBleEvent
        resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = new_event_handle();
        break;
    default:
        LOG("[bt] cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
        resp_size(resp, 0x10);
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ csrng (spl random bytes)
SERVICE("csrng", csrng) {
    (void)s;
    if (req->cmd == 0) {  // GenerateRandomBytes(out buffer)
        IpcBuf *b = out_buf(req, 0);
        if (b && b->size) {
            uint8_t *p = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)b->addr;
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < b->size; i += 4) {
                uint32_t v = arc4random();
                memcpy(p + i, &v, b->size - i < 4 ? b->size - i : 4);
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    LOG("[csrng] cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
}
```

`runtime/services/time.c`:

```c
// time:u / time:a / time:s
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "../hle.h"
#include "../ipc.h"

static const uint8_t clock_uuid[16] = {0x4c, 0x41, 0x52, 0x65, 0x63, 0x6f, 0x6d, 0x70, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8};

static int64_t steady_seconds(void) { return (int64_t)(rt_ticks() / 19200000ull); }
// LARECOMP_DAYS_AHEAD=<n>: the clock n days ahead (tests of daily things: the partner's hunger, daily items)
static int64_t unix_now(void) {
    static int64_t ahead = -1;
    if (ahead < 0) ahead = getenv("LARECOMP_DAYS_AHEAD") ? atoll(getenv("LARECOMP_DAYS_AHEAD")) * 86400 : 0;
    return (int64_t)time(NULL) + ahead;
}

static void write_system_context(uint8_t *p) {  // SystemClockContext (0x20)
    int64_t steady = steady_seconds();
    *(int64_t *)p = unix_now() - steady;
    *(int64_t *)(p + 8) = steady;
    memcpy(p + 0x10, clock_uuid, 16);
}

static void time_shmem_map(KSharedMem *s) {
    uint8_t *m = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)s->guest_addr;
    LOG("[time] shared memory mapped at %llx\n", (unsigned long long)s->guest_addr);
    // 0x00: LockFreeAtomicType<SteadyClockContext{u64 internal_offset, uuid}>
    *(uint32_t *)m = 0;
    *(uint64_t *)(m + 0x08) = 0;
    memcpy(m + 0x10, clock_uuid, 16);
    // 0x38 local system clock, 0x80 network system clock
    *(uint32_t *)(m + 0x38) = 0;
    write_system_context(m + 0x40);
    *(uint32_t *)(m + 0x80) = 0;
    write_system_context(m + 0x88);
    // 0xC8 automatic correction enabled
    *(uint32_t *)(m + 0xC8) = 0;
    m[0xCC] = 0;
}

static void system_clock(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: OUT(int64_t, 0) = unix_now(); resp_size(resp, 8); break;  // GetCurrentTime
    case 2: write_system_context(resp->data); resp_size(resp, 0x20); break;  // GetSystemClockContext
    default: LOG("[time] ISystemClock cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
    }
}

static void steady_clock(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0:  // GetCurrentTimePoint
        OUT(int64_t, 0) = steady_seconds();
        memcpy(resp->data + 8, clock_uuid, 16);
        resp_size(resp, 0x18);
        break;
    default: OUT(int64_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 8); LOG("[time] ISteadyClock cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd);
    }
}

static void to_calendar(int64_t t, IpcResp *resp, int utc) {
    time_t tt = (time_t)t;
    struct tm tm;
    if (utc) gmtime_r(&tt, &tm); else localtime_r(&tt, &tm);
    uint8_t *o = resp->data;
    *(uint16_t *)o = (uint16_t)(tm.tm_year + 1900);
    o[2] = (uint8_t)(tm.tm_mon + 1); o[3] = (uint8_t)tm.tm_mday;
    o[4] = (uint8_t)tm.tm_hour; o[5] = (uint8_t)tm.tm_min; o[6] = (uint8_t)tm.tm_sec;
    *(uint32_t *)(o + 8) = (uint32_t)tm.tm_wday;
    *(uint32_t *)(o + 12) = (uint32_t)tm.tm_yday;
#ifdef _WIN32  // no tm_zone / tm_gmtoff: offset = local broken-down time read back as UTC, minus now
    struct tm g;
    gmtime_r(&tt, &g);
    long gmtoff = (long)difftime(_mkgmtime(&tm), _mkgmtime(&g));
    memcpy(o + 16, utc ? "UTC" : "LCL", 4);
#else
    long gmtoff = tm.tm_gmtoff;
    memcpy(o + 16, utc ? "UTC" : tm.tm_zone, 4);
#endif
    *(uint32_t *)(o + 24) = (uint32_t)tm.tm_isdst;
    *(int32_t *)(o + 28) = utc ? 0 : (int32_t)gmtoff;
    resp_size(resp, 0x20);
}

static void timezone_service(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: memcpy(resp->data, "UTC", 4); resp_size(resp, 0x24); break;  // GetDeviceLocationName
    case 100: to_calendar(IN(int64_t, 0), resp, 1); break;  // ToCalendarTime(rule buffer)
    case 101: to_calendar(IN(int64_t, 0), resp, 0); break;  // ToCalendarTimeWithMyRule
    case 201: {  // ToPosixTimeWithMyRule -> count + buffer of posix times
        const uint8_t *in = req->data;
        struct tm tm = {0};
        tm.tm_year = *(uint16_t *)in - 1900; tm.tm_mon = in[2] - 1; tm.tm_mday = in[3];
        tm.tm_hour = in[4]; tm.tm_min = in[5]; tm.tm_sec = in[6]; tm.tm_isdst = -1;
        int64_t t = mktime(&tm);
        if (req->nc) *(int64_t *)(uintptr_t)req->c[0].addr = t;
        else if (req->nb) *(int64_t *)(uintptr_t)req->b[0].addr = t;
        OUT(uint32_t, 0) = 1;
        resp_size(resp, 4);
        break;
    }
    default: LOG("[time] ITimeZoneService cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd); resp_size(resp, 0x10);
    }
}

static uint32_t g_shmem_handle;
RT_ON_RESET(time_reset) { g_shmem_handle = 0; }

static void static_service(Service *s, IpcReq *req, IpcResp *resp) {
    (void)s;
    switch (req->cmd) {
    case 0: case 1: case 4: case 5:
        ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("ISystemClock", system_clock, NULL));
        break;
    case 2: ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("ISteadyClock", steady_clock, NULL)); break;
    case 3: ipc_return_object(resp, service_new("ITimeZoneService", timezone_service, NULL)); break;
    case 20: {  // GetSharedMemoryNativeHandle
        if (!g_shmem_handle) kernel_create_shared_memory(0x1000, time_shmem_map, &g_shmem_handle);
        resp->copy_handles[resp->ncopy++] = g_shmem_handle;
        break;
    }
    case 100: case 101: OUT(uint8_t, 0) = 0; resp_size(resp, 1); break;
    default: LOG("[time] IStaticService cmd %u (ok)\n", req->cmd); resp_size(resp, 0x10);
    }
}

SERVICE("time:u", time_u) { static_service(s, req, resp); }
SERVICE("time:a", time_a) { static_service(s, req, resp); }
SERVICE("time:s", time_s) { static_service(s, req, resp); }

// nn::time::StandardUserSystemClock::GetCurrentTime(PosixTime*): answered directly from the host clock. The SDK's
// shared-memory path aborts (svcBreak via nn::diag::Abort, result 0xcc74) if the local clock's source id ever
// differs from the steady clock's; that happened once in the room sweep on an autosave (entering Eagle's Tower) and
// could not be reproduced, so the date stamp no longer depends on it.
HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn4time23StandardUserSystemClock14GetCurrentTimeEPNS0_9PosixTimeE", time_std_user_now) {
    static int n;
    if (n++ < 3) LOG("[time] StandardUserSystemClock::GetCurrentTime (host clock)\n");
    if (c->x[0]) *(int64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0] = unix_now();
    c->x[0] = 0;  // ResultSuccess
}
```

`runtime/settings.c`:

```c
#include "settings.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "hle.h"
#include "input_bind.h"
#include "paths.h"

#define SETTINGS_FILE settings_file()

// LARECOMP_SETTINGS=<path>: another settings file (test runs never touch the player's larecomp.ini)
static const char *settings_file(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("LARECOMP_SETTINGS");
    return e && *e ? e : "larecomp.ini";
}

Settings g_settings = {
    .fullscreen = false,
    .fps = 30,
    .volume = 1.0f,
    .brightness = 1.0f,
    .contrast = 1.0f,
    .saturation = 1.0f,
    .ssao = false,
    .ssao_intensity = 2.0f,
    .ssao_radius = 100.0f,
    .ssao_temporal = true,
    .ssao_samples = 16,
    .shadow_filter = SHADOW_SMOOTH,
    .ui2x = true,
    .blur_quality = true,
    .mv_objects = true,
    .taa_sharpness = 0.5f,
    .fsr3_sharpness = 0.5f,
    .fsr3_preset = FSR3_QUALITY,
    .gi = false,
    .gi_intensity = 2.0f,
    .gi_radius = 300.0f,
    .gi_thickness = 25.0f,
    .gi_rays = 4,
    .gi_steps = 8,
    .gi_div = 2,
    .gi_temporal = true,
    .mouse_sens = 0.1f,
    .stick_deadzone = 0.15f,
    .reverb = true,
    .movie_audio = true,
    .show_fps = false,
    .render_thread = true,
    .vertex_read = VREAD_AUTO,
    .upscaler = UPSCALE_SHARP,
    .upscaler_pick = UPSCALE_SHARP,
    .antialias = AA_SMAA,  // (the game has no anti-aliasing of its own)
};

// Unknown keys (an older larecomp.ini: Link's Awakening's options from LAS Recomp) are ignored, and dropped at the
// next save.
static void parse_line(const char *line) {
    char key[64];
    char val[1100];  // (the mods list can be long)
    if (sscanf(line, " %63[^= ] = %1099[^\n]", key, val) < 1) return;
    if (!strcmp(key, "game_lang") || !strcmp(key, "mod")) {  // (may be empty)
        if (sscanf(line, " %63[^= ] = %1099[^\n]", key, val) != 2) val[0] = 0;
        if (key[0] == 'g') strlcpy(g_settings.game_lang, val, sizeof g_settings.game_lang);
        else strlcpy(g_settings.mod, val, sizeof g_settings.mod);
        return;
    }
    if (!strcmp(key, "fullscreen")) g_settings.fullscreen = atoi(val) != 0;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "fps")) g_settings.fps = atoi(val) == 120 ? 120 : atoi(val) == 60 ? 60 : 30;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "render_height")) g_settings.res_height = atoi(val) >= 360 && atoi(val) <= 4320 ? atoi(val) : 0;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "volume")) g_settings.volume = (float)atof(val);
    else if (!strcmp(key, "brightness")) g_settings.brightness = (float)atof(val);
    else if (!strcmp(key, "contrast")) g_settings.contrast = (float)atof(val);
    else if (!strcmp(key, "saturation")) g_settings.saturation = (float)atof(val);
    // (an older file's "ssao = 1" / "gi = 1" were today's high; the levels are saved after them)
    else if (!strcmp(key, "ssao")) g_settings.ssao_level = atoi(val) != 0 ? FX_HIGH : FX_OFF;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "ssao_level")) g_settings.ssao_level = atoi(val);
    else if (!strcmp(key, "gi_level")) g_settings.gi_level = atoi(val);
    else if (!strcmp(key, "mv_objects")) g_settings.mv_objects = atoi(val) != 0;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "gi")) g_settings.gi_level = atoi(val) != 0 ? FX_HIGH : FX_OFF;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "gi_debug")) g_settings.gi_debug = atoi(val) != 0;  // (by hand / tests: never saved)
    else if (!strcmp(key, "ui2x")) g_settings.ui2x = atoi(val) != 0;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "blur_quality")) g_settings.blur_quality = atoi(val) != 0;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "shadow_filter"))
        g_settings.shadow_filter = !strcmp(val, "game") ? SHADOW_GAME : !strcmp(val, "bilinear") ? SHADOW_BILINEAR : SHADOW_SMOOTH;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "ssao_debug")) g_settings.ssao_debug = atoi(val) != 0;  // (by hand / tests: never saved)
    else if (!strcmp(key, "mv_debug")) g_settings.mv_debug = atoi(val) != 0;      // (the same)
    else if (!strcmp(key, "mouse_sens")) g_settings.mouse_sens = (float)atof(val);
    else if (!strcmp(key, "stick_deadzone")) g_settings.stick_deadzone = (float)atof(val);
    else if (!strcmp(key, "reverb")) g_settings.reverb = atoi(val) != 0;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "movie_audio")) g_settings.movie_audio = atoi(val) != 0;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "show_fps")) g_settings.show_fps = atoi(val) != 0;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "resolution")) {
        int n = atoi(val);
        g_settings.res_mode = !strcmp(val, "dynamic") ? RES_DYNAMIC : (!strcmp(val, "75%") || !strcmp(val, "67%")) ? RES_Q75 :
                              !strcmp(val, "50%") ? RES_Q50 : !strcmp(val, "25%") ? RES_Q25 :
                              (n >= 1 && n <= 4) ? n : n > 4 ? 4 : RES_MATCH;
    }
    // (after "aa" in the file. An older file's "fsr3": FSR 3.1 is an anti-aliasing choice now)
    else if (!strcmp(key, "upscaler")) {
        if (!strcmp(val, "fsr3")) g_settings.antialias = AA_FSR3;
        else g_settings.upscaler_pick = !strcmp(val, "bilinear") ? UPSCALE_BILINEAR : UPSCALE_SHARP;
    }
    // (an older "antialias = off" was only LAS Recomp's default being saved: a new key, so SMAA starts on)
    else if (!strcmp(key, "smaa")) g_settings.antialias = atoi(val) != 0 ? AA_SMAA : AA_OFF;
    // (after "smaa" in the file: the choice among the three; "smaa" stays for older versions)
    else if (!strcmp(key, "aa"))
        g_settings.antialias = !strcmp(val, "fsr3") ? AA_FSR3 : !strcmp(val, "taa") ? AA_TAA : !strcmp(val, "smaa") ? AA_SMAA : AA_OFF;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "taa_sharpness")) g_settings.taa_sharpness = (float)atof(val);
    else if (!strcmp(key, "fsr3_sharpness")) g_settings.fsr3_sharpness = (float)atof(val);
    else if (!strcmp(key, "fsr3_preset"))
        g_settings.fsr3_preset = !strcmp(val, "native") ? FSR3_NATIVE_AA : !strcmp(val, "balanced") ? FSR3_BALANCED :
                                 !strcmp(val, "performance") ? FSR3_PERFORMANCE : !strcmp(val, "ultra") ? FSR3_ULTRA_PERFORMANCE : FSR3_QUALITY;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "frame_gen"))  // (1: an older on / off)
        g_settings.frame_gen = !strcmp(val, "auto") ? FG_AUTO : atoi(val) == 1 ? 2 : atoi(val);
    else if (!strcmp(key, "fg_quality")) {}  // (a setting of a test version: the in-between images are always full size)
    else if (!strcmp(key, "render_thread")) g_settings.render_thread = atoi(val) != 0;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "vertex_read")) g_settings.vertex_read = !strcmp(val, "direct") ? VREAD_DIRECT : !strcmp(val, "copy") ? VREAD_COPY : VREAD_AUTO;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "dpad_move")) g_settings.dpad_move = atoi(val) != 0;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "wild_battle")) g_settings.wild_battle = atoi(val) != 0;
    else if (!strcmp(key, "skip_controller")) g_settings.skip_controller = atoi(val) != 0;
    else bind_settings_load(key, val);  // bind_pad_* / bind_key_*: runtime/hle/bindings.c
}

float settings_fsr3_ratio(void) {
    static const float r[] = {1.0f, 1.5f, 1.7f, 2.0f, 3.0f};
    return r[g_settings.fsr3_preset >= 0 && g_settings.fsr3_preset <= 4 ? g_settings.fsr3_preset : 1];
}

static float clampf_(float v, float lo, float hi) { return v != v ? 1 : v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v; }
void settings_clamp_color(void) {
    g_settings.brightness = clampf_(g_settings.brightness, 0.5f, 1.5f);
    g_settings.contrast = clampf_(g_settings.contrast, 0.5f, 1.5f);
    g_settings.saturation = clampf_(g_settings.saturation, 0.0f, 2.0f);
    if (g_settings.shadow_filter < SHADOW_GAME || g_settings.shadow_filter > SHADOW_SMOOTH) g_settings.shadow_filter = SHADOW_SMOOTH;
    g_settings.taa_sharpness = g_settings.taa_sharpness != g_settings.taa_sharpness ? 0.5f : clampf_(g_settings.taa_sharpness, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    g_settings.fsr3_sharpness = g_settings.fsr3_sharpness != g_settings.fsr3_sharpness ? 0.5f : clampf_(g_settings.fsr3_sharpness, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    settings_apply_levels();
}

// SSAO and GI by level (F12 menu). High: the parameters they had before the levels (SSAO 16 samples; GI 4 rays x 8
// steps at half the scene's size). Medium and low keep the look (strength, reach, accumulation over frames) with less
// work: SSAO 12 / 8 samples (the accumulation evens out the noise); GI 3 rays x 6 steps at half the size, 2 x 6 at a
// third (about 1/2 and 1/6 of high's). The upscaler: FSR 3.1 when it is the anti-aliasing, else bilinear (FSR 1 stays
// only as FSR 3.1's fallback without its DLL: exec.c post_process).
void settings_apply_levels(void) {
    int s = g_settings.ssao_level < FX_OFF || g_settings.ssao_level > FX_ULTRA ? FX_OFF : g_settings.ssao_level;
    int g = g_settings.gi_level < FX_OFF || g_settings.gi_level > FX_HIGH ? FX_OFF : g_settings.gi_level;
    g_settings.ssao_level = s, g_settings.gi_level = g;
    static const int ssao_samples[] = {16, 8, 12, 16, 16};
    g_settings.ssao = s != FX_OFF;
    // Ultra: high plus the contact shadows (8 steps, strength 0.375: ~half the GPU time of 16 steps at 0.5)
    g_settings.contact_on = s == FX_ULTRA;
    g_settings.contact_steps = 8;
    g_settings.contact_strength = 0.375f;
    g_settings.ssao_samples = ssao_samples[s];
    g_settings.ssao_intensity = 2.0f, g_settings.ssao_radius = 100.0f, g_settings.ssao_temporal = true;
    static const int gi_rays[] = {4, 2, 3, 4}, gi_steps[] = {8, 6, 6, 8}, gi_div[] = {2, 3, 2, 2};
    g_settings.gi = g != FX_OFF;
    g_settings.gi_rays = gi_rays[g], g_settings.gi_steps = gi_steps[g], g_settings.gi_div = gi_div[g];
    g_settings.gi_intensity = 2.0f, g_settings.gi_radius = 300.0f, g_settings.gi_thickness = 25.0f, g_settings.gi_temporal = true;
    if (g_settings.antialias < AA_OFF || g_settings.antialias > AA_FSR3) g_settings.antialias = AA_SMAA;
    g_settings.upscaler_pick = UPSCALE_BILINEAR;
    g_settings.upscaler = g_settings.antialias == AA_FSR3 ? UPSCALE_FSR3 : UPSCALE_BILINEAR;
    if (g_settings.frame_gen != FG_AUTO && (g_settings.frame_gen < 2 || g_settings.frame_gen > 4)) g_settings.frame_gen = 0;
}

// One larecomp.ini line applied now, then the settings that follow from it (LARECOMP_SET_AT: runtime/nvn/vulkan/device.c)
void settings_set_line(const char *line) {
    parse_line(line);
    settings_apply_levels();
}

void settings_load(void) {
    static bool loaded;
    if (loaded) return;
    loaded = true;
    FILE *f = fopen(SETTINGS_FILE, "r");
    if (!f) { settings_apply_levels(); return; }
    char line[1200];  // (the mods list can be long)
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        // (a file edited by hand may have CRLF: "resolution = dynamic\r" did not match and fell back silently)
        for (size_t n = strlen(line); n && (line[n - 1] == '\n' || line[n - 1] == '\r' || line[n - 1] == ' '); n--) line[n - 1] = 0;
        // (0.3.1 saved some settings without their line break - "fullscreen = 0fps = 60render_height = 1440": a key
        // glued to the previous value is split off again, so a file written then keeps its settings)
        const char *p = line;
        for (;;) {
            const char *eq = strstr(p, " = "), *next = eq ? strstr(eq + 3, " = ") : NULL, *k = next;
            while (k && k > eq + 3 && ((k[-1] >= 'a' && k[-1] <= 'z') || k[-1] == '_')) k--;
            if (!next || k == next || k <= eq + 3) { parse_line(p); break; }
            char part[256];
            snprintf(part, sizeof part, "%.*s", (int)(k - p), p);
            parse_line(part);
            p = k;
        }
    }
    fclose(f);
    if (g_settings.volume < 0) g_settings.volume = 0;
    if (g_settings.volume > 2) g_settings.volume = 2;
    settings_clamp_color();
    LOG("[settings] loaded %s\n", SETTINGS_FILE);
}

void settings_save(void) {
    FILE *f = fopen(SETTINGS_FILE, "w");
    if (!f) { LOG("[settings] cannot write %s\n", SETTINGS_FILE); return; }
    fprintf(f, "# " RT_APP_NAME " settings (set on the start screen)\n");
    fprintf(f, "fullscreen = %d\n", g_settings.fullscreen);
    fprintf(f, "fps = %d\n", g_settings.fps);
    fprintf(f, "render_height = %d\n", g_settings.res_height);
    fprintf(f, "smaa = %d\n", g_settings.antialias != AA_OFF);
    fprintf(f, "aa = %s\n", g_settings.antialias == AA_FSR3 ? "fsr3" : g_settings.antialias == AA_TAA ? "taa" :
                            g_settings.antialias == AA_SMAA ? "smaa" : "off");
    fprintf(f, "upscaler = bilinear\n");  // (FSR 3.1: "aa"; for older versions)
    fprintf(f, "taa_sharpness = %.2f\n", g_settings.taa_sharpness);
    fprintf(f, "fsr3_sharpness = %.2f\n", g_settings.fsr3_sharpness);
    static const char *const presets[] = {"native", "quality", "balanced", "performance", "ultra"};
    fprintf(f, "fsr3_preset = %s\n", presets[g_settings.fsr3_preset >= 0 && g_settings.fsr3_preset <= 4 ? g_settings.fsr3_preset : 1]);
    if (g_settings.frame_gen == FG_AUTO) fprintf(f, "frame_gen = auto\n");
    else fprintf(f, "frame_gen = %d\n", g_settings.frame_gen);
    fprintf(f, "mod = %s\n", g_settings.mod);
    fprintf(f, "mouse_sens = %.3f\n", g_settings.mouse_sens);
    fprintf(f, "stick_deadzone = %.2f\n", g_settings.stick_deadzone);
    fprintf(f, "volume = %.2f\n", g_settings.volume);
    fprintf(f, "brightness = %.2f\n", g_settings.brightness);
    fprintf(f, "contrast = %.2f\n", g_settings.contrast);
    fprintf(f, "saturation = %.2f\n", g_settings.saturation);
    fprintf(f, "ssao_level = %d\n", g_settings.ssao_level);
    fprintf(f, "gi_level = %d\n", g_settings.gi_level);
    fprintf(f, "mv_objects = %d\n", g_settings.mv_objects);
    fprintf(f, "ui2x = %d\n", g_settings.ui2x);
    fprintf(f, "blur_quality = %d\n", g_settings.blur_quality);
    fprintf(f, "shadow_filter = %s\n", g_settings.shadow_filter == SHADOW_GAME ? "game" :
                                       g_settings.shadow_filter == SHADOW_BILINEAR ? "bilinear" : "smooth");
    fprintf(f, "reverb = %d\n", g_settings.reverb);
    fprintf(f, "movie_audio = %d\n", g_settings.movie_audio);
    fprintf(f, "show_fps = %d\n", g_settings.show_fps);
    if (g_settings.res_mode == RES_DYNAMIC) fprintf(f, "resolution = dynamic\n");
    else if (g_settings.res_mode == RES_Q75) fprintf(f, "resolution = 75%%\n");
    else if (g_settings.res_mode == RES_Q25) fprintf(f, "resolution = 25%%\n");
    else if (g_settings.res_mode == RES_Q50) fprintf(f, "resolution = 50%%\n");
    else if (g_settings.res_mode >= 1 && g_settings.res_mode <= 8) fprintf(f, "resolution = %dx\n", g_settings.res_mode);
    else fprintf(f, "resolution = match\n");
    fprintf(f, "render_thread = %d\n", g_settings.render_thread);
    fprintf(f, "vertex_read = %s\n", g_settings.vertex_read == VREAD_DIRECT ? "direct" : g_settings.vertex_read == VREAD_COPY ? "copy" : "auto");
    fprintf(f, "dpad_move = %d\n", g_settings.dpad_move);
    fprintf(f, "wild_battle = %d\n", g_settings.wild_battle);
    fprintf(f, "skip_controller = %d\n", g_settings.skip_controller);
    fprintf(f, "game_lang = %s\n", g_settings.game_lang);
    bind_settings_save(f);
    fclose(f);
}
```

`runtime/settings.h`:

```h
// User settings (larecomp.ini in the data folder), set on the start screen (runtime/ui/launcher_lg.mm).
#pragma once
// frame_gen = auto ("auto" in larecomp.ini): the most images per world frame that the display's refresh shows evenly
// and the GPU keeps up with (runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c ip_images)
#define FG_AUTO 1
#include <stdbool.h>

enum { RES_MATCH = 0, /* 1..8 = 1x..8x */ RES_DYNAMIC = 9, RES_Q75 = 10, RES_Q25 = 11, RES_Q50 = 12 };
// (11 was 67% of the display: larecomp.ini "67%" now loads as RES_Q75)
// FSR 3.1: temporal (AMD FidelityFX, runtime/nvn/vulkan/fsr3.c), FSR 1 when its DLL is missing
enum { UPSCALE_BILINEAR = 0, UPSCALE_FSR1 = 2 /* AMD FSR 1 */, UPSCALE_FSR3 = 3 };
// FSR 3.1's presets (AMD's ratios, each axis): the render resolution is the window's divided by it
enum { FSR3_NATIVE_AA = 0, FSR3_QUALITY = 1, FSR3_BALANCED = 2, FSR3_PERFORMANCE = 3, FSR3_ULTRA_PERFORMANCE = 4 };
float settings_fsr3_ratio(void);  // 1.0, 1.5, 1.7, 2.0, 3.0
#define UPSCALE_SHARP UPSCALE_FSR1  // the non-bilinear upscaler (the default)
// TAA: temporal, on the game's HDR scene before its bloom (runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c taa_run), jittered draws
// FSR 3.1 is the fourth choice: it anti-aliases and upscales; with the others a lower internal resolution reaches the
// window bilinearly (the upscaler follows: settings_apply_levels)
enum { AA_OFF = 0, AA_SMAA = 1, AA_TAA = 2, AA_FSR3 = 3 };
// SSAO and GI quality (F12 menu): their parameters follow (settings_apply_levels); HIGH = the former defaults
enum { FX_OFF = 0, FX_LOW = 1, FX_MEDIUM = 2, FX_HIGH = 3, FX_ULTRA = 4 };  // (ultra: SSAO only - high plus light contact shadows)
enum { VREAD_AUTO = 0, VREAD_COPY = 1, VREAD_DIRECT = 2 };
// the game's (each of its taps a hard in / out), each tap bilinear (2x2 PCF), each tap a 3x3 tent (4 bilinear lookups)
enum { SHADOW_GAME = 0, SHADOW_BILINEAR = 1, SHADOW_SMOOTH = 2 };

typedef struct {
    bool fullscreen;
    int fps;  // 30 (the game's own), 60 or 120 (experimental): the world's rate (runtime/hle/fps60.c; F12 menu, live)
    int res_mode;        // RES_MATCH, 1..4 (N x the Switch's 1080p), RES_DYNAMIC, RES_Q75/50/25 (share of the display)
    int res_height;      // the launcher's render height in lines (720 / 1080 / 1440 / 2160); 0: res_mode decides
    int upscaler;        // UPSCALE_*: how a lower internal resolution reaches the window (FSR 3.1 with its anti-aliasing,
                         // else upscaler_pick: settings_apply_levels)
    int upscaler_pick;   // (older files' upscaler choice: read, no longer used - bilinear unless FSR 3.1)
    int antialias;       // AA_*: anti-aliasing of the game image before it is scaled to the window
    float volume;        // master volume, 1 = 100%
    float brightness;    // colour of the game image (F12 menu, runtime/ui/menu.mm; post pass in runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c):
    float contrast;      // 1 = unchanged for all three; brightness / contrast 0.5..1.5, saturation 0..2
    float saturation;
    int ssao_level;       // FX_*: SSAO quality (default off); ssao and its parameters follow it
    int gi_level;         // FX_*: GI quality (default off); gi and its parameters follow it
    bool ssao;            // screen-space ambient occlusion on the game's HDR scene (F12 menu; runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c)
    int ssao_samples;     // per pixel: 8 / 12 / 16
    float ssao_intensity; // 0..3 (default 2)
    float ssao_radius;    // in the game's world units (~cm): 10..400 (default 100)
    bool ssao_temporal;   // accumulated over frames along the camera motion vectors (exec.c ssao_run)
    bool contact_on;      // (settings_apply_levels: SSAO ultra) short rays toward the sun in the depth: small objects'
                          // shadows the shadow map misses (exec.c contact_run)
    int contact_steps;    // ... their steps along a ray (8)
    float contact_strength;  // ... and how dark (0.375)
    bool ssao_debug;      // (not saved) the scene shows the occlusion alone
    bool mv_debug;        // (not saved) the scene shows its camera motion vectors (runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c scene_hook)
    bool mv_objects;      // per-object motion vectors (characters' own motion) when motion vectors are in use (default on)
    float taa_sharpness;  // TAA: RCAS sharpening at the present, 0..1 (default 0.5)
    float fsr3_sharpness; // FSR 3.1: its RCAS sharpening (AMD's robust CAS), 0..1 (default 0.5; graphics page, under its mode)
    int fsr3_preset;      // FSR3_*: with the FSR 3.1 upscaler, the render resolution (default FSR3_QUALITY)
    int frame_gen;        // frame generation: 0 off, FG_AUTO, 2 / 3 / 4 images per world frame (exec.c frame interpolation, any GPU)
    bool blur_quality;    // the game's downsample / blur / depth-of-field composite read better (runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c fx_patch_fs)
    bool ui2x;            // the interface textures at 2x when cache/ui2x.pak was made (start screen; runtime/ui2x.c)
    int shadow_filter;    // SHADOW_*: how the shadow map is filtered (F12 menu; textures.c vk_sampler, translate.c shpcf)
    // screen-space indirect light, one bounce (F12 menu / advanced; runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c gi_run). World units ~cm
    bool gi;
    float gi_intensity;   // 0..4 (default 2): x the diffuse reflectance (0.5)
    float gi_radius;      // the rays' reach: 50..1000 (default 300)
    float gi_thickness;   // depth tolerance of a hit: 5..100 (default 25)
    int gi_rays;          // per GI pixel: 1..8 (default 4)
    int gi_steps;         // depth checks per ray: 4..32 (default 8)
    int gi_div;           // GI resolution: 2 half, 3 third, 4 quarter of each axis (default 2)
    bool gi_temporal;     // accumulated over frames along the camera motion vectors (default on)
    bool gi_debug;        // (not saved) the indirect light alone, shown at the present
    float mouse_sens;    // mouse aim (the virtual gyro, runtime/hle/input.c): degrees per pixel
    float stick_deadzone;  // a controller's sticks: the share of their travel read as rest (runtime/hle/input.c)
    bool reverb;         // room reverb effect
    bool movie_audio;
    bool show_fps;
    bool dpad_move;      // the d-pad (and arrow keys) move the player like the stick
    bool render_thread;  // the backend runs on its own thread (runtime/nvn/vulkan/renderthread.c); default on
    int vertex_read;     // VREAD_*: where the GPU reads vertex and index data (runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c)
    bool wild_battle;    // touching a wild Pokémon starts a battle, then the capture (runtime/hle/wildbattle.c)
    bool skip_controller;  // no controller screen at start: straight to the Game Freak logo (runtime/hle/controller_skip.c)
    char game_lang[8];   // the game's language code ("en-US", "es"...: runtime/mods.c game_language)
    char mod[1024];      // the active mods (mods/<name>/), '|' between them, the first one's files win; empty = none (runtime/mods.h)
} Settings;
```

`runtime/simd.h`:

```h
// Portable C lowering of AArch64 FP / AdvSIMD / crypto / CRC32 (tools/simd_c.py emits calls with constant
// fields; everything is always_inline so the size/lane/op switches fold at -O1).
// Semantics follow the ARM pseudocode, not the host: NaN propagation (first signalling NaN quietened, then
// first quiet NaN), FPCR.DN default NaN, FPCR.FZ flushing (inputs and pre-rounding-tiny results), FPCR.RMode
// for arithmetic / conversions / FRINTX/I, saturating FP->int conversions, fused multiply-add, ARM estimate
// tables. Not modelled: FPSR cumulative exception bits and QC, FPCR trap enables, FP16 arithmetic (ARMv8.2).
// FPCR.AHP is honoured by the half-precision conversions. Host assumptions: IEEE binary32/64, MXCSR (or the
// host FPU) in round-to-nearest with denormals enabled; fma must be correctly rounded (build x86 with -mfma).
#pragma once
#include <fenv.h>
#include <math.h>

#include "cpu.h"

typedef __uint128_t u128;
#define SI static inline __attribute__((always_inline))
#define SN static __attribute__((noinline))
#define SIMD_CAT2(a, b) a##_##b
#define SIMD_CAT(a, b) SIMD_CAT2(a, b)

#define SIMD_VT(name, T) typedef T name __attribute__((vector_size(16), may_alias));
SIMD_VT(vu8, uint8_t) SIMD_VT(vs8, int8_t) SIMD_VT(vu16, uint16_t) SIMD_VT(vs16, int16_t)
SIMD_VT(vu32, uint32_t) SIMD_VT(vs32, int32_t) SIMD_VT(vu64, uint64_t) SIMD_VT(vs64, int64_t)
SIMD_VT(vf32, float) SIMD_VT(vf64, double)
typedef uint16_t __attribute__((may_alias)) sa16;
typedef uint32_t __attribute__((may_alias)) sa32;
typedef uint64_t __attribute__((may_alias)) sa64;
typedef float __attribute__((may_alias)) saf32;
typedef double __attribute__((may_alias)) saf64;
typedef u128 __attribute__((aligned(1), may_alias)) u128u;

// ---- registers: VREG = whole V register as a vector type; VQ = source with the upper half cleared when
// Q=0; VW = write, zeroing the upper half when Q=0. Scalar views of lane 0: VS8..VS64, VSF32/VSF64.
#define VREG(T, n) (*(T *)&c->v[n])
#define VQ(T, Q, n) ((T)((Q) ? c->v[n] : (u128)(uint64_t)c->v[n]))
#define VW(T, Q, d, e) do { T _w = (e); c->v[d] = (Q) ? (u128)_w : (u128)(uint64_t)(u128)_w; } while (0)
#define VS8(n) (*(uint8_t *)&c->v[n])
#define VS16(n) (*(sa16 *)&c->v[n])
#define VS32(n) (*(sa32 *)&c->v[n])
#define VS64(n) (*(sa64 *)&c->v[n])
#define VSF32(n) (*(saf32 *)&c->v[n])
#define VSF64(n) (*(saf64 *)&c->v[n])
#define VHI64(n) (((sa64 *)&c->v[n])[1])
#define LD128(a) (*(const u128u *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define ST128(a, v) (*(u128u *)(uintptr_t)(a) = (u128)(v))
#define SHUF __builtin_shufflevector
#define CVT __builtin_convertvector

#define FPCR_AHP (1u << 26)
#define FPCR_DN (1u << 25)
#define FPCR_FZ (1u << 24)
#define FPCR_RM (3u << 22)
#define FPCR_SLOW (FPCR_FZ | FPCR_RM)

enum { FOP_ADD, FOP_SUB, FOP_MUL, FOP_MULX, FOP_NMUL, FOP_DIV, FOP_ABD, FOP_SQRT, FOP_MADD, FOP_RECPS, FOP_RSQRTS,
       FOP_MAX, FOP_MIN, FOP_MAXNM, FOP_MINNM };

SI int simd_fe_mode(uint64_t fpcr) {
    static const int m[4] = {FE_TONEAREST, FE_UPWARD, FE_DOWNWARD, FE_TOWARDZERO};
    return m[(fpcr >> 22) & 3];
}

#define F s
#define T float
#define U uint32_t
#define NB 32
#define EB 8
#define MB 23
#define VT vf32
#define VTU vu32
#define VTS vs32
#define NL 4
#include "simd_fp.h"
#undef F
#undef T
#undef U

#undef EB
#undef MB
#undef VT
#undef VTU
#undef VTS
#undef NL

#define T double

#define VT vf64
#define VTU vu64
#define VTS vs64
#define NL 2

#undef F

#undef EB
```
