```mm
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the Mods tab
// The folders under mods/ that hold a romfs/ (runtime/mods.h): one active at a time, or none (the game as it is)
static const char *lang_name(const char *code) {
    static const struct { const char *code, *en, *pt; } k[] = {
        {"en-US", "English", "inglês"}, {"es", "Spanish", "espanhol"}, {"fr", "French", "francês"}, {"de", "German", "alemão"},
        {"it", "Italian", "italiano"}, {"ja", "Japanese", "japonês"}, {"ko", "Korean", "coreano"},
        {"zh-CN", "Simplified Chinese", "chinês simplificado"}, {"zh-TW", "Traditional Chinese", "chinês tradicional"}};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof k / sizeof k[0]; i++) if (!strcmp(k[i].code, code)) return T(k[i].en, k[i].pt);
    return code;
}

// The mods in their order (the active ones first, as larecomp.ini lists them: "<name>|<name>..."), and which are on
static char g_mods[MODS_MAX][128];
static bool g_mod_on[MODS_MAX];
static int g_nmods;
// Reads mods/ again: the names in `active` ('|' between them) on and first, in that order; the rest after, off
static void mods_reload(const char *active) {
    char found[MODS_MAX][128];
    int n = mods_list(found, MODS_MAX);
    bool used[MODS_MAX] = {};
    g_nmods = 0;
    char list[sizeof g_settings.mod];
    snprintf(list, sizeof list, "%s", active);
    for (char *save = NULL, *name = strtok_r(list, "|", &save); name; name = strtok_r(NULL, "|", &save))
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            if (!used[i] && !strcmp(found[i], name)) {
                used[i] = true;
                snprintf(g_mods[g_nmods], sizeof g_mods[0], "%s", found[i]);
                g_mod_on[g_nmods++] = true;
            }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (!used[i]) snprintf(g_mods[g_nmods], sizeof g_mods[0], "%s", found[i]), g_mod_on[g_nmods++] = false;
}
// The active ones, in order, as larecomp.ini keeps them
static void mods_active(char *out, size_t cap) {
    out[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nmods; i++)
        if (g_mod_on[i]) {
            if (out[0]) strncat(out, "|", cap - strlen(out) - 1);
            strncat(out, g_mods[i], cap - strlen(out) - 1);
        }
}

static void mods_section(SDL_Window *win, int inst) {
    static const SDL_DialogFileFilter filters[] = {{"Mod (.zip, .rar, .7z)", "zip;rar;7z"}};
    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0);
    ImGui::TextUnformatted(T("Mods that replace the game's files (a romfs folder, as Atmosphere's LayeredFS): translations, textures, models. "
                             "Mods of the game's code (exefs, IPS patches, cheats) don't work in this port.",
                             "Mods que trocam arquivos do jogo (uma pasta romfs, como o LayeredFS do Atmosphere): traduções, texturas, modelos. "
                             "Mods do código do jogo (exefs, patches IPS, cheats) não funcionam neste port."));
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
    ui_heading(T("Mods", "Mods"));
    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0);
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", T("Turn on the ones to use (several at once). Where two change the same file, the higher one wins: the arrows move it.",
                                "Ligue os que vão ser usados (vários ao mesmo tempo). Se dois trocam o mesmo arquivo, vale o de cima: as setas mudam a ordem."));
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
    // each mod a row: its name (cut short with "..." when long: the whole of it in the tip), an on / off switch and the
    // arrows that move it up / down at the row's right end (bare on the pill; a circle under the mouse)
    int move = -1, dir = 0;
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, 0);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_FrameBorderSize, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nmods; i++) {
        ImGui::PushID(i);
        ui_pill_row();
        ImGuiWindow *w = ImGui::GetCurrentWindow();
        ImDrawList *dl = w->DrawList;
        float h = ImGui::GetFrameHeight(), sp = ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.x, gap = sp * 0.5f, sw = h * 1.45f;
        ImVec2 p = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
        float end = w->WorkRect.Max.x - ui_inset() * 0.6f, ax = end - h * 2 - gap, sx = ax - sp - sw, nmax = sx - sp * 1.5f;
        ImVec2 ts = ImGui::CalcTextSize(g_mods[i]);
        float ty = p.y + (h - ts.y) * 0.5f;
        ImGui::RenderTextEllipsis(dl, ImVec2(p.x, ty), ImVec2(nmax, ty + ts.y), nmax, nmax, g_mods[i], NULL, &ts);
        // the switch: green with the knob at the right when on
        ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(sx, p.y));
        if (ImGui::InvisibleButton("##on", ImVec2(sw, h))) g_mod_on[i] = !g_mod_on[i];
        const char *lang = mod_language(g_mods[i]);
        char tip[320];
        if (lang) snprintf(tip, sizeof tip, g_pt ? "%s: troca os textos em %s." : "%s: replaces the %s texts.", g_mods[i], lang_name(lang));
        else snprintf(tip, sizeof tip, "%s", g_mods[i]);
        ui_tip(tip);
        float th = h * 0.62f, cy = p.y + h * 0.5f, kr = th * 0.5f - 3 * g_scale, kx = g_mod_on[i] ? sx + sw - th * 0.5f : sx + th * 0.5f;
        dl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(sx, cy - th * 0.5f), ImVec2(sx + sw, cy + th * 0.5f),
                          g_mod_on[i] ? ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_PlotHistogram) : ImGui::GetColorU32(IM_COL32(200, 208, 176, 255)), th * 0.5f);
        dl->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(kx, cy), kr, ImGui::GetColorU32(IM_COL32_WHITE));
        ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(ax, p.y));
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(i == 0);
        if (ImGui::ArrowButton("##up", ImGuiDir_Up)) move = i, dir = -1;
        ImGui::EndDisabled();
        ImGui::SameLine(0, gap);
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(i == g_nmods - 1);
        if (ImGui::ArrowButton("##down", ImGuiDir_Down)) move = i, dir = 1;
        ImGui::EndDisabled();
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    if (move >= 0) {  // (swapped with the one above / below it)
        int j = move + dir;
        char name[128];
        bool on = g_mod_on[move];
        memcpy(name, g_mods[move], sizeof name), memcpy(g_mods[move], g_mods[j], sizeof name), memcpy(g_mods[j], name, sizeof name);
        g_mod_on[move] = g_mod_on[j], g_mod_on[j] = on;
    }
    if (!g_nmods) ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", T("No mods in the mods folder yet: the game as it is.", "Nenhum mod na pasta mods ainda: o jogo original."));
    ui_group_gap();
    if (inst == MOD_INSTALL_RUNNING) ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", T("Installing the mod...", "Instalando o mod..."));
    else if (ui_button(T("Install a mod...", "Instalar mod..."))) SDL_ShowOpenFileDialog(picked_mod, NULL, win, filters, 1, NULL, false);
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ui_button(T("Open the mods folder", "Abrir a pasta de mods"))) {
        char url[1200];
        snprintf(url, sizeof url, "file:///%s", mods_dir_abs());
        for (char *c = url; *c; c++) if (*c == '\\') *c = '/';
        SDL_OpenURL(url);
    }
    if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
        ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", T("A mod copied there by hand (its folder, with a romfs inside) shows up here when you come back.",
                                  "Um mod copiado para lá à mão (a pasta dele, com uma romfs dentro) aparece aqui quando você voltar."));
    if (inst == MOD_INSTALL_FAIL_UNPACK || inst == MOD_INSTALL_FAIL_NOT_MOD)
        ImGui::TextColored(k_red, "%s", inst == MOD_INSTALL_FAIL_UNPACK ? T("Couldn't unpack that file.", "Não foi possível abrir esse arquivo.")
                                                                        : T("No mod for this game in that file (no romfs folder).",
                                                                            "Esse arquivo não tem mod para este jogo (nenhuma pasta romfs)."));
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the launcher's window
// A launcher's own window while the start screen is up: no system frame (dragged by its top strip; its own minimize and
// close buttons), taller than wide, in the middle of the screen. Play gives the game its window back: the frame, the
// size it had (1280 x 720, or LARECOMP_WINDOW) and full screen when that setting is on.
static float g_drag_h, g_buttons_w;  // (logical pixels: the strip that drags the window, the buttons at its right end)
static SDL_HitTestResult SDLCALL launcher_hit(SDL_Window *win, const SDL_Point *pt, void *) {
    int w = 0, h = 0;
    SDL_GetWindowSize(win, &w, &h);
    return pt->y < g_drag_h && pt->x < w - g_buttons_w ? SDL_HITTEST_DRAGGABLE : SDL_HITTEST_NORMAL;
}
static int g_game_w = 1280, g_game_h = 720;
static void window_as_launcher(SDL_Window *win) {
    int w, h;
    SDL_GetWindowSize(win, &w, &h);
    if (!(SDL_GetWindowFlags(win) & SDL_WINDOW_FULLSCREEN) && w > 0 && h > 0 && !getenv("LARECOMP_LAUNCHER_SHOT")) g_game_w = w, g_game_h = h;
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_WINDOW")) sscanf(getenv("LARECOMP_WINDOW"), "%dx%d", &g_game_w, &g_game_h);
    SDL_SetWindowFullscreen(win, false);
    SDL_Rect usable = {0, 0, 1920, 1040};
    SDL_GetDisplayUsableBounds(SDL_GetDisplayForWindow(win), &usable);
    int lh = usable.h * 86 / 100 < 900 ? usable.h * 86 / 100 : 900, lw = lh * 86 / 100;
    SDL_SetWindowBordered(win, false);
    SDL_SetWindowResizable(win, false);
    SDL_SetWindowSize(win, lw, lh);
    SDL_SetWindowPosition(win, SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED, SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED);
    SDL_SetWindowHitTest(win, launcher_hit, NULL);
}
static void window_as_game(SDL_Window *win) {
    SDL_SetWindowHitTest(win, NULL, NULL);
    SDL_SetWindowBordered(win, true);
    SDL_SetWindowResizable(win, true);
    SDL_SetWindowSize(win, g_game_w, g_game_h);
    SDL_SetWindowPosition(win, SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED, SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED);
    if (g_settings.fullscreen && !getenv("LARECOMP_WINDOW") && !getenv("LARECOMP_HIDDEN")) SDL_SetWindowFullscreen(win, true);
    // black at the new size until the game draws (else the launcher's last image stayed in a corner while it loads);
    // vk_frame_begin makes the swapchain again for the new size
    SDL_SyncWindow(win);
    SDL_PumpEvents();
    static const float black[4] = {0, 0, 0, 1};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        if (vk_frame_begin(black)) vk_frame_end(NULL);
}

// The project's icon (the Master Ball: icon.png beside the exe, or docs/icon), for the sidebar
extern "C" uint64_t vk_imgui_texture_rgba(const void *rgba, int w, int h);  // runtime/nvn/vulkan/imgui_glue.cpp
static ImTextureID icon_texture(void) {
    char p[1100];
    if (!rt_resource("icon.png", "docs/icon/icon_1024.png", p, sizeof p)) return 0;
    SDL_Surface *s = SDL_LoadPNG(p);
    if (!s) return 0;
    for (int size = s->w / 2; size >= 256; size /= 2) {  // (halved in steps: smooth at the size it is drawn)
        SDL_Surface *t = SDL_ScaleSurface(s, size, size, SDL_SCALEMODE_LINEAR);
        if (!t) break;
        SDL_DestroySurface(s);
        s = t;
    }
    SDL_Surface *rgba = SDL_ConvertSurface(s, SDL_PIXELFORMAT_ABGR8888);  // (R, G, B, A bytes in memory)
    SDL_DestroySurface(s);
    if (!rgba) return 0;
    ImTextureID id = (ImTextureID)vk_imgui_texture_rgba(rgba->pixels, rgba->w, rgba->h);
    SDL_DestroySurface(rgba);
    return id;
}

// A window button in the top right corner (minimize: a line, close: an X), drawn so no font is needed
static bool window_button(const char *id, bool close, float size) {
    ImVec2 p = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
    bool hit = ImGui::InvisibleButton(id, ImVec2(size, size));
    ImDrawList *dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
    if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
        dl->AddRectFilled(p, ImVec2(p.x + size, p.y + size), close ? IM_COL32(196, 43, 28, 255) : IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 150), size * 0.2f);
    ImU32 col = close && ImGui::IsItemHovered() ? IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 255) : IM_COL32(60, 62, 56, 255);
    float m = size * 0.34f, t = size * 0.06f > 1 ? size * 0.06f : 1;
    if (close) {
        dl->AddLine(ImVec2(p.x + m, p.y + m), ImVec2(p.x + size - m, p.y + size - m), col, t);
        dl->AddLine(ImVec2(p.x + size - m, p.y + m), ImVec2(p.x + m, p.y + size - m), col, t);
    } else {
        dl->AddLine(ImVec2(p.x + m, p.y + size * 0.5f), ImVec2(p.x + size - m, p.y + size * 0.5f), col, t);
    }
    return hit;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the start screen
extern "C" void launcher_lg_run(const char *root) {
    (void)root;
    ui_pick_language();
    g_pt = g_ui_lang == 1;
    ui_window_init();
    SDL_Window *win = ui_window();
    window_as_launcher(win);
    ImGuiContext *prev_ctx = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();  // (the in-game menu's, when back here after a reboot)
    ImGuiContext *ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGuiIO &io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.ConfigFlags |= ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard | ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableGamepad;
    io.IniFilename = NULL;
    UiFonts fonts = ui_load_fonts();
    ui_style();
    UiScaler scaler;
    ImGui_ImplSDL3_InitForVulkan(win);
    vk_imgui_backend_init();
    ImTextureID icon = icon_texture();

    static const char *const res_en[] = {"Automatic", "720p", "1080p", "1440p", "4K"};
    static const char *const res_pt[] = {"Automática", "720p", "1080p", "1440p", "4K"};
    static const int res_lines[] = {0, 720, 1080, 1440, 2160};
    int res = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) if (res_lines[i] == g_settings.res_height) res = i;
    bool ui2x_on = g_settings.ui2x;  // (the interface at 2x: runtime/ui2x.c)
    bool full = g_settings.fullscreen, wildb = g_settings.wild_battle, skipc = g_settings.skip_controller;
    mods_reload(g_settings.mod);  // (the folders under mods/: runtime/mods.h)
    long shot_at = getenv("LARECOMP_LAUNCHER_SHOT") ? atol(getenv("LARECOMP_LAUNCHER_SHOT")) : 0, frame = 0;
    bool autoplay = getenv("LARECOMP_LAUNCHER_AUTOPLAY") != NULL, play = false;
    const char *keys_test = getenv("LARECOMP_LAUNCHER_KEYS");
    enum { TAB_GAME, TAB_GRAPHICS, TAB_IMAGE, TAB_CONTROLS, TAB_MODS, NTABS };
    int tab = getenv("LARECOMP_LAUNCHER_TAB") ? atoi(getenv("LARECOMP_LAUNCHER_TAB")) : keys_test ? TAB_CONTROLS : TAB_GAME;
    if (keys_test && atoi(keys_test) > 0) bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_KEY, atoi(keys_test));
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_SETUP_DIR")) setup_start(getenv("LARECOMP_SETUP_DIR"));
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_MOD_INSTALL")) mod_install_start(getenv("LARECOMP_MOD_INSTALL"));
    static const float bg[4] = {0.86f, 0.93f, 0.47f, 1};  // (the F12 menu's look: ui_backdrop over it)
    const ImVec4 side_bg(1, 1, 1, 0.55f), gold(0.98f, 0.82f, 0.22f, 1), gold_hover(1.0f, 0.88f, 0.38f, 1),
        gold_text(0.23f, 0.18f, 0.03f, 1);

    while (!play) {
        menu_apply_window_requests(win);
        SDL_Event e;
        bool focus_back = false;
        while (SDL_PollEvent(&e)) {
            if (bind_capture_event(&e)) continue;  // (waiting for a new key: the press is the binding's)
            ImGui_ImplSDL3_ProcessEvent(&e);
            if (e.type == SDL_EVENT_QUIT) exit(0);
            if (e.type == SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_FOCUS_GAINED) focus_back = true;
        }
        char path[1024];
        if (take(g_pick_game, path, sizeof path)) setup_start(path);
        if (take(g_pick_mod, path, sizeof path)) mod_install_start(path);
        static int last_install;
        int inst = mod_install_state();
        if ((inst != last_install && inst == MOD_INSTALL_DONE) || focus_back) {  // a new mod (installed, or copied by hand)
            char was[sizeof g_settings.mod], want[sizeof g_settings.mod + 130];
            mods_active(was, sizeof was);
            if (inst != last_install && inst == MOD_INSTALL_DONE) snprintf(want, sizeof want, "%s%s%s", mod_install_name(), was[0] ? "|" : "", was);
            else snprintf(want, sizeof want, "%s", was);  // (a new one installed: on, and first)
            mods_reload(want);
        }
        last_install = inst;
        bool ready = !setup_running() && setup_ready();
        {   // (tests, LARECOMP_UI2X_GENERATE=1: the 2x interface images made, then exit - status 0 when done)
            static int gen = -1;
            if (gen < 0) gen = getenv("LARECOMP_UI2X_GENERATE") != NULL;
            if (gen == 1 && ready) { ui2x_generate_start(); gen = 2; }
            else if (gen == 2 && !ui2x_running()) exit(ui2x_state() == UI2X_DONE ? 0 : 1);
        }
        if (autoplay && ready && inst != MOD_INSTALL_RUNNING) play = true;
        if (!vk_frame_begin(bg)) { SDL_Delay(16); continue; }
        if (keys_test && strchr(keys_test, ':') && frame == 5) {  // "<slot>:<key name>": the key pressed for the test
            SDL_Event k = {};
            k.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN;
            k.key.scancode = SDL_GetScancodeFromName(strchr(keys_test, ':') + 1);
            k.key.down = true;
            SDL_PushEvent(&k);
        }
        ImGui_ImplVulkan_NewFrame();
        ImGui_ImplSDL3_NewFrame();
        // (the launcher is narrow: its fonts a little smaller than the F12 menu's at the same height)
        g_scale = ui_scale(scaler, io.DisplaySize.y * 0.86f);
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        float s = g_scale;
        bool known = !setup_ready() || game_build("extracted/exefs") != GAME_BUILD_OTHER;
        const char *only = T("Only with version 1.0.0 (the base game) of Eevee or Pikachu for now.",
                             "Por enquanto só na versão 1.0.0 (o jogo base) do Eevee ou do Pikachu.");
        const char *names[NTABS] = {T("Game", "Jogo"), T("Graphics", "Gráficos"), T("Image and sound", "Imagem e som"),
                                    T("Controls", "Controles"), "Mods"};
        ui_tabs_begin(&tab, NTABS);  // (L1 / R1 on a controller: the page before / after)

        ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(0, 0), ImGuiCond_Always);
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(io.DisplaySize, ImGuiCond_Always);
        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowRounding, 0);
        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(0, 0));
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_WindowBg, ImVec4(bg[0], bg[1], bg[2], 1));
        ImGui::Begin("##launcher", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
                                             ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBringToFrontOnFocus);
        ImGui::PopStyleColor();
        ImGui::PopStyleVar(2);
        ui_window_backdrop();
        float pad = 22 * s, side_w = 270 * s;
        g_drag_h = 70 * s, g_buttons_w = 120 * s;

        // ---- the sidebar: the icon and the name, the pages, Play
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ChildBg, side_bg);
        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(pad, pad));
        ImGui::BeginChild("##side", ImVec2(side_w, 0), ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding | ImGuiChildFlags_NavFlattened,
                          ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar);
        {
            {   // the icon and the name in two lines beside it, both centred on one height (Baloo's lines are tall:
                // the two are drawn closer than its line height)
                ImGui::PushFont(fonts.title);
                float fs = ImGui::GetFontSize(), step = fs * 0.78f, block = fs * 1.75f;
                ImVec2 p = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
                ImDrawList *dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
                if (icon) dl->AddImage(icon, p, ImVec2(p.x + block, p.y + block));
                float tx = p.x + block + 12 * s, ty = p.y + (block - step - fs) * 0.5f;
                dl->AddText(ImGui::GetFont(), fs, ImVec2(tx, ty), ImGui::GetColorU32(UI_GOLD), "Let's Go");
                dl->AddText(ImGui::GetFont(), fs, ImVec2(tx, ty + step), ImGui::GetColorU32(UI_GOLD), "Recomp");
                ImGui::PopFont();
                ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(side_w - pad * 2, block));
            }
            ImGui::TextDisabled("v" RT_APP_VERSION);
            ImGui::Spacing();
            // the pages: pills as tall as the rows, the current one yellow, a white one under the cursor; the names on
            // the rows' text inset
            float row_h = ImGui::GetFrameHeight(), in = ui_inset();
            for (int t = 0; t < NTABS; t++) {
                ImVec2 a = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos(), b(a.x + ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x, a.y + row_h);
                ImGui::PushID(t);
                if (ImGui::InvisibleButton("##nav", ImVec2(b.x - a.x, row_h))) tab = t;
                ImGui::PopID();
                ImDrawList *dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
                bool hot = ui_hot(a, b);
                if (tab == t || hot) ui_pill(dl, a, b, tab == t);
                ImVec2 ts = ImGui::CalcTextSize(names[t]);
                dl->AddText(ImVec2(a.x + in, a.y + (row_h - ts.y) * 0.5f), ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text), names[t]);
            }
            float play_h = 64 * s;
            ImGui::SetCursorPosY(fmaxf(ImGui::GetCursorPosY(), ImGui::GetWindowHeight() - pad - play_h));
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, gold);
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered, gold_hover);
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonActive, gold_hover);
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, gold_text);
            ImGui::PushFont(fonts.title);
            ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_FrameBorderSize, 0);
            ImGui::BeginDisabled(!ready);
            if (frame == 0 && ready) ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
            if (ImGui::Button(T("Play", "Jogar"), ImVec2(-FLT_MIN, play_h))) play = true;
            ImGui::EndDisabled();
            ImGui::PopStyleVar();
            ImGui::PopFont();
            ImGui::PopStyleColor(4);
            if (!ready && ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenDisabled))
                ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", T("Set up the game files first (Game page).", "Configure os arquivos do jogo antes (página Jogo)."));
        }
        ImGui::EndChild();
        ImGui::PopStyleVar();
        ImGui::PopStyleColor();

        // ---- the page
        ImGui::SameLine(0, 0);
        float cpad = 24 * s;  // (the content's sides: room for the cursor's arrow at the rows' left end)
        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(cpad, pad));
        ImGui::BeginChild("##content", ImVec2(0, 0), ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding | ImGuiChildFlags_NavFlattened,
                          ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar);
        {
            ui_title(fonts.title, names[tab]);
            {   // the window's buttons in its top right corner, side by side on one line (placed, not flowed after the title)
                ImVec2 back = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos(), wp = ImGui::GetWindowPos();
                float bsz = 40 * s, gap = 6 * s, x = wp.x + ImGui::GetWindowWidth() - cpad - bsz * 2 - gap, y = wp.y + pad * 0.6f;
                ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(x, y));
                if (window_button("##min", false, bsz)) SDL_MinimizeWindow(win);
                ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(x + bsz + gap, y));
                if (window_button("##close", true, bsz)) exit(0);
                ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(back);
            }
            ImGui::SetCursorPosY(ImGui::GetCursorPosY() + 16 * s - ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.y);  // (16 px to the page)
            ui_page_begin("##page", ImVec2(0, 0));
            if (tab == TAB_GAME) {
                game_files_section(win);
                ui_heading(T("Options", "Opções"));
                // A / B and X / Y by the layout's positions (runtime/hle/bindings.c bind_set_layout)
                const char *ol[] = {T("Wild battles (experimental)", "Batalhas selvagens (experimental)"),
                                    T("Skip controller selection", "Pular a escolha do controle"), T("Controller layout", "Layout do controle")};
                float ox = ui_label_x(ol, 3);
                ImGui::BeginDisabled(!known);
                ui_toggle("##wild", ol[0], ox, &wildb);
                ui_tip(!known ? only : T("Touching a wild Pokémon starts a classic battle, then the capture, instead of going straight to the capture.",
                                         "Encostar num Pokémon selvagem começa uma batalha clássica e, depois, a captura, em vez de ir direto para a captura."));
                ui_toggle("##skipc", ol[1], ox, &skipc);
                ui_tip(!known ? only : T("The game starts at the Game Freak logo, with your controller already chosen, instead of asking for a button press first.",
                                         "O jogo começa no logo da Game Freak, com o seu controle já escolhido, em vez de pedir antes que se aperte um botão."));
                ImGui::EndDisabled();
                const char *lay[] = {"Nintendo", "Xbox"};
                int lv = bind_layout();
                ui_row(ol[2], ox);
                if (ui_combo("##padlayout", &lv, lay, 2)) bind_set_layout(lv);
                ui_tip(T("Which controller buttons are A / B and X / Y. Nintendo: A right, B bottom. Xbox: A bottom, B right, as the letters on an Xbox controller. The button prompts follow.",
                         "Quais botões do controle são A / B e X / Y. Nintendo: A à direita, B embaixo. Xbox: A embaixo, B à direita, como as letras de um controle de Xbox. Os ícones dos botões acompanham."));
            } else if (tab == TAB_GRAPHICS) {
                const char *extra[] = {T("Resolution", "Resolução"), T("Fullscreen", "Tela cheia")};
                float x = ui_graphics_x(extra, 2);
                ui_row(extra[0], x);
                ui_combo("##res", &res, g_pt ? res_pt : res_en, 5);
                ui_toggle("##full", extra[1], x, &full);
                ui_tip(T("When the game starts.", "Ao começar o jogo."));
                ui_group_gap();
                ui_page_graphics(x, known);
                ui2x_section(ready, &ui2x_on);
            } else if (tab == TAB_IMAGE) {
                ui_page_image_sound();
            } else if (tab == TAB_CONTROLS) {
                keys_section();
            } else {
                mods_section(win, inst);
            }
            ui_page_end();
        }
        ImGui::EndChild();
        ImGui::PopStyleVar();
        ImGui::End();

        ui_frame_end();
        ImGui::Render();
        ImGui_ImplVulkan_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), (VkCommandBuffer)vk_frame_cmd());
        bool shot = shot_at && ++frame == shot_at;
        if (!shot_at) frame++;
        vk_frame_end(shot ? (getenv("LARECOMP_SHOT_PATH") ? getenv("LARECOMP_SHOT_PATH") : "build/launcher.png") : NULL);
        if (shot) exit(0);
    }
    g_settings.res_height = res_lines[res];
    g_settings.fullscreen = full;
    settings_apply_levels();  // (the upscaler follows the anti-aliasing)
    g_settings.wild_battle = wildb;
    g_settings.skip_controller = skipc;
    g_settings.ui2x = ui2x_on;
    mods_active(g_settings.mod, sizeof g_settings.mod);
    settings_save();
    vk_imgui_backend_shutdown();
    ImGui_ImplSDL3_Shutdown();
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev_ctx);
    window_as_game(win);
}
```

```h
// In-game overlay (Dear ImGui): the "close the game?" question (Esc, F1, or Minus+Plus on a controller), the F12
// settings (volume, brightness, contrast, saturation), the name
```

`runtime/ui/menu.mm`:

```mm
// In-game overlay (Dear ImGui on the Vulkan renderer; input fed from SDL events): the "close the game?" question
// (Esc, F1 or Minus + Plus on a controller), the F12 settings (tabs: graphics, image and sound, advanced - the same
// pages as the start screen's, runtime/ui/settings_ui.mm), the name entry the game asks for (runtime/hle/swkbd.c), the
// FPS counter and the controller's finger on the touch screen (runtime/hle/input.c).
// LARECOMP_MENU_KEY=<SDL scancode name> ("F10", "Insert"...): another key for the F12 settings (Steam takes F12 for
// screenshots by default).
//
// Threads: SDL events arrive on the main thread and are queued; the overlay is laid out and drawn on the render
// thread inside backend_present, after the game image, into the same window image.
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <float.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <atomic>
#include <vector>

#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_internal.h"
#include "imgui_impl_vulkan.h"
#include "osk.h"
#include "settings_ui.h"
extern "C" bool vk_imgui_backend_init(void);  // runtime/nvn/vulkan/imgui_glue.cpp

extern "C" {
#include "../hle.h"
#include "../input_bind.h"
#include "../settings.h"
#include "menu.h"
#include "../paths.h"
void input_reset(void);
uint64_t rt_addr(uint64_t eevee);  // runtime/fnhook.c (0: a build without the tables the frame rate modes need)
bool input_finger_cursor(float *x, float *y, bool *down);  // runtime/hle/input.c
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ language
// English, Portuguese or Russian (issue #1), from the system's language (runtime/ui/settings_ui.h)
#define M UI_T

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ state shared with the main thread
static std::atomic<bool> g_open{false};  // the "close the game?" question is up
static std::atomic<bool> g_cfg{false};   // the F12 settings are up
static int g_cfg_tab;                    // the F12 settings' tab: graphics, image and sound, advanced (render thread)
static std::atomic<bool> g_want_fullscreen_apply{false};

struct QEvent {
    enum { KEY, ANALOG, MOUSE_POS, MOUSE_BUTTON, WHEEL, TEXT } kind;
    ImGuiKey key;
    bool down;
    float value, x, y;
    int button;
    char text[32];
};
static pthread_mutex_t q_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static std::vector<QEvent> q_events;
static float g_pixel_density = 1;

static void push(const QEvent &e) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&q_lock);
    q_events.push_back(e);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&q_lock);
}

bool menu_is_open(void) { return g_open.load(); }
static void set_open(bool open) {
    if (open == g_open.load()) return;
    g_open.store(open);
    input_reset();  // nothing held while the question had focus leaks into the game
    if (!open) settings_save();
}
static void set_cfg(bool open) {
    if (open == g_cfg.load()) return;
    if (open) set_open(false);
    g_cfg.store(open);
    input_reset();
    if (!open) settings_save();
}
// (LARECOMP_MENU_AT: runtime/nvn/vulkan/device.c; LARECOMP_MENU_PAGE=cfg / adv / <tab number>: the F12 settings on that
// tab instead - cfg the first, adv the advanced one)
extern "C" void menu_test_open(void) {
    const char *pg = getenv("LARECOMP_MENU_PAGE");
    if (!pg) { set_open(true); return; }
    g_cfg_tab = !strcmp(pg, "adv") ? 2 : atoi(pg);
    set_cfg(true);
}

static ImGuiKey key_from_scancode(SDL_Scancode sc) {
    switch (sc) {
    case SDL_SCANCODE_UP: return ImGuiKey_UpArrow;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN: return ImGuiKey_DownArrow;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_LEFT: return ImGuiKey_LeftArrow;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_RIGHT: return ImGuiKey_RightArrow;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_RETURN: return ImGuiKey_Enter;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_KP_ENTER: return ImGuiKey_KeypadEnter;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE: return ImGuiKey_Space;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_TAB: return ImGuiKey_Tab;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_BACKSPACE: return ImGuiKey_Backspace;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_DELETE: return ImGuiKey_Delete;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_HOME: return ImGuiKey_Home;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_END: return ImGuiKey_End;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_LSHIFT: return ImGuiKey_LeftShift;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_RSHIFT: return ImGuiKey_RightShift;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_LCTRL: return ImGuiKey_LeftCtrl;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_RCTRL: return ImGuiKey_RightCtrl;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_A: return ImGuiKey_A;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_C: return ImGuiKey_C;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_V: return ImGuiKey_V;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_X: return ImGuiKey_X;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_Z: return ImGuiKey_Z;
    default: return ImGuiKey_None;
    }
}

// A confirms, B goes back, as in the game: by the controller layout (runtime/hle/bindings.c) - Nintendo: A the right
// face button, B the bottom one; Xbox: A the bottom one, B the right one.
static ImGuiKey key_from_pad(Uint8 b) {
    bool xbox = bind_layout() == BIND_LAYOUT_XBOX;
    switch (b) {
    case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST: return xbox ? ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight : ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceDown;   // activate (Nintendo)
    case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH: return xbox ? ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceDown : ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight;  // cancel / back (Nintendo)
    case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH: return ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceUp;
    case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_WEST: return ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceLeft;
    case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_UP: return ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadUp;
    case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_DOWN: return ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadDown;
    case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_LEFT: return ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadLeft;
    case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_RIGHT: return ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadRight;
    case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER: return ImGuiKey_GamepadL1;
    case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT_SHOULDER: return ImGuiKey_GamepadR1;
    case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_START: return ImGuiKey_GamepadStart;
    case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_BACK: return ImGuiKey_GamepadBack;
    default: return ImGuiKey_None;
    }
}

// ---- software keyboard (runtime/hle/swkbd.c: the game's name entry) ------------------------------------------
// The game thread waits in menu_keyboard_run (re-presenting the last frame); this dialog takes the text: typed
// directly when the player last used a keyboard, an on-screen keyboard (d-pad + A, B deletes, Start / + OK) when
// they last used a controller.
static std::atomic<int> g_kbd{0};  // 1 open, 2 confirmed, 3 cancelled
static std::atomic<bool> g_last_pad{false};
static char g_kbd_text[96];
static int g_kbd_max = 8;
static bool capturing() { return g_open.load() || g_cfg.load() || g_kbd.load() == 1; }
// The game gets no input while this is true (runtime/hle/input.c): the question, the settings or the name entry is up.
extern "C" bool menu_input_captured(void) { return capturing(); }

static SDL_Scancode cfg_key(void) {
    static SDL_Scancode k = SDL_SCANCODE_UNKNOWN;
    if (k == SDL_SCANCODE_UNKNOWN) {
        const char *e = getenv("LARECOMP_MENU_KEY");
        k = e && *e ? SDL_GetScancodeFromName(e) : SDL_SCANCODE_UNKNOWN;
        if (k == SDL_SCANCODE_UNKNOWN) k = SDL_SCANCODE_F12;
    }
    return k;
}

bool menu_handle_event(const SDL_Event *e) {
    static bool back_down, start_down;
    if (e->type == SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN) g_last_pad = false;
    if (e->type == SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DOWN) g_last_pad = true;
    bool typing = g_kbd.load() == 1;  // (the name entry: keys are text, not shortcuts)
    if (typing && e->type == SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN && !e->key.repeat) {  // Enter confirms, Esc cancels
        if (e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_RETURN || e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_KP_ENTER) { g_kbd = 2; return true; }
        if (e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE) { g_kbd = 3; return true; }
    }
    if (typing && e->type == SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DOWN && e->gbutton.button == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_START) {
        g_kbd = 2;
        return true;
    }
    switch (e->type) {
    case SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN:
        if (!e->key.repeat && !typing && (e->key.scancode == cfg_key() || (e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE && g_cfg.load()))) {
            set_cfg(e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE ? false : !g_cfg.load());  // (Esc closes the settings)
            return true;
        }
        if (!e->key.repeat && (e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_F1 ||
                               (e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE && !g_open.load()))) {
            if (!typing) { set_cfg(false); set_open(!g_open.load()); }  // (Esc with the question up goes to it below: "Não")
            return true;
        }
        if (!e->key.repeat && (e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_F11 ||
                               (e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_RETURN && (e->key.mod & (SDL_KMOD_ALT | SDL_KMOD_GUI))))) {
            g_settings.fullscreen = !g_settings.fullscreen;
            g_want_fullscreen_apply.store(true);
            settings_save();
            return true;
        }
        /* fallthrough */
    case SDL_EVENT_KEY_UP: {
        if (!capturing()) return false;
        bool down = e->type == SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN;
        if (down && e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE) {
            QEvent q = {};
            q.kind = QEvent::KEY; q.key = ImGuiKey_Escape; q.down = true; push(q);
            q.down = false; push(q);
            return true;
        }
        ImGuiKey k = key_from_scancode(e->key.scancode);
        if (k != ImGuiKey_None) { QEvent q = {}; q.kind = QEvent::KEY; q.key = k; q.down = down; push(q); }
        return true;
    }
    case SDL_EVENT_TEXT_INPUT:
        if (!capturing()) return false;
        { QEvent q = {}; q.kind = QEvent::TEXT; strlcpy(q.text, e->text.text, sizeof q.text); push(q); }
        return true;
    case SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DOWN: case SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_UP: {
        bool down = e->type == SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DOWN;
        if (e->gbutton.button == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_BACK) back_down = down;
        if (e->gbutton.button == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_START) start_down = down;
        if (down && !typing && ((back_down && start_down) || e->gbutton.button == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_GUIDE)) {
            set_cfg(false);
            set_open(!g_open.load());
            return true;
        }
        if (!capturing()) return false;
        ImGuiKey k = key_from_pad(e->gbutton.button);
        if (k != ImGuiKey_None) { QEvent q = {}; q.kind = QEvent::KEY; q.key = k; q.down = down; push(q); }
        return true;
    }
    case SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_AXIS_MOTION: {
        if (!capturing()) return false;
        float v = e->gaxis.value / 32767.0f;
        QEvent q = {};
        q.kind = QEvent::ANALOG;
        switch (e->gaxis.axis) {
        case SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTX:
            q.key = ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickLeft; q.value = v < -0.3f ? -v : 0; push(q);
            q.key = ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickRight; q.value = v > 0.3f ? v : 0; push(q);
            break;
        case SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTY:
            q.key = ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickUp; q.value = v < -0.3f ? -v : 0; push(q);
            q.key = ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickDown; q.value = v > 0.3f ? v : 0; push(q);
            break;
        default: break;
        }
        return true;
    }
    case SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_MOTION:
        if (!capturing()) return false;
        { QEvent q = {}; q.kind = QEvent::MOUSE_POS; q.x = e->motion.x * g_pixel_density; q.y = e->motion.y * g_pixel_density; push(q); }
        return true;
    case SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_DOWN: case SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_UP:
        if (!capturing()) return false;
        {
            QEvent q = {};
            q.kind = QEvent::MOUSE_BUTTON;
            q.button = e->button.button == SDL_BUTTON_LEFT ? 0 : e->button.button == SDL_BUTTON_RIGHT ? 1 : 2;
            q.down = e->type == SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_DOWN;
            push(q);
        }
        return true;
    case SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_WHEEL:
        if (!capturing()) return false;
        { QEvent q = {}; q.kind = QEvent::WHEEL; q.x = e->wheel.x; q.y = e->wheel.y; push(q); }
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

void menu_apply_window_requests(void *win) {
    SDL_Window *w = (SDL_Window *)win;
    g_pixel_density = SDL_GetWindowPixelDensity(w);
    static bool text_input;
    bool want_text = capturing();
    if (want_text != text_input) {
        if (want_text) SDL_StartTextInput(w);
        else SDL_StopTextInput(w);
        text_input = want_text;
    }
    // F11 / Alt+Enter only: the setting itself is applied where the window is made (ui_window_init) and handed to the game
    // (runtime/ui/launcher_lg.mm window_as_game) - applied here on the first call too, the start screen (which calls this
    // each frame) went back to full screen right after taking its own size
    if (g_want_fullscreen_apply.exchange(false)) SDL_SetWindowFullscreen(w, g_settings.fullscreen);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ render thread
static bool g_inited;
static ImGuiContext *g_ctx;  // ours: the start screen has its own context
static ImFont *g_font, *g_font_big;  // the FPS counter and the name entry
static ImFont *g_menu_font;          // the "close the game?" question (Baloo 2, as on the start screen)

static void init(void) {
    IMGUI_CHECKVERSION();
    ui_pick_language();
    g_ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(g_ctx);
    ImGuiIO &io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.ConfigFlags |= ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard | ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableGamepad;
    io.BackendFlags |= ImGuiBackendFlags_HasGamepad;
    io.IniFilename = NULL;
    UiFonts f = ui_load_fonts();
    g_font = f.body, g_font_big = f.big, g_menu_font = f.title;
    ui_style();
    g_ui_tips_in_box = true;  // (the settings show the descriptions in their box)
    vk_imgui_backend_init();
    g_inited = true;
}

static void drain_events(ImGuiIO &io) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&q_lock);
    std::vector<QEvent> ev;
    ev.swap(q_events);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&q_lock);
    for (const QEvent &q : ev) {
        switch (q.kind) {
        case QEvent::KEY: io.AddKeyEvent(q.key, q.down); break;
        case QEvent::ANALOG: io.AddKeyAnalogEvent(q.key, q.value > 0.1f, q.value); break;
        case QEvent::MOUSE_POS: io.AddMousePosEvent(q.x, q.y); break;
        case QEvent::MOUSE_BUTTON: io.AddMouseButtonEvent(q.button, q.down); break;
        case QEvent::WHEEL: io.AddMouseWheelEvent(q.x, q.y); break;
        case QEvent::TEXT: io.AddInputCharactersUTF8(q.text); break;
        }
    }
}

// Reboot (runtime/main.c): the game is gone - the question and the name entry close; the ImGui context stays.
RT_ON_RESET(menu_reset) {
    set_open(false);
    set_cfg(false);
    g_kbd = 0;
    osk_cancel();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&q_lock);
    q_events.clear();
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&q_lock);
}

static void keyboard_draw(ImGuiIO &io, float scale) {
    ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList()->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(0, 0), io.DisplaySize, IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 120));
    float w = fminf(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.9f, 1100 * scale);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.5f, io.DisplaySize.y * 0.5f), ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(0.5f, 0.5f));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(w, 0), ImGuiCond_Always);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_WindowBg, 0);
    ImGui::Begin("##kbd", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
                                    ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    ui_window_backdrop();
    ImGui::PushFont(g_font_big);
    ImGui::TextColored(UI_TEXT, "%s", M("Enter a name", "Digite o nome", "Введите имя"));
    ImGui::PopFont();
    static bool was_open, was_pad;
    bool pad = g_last_pad.load(), appearing = !was_open || pad != was_pad;  // (switching device: focus the new one)
    was_open = true, was_pad = pad;
    if (!pad) {  // keyboard: type straight into the field
        if (appearing) ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
        ImGui::PushFont(g_font_big);
        ImGui::InputText("##name", g_kbd_text, (size_t)(g_kbd_max * 4 + 1 < (int)sizeof g_kbd_text ? g_kbd_max * 4 + 1 : sizeof g_kbd_text),
                         ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackCharFilter,
                         [](ImGuiInputTextCallbackData *d) -> int { return d->EventChar < 0x20 ? 1 : 0; });
        ImGui::PopFont();
        if ((int)strlen(g_kbd_text) > g_kbd_max) g_kbd_text[g_kbd_max] = 0;
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s      (%d / %d)", M("Enter  confirms      Esc  cancels", "Enter  confirma      Esc  cancela",
                                                   "Enter  готово      Esc  отмена"),
                            (int)strlen(g_kbd_text), g_kbd_max);
    } else {  // controller: on-screen keyboard (osk.mm)
        int r = osk_keys(g_kbd_text, sizeof g_kbd_text, g_kbd_max, appearing, scale, g_font_big);
        if (r) g_kbd = r > 0 ? 2 : 3;  // (Start / + confirms in menu_handle_event too)
    }
    ImGui::End();
    if (g_kbd.load() != 1) was_open = false;
}

// Game thread (runtime/hle/swkbd.c): show the dialog, re-present the last frame until it's answered.
// Returns 1 confirmed (out = text, UTF-8), 0 cancelled.
extern "C" int menu_keyboard_run(const char *initial, int max_len, char *out, int cap) {
    extern void backend_represent(void);
    snprintf(g_kbd_text, sizeof g_kbd_text, "%s", initial ? initial : "");
    g_kbd_max = max_len > 0 && max_len < (int)sizeof g_kbd_text / 4 ? max_len : 8;
    input_reset();
    g_kbd = 1;
    // (test) LARECOMP_KBD_AUTO=<text>: answer at once
    if (getenv("LARECOMP_KBD_AUTO")) { snprintf(g_kbd_text, sizeof g_kbd_text, "%s", getenv("LARECOMP_KBD_AUTO")); g_kbd = 2; }
    while (g_kbd.load() == 1 && !g_rt_unwind) {  // ~60 Hz (a reboot cancels)
        uint64_t t0 = SDL_GetTicks();
        backend_represent();
        uint64_t dt = SDL_GetTicks() - t0;
        if (dt < 16) SDL_Delay((uint32_t)(16 - dt));
    }
    bool ok = g_kbd.load() == 2 && g_kbd_text[0];
    if (ok) snprintf(out, cap, "%s", g_kbd_text);
    g_kbd = 0;
    input_reset();
    return ok;
}

// "Close the game?" - Não has the focus first (Enter / A by reflex keeps playing); B / Esc answer Não.
static void quit_draw(ImGuiIO &io, float scale) {
    ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList()->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(0, 0), io.DisplaySize, IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 110));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.5f, io.DisplaySize.y * 0.5f), ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(0.5f, 0.5f));
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_WindowBg, 0);
    ImGui::Begin("##quit", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
                                     ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    ui_window_backdrop();
    ui_title(g_menu_font, M("Close the game?", "Deseja fechar o jogo?", "Закрыть игру?"));
    const char *lost = M("Progress since the last save will be lost.", "O progresso desde o último save será perdido.",
                         "Прогресс после последнего сохранения будет потерян.");
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", lost);
    ImGui::Spacing();
    // the two answers side by side, Settings under them: together as wide as the text (at least 2 x 240 px)
    float sp = ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.x, w = fmaxf(ImGui::CalcTextSize(lost).x, 480 * scale + sp), bw = (w - sp) / 2;
    static bool focus_no;
    if (!focus_no) { ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere(1); focus_no = true; }
    if (ImGui::Button(M("Yes", "Sim", "Да"), ImVec2(bw, 0))) {
        settings_save();
        SDL_Event q = {};
        q.type = SDL_EVENT_QUIT;
        SDL_PushEvent(&q);
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    bool no = ImGui::Button(M("No", "Não", "Нет"), ImVec2(bw, 0));
    if (ImGui::Button(M("Settings (F12)", "Configurações (F12)", "Настройки (F12)"), ImVec2(w, 0))) {
        focus_no = false;
        set_cfg(true);  // (closes the question: the way in from a controller)
    } else if (no || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, false)) {
        set_open(false);
        focus_no = false;
    }
    ImGui::End();
}

// A button prompt as in the game's bottom strip: the button (a coloured circle with its letter, or a key's name on a
// pill) then what it does, from x on the line centred at y. Returns its width; draw = false only measures it.
static float prompt(ImDrawList *dl, float x, float y, const char *key, ImU32 col, const char *text, bool draw) {
    float h = ImGui::GetFrameHeight() * 0.78f, gap = h * 0.25f;
    ImVec2 ks = ImGui::CalcTextSize(key), ts = ImGui::CalcTextSize(text);
    float kw = strlen(key) == 1 ? h : ks.x + h * 0.7f;
    if (draw) {
        ImVec2 a(x, y - h * 0.5f), b(x + kw, y + h * 0.5f);
        dl->AddRectFilled(a, b, col, h * 0.5f);
        dl->AddRect(a, b, IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 255), h * 0.5f, 0, h * 0.07f);
        dl->AddText(ImVec2(x + (kw - ks.x) * 0.5f, y - ks.y * 0.5f), IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 255), key);
        dl->AddText(ImVec2(x + kw + gap, y - ts.y * 0.5f), ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text), text);
    }
    return kw + gap + ts.x;
}

// The description box: the text of the setting under the cursor (ui_tip), else the page's, on the rows' text column
// with as much room above it as at its left; at the text's size unless it is longer than the box (smaller then)
static void description(ImDrawList *dl, ImVec2 a, ImVec2 b, float pad_y, const char *text) {
    ui_info_box(dl, a, b);
    float in = ui_inset(), ww = b.x - a.x - in * 2, hh = b.y - a.y - pad_y * 2;
    ImFont *font = ImGui::GetFont();
    float size = ImGui::GetFontSize();
    for (float f = 1.0f; f >= 0.6f; f -= 0.05f) {
        size = ImGui::GetFontSize() * f;
        if (font->CalcTextSizeA(size, FLT_MAX, ww, text).y <= hh) break;
    }
    dl->AddText(font, size, ImVec2(a.x + in, a.y + pad_y), ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text), text, NULL, ww);
}

// F12: the settings, applied live (runtime/ui/settings_ui.mm: the start screen's pages); saved to larecomp.ini on closing.
// B / Esc / F12 close; L / R on a controller change the tab. The look of the game's Options screen: the title and the
// tabs, the description box, the settings as pills, the button prompts on a white strip at the bottom.
static void cfg_draw(ImGuiIO &io, float scale) {
    ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList()->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(0, 0), io.DisplaySize, IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 70));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.5f, io.DisplaySize.y * 0.5f), ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(0.5f, 0.5f));
    // one size for every tab (a page taller than it scrolls; pad navigation follows)
    float ww = fminf(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.92f, 1120 * scale), wh = fminf(io.DisplaySize.y * 0.92f, 900 * scale);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(ww, wh), ImGuiCond_Always);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_WindowBg, 0);
    ImGui::Begin("##cfg", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse |
                                    ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar);
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    ui_window_backdrop();
    const ImGuiStyle &st = ImGui::GetStyle();
    ImDrawList *dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
    ImVec2 wp = ImGui::GetWindowPos(), ws = ImGui::GetWindowSize();
    float fh = ImGui::GetFrameHeight();
    bool popup = ImGui::IsPopupOpen((const char *)NULL, ImGuiPopupFlags_AnyPopupId);

    // the title, and the tabs at its right as pills between L and R (a click picks one too)
    ui_title(g_menu_font, M("Settings", "Configurações", "Настройки"));
    ImVec2 t0 = ImGui::GetItemRectMin(), t1 = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
    if (!popup) ui_tabs_begin(&g_cfg_tab, 3);
    {
        const char *names[] = {M("Graphics", "Gráficos", "Графика"), M("Image and sound", "Imagem e som", "Изображение и звук"),
                               M("Advanced", "Avançado", "Дополнительно")};
        float pad = fh * 0.55f, gap = st.ItemSpacing.x, chip = fh * 0.95f, w[3], total = chip * 2 + gap * 4;
        for (int t = 0; t < 3; t++) total += w[t] = ImGui::CalcTextSize(names[t]).x + pad * 2;
        float x = wp.x + ws.x - st.WindowPadding.x - total, y = (t0.y + t1.y) * 0.5f;
        auto shoulder = [&](float cx, const char *k) {  // L / R: a dark rounded chip
            ImVec2 a(cx, y - fh * 0.36f), b(cx + chip, y + fh * 0.36f), ks = ImGui::CalcTextSize(k);
            dl->AddRectFilled(a, b, IM_COL32(70, 76, 66, 255), fh * 0.2f);
            dl->AddText(ImVec2(cx + (chip - ks.x) * 0.5f, y - ks.y * 0.5f), IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 255), k);
        };
        shoulder(x, "L");
        x += chip + gap;
        ImGui::PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav, true);
        for (int t = 0; t < 3; t++) {
            ImVec2 a(x, y - fh * 0.5f), b(x + w[t], y + fh * 0.5f);
            ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(a);
            ImGui::PushID(t);
            if (ImGui::InvisibleButton("##tab", ImVec2(w[t], fh))) g_cfg_tab = t;
            ImGui::PopID();
            bool sel = g_cfg_tab == t;
            ui_pill(dl, a, b, sel);
            if (!sel && ImGui::IsItemHovered()) dl->AddRect(a, b, ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Border), fh * 0.5f, 0, 2.5f * scale);
            ImVec2 ts = ImGui::CalcTextSize(names[t]);
            dl->AddText(ImVec2(a.x + (w[t] - ts.x) * 0.5f, y - ts.y * 0.5f), ImGui::GetColorU32(sel ? ImGuiCol_Text : ImGuiCol_TextDisabled), names[t]);
            x += w[t] + gap;
        }
        ImGui::PopItemFlag();
        shoulder(x, "R");  // (the row ends on the box's right edge)
        ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(t0.x, fmaxf(t1.y, y + fh * 0.5f) + 16 * scale));
    }

    // the description box: two lines of text
    {
        float pad_y = ui_inset() * 0.75f;
        ImVec2 a = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos(), b(wp.x + ws.x - st.WindowPadding.x, a.y + ImGui::GetTextLineHeight() * 2 + pad_y * 2);
        const char *d = ui_tip_last();
        description(dl, a, b, pad_y, d ? d : M("Changes apply at once and are saved when this menu closes. Left / right change the highlighted setting.",
                                        "As mudanças valem na hora e são salvas ao fechar este menu. Esquerda / direita mudam a opção destacada.",
                                        "Изменения применяются сразу и сохраняются при закрытии меню. Влево / вправо — изменить выбранный параметр."));
        ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y + 16 * scale - st.ItemSpacing.y));  // (16 px to the page, as above the box)
    }

    // the page, above the strip at the bottom: as wide as the box (the cursor's arrow in the window's margin)
    float strip = fh * 1.45f, page_h = wp.y + ws.y - strip - st.ItemSpacing.y - ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos().y;
    bool known = rt_addr(0x70002f8bb0ull) != 0;
    ImGui::PushID(g_cfg_tab);  // (each page its own scroll)
    ui_page_begin("##page", ImVec2(0, page_h));
    static int shown = -1;  // (another page: the cursor on its first setting)
    if (shown != g_cfg_tab && shown >= 0 && GImGui->NavCursorVisible) ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
    shown = g_cfg_tab;
    if (g_cfg_tab == 0) ui_page_graphics(ui_graphics_x(NULL, 0), known);
    else if (g_cfg_tab == 1) ui_page_image_sound();
    else ui_page_advanced();
    ui_page_end();
    ImGui::PopID();

    // the strip: L / R change the tab, B closes (Esc / F12 on a keyboard); a click on Close closes too
    bool close = !popup && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, false);
    {
        ImVec2 a(wp.x, wp.y + ws.y - strip), b(wp.x + ws.x, wp.y + ws.y);
        dl->AddRectFilled(a, b, IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 245), st.WindowRounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottom);
        float y = (a.y + b.y) * 0.5f, x = b.x - st.WindowPadding.x, sp = fh * 0.7f;
        bool pad = g_last_pad.load();
        const char *l_close = M("Close", "Fechar", "Закрыть"), *l_tab = M("Tabs", "Abas", "Вкладки");
        char k_close[48];
        snprintf(k_close, sizeof k_close, pad ? "B" : "Esc / %s", SDL_GetScancodeName(cfg_key()));
        ImU32 orange = IM_COL32(240, 160, 36, 255), grey = IM_COL32(70, 76, 66, 255);
        float wc = prompt(dl, 0, 0, k_close, orange, l_close, false);
        x -= wc;
        prompt(dl, x, y, k_close, pad ? orange : grey, l_close, true);
        ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(x, y - fh * 0.5f));
        ImGui::PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav, true);
        if (ImGui::InvisibleButton("##close", ImVec2(wc, fh))) close = true;
        ImGui::PopItemFlag();
        if (pad) {  // (L R  Tabs)
            float wl = prompt(dl, 0, 0, "L", grey, "", false), wt = wl + prompt(dl, 0, 0, "R", grey, l_tab, false);
            x -= sp + wt;
            prompt(dl, x, y, "L", grey, "", true);
            prompt(dl, x + wl, y, "R", grey, l_tab, true);
        }
    }
    ImGui::End();
    if (close) set_cfg(false);
}

void menu_render(void *cmd, uint32_t target_w, uint32_t target_h) {
    bool open = g_open.load(), cfg = g_cfg.load(), kbd = g_kbd.load() == 1;
    float fx, fy;
    bool fdown, finger = !open && !cfg && input_finger_cursor(&fx, &fy, &fdown);
    if (!open && !cfg && !kbd && !g_settings.show_fps && !finger) {
        if (g_inited) { pthread_mutex_lock(&q_lock); q_events.clear(); pthread_mutex_unlock(&q_lock); }
        return;
    }
    if (!g_inited) init();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(g_ctx);
    ImGuiIO &io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2((float)target_w, (float)target_h);
    io.DisplayFramebufferScale = ImVec2(1, 1);
    static double last;
    double now = SDL_GetTicks() / 1000.0;
    io.DeltaTime = last > 0 && now > last ? (float)(now - last) : 1.0f / 60;
    last = now;
    drain_events(io);
    // fonts are built for a ~1080 px tall output; scale to the window (spacing / rounding too)
    static UiScaler scaler;
    float scale = ui_scale(scaler, (float)target_h);
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_NewFrame();
    ImGui::NewFrame();

    if (g_settings.show_fps) {
        ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(io.DisplaySize.x - 16 * scale, 16 * scale), 0, ImVec2(1, 0));
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_WindowBg, ImVec4(0, 0, 0, 0.5f));  // (dark: over the game, not the menus' look)
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImVec4(1, 1, 1, 1));
        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowRounding, 10 * scale);
        ImGui::Begin("##fps", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize |
                                        ImGuiWindowFlags_NoInputs | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNav | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoFocusOnAppearing);
        ImGui::Text("%.0f fps", io.Framerate);
        ImGui::End();
        ImGui::PopStyleVar();
        ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
    }
    if (finger) {  // the controller's finger on the touch screen (right stick moves it, ZR touches)
        ImDrawList *dl = ImGui::GetForegroundDrawList();
        float r = 26 * scale;
        dl->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(fx, fy), r, fdown ? IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 170) : IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 60));
        dl->AddCircle(ImVec2(fx, fy), r, IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 235), 0, 4 * scale);
    }
    if (open) quit_draw(io, scale);
    else if (cfg && !kbd) cfg_draw(io, scale);
    if (kbd) keyboard_draw(io, scale);
    ui_frame_end();
    ImGui::Render();
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), (VkCommandBuffer)cmd);  // inside the window image's rendering
}
```

```h
// On-screen keyboard (ImGui) for controllers, shared by the game's name entry (runtime/ui/menu.mm keyboard_draw,
// runtime/hle/swkbd.c) and every text field in our menus (in-game overlay, start screen): ui_input_text.
#pragma once
#include <stddef.h>
#include "imgui.h"

// A text field. Activated with a controller (A on it) it opens the on-screen keyboard and the confirmed text goes
// back into buf; with a mouse / keyboard it's typed into directly. Returns true when the text changed (typed, or OK
// on the on-screen keyboard; with ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue: Enter / OK). title heads the keyboard.
bool ui_input_text(const char *label, char *buf, size_t size, ImGuiInputTextFlags flags = 0, const char *hint = NULL,
                   const char *title = NULL);
// true (once) after the on-screen keyboard of the field just drawn with ui_input_text was cancelled
bool ui_input_text_cancelled(void);

// Once per frame, after the rest of the UI, at the root (outside any window), in the context the field was drawn in.
void osk_draw(ImFont *big, float scale);
bool osk_is_open(void);
void osk_cancel(void);  // (menu closed / reboot: drop it, the field keeps its text)

// Something is being typed in the current context: a text field has keyboard focus or the on-screen keyboard is up.
// Menu shortcuts (back, tabs, close) must not fire then: the keys are text.
bool ui_text_busy(void);

// The typed text (big font) and the key grid, drawn into the current window: d-pad / stick move, A types, B deletes,
// Start / + OK; typed keys work too (Enter OK, Esc cancel). text: ASCII, at most max_chars. Returns 1 OK, -1 cancel,
// 0 still typing.
int osk_keys(char *text, size_t cap, int max_chars, bool appearing, float scale, ImFont *big, bool upper_first = true);
```

`runtime/ui/osk.mm`:

```mm
// On-screen keyboard (see osk.h). A controller has no keys to type with, and ImGui only starts text entry on a
// gamepad's Y (A on a field did nothing): A on any of our text fields opens this keyboard instead.
//
// One keyboard at a time (only one ImGui UI runs: start screen or in-game overlay, one thread each). It is a modal
// popup at the root of the UI, so the menu behind sees "a popup is open" and B / Esc / L / R don't act on it.
#include <ctype.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <atomic>
#include <string>

#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_internal.h"
#include "osk.h"
#include "settings_ui.h"

static struct {
    int open;                        // a field's keyboard is up
    ImGuiID field;                   // the field it types for
    char *buf;                       // ... and its buffer (static in every caller: written on OK)
    size_t size;
    ImGuiInputTextFlags flags;
    char text[128], title[96];
    bool appearing, nav_kbd_off;
    ImGuiID done_field;              // answered: reported by that field's next ui_input_text
    int done, done_frame;            // 1 OK, -1 cancelled; when (a field gone by then never hears of it)
} s;
static std::atomic<bool> s_cancel_req{false};
static bool s_cancelled_now;

bool osk_is_open(void) { return s.open != 0; }
void osk_cancel(void) { s_cancel_req = true; }

bool ui_text_busy(void) {
    ImGuiContext *g = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    return s.open || (g && (g->IO.WantTextInput || g->WantTextInputNextFrame == 1));
}

bool ui_input_text_cancelled(void) { return s_cancelled_now; }

// (test) LARECOMP_FIELD_FOCUS=<label>:<n>[:edit]: the n-th time field <label> is drawn it gets the nav cursor (a
// controller's A - LARECOMP_HOST_INPUT sdlpad:east - then opens the keyboard); :edit starts typing in it instead.
static int test_focus(const char *label) {
    static const char *spec = getenv("LARECOMP_FIELD_FOCUS");
    static int count;
    if (!spec) return 0;
    const char *c = strchr(spec, ':');
    if (!c || strncmp(spec, label, (size_t)(c - spec)) || label[c - spec]) return 0;
    if (++count != atoi(c + 1)) return 0;
    return strstr(c + 1, ":edit") ? 2 : 1;
}

bool ui_input_text(const char *label, char *buf, size_t size, ImGuiInputTextFlags flags, const char *hint, const char *title) {
    ImGuiContext &g = *GImGui;
    int test = test_focus(label);
    if (test == 2) ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
    bool r = hint ? ImGui::InputTextWithHint(label, hint, buf, size, flags) : ImGui::InputText(label, buf, size, flags);
    ImGuiID id = ImGui::GetItemID();
    if (test == 1) { ImGui::FocusItem(); ImGui::SetNavCursorVisible(true); }
    // (and in view for the screenshots for a few frames: the focus' own scroll misses on a NavFlattened page)
    static ImGuiID in_view_id;
    static int in_view;
    if (test) in_view_id = id, in_view = 10;
    if (in_view_id == id && in_view > 0 && in_view--) ImGui::SetScrollHereY(0.5f);
    if (test) fprintf(stderr, "[osk] test: %s field %s\n", test == 2 ? "typing in" : "cursor on", label);
    static std::string last;  // (test runs: what the field holds, as it changes)
    const char *tf = getenv("LARECOMP_FIELD_FOCUS");
    if (tf && !strncmp(tf, label, strlen(label)) && tf[strlen(label)] == ':' && last != buf) { last = buf; fprintf(stderr, "[osk] test: %s = \"%s\"%s\n", label, buf, g.ActiveId == id ? " (typing)" : ""); }
    s_cancelled_now = false;
    if (s.done && s.done_field == id && ImGui::GetFrameCount() - s.done_frame <= 1) {
        if (s.done > 0) r = true;
        else s_cancelled_now = true;
        s.done = 0, s.done_field = 0;
    }
    // activated from the controller: A (ImGui's "activate", which leaves a text field alone), Y (its "input"), or a
    // focus request (SetKeyboardFocusHere) while the controller drives the menu. A mouse click types directly.
    bool by_nav = g.NavActivateId == id || (ImGui::IsItemActivated() && g.ActiveIdSource != ImGuiInputSource_Mouse);
    if (by_nav && g.NavInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad && !s.open && !(flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly)) {
        if (g.ActiveId == id) ImGui::ClearActiveID();
        s.open = 1, s.appearing = true, s.done = 0;
        s.field = id, s.buf = buf, s.size = size, s.flags = flags;
        snprintf(s.text, sizeof s.text, "%s", buf);
        snprintf(s.title, sizeof s.title, "%s", title ? title : hint ? hint : "Enter text");
        r = false;
    }
    return r;
}

int osk_keys(char *text, size_t cap, int max_chars, bool appearing, float scale, ImFont *big, bool upper_first) {
    static bool upper = true;
    if (appearing) upper = upper_first;
    ImGuiIO &io = ImGui::GetIO();
    // B deletes: owning it keeps ImGui's nav cancel (which drops the cursor off the keys) from seeing it
    ImGuiID own = ImGui::GetID("##oskkeys");
    ImGui::SetKeyOwner(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, own);
    if (max_chars <= 0 || max_chars > (int)cap - 1) max_chars = (int)cap - 1;
    int len = (int)strlen(text), r = 0;
    auto add = [&](char ch) { if (len < max_chars) text[len++] = ch, text[len] = 0; };
    auto del = [&]() { if (len > 0) text[--len] = 0; };

    // typed on a keyboard while it's up: straight into the text
    for (ImWchar c : io.InputQueueCharacters) if (c >= 0x20 && c < 0x7f) add((char)c);
    io.InputQueueCharacters.resize(0);
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Backspace)) del();
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Enter, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_KeypadEnter, false)) r = 1;
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, false)) r = -1;
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadStart, false)) r = 1;
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat, own)) del();

    ImGui::PushFont(big);
    ImGui::Text("%s_", text);
    ImGui::PopFont();
    static const char *rows_u[] = {"ABCDEFGHIJ", "KLMNOPQRST", "UVWXYZ-.'!", "0123456789"};
    static const char *rows_l[] = {"abcdefghij", "klmnopqrst", "uvwxyz-.'!", "0123456789"};
    const char **rows = upper ? rows_u : rows_l;
    float k = 70 * scale;
    for (int row = 0; row < 4; row++) {
        for (int i = 0; rows[row][i]; i++) {
            if (i) ImGui::SameLine();
            char lbl[8] = {rows[row][i], 0};
            if (appearing && row == 0 && i == 0) {  // (cursor shown: else the first A only reveals it)
                ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
                ImGui::SetNavCursorVisible(true);
            }
            if (ImGui::Button(lbl, ImVec2(k, k))) add(rows[row][i]);
        }
    }
    if (ImGui::Button(upper ? "abc" : "ABC", ImVec2(k * 2, k))) upper = !upper;
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Space", ImVec2(k * 3, k)) && len > 0) add(' ');
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Delete", ImVec2(k * 2, k))) del();
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Cancel", ImVec2(k * 2, k))) r = -1;
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("OK", ImVec2(k * 2, k))) r = 1;
    ImGui::TextDisabled("A  type      B  delete      Start / +  OK      (%d / %d)", len, max_chars);
    return r;
}

// close it (and give the keyboard back to ImGui's navigation)
static void finish(int result) {
    if (result > 0 && s.buf && s.size) {
        if (s.flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsUppercase)
            for (char *p = s.text; *p; p++) *p = (char)toupper((unsigned char)*p);
        snprintf(s.buf, s.size, "%s", s.text);
    }
    s.done = result, s.done_field = s.field, s.done_frame = ImGui::GetFrameCount();
    s.open = 0, s.buf = NULL;
    if (s.nav_kbd_off) ImGui::GetIO().ConfigFlags |= ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard;
    s.nav_kbd_off = false;
}

void osk_draw(ImFont *big, float scale) {
    bool cancel = s_cancel_req.exchange(false);
    if (!s.open) return;
    ImGuiIO &io = ImGui::GetIO();
    ImGuiContext &g = *GImGui;
    if (!ImGui::IsPopupOpen("##osk")) {
        ImGui::OpenPopup("##osk");
        s.appearing = true;
        // keys typed while it's up are text: Space / Enter / arrows must not also press the focused key
        if (io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard) { io.ConfigFlags &= ~ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard; s.nav_kbd_off = true; }
    }
    g.WantTextInputNextFrame = 1;  // (typing stays on: the backends keep text input enabled; ui_text_busy)
    float w = fminf(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.9f, 1100 * scale);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.5f, io.DisplaySize.y * 0.5f), ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(0.5f, 0.5f));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(w, 0), ImGuiCond_Always);
    if (!ImGui::BeginPopupModal("##osk", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove |
                                                   ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings | ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize)) {
        finish(-1);
        return;
    }
    ImGui::PushFont(big);
    ImGui::TextColored(UI_TEXT, "%s", s.title);
    ImGui::PopFont();
    int max = (int)(s.size < sizeof s.text ? s.size : sizeof s.text) - 1;
    int r = cancel ? -1 : osk_keys(s.text, sizeof s.text, max, s.appearing, scale, big);
    s.appearing = false;
    if (r) {
        ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
        finish(r);
    }
    ImGui::EndPopup();
}
```

`runtime/ui/settings_ui.h`:

```h
// The look and the settings pages shared by the start screen (runtime/ui/launcher_lg.mm) and the F12 menu
// (runtime/ui/menu.mm), so both look and work alike: the same colours and fonts, and the same rows for the graphics,
// the image and sound, and the advanced settings. Each screen has its own Dear ImGui context; these act on the
// current one. The pages edit g_settings directly (in game they apply at once); the caller saves them.
#pragma once
#include "imgui.h"

// The language: 0 English, 1 Portuguese, 2 Russian (LARECOMP_LANG=en|pt|ru, else the system's)
extern int g_ui_lang;
void ui_pick_language(void);
#define UI_T(en, pt, ru) (g_ui_lang == 2 ? (ru) : g_ui_lang == 1 ? (pt) : (en))

// Fonts into the current context's atlas, built for a 1080 px tall window (ui_scale scales them): Segoe UI Semibold for
// the text (Latin-1 and Cyrillic) at 34 px, a bigger one, and Baloo 2 for titles at 50 (no Cyrillic: Segoe UI for Russian).
struct UiFonts { ImFont *body, *big, *title; };
UiFonts ui_load_fonts(void);
// The look of the game's own menus (its Options screen): dark text on white pills over a lime background with gears,
// the setting under the cursor yellow with a bobbing arrow beside it. ui_style: the colours, rounding and spacing (for
// 1080 px).
void ui_style(void);

struct UiScaler { ImGuiStyle base; float scale = -1; };
float ui_scale(UiScaler &s, float window_h);

extern const ImVec4 UI_GOLD, UI_GREEN_TEXT, UI_RED_TEXT, UI_TEXT, UI_HEADING;

// after its Begin, with ImGuiCol_WindowBg transparent)

// and spanning the page from its left edge to its right one; their text inset by ui_inset from the pill's left end, and
// the page's other text (headings, notes) on that same column. Rows 12 px apart, groups 24 (ui_group_gap). The
// cursor's arrow overlaps a pill's left end and hangs out by about half a frame: keep that much margin outside a page.

float ui_label_x(const char *const *labels, int n);
```

`runtime/ui/settings_ui.mm`:

```mm
// The look and the settings pages shared by the start screen and the F12 menu (runtime/ui/settings_ui.h).
#define IMGUI_DEFINE_MATH_OPERATORS
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "settings_ui.h"
#include "imgui_internal.h"

extern "C" {
#include "../paths.h"
#include "../settings.h"
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ language
int g_ui_lang;
void ui_pick_language(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("LARECOMP_LANG"), *lang = e && *e ? e : "";
    SDL_Locale **l = NULL;
    int n = 0;
    if (!*lang && (l = SDL_GetPreferredLocales(&n)) && n > 0 && l[0]->language) lang = l[0]->language;
    g_ui_lang = !strncmp(lang, "pt", 2) ? 1 : !strncmp(lang, "ru", 2) ? 2 : 0;
    SDL_free(l);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ look
// After the game's own menus (its Options screen): a lime background with big pale gears, slow diagonal stripes and
// halftone dots; each setting a white pill with dark text, the one under the cursor yellow with a bobbing arrow at its
// left and < > around its value; a description box with a rainbow frame. All of it drawn here from shapes and
// gradients: nothing of the game's.
const ImVec4 UI_GOLD(0.85f, 0.47f, 0.04f, 1), UI_GREEN_TEXT(0.12f, 0.50f, 0.16f, 1), UI_RED_TEXT(0.80f, 0.16f, 0.12f, 1),
    UI_TEXT(0.23f, 0.23f, 0.22f, 1), UI_HEADING(0.26f, 0.42f, 0.07f, 1);

UiFonts ui_load_fonts(void) {
    ImGuiIO &io = ImGui::GetIO();
    ImFontConfig cfg;
    cfg.OversampleH = 2;
    static const ImWchar ranges[] = {0x20, 0xFF, 0x400, 0x45F, 0};  // (Latin-1: Portuguese accents; Cyrillic)
    UiFonts f = {};
    // (Segoe UI Semibold first: dark text on light pills, as the game's)
    const char *paths[] = {"C:/Windows/Fonts/seguisb.ttf", "C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeui.ttf", "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf",
                           "/usr/share/fonts/TTF/DejaVuSans.ttf", "/usr/share/fonts/dejavu-sans-fonts/DejaVuSans.ttf"};
    for (const char *p : paths) {
        if (FILE *fp = fopen(p, "rb")) fclose(fp);  // (a missing file is an assertion in ImGui, not a NULL return)
        else continue;
        f.body = io.Fonts->AddFontFromFileTTF(p, 34, &cfg, ranges);
        f.big = io.Fonts->AddFontFromFileTTF(p, 56, &cfg, ranges);
        break;
    }
    char baloo[1024];
    if (rt_resource("Baloo2-SemiBold.ttf", "third_party/fonts/Baloo2/Baloo2-SemiBold.ttf", baloo, sizeof baloo))
        f.title = io.Fonts->AddFontFromFileTTF(baloo, 50, &cfg, ranges);
    if (!f.body) f.body = io.Fonts->AddFontDefault();
    if (!f.big) f.big = f.body;
    if (!f.title || g_ui_lang == 2) f.title = f.body;
    return f;
}
```
